༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa sku 'phreng bcu drug pa tshun rim par byon pa'i rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs/mdzad pa po/7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa sku 'phreng bcu drug pa tshun rim par byon pa'i rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs/

mdzad pa po/ 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che sogs/wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang*/ ༄༅/ /dpal rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa tshun rim byon rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs/ mdzad pa po/ 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che sogs/ zhu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ dge slong tshe ring*/zhu dag pa/ bstan 'dzin shes rab/dpe sgrig pa/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/phyi lo 2008 lo'i zla 7 par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/phyi lo 2008 lo'i zla 8 par ldi lir par thengs dang po rgyab/par thengs dang por deb grangs 1000 par btab/wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang*/ Vajra Vidya Institute LibraryKhajuhee P.O. Sarnath, Varanasi, U.P., India 221007 Phone: 00-91-542-2595744, 2595747, 2595748 Fax: 00-91-542-2595746 Email: vajravidya@yahoo.com ༄༅/ /7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gi rang rnam mdor bsdus bzhugs so// nga rang phyi lo 1933 lor seng ze grong*/ rgya nag ma ṇi dang nye ba'i yul ra'u nang*/ de la yang phu mda' grong tsho gnyis yod pa'i ra'u mdar/ grong ming gnyer gzhes tshang zhes/ sngon rgya nag rtogs ldan byang chub 'phags dbyangs kyis rgya nag ma ṇi gsar bzhengs dang*/ lha rdzong nas rdo gter bzhes pa'i skabs su/ gnyer gzhes nas sbyin bdag zhus te/ mdzo mo gzi 'dra ba zhig phul zhes rnam thar nang gsal ba'i mi tshang gi rigs brgyud las/ pha ming kun dga' don grub dang*/ ma ming skal bzang dbang mo zhes pa'i bur skyes/ rang lo lnga nas rgyal dbang karma pa rig pa'i rdo rje mchog dang*/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po gnyis nas ngos 'dzin brtag yig gnang nas khra 'gu sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang*/ de rjes skyabs rje khra legs rin po ches karma dbang phyug ces pa slob dpon du bskos nas/ 'bri klog nas bzung*/ dag sum snyan ngag sogs rig gnas spyi dang*/ dgon gyi chos spyod blo 'dzin/

cho ga phyag len bcas bslab sbyangs dang*/ de rjes rang lo bcu drug la zhe chen mkhan po blo gros rab gsal zhes pa dgon par gdan drangs nas/ bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs nang sdod pa'i go skabs byung ste/ khong gi drung nas/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod/ tshad ma bcas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang*/ rgyud bla ma sogs byams chos skor bcas la thos bsam dang*/ skyabs rje khra legs rin po che dang*/ zur sprul rin po che rnam pa gnyis las/ rang lugs cho ga'i dbang lung khrid gsum sogs zhu ba'i skal bzang thob/ rang lo nyer drug la dbus su phyin nas/ rgyal dbang karma pa sogs skyes chen dam pa mang po dang lhan du rgya gar phyogs phyin/ sbag sa chos sgar du/ gdan sa chen po gsum dang*/ chos lugs bzhi'i dge 'dun rnams smon lam chen mo 'tshogs skabs/ grwa skor byas pas lha rams dge bshes kyi ming rtags gnang*/ de rjes dpal rgyal dbang karma pa mchog nas rum bteg gdan sa gsar bzhengs gnang skabs/ bka' brgyud mkhan chen gyi mtshan gnas su bsko bzhag gnang nas/ bla sprul dge 'dun rnams la dpe cha bshad khrid kyi zhabs zhu byas/ rgyal dbang mchog gi zhabs drung nas dbang lung zab khrid dpag med bka' drin thob/ rgyal dbang mchog zhi bar gshegs pa'i skabs/ kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar de nyid gsar bsgrigs dang*/ spar bskrun zhus pa lags/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/dkar chag ka sngon brjod/kha gzhung dngos/mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che'i rang rnam mdor bsdus/ vii karma pa sku phreng dang po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar/ 1 karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa/ karma pak+ṣi'i rnam thar/ 25 karma pa sku phreng gsum pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 53 karma pa sku phreng bzhi pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 75 karma pa sku phreng lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar/ 99 karma pa sku phreng drug pa/ mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar/ 115 karma pa sku phreng bdun pa/

chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/ 121 karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 143 karma pa sku phreng dgu pa/ dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 159 karma pa sku phreng bcu pa/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 165 karma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 187 karma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa/ byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 193 karma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 199 karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa/ theg mchog rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 217 karma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa/ mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 237 karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa/ rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 321 ga lhan thabs/karma pa sku phreng dang po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 391 karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa/ karma pak+ṣi'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 395 karma pa sku phreng gsum pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 397 karma pa sku phreng bzhi pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 409 karma pa sku phreng lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 410 karma pa sku phreng drug pa/ mthong ba don ldan gyi gsung 'bum dkar chag 411 karma pa sku phreng bdun pa/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 413 karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 415 karma pa sku phreng dgu pa/ dbang phyug rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 438 karma pa sku phreng bcu pa/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 443 karma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 444 karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa/ theg mchog rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 448 karma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa/ mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gsung 'bum dkar chag 449 par skrun gsal bshad/ ༄༅/ /da lam bdag cag rnams kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gis phyogs bsgrigs mdzad gnang ba'i dpal rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa sku 'phreng bcu drug pa tshun rim par byon pa'i rnam thar 'di ni sngar phyi lo 1994

lor dpe gzugs su par bskrun zhus te ris med dgon sde kun la chos sbyin du bstsal bar mdzad de rdzogs zin nye bar brten/ da lan slar yang deb gzugs su deb grangs 1000 tham pa par skrun zhus skabs/ hong kong khra 'gu chos tshogs kyi shes ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa karma zla ba lags nas sngar yang 'di ga dpe mdzod khang gi dpe deb du ma zhig dang*/ 7skyabs rje rin po che mchog gi gsung deb mang po zhig gi 'gro gron sbyin bdag gnang ba ma zad/ 'di lor yang gong gsal par skrun gyi sbyin bdag cha tshang gnang ba la 'di ga wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas/ wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang nas dge slong tshe ring pas spyi lo 2008 zla 7 tshes 5 la/༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa sku 'phreng bcu drug pa tshun rim par byon pa'i rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /chos rje karma pa sku 'phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dpag bsam khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ gu ru rat+na karma ka ye/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgon po/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun la brtse bas gzigs pa/ ngan song thams cad las skyob pa/ chos mnyam pa nyid rtogs par byed pa/ lam bde ba dang mi bde ba ston pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas 'doms pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer gyi lam ston pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas su bskyal ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa/ dus gsum gyi shes bya'i rgya mtsho ston pa/ 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa/ dkar po'i chos thams cad 'phel bar byed pa/

dug gsum gyi nad gso ba'i sman pa chen po/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i ded dpon dam pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i zla ba/ shes bya'i mun pa 'joms pa'i nyi ma/ phan bde ma lus pa sgrub pa'i bshes gnyen dam par gyur pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtshos ngo bo/ yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs rje/ gangs can mgon po phyag na pad dkar 'chang dngos dpal ldan karma pa chen po'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ chos dbyings mnyam pa chen por bla ma chos sku srid zhi'i khyab bdag spros mtshan bral//'og min gnas mchog lhun gyi grub par longs sku zhi khro'i sgyu 'phrul 'byams su klas//mkha' mnyam 'jig rten kun tu bzo skye mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad phrin bsam mi khyab//mi mjed zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang karma pa der 'dud// gang zhig bgrang yas bskal pa'i sngon//bla med bdud rtsi brnyes gyur kyang*//mtha' med 'khor ba'i chu gter las//'gro ba sgrol phyir phrin las kyi// 'jug pa mi zad 'khor lo'i tshul//nam yang brtul ba srid min pas//slar yang grangs med bskal mang gi/lam rnams mi mnyam brtson 'grus kyis/ bzlums te thar mchog brnyes pa'i tshul//yang yang ston mdzad bdag cag gi/ston pa mtshungs med karma pa//zhes grags bla ma'i rnam thar ni// dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la//rnam pa kun ldan gzugs sku'i 'byor ba rdzogs//phrin las khyab dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid kyis//'khor ba ji srid 'gro ba sgrol ba ste// theg pa sna tshogs tshul gyis thabs chen pos//mtha' dag theg pa chen por rab drangs nas//mthar thug theg pa gcig gis lam bgrod de//yongs grub 'chi med rtag sku stsol bar mdzad//

gang gi ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang*//ma lus zhing kun spro zhing bsdu ba sogs//thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes spyod yul las//bdag lta so skyes shes pa'i gnas ma yin// thun mongs byis pa'i blo yul du//'char rung rnam thar rgya mtsho las//chu yi thigs pa'i cha shas tsam///rang dang rang 'dra'i skye bo rnams// dad pa'i bag chags gso phyir 'bri//bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs//'di mthong thos pa'i 'gro ba rnams//thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol// de yang bdag sogs 'gro ba yongs kyi ston pa dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi spyi gzugs dpal ldan bla ma 7karma pa zhes mtshan gyi rnga chen 'khor 'das kyi zhing khams ris su ma chad par yongs su grags shing*/ de nyid thos pa tsam gyi 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'di ni/ rgyu'i theg pas 'dul ba'i gdul bya dag gi ngor ni/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ bar du bskal pa grangs med du mar tshogs bsags shing rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi pha rol son te/ mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bcom ste/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes bla na med pa mngon du mdzad pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pas 'dul ba'i gdul bya'i ngor ni/ phyi rol mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs la ma ltos par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs su gdod nas grub pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pas 'gyur ba mtha' dag 'gyur med gcig tu sdom pa'i 'pho med tshul khrims kyi tshogs gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs gsum gyi stobs bla na med par bskyed pas sgrib gsum mtha' dag bcom ste/ rtsa thams cad sgrib bral gyi dbu ma mchog tu dag /rlung thams cad 'gro 'ong bral ba'i nā da chen por zhugs/

kun da thams cad 'pho 'dzag bral ba'i spros bral mi shigs pa'i thig le chen por thim nas/ kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas su zin mod kyang*/ lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las gang la gang 'dul gyi 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa ji snyed ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na las 'phags chen rnams kyis kyang spyod yul ma yin pas so skyes lta ci smos/ so skye'i sgra rtog 'jug yul tsam du yang*/ 'das pa'i dus na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan rnam rol sogs zhing khams rgya mtshor mdzad pa bcu gnyis gcig car du bstan pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge sogs zhing khams rgya mtshor mdzad pa bcu gnyis gcig car du ston par 'gyur ba dang*/ da lta'i dus na bde ba can sogs zhing khams rgya mtshor rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis gcig car du ston bzhin pa dang*/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba rigs drug 'dren pa la tshad bzung med pa dang*/ de bzhin du mahā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ dpal sa ra ha sogs rig 'dzin grub thob yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bo/ pha dam pa sogs rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po dang*/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ pu to ba/ shākya mchog ldan/ rā ga a s+ya sogs bod kyi mkhas grub mang po dang*/ srong btsan sgam po/ gong ma ta'i ming g.yun lo sogs chos kyi rgyal po mang po dang*/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi 'dul ba la sangs rgyas/ sems dpa'i 'dul ba la sems dpa'/ nyan rang gis 'dul ba la nyan rang*/ tshangs pas 'dul ba la tshangs pa/ de bzhin du brgya byin/ 'khor los bsgyur ba/ grub thob/ paṇ+ḍi ta/ dge slong*/ bram ze/ drang srong*/ rgyal po/ blon po/ khyim bdag /lha/ klu/

gnod sbyin/ mi 'am ci sogs dang*/ skyes pa/ bud med/ khye'u/ bu mo/ seng ge/ glang chen/ rta mchog /bya/ ri dwags/ rtsi sman/ kha zas/ gru zam/ sa chu me rlung sogs gang dang gang gis sems can la phan pa de dang der sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni rang cag tshur mthong byis pa'i blo'i ra ba las 'das pas su zhig gis tshad 'dzin nus/ 'dir skabs su babs pa'i gleng bya/ slob dpon chen po gu ru pad+mas zhal lung dri bral rnams su gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir nyid dang tha mi dad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po zhwa nag gi cod pan 'chang ba mtshan gyi nges pa gsal ba dang mi gsal ba rgyun mi chad du 'byon pa dang*/ de rnams mthong thos dran reg thams cad ngan song med par mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam sna zin par rdo rje'i lung bstan yang yang bstsal ba bzhin rang re snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams kyi 'dren pa mtshungs med grol ba bzhi ldan gyi mnga' bdag chos rje karma pa zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags shing*/ ches gdul bar dka' ba'i rtsod dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams la'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dngos su snang 'jug nus pa'i thugs rje'i mthu grub rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi phreng ba rim par byon pa'i rnam par thar pa la phyi nang gsang ba gsum las/ nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar ni/ 'phags chen rnams kyis kyang gzhal bar dka' na rang res lta ci smos/ thun mong phyi'i rnam thar yang rgya mtsho ltar tshad med pa las chu thigs tsam zhig brjod na/ de la thog mar rgyal bas lung bstan bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i spyi mes khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i sras kyi thu bo dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i lung don spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par yongs su grags shing*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī dang*/ bla ma zhang gis ma 'ongs sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul du lung bstan pa de nyid kyi 'khrungs yul/

mdo smad shar phyogs tre shod du yab sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon dang*/ yum sgang lcam ming 'dren gyi sras su bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po shing byi sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad la bltams

( kar lugs mchan/ ) nas bgrang bya nyis stong drug bcu re bdun pa/ lcags stag la sku bltams/ mtshan dge 'phel du btags/ mes po stong dpon shes rab mgon po dang yab la lha mo'i sgrub thabs zhus/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la lha mo zhal gzigs/ brag la zhabs rjes mdzad/ de skabs dgra gcig yod pa rtas brdabs te bsad pas/ chos skyong la btang rag gtang nus mthu che bar grags/ bla ma be ro dang dpal 'dzin la gdams ngag mang po gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug par bka' gdams pa'i mkhan po mchog gi bla ma dang*/ slob dpon chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung nas mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes gsol/ yol chos dbang dang*/ dge bshes bkra rab la jo bo lugs kyi bde mchog sogs bka' gdams pa'i chos skor mang du gsan zhing bsgrubs pas rtags thon/ dgung lo bcu dgu la dbus su byon/ nyi shu pa la dge bshes rgya dmar/ phywa pa chos seng*/ pa tshab nyi grags/ sha ra ba/ de'i slob ma shes rab rdo rje rnams la bka' gdams pa'i chos ji snyed pa gsan/ phyi ma gnyis la lo drug bsten/ mkhan po mal 'dul 'dzin/ slob dpon ye shes blo gros las bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba gsan/ dpal rga lo dang*/ khams pa a seng la dus 'khor sogs chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo sum cu pa la chos rje sgam po pa mjal du byon/ lam du dge bshes sha ba gling dang*/ slob dpon sgom tshul mjal/ gdan bzhi gsan pas slob dpon sgrol dkar du gzigs/ de nas sgam por byon/ zla ba gnyis tsam mjal kha ma byung*/ de nas mjal te gdams ngag zhus pas bka' gdams kyi lam rim rags tsam gsungs nas ngas kyang 'di bsgom pa yin khyod rang yang sgom gsungs/ zhu sna dang bdag rkyen thams cad slob dpon sgom tshul gyis mdzad/ chos rje la dgyes rdor gyi dbang zhus pas chos rje dgyes rdor du gzigs/ thabs lam zhus nas bsgoms pas zhag dgu nas drod rang 'bar du byung*/ ras rkyang mdzad nas zla ba dgu la phyag rdul dang ma bral bar bsgoms pas ting 'dzin gyi yon tan dpag med 'khrungs/

chos rjes lung bstan nas zangs ri la bsgom du byon te/ til phug tu zla ba bzhi/ phag grur zla gcig dang zhag lnga bsgoms pas sems gnas la rang dbang thob/ rlung nyams dpag med byung*/ lhag mthong sprin bar gyi nyi ma 'dra/ slar bla ma'i drung du byon nas lo gsum dka' thub drag po mdzad cing bsgoms pas sgom chen brgyad brgya'i nang nas sgom sran che bar grags/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'ol kar bsgom du byon/ brag srin mo byung nas 'dir ma 'dug nga'i ma jo 'od zer ba la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom/ zla ba bcu bzhi bzhugs pas drod klong du tshud/ rtags ngo mtshar can mang*/ nges shes khyad 'phags 'khrungs pas dgyes/ chos rje bya lkog tu bzhugs pa mjal/ rtogs pa phul bas/ khams pa se bo la nga re che ba yin te/ khyod kyis nor 'dug da dung bsgom gsungs/ nga'i de nor sa mi 'dug kyang bla ma'i bka' yin dgongs nas zla ba drug bsgoms pas sngar gyi de las ma 'gyur/ yang bla ma la lor bsgoms kyang ngo bo la bskyed 'ong rgyu mi 'dug pas nor na'ang nga rang gi de ka bsgom pa lags zhus pas/ phyag spyi bor bzhag nas/ bu 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa yin no gsungs/ gnas lugs ngo sprod gnang*/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin bcang phyogs la byon/ skabs shig dpon slob lnga khams pa bzhi dang 'grogs nas lam du gro btab pas thog lhung nas gnyis bsad/ nyid la rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam las ma byung*/ rje mi la'i slob ma dge tshul gnyis 'dug pas chung ba la phyag chen rde'u skor gyi gdams pa zhus/ rong pa 'gar gi dpon slob/ mes tshon po'i slob ma rkyang mo spang kha sogs la chos gsan/ 'phan yul du dbyar dgun gsum bsgoms pas yon tan mang po 'khrungs/ bde mchog zhal gzigs/ brag la thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ sku chab zhal lud thams cad kyang yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha dog dbyibs sna tshogs byon/

yang chos rje mjal/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin tshwa bre lnga bsnams nas mon yul du byon/ mon rgyal po'i btsun mo bod mo zhig pha ming gi zhen byas te lo tsā bsgyur/ tsha de rgyal po la phul nas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ rgyal pos mchod gnas su bkur/ stag sgo dom tshang shel phug tu bzhugs/ skabs shig byon lam du stag gcig byung nas bskor ba mang du byas nas song*/ bud med gnyis kyis ku ba phyed brags thod pa 'dra zhig chang gis bkang nas drangs/ rgyal pos dug sngags sogs rdzong ba phul nas bod du byon/ lo ror rje btsun ras chung pa mjal/ gdams ngag mang po gsan/ de nas sgam por byon chos rje mjal dus/ stag dang bud med gnyis bcas mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs/ der lo gcig bzhugs nas jo mo gangs su song gsungs pas byon/ gu ru'i bzhugs gnas pha wang dkar leb tu zla ba bzhi bcud len mdzad cing bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs/ lar mos gus med na yon tan mi 'byung*/ ngas bla ma la tha mal gyi 'du shes skad cig kyang skye ma myong gsungs/ ston snye mor byon pa'i lam du bud med bzhi thag 'thags pa gcig gis dro gsol zer bas rung gsungs/ gcig nang du song nas yar byon zer/ phyir khyer shog gsungs pas cang mi nyen nang du byon zer byon pas ku ba phyed pa'i nang du mi'i sor mdzub kyi tshod ma drangs/ the tshom med par gsol bas ro mchog dang ldan/ bud med tshod ma 'dren pa'i mthe bong la bde mchog gzigs/ yang bud med des phor ba nam mkha' la zed pas 'o ma 'dra bas gang ba drangs te gsol ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' ltar 'khrungs/ de nas byon pas sa gzhi dar 'bol ltar 'jam pa/ sku ras bal ltar yang*/ thugs ngos bzung med par dga' ba byung*/ de nas gzhu snye'i bar rdzong zhes pa'i dgon pa'i mdun na btsun ma phyugs rdzi zhig 'phrad/ ya ka'i dgon pa na su bzhugs dris pas/ nga'i slob dpon bzhugs zer/

'o na mjal bar zhu gsungs pas/ mtshams byas yod zer/ cis kyang mjal bar zhu gsungs pas/ ngas zhus yongs zer nas song*/ yar byon zer nang du byon pas btsun rgan pho mo gnyis snang*/ phyag mdzad pas/ phyag ma byed gsungs nas btsun ma yod kyi brda' mdzad kyang legs par 'tshal/ khyod la de ring bud med bzhis drangs pa'i tshod ma de bal yul pham thing na khyim bdag gi bu shi ba'i ro dur khrod du bskyal ba mkha' 'gro mas blangs pa yin/ de rnams mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs/ da lta de na yod dam dris pas/ med kha che'i dur khrod na mar ngo'i tshes bcur mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs mchod la song zin/ mon du btung ba 'dren pa de gnyis kyang mkha' 'gro ma yin/ de rnams khyed la dngos grub ster ba yin gsungs/ dgon pa 'di bla ma'i 'phar tshang dgon pa de 'dra dgongs tshe/ khyed kyi bla ma'i 'phar 'tshang dgon pa de nga'i 'di 'dra'am gsungs/ der bsam mno mdzad ma spob pa sogs gsungs/ der bla ma rdzong pa la gdams ngag mang du gsan/ khyed bla ma lha rjes ci gsung gyis/ zhes sogs zhal ta gnang*/ de nas sgam por pheb dus/ chos rjes/ do nub grol sgom dang*/ khams pa se bo gnyis sdod gsungs nyams dga'i zhal ta mang po gsungs/ mkha' 'gro mas tshod ma drangs pa sogs bla mas mkhyen nas gsungs/ bla ma rdzong pa de na ro'i sum slob yin gsungs/ nga'i bla ma mi la de zad par me'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs dus/ ngas mer mthong nas dros/ chu'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs dus chur mthong*/ zad par gyi yon tan dang mngon shes rgya cher mnga' yang khong la rlom pa rdul tsam med/ spyir sgom chen pa yon tan la rlom pa skye mi rung gsungs/ rlung sems gnyis med sogs gzhan la ma gnang ba rnams lhag med bum pa gang byor gnang*/ nga kam po gnas nang du 'gro grab byas kyang 'gro ma btub/ bu khyod sgrub pa khams kyi kam po gangs rar gyis/ 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum du 'byung ngo*/

/zhes lung bstan/ slob dpon sgom tshul la thon phyag tu byon pas de thams cad mkhyen nas tshur gsungs/ bla ma 'di he ru ka /dgyes rdor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs su gzigs/ de gong skabs shig khams pa mi gsum gyi rdzu 'phrul dang bcas tshogs 'khor mdzad pas/ zhal lta pas gnas nas phyung skabs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad phyir 'brangs/ rtsi shing kun rtse gug /chos rje yang sba ber bsnams te khong gsum 'gro na nga yang 'gro gsungs dri ba dris lan gyi mgur mdzad/ nyams 'ur te pha wang gi steng zhabs rjes kyis gang bas thams cad dad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis par gru bzhi dgon par pheb/ 'di phan chad lto gos 'dzom po ma byung yang ci yod bzhi sde dang tshogs sog kho na byas lto gos kyi phyir sgrub pa la thang lhod shor ma myong*/ nga'i dka' las tsam sus mi nus lto rgyab la gyong bskur mi nus par dang po nas 'dzom po 'dod pa la chos mi yong gsungs/ chos rje sku yal ba gsan nas byon pas/ slob dpon sgom tshul dpon slob mjal/ na bza' la 'jus nas spyan chab bcas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ chos rje rin po che mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa dpon slob gsum gyis gzigs/ spyir gru bzhi dgon par lo brgyad bzhugs/ don zhags smyung gnas mang po bzhugs/ tshogs pa bzhi bcu tsam 'dus/ nub gcig mnal lam du sbrul chen po zhig gis ded de mtho ri rtse dma' rgya mtsho gar bros kyang ma thar/ nam mkha' la 'phur grab mdzad pas sbrul des sku lus khyur mid byas/ mtheb chen phyir lus pa zhig byung*/ zhag shas nas nye gnas la rmi lam de bzang po yang dag yin par 'dug /sngar ting nge 'dzin la dran pas cung zad 'dzin dgos pa de da mi dgos pa byung*/ de yang zhag 'ga' 'dzin dgos byung ba de mtheb chen lus pa der 'dug /rmi lam rtsa rlung gis rten 'brel rlung sems a ba dhu tir tshud pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs te/

de phyin byis pa chung ngu'i spyod pa mdzad pa byung*/ yang nub gcig ri mthon po zhig gi rtse nas dar dkar po zhig phyar bas rgya dkar nag tshun gyi mthong nas ltad mo lta ba rmis/ da lta phal cher la grags pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ de nas kam po gnas nang du 'gro 'am dgongs pa la rdo rje dpal rtsegs bsu ba la byung ba gzhu'i lhas bkag rung ma khegs gsungs/ de nas slob dpon sgom tshul la phyag 'bul du byon pas/ nga yang gnas nang du 'gro snyam yang rkang pa na bas ma brtol/ bla ma'i bka' yin pas khyod byon/ 'tsho ba ma rnyed pa'i g.yeng ba che nas dge sbyor ma smar na yar shog /kho bo ni yun ring mi sdod 'chi ba yin gsungs/ der bshums pas/ ma ngu skad cha bshad kyi nyon da gsungs/ sngar sgrub pa mdzad tshul/ da lta chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar mkhyen cing rdo rje gdan sogs skad cig la gzigs nus pa sogs gsung ngo mtshar can mang du byon pas shin tu spro ba byung gsungs/ bla ma phag grus ye shes 'od la phrin bskur te/ khyed khams su ma 'byon/ gal te 'byon na'ang dbang skur dang rab gnas mang po ma mdzad sku tshe la bar chad 'byung dogs yod gsungs pa la/ khong nga la thugs brtse ba yin/ kho bo de tsam gyi gdeng med par dbang skur dang rab gnas mi byed/ dbang skur yang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ma bskur yang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ rje btsun mi la'i sku tshe tsam zhig thub pa yin gsungs/ dbus su thos bsam la lo bcu/ sgrub pa lo bcu gnyis/ gru bzhir lo brgyad bcas song ba'i dgung lo lnga bcu pa la khams su byon/ nub gcig rnal lam du bud med tsho mo zhig gi ro bshas pas rtsib bar nas ḍā ru mang po byung*/ rang sgra sgrog cing nam mkhar song bas/ nyid kyang de rnams dang 'grogs te byon pas o rgyan du phebs/ bud med gcig gis/ 'di yan chad ye shes dang man chad 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki ma rnams kyi gling yin zhes gdams ngag dang rjes bstan du ma gsan pa byung*/

zla stod dang*/ trer lo shas bzhugs/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga par gnas nang du phebs/ rnal lam sngon nas rtsal 'byongs kyang*/ der phebs nas rnal 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song*/ 'od gsal nyin mtshan 'khor yug rgyun chad med pa de nas byung*/ chos rje sgam po pas de mkhyen nas lung bstan pa yin 'dug /bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyang yin te 'ong gsungs/ ston ra ba'i nya la chos rje'i 'das mchod byas dus nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na bla ma lha rje gtso 'khor gsum zhal gzigs te/ bu gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don//yengs su med pa sgom pa'i don//zung du 'jug pa spyod pa'i don//de gsum dbyer med 'bras bu'i don/ /zhes gsungs/ yang nub cig rmang lam du rgya gar gyi ri gser gyi bya skyibs can na bla ma lha rje bzhugs pa dang mjal/ bla ma brdzus skyes lags sam zhus pas/ mngal skyes yin brdzus skyes kyis sems can gyi don mi 'ong gsungs/ slob dpon yod lags sam zhus pas/ gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa la slob dpon mi dgos par gda' gsungs/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhus pas/ skyes pa'i yul de spangs na chags sdang bral bar nges//tshul khrims don dang ldan na bde 'gro thob par nges//thabs la nan tan byas na lam de chod par nges//ma bcos rang sar bzhag na don de rtogs par nges/ /zhes gsungs/ yang slob dpon sgom tshul ba'i 'das mchod mdzad pa'i dag snang du rdo rje gdan gyi byang du slob dpon mjal/ khyed 'dir yong ba'i nus pa yod ang gsung zhing gdams ngag mang po gsungs/ nub cig dga' ldan du byon nas rgyal ba byams pa longs sku'i cha lugs can la chos gsan/ rten la rab gnas mdzad dus/ thag ring ba rnams kyis lha khang me 'bar ba mthong*/ nye bas lha khang 'khor bar mthong*/ nang na yod pas rten rnams 'gul ba dang sgra sgrags pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs mthong*/ rten snying bzlas dus me tog gi nas rnams khol zhing rang 'thor du 'gro ba dang*/

me tog gi snod nam mkhar sdod pa dang*/ bla ma/ yi dam/ ḍā ki /chos skyong gi zhal gzigs pa ni grangs las 'das/ rje nyid 'jam ston gyis bde mchog tu mthong*/ bla ma bsam yas pas phyag stong spyan stong rtsa zhal bla ma nyid du mthong*/ la las shākya'i rgyal po/ la las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ la las mchod rten dkar po sogs mthong tshul sna tshogs pa byung*/ sngags pa zhig gis phyag 'tshal bar 'dod kyang ma mthong*/ nye gnas dang jo bo byang chub kyis bstan kyang ma mthong nas/ jo bo byang chub yid mug ste spyan chab shor/ gzhan yang 'ga' res yun ring por mi mthong*/ la las nyin lam mang po nas gsol ba drag tu btab na der byon nas yal ba du ma byung*/ rten 'dre can brgya la rab gnas/ mdze bo dang nyams pa brgya la dbang skur yang sku grib mi yong ba ci lags zhus pas/ gnyis 'dzin bral zhing chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu rtogs nas gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor ba la dngos por 'dzin pa'i grib 'byung ba'i yul med gsungs/ skabs shig sgam po'i gdan sa zhig skad zhus pas/ dgongs pa gtad nas gzigs tsa na/ dang po gdan sa/ de nas bal yul tshun/ de nas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mang por sangs rgyas rnams chos gsungs pa gzigs/ gdan sa zhig pa mi bden 'dug ngas da lta bltas pas mthong gsungs/ gangs kyi chu 'dis sba ba yong ba na dbus su 'gro ran pa 'dra gsungs pas/ de nub dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal rtsegs mi dkar rta dkar can thal mo sbyar te/ 'gyur chu'i sman ldum brgyad po 'dis phan pa lags/ dus rtag tu bzhud dgos mi gsung bar zhu blo mi bde bar 'dug zer te song*/ phyis bzhud par brtsam pa na rlung thog gis thang shing mang po sgyel pha wang du ma gas pa sogs cho 'phrul mang po bstan/ der lo bcu dgu bzhugs te 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ lhag par sras kyi thu bo 'gro mgon ras chen zhes pa gtsang du 'khrungs/

byis pa'i dus ri'u lug 'tsho ba gar pheb tu 'ja' zug pa kun gyis mthong*/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gis bu chung 'di nga la bslang zer/ de ci lags byas pas/ 'di la bud med gser rgyan can mang po 'khor 'dug de mkha' 'gro ma yin chos byas na bzang po yong zer yang yab kyis ma phul/ dgung lo dgu pa la chos bros la byon 'bro sgom ras pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ gnyal jo sras sogs bla ma mang po bsten gdams ngag dang nus pa che/ pha yul spangs nas khams su byon/ kam po gnas nang du rin po che dus mkhyen bzhugs pa la/ chos zhu rgyu med phyag cig 'tshal gnas la ltad mo zhig lta bar 'gro dgongs nas byon pas rdo rje dpal rtsegs kyis bsu ba byas/ rin po che mjal bas khyod sngags chung shes rab can zhig 'dug nga'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ khyed la slob ma ci 'dra bdog zhus pas/ 'bal cha stag del ba dang*/ lde chung sangs rgyas sogs yod khyed rang de rnams kyi rtsar song gsungs nas byon pas lde chung dang 'phrad/ khyod sngags chung shes rab can zhig 'dug /nga'i bla ma'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug /nga'i grogs po 'bal tsha'i rtsar song zer byon pas phug par stag chen po zhig nyal 'dug shin tu skrag nas bros nas lde chung la bshad pas/ da rung song zer phyin pas stag med par mtsho chung zhig 'dug /skor ba byas rde'u gcig gnyis 'phang nas 'ong*/ da rung song zer byon pas mtsho med par sgom chen cig 'dug /sngar 'phangs pa'i rde'u mgo dang spang na 'dug /des kyang sngar bzhin zer slob ma la yon tan 'di lta na bla ma lta ci smos snyam dad pa dbang med du skyes nas/ rin po che la chos zhus/ lo bdun dbu sngas la mi 'bebs pa'i dam bca' phul/ rin po che nas/ dbus pa rnyed pa tshol ba zhig la bka' gdams pa dang khyed gnyis rnyed pa che'o gsungs/ dgung lo so bdun par mkhan po la khrom pa dang slob dpon bka' gdams pas bsnyen par rdzogs/

de tsa na nga bsnyen rdzogs cung 'phyis dgongs pa byung*/ mchog thun gyi grub pa brnyes pa'i yon tan tshad med pa de byung*/ 'dir gnas nang pa'i ngag sgros rje dpa' bo'i chos 'byung du bkod pa chags med ri chos su gsal lo/ /de nas rin po che 'bri klung sogs su byon/ de nas trer byon lo phyed gnyis bzhugs/ de nas sle du karmar byon dgon pa btab lo shas bzhugs/ de dag rnams su 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ sgam po gdan sar 'bul ba yang yang mdzad/ de nas rim par dbus su byon rje 'jig rten mgon po sgam por bzhugs pas/ der phebs dgos zhus kyang ma phebs/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos 'bam thang nas bsu ba mdzad/ chos gsan zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ khyed klu sgrub yin zhes lung bstan/ sgam por gser gyi glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ mdzo rta lnga bcu sogs phul/ jo shāka gtsos dbus gtsang gi sde dgon rnams su rta bdun cu/ nor brgya lhag sogs phul/ kho bo dbus su 'ong pa la don bzhi yod/ chos rjes bka' sgrub pa dang*/ gdan sar gser chos brgya 'bul byed pa dang*/ zhang tshal pa sgom chen pa 'khrugs pa mdzad pa 'di rna bar ma snyan pas bshol 'debs pa dang*/ mtshur phur dgon pa gcig bya snyam gsungs/ tshal du byon/ 'khrugs pa bsdums pas/ bla ma zhang gis dag snang mang du gzigs/ phyag nas 'jus te bro brdung de phyin 'khrugs pa ma mdzad do/ /rin po che dgung lo brgyad cu zhes pa sa mo bya lor mtshur phu dgon pa btab nas bzhugs/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi zhal gzigs ches mang ba byung*/ 'di skabs gtsang du la stod thang chung ston pa chos gos grub cing yod skabs/ a tsa ra ras rkyang dang thod pa thogs pa gsum dang*/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa na bza' ras rkyang dang phyag na thod pa dang sba'i ber ma lcags thogs pa dung lung can lo bcu drug gi na tshod can gcig dang bzhi byung bas/ ston pa na re/

khyed gang nas byon dris pas/ rnal 'byor pa des/ nged rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas 'ong*/ kha che dang pu rang rgyud nas lam byas nas 'ong gsungs/ rgya gar du ci la byon zhus pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la phyin gsungs/ 'o na bya lo'i dus mchod la grub thob mang po 'byon zer ba mjal lam zhus pas/ rgyal po zla bas dur khrod ha ha sgrog pa na tshogs 'khor bskor 'dod nas gsol ba btab pas/ rgya gar gyi grub thob bzhi dang bod kyi gnyis byon gsungs/ de rnams su lags zhus pas/ rgya gar gyi bzhi ni/ in+d+ra bo dhi/ nag po spyod pa/ dzā lan+dha ra/ shing lo pa rnams yin/ bod kyi gnyis po dharmā kirti dang*/ dharmā shī la yin gsungs/ de gnyis gang lags zhus pas/ dharma shī la bya ba 'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag yod/ da lta mnga' ris stod kyi lha khang gcig na bzhugs/ dharmā kirti zhes bya ba lam rtsa rlung la rten nas phyag rgya chen po lam cig chod kyi gdams ngag yod/ da lta bod yul smad na bzhugs/ yongs su grags pa'i mtshan ni bla ma dbu se zhes bya ba yin/ nged kyang der 'gro gsungs/ ston pa na re/ bla ma dbu se de sku snyan pa che bas nga yang der 'gro snyam yang sku na mtho bas chos ma tshar gyis dogs nas 'gro ba ma byung zhus pas/ ston pa khyed kyis/ gdul bya gang zhig gcig tsam gyi//don du thub pas bskal bar bzhugs//de yang myur du smin mdzad de//drod gsher ldan pa'i myu gu bzhin//bya ba ma gsan nam/ dad gus dang ma bral bar myur du song*/ chos tshar nas 'ong gsungs/ ston pa dga' nas rnal 'byor ba de la gdams ngag zhus pas/ gro ga la yi ge bris pa zhig dpe dang bcas pa gnang*/ 'di rnam bzhi rgyud grol byin rlabs nus 'don gyi gdams pa shin tu zab mo yin pas mi la ma ston gsungs/ phyis kyang nga dang 'phrad yong gsungs nas bzhud/ ston pas khang par phyin nas chos ston 'dren bsam nas btsal bas gar song ma rnyed/

kun la dris kyang*/ mthong thos ma byung*/ ston pas dbus phyogs la byon pas mtshur phur mjal/ rnal 'byor pa bzhi po de 'dir byon ma byon zhu bsam pa'i tshe/ bla mas/ khyed kyi de sang tsam byas chog gsungs pas zhu ma spob/ de ni zhu dgos bsam te tshogs 'khor bshams/ rin po che dang*/ bla ma stag del ba sogs grwa pa sgres pa bcu tsam gdan drangs/ sngar gyi de rnams gsungs par zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ in+d+ra bud dhi bar pa/ shing lo pa/ nag po spyod pa dang gsum yin/ khyed la chos ston mkhan de nga yin/ gdams ngag de yang in+d+ra bud dhi la zhus pa yin/ khyod nga'i skye ba bzhi'i slob ma yin/ da lan dang lnga yin da res nga dang ma phrad na bshad pa la 'byams 'gro bar 'dug /bsgom bcug pa'i don du nga 'ong ba yin gsungs/ yang bla ma rin po che la bla ma du tsam bzhugs zhus pas/ mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi slob dpon mang du bzhugs te/ khyad par grub pa thob nges bla ma dgu yod gsungs/ de rnams gang dang gang lags zhus pas/ bla ma lha rje rin po che/ rje sgom tshul/ mnga' bdag ras chung ba/ grub thob rdzong pa/ bla ma spen phug pa/ dpal chen rga lo/ bla ma a seng*/ bla ma bkra na ba chen po/ bla ma bai ro ste dgu dang*/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtshan brjod par dka' ba mang du bzhugs gsungs/ bla ma de rnams dang gzhan yang bla ma rnams sku skye ba gar bzhes zhus pas/ rje mar pa lho phyogs dpal gyi ri dang nye bar paṇ+ḍi tar sku 'khrungs pa dang*/ bla ma lha rje sprul pa gcig bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' dri med grags pa zhes bya ba dang*/ gcig shar phyogs mu tig gi brgyan pa na byang chub sems dpa' dri med zla ba zhes bya ba dang*/ gcig rgya gar kha che'i bar na zhi ba'i go cha zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas spyod pa sna tshogs kyi 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon sgom tshul rgya gar nub phyogs su sku 'khrungs nas mu stegs btul ba dang*/

mnga' bdag ras chung pa rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams su sku 'khrungs pa dang*/ grub thob rdzong pa kha che dang o rgyan mtshams su 'khrungs pa dang*/ bla ma bkra na ba cog ro ye shes 'byung gnas su sku 'khrungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du bla ma spen phug ba dang*/ bla ma dpal chen dang*/ bla ma bai ro sogs bla ma gong ma dang*/ pa tshab lo tsā dang*/ shes rab rdo rje sogs bla ma rnams gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul phyogs/ yab yum/ mtshan/ mdzad 'phrin thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi skye ba snga phyi mkhyen pa dang*/ rin po che nyid kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs mang po tshad med par mkhyen pa dang*/ ma 'ongs par skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul ston tshul mang po dang*/ da ltar yang sku'i bkod pa du mas 'gro don mdzad pa dang bu slob rnams kyi skye ba snga phyi mang po mkhyen nas gsungs pa sogs dus gsum gyi shes bya thams cad sgrib pa med par sa ler mkhyen nas mang du gsungs pa rnams rnam thar chen mor gsal zhing*/ de'i phyir dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes mtshan gyi grags pas sa gsum khyab par gyur pa dang*/ sku chab bdud rtsi thams cad kyang ring bsrel du gyur/ khyad par tshems byon pa la tshems gcig pu de tshems chung mang por gyur/ ci zhig ltar na de rnams ring bsrel du gyur zhing dbyibs mchod rten dang*/ tsha tsha dang*/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzugs su grub pa dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams dad ldan mang pos phyogs phyogs su gdan drangs/ rje sgom tshul bzhed gsungs nas ring bsrel dad rten du phul bas shin tu mnyes/ khyad par du he ru ka dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ kha sar pa ṇi gsum gyi sku rgyu ring bsrel las grub pa byon pa'i kha sar pa ṇa'i sku de 'khrid pa gnas brtan la phul/ rje btsun ma'i sku de jo sras rdo rje 'od la gnang*/ dpal he ru ka'i sku de rnal 'byor ba gcig la byin gsungs/ spyir ring bsrel rkyen gyis 'phel ba dang*/

gshegs pa dang*/ dbyibs dang kha dog 'gyur ba dang*/ mngon sum du 'phar zhing lding ba sogs ngo mtshar sna tshogs pas dang po the tshom can rnams kyang phyis som nyi med par yid ches kyi dad pa thob pa dang*/ long ba dang lkugs pa rnams la byin rlabs mdzad pas mthong zhing smra shes par gyur pa dang*/ zha bo dang rgur po rnams la phyag gis reg pas drang zhing 'gro nus pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa la bden pa brjod pa tsam gyis phrin las sgrub pa sogs brjod kyi mi langs te bsam gyis mi khyab bo//rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas kyang*/ dpal rdo rje gdan pas sngon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bus pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung bskur te da lta sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dngos gzhi bod yul du yod cing bstan pa'i bdag po shrī dharmā kirti yin pas phul cig ces 'bul du btang ba phyis gan dho la'i mchod bshams la bzhugs/ de nas sku skye ba de nyid kyis sems can dpag med smin grol la bkod de mya ngan las 'da' ba'i snga rol zla ba gsum tsam nas bzung nam mkha' la 'ja' dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'ur thug gi sgra sogs ltas chen po mang du byung*/ dgung lo gya bzhi pa glang lo stag zla'i tshes gcig gi nyin/ dge bshes gtsang pa dpon g.yog dang*/ dpon 'dul/ dpon grags/ grags rin/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ na bun pa sogs grwa pa sgres pa 'ga' la/ kho bo la bdag tu bzung ba gos lus gang 'di dang zhib 'thag pa'i rang thag 'di las med/ gzhan ci yod dge 'dun gyi dbang ba yin pas nas su brgyur nas 'gyed kho bo 'das pa'i shul 'dir lo gcig gnyis sdod gsungs/ dpon grags seng ges sdod pa rang 'ong ngam zhus pas/ sku yar bsrengs spyan hur mdzad nas ma tha yang dbyar rgyun gnyis tsam sdod pa 'ong min nam gsungs/ yang gzhon nu khyod kyis lo gcig gnyis 'dir sdod la kho bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams las yi ge gcig kyang ma 'thor ba gyis/

ngas kyang chos skyong la bka' bsgo zhing gnyer du gtad yod gsungs/ de skabs sa g.yos yang yang dang*/ dgon pa'i steng du 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs 'khrigs/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra sgrogs pa sogs rtags mtshan mang*/ tshes gsum gyi nyin thams cad la zhal bstan nas gdams ngag mang du mdzad de sku drangs por bsrang ste nam mkhar lta stangs mdzad nas rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir sprul pa sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te zhing khams gzhan du bde bar gshegs/ tshes bcu'i nyin gdung bzhus pas/ nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyi ring ba dang*/ la las nyi ma bdun dang brgyad dang bcu gsum sogs mthong ba dang*/ 'od zer rma bya'i gdugs 'dra ba dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog gi char dang*/ du ba 'ja' tshon du gyur pa'i nang du bla ma'i sku dngos su mthong ba dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ bya dang ri dwags rnams bskor ba byed cing sgra 'byon pa dang*/ dge sbyor sngar med skyes shing sngar yod bogs thon pa sogs ngo mtshar bsam las 'das/ spur khang zhal phye bas thugs ljags dang ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga la dkar po shas che ba/ sa bon phyag mtshan lha sku sogs dpag tu med pa byon pas/ thams cad dad pa'i nges shes brtan por gyur/ de nas 'ga' res mtshur phu dgon pa 'dzin pa dka'/ ca rar spos na legs zer ba mang po byung skabs slob dpon shes rin gyis mtshur phu dgon pa 'di chos rje rin po che kam po gnas nang nas 'dir thugs gtad nas byon/ zhal chems su yang phog /sku yang 'dir gshegs/ lha tshogs mang pos zhal gzigs/ dbang rab gnas mang po mdzad de byin gyi rlabs pa'i sa gzhi phul du+u phyin pa 'di lta bu bzhag nas gar 'gro gsungs te dpon slob gsum gyis dam bca' mdzad/ gdung thal sogs las chos rje'i sku tshab/ sku 'bum dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gyi bkod pa bcas rgya dbang 'dom brgyad pa sangs rgyas byang sems bka' rgyud gong ma rnams dang nyid kyi gdung ring bsrel sogs kyis gtams pa 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur pa bzhengs pas der yang 'ja' 'od me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas so//rje de la bu chen byon pa yang*/

mngon shes kyi bka' babs lde chung sangs rgyas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' babs 'bal tsha stag del ba rnam thar gyi bka' babs bra ba bka' gdams pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs ye dge chos brtson/ 'gro don bka' babs don brgyud kyi mnga' bdag 'gro mgon ras chen te bka' babs kyi bu lnga/ gya pa gangs pa rin chen 'od zer/ rang byung sangs rgyas/ gtsang po pa dkon seng*/ 'gro mgon ras chen rnams la brgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhir yang grags/ nam mkha' 'od/ ye shes 'od/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od ste nye gnas 'od bzhi/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ 'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma/ dge slong brtson shes rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ rmeng dge jo sras/ gtsang ston tshul seng*/ tre bo dkon mchog dpal/ rdo rje shes rab/ sgang lo tsā ba ste yongs grags kyi bu chen rnams dang*/ lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po/ stag lung thang pa/ gling ras/ rgya ras/ man lung gu ru/ ri gong sangs rgyas mnyan ston rgya pho ba lung sogs ni dam pa'i chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen rnams dang*/ gzhan yang*/ lha rje me mchod pa/ rong po khams gsum grags/ sngags mchog bal po/ rma bya ras pa/ dge bshes na bun pa/ khams pa dbang rdor/ sta sgom ras pa/ dpon ston dar ma/ rdo rje brtson 'grus/ dar ma seng ge /dbang phyug grags pa/ rin chen grags pa/ shes rab grags pa/ ston pa byang chub/ dge 'dun grags/ shākya shes rab/ rdo rje 'bum/ ka thog pa chen po sogs ches mang ba dang bu chen phal cher grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i yon tan gyi mchog mnga' ba sha stag go/

gnyis pa grub chen karma pak+shi'i rnam thar/ gnyis pa grub chen karma pak+shi'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las rags rim mdor bsdus ni/ sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras sat+na legs dang*/ sat+na 'jing yon gnyis las snga ma 'bangs kyis bkrong*/ chung ba la sras gsum yod pa'i sa stag nam mkha'i lha gzungs zhes/ bi ma mi tra/ slob dpon pad+ma/ nam mkha'i snying po rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i grub thob na bza' nyi zer la 'gel ba dang*/ 'ja' zer la chibs nas nam mkha' la 'byon nus pa de'i brgyud pa mi rabs bcu gsum tsam song ba'i dus su 'bri klung gi yul du yab rgya dbang tshur tsha dang*/ yum seng bza' skyid gnyis la sras 'ga' yod pa'i chung shos su me stag lor sku 'khrungs mtshan chos 'dzin zhes par gsol/ dad pa che zhing zab don la mos pa dgung lo drug nas yi ge phyogs med du mkhyen/ dgu dang bcu lon gyi bar gsung rab thams cad la thos pa mdzad pas thugs su chud/ thugs sems kyi gshis 'gyur ba med pa rang bzhin gyis gnas pa rgya mtsho ltar rang babs su gnas kyang*/ ci ltar yin cung zad ngo ma 'phrod pa rin po che spom brag pas ngo sprad pas mkhyen pa ste/ de yang 'gro mgon ras chen gyi sras kyi thu bo sar gnas sems dpa' chen po ye shes blo gros kyi rnam rol rgyal sras spom brag pa bsod nams rdo rje zhes mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa rtogs pa don brgyud kyi mnga' bdag de/ sha 'bom na bzhugs skabs/ chos rje karma pa dbus su phebs dgongs te byon pas mjal/ btsun chung khyod gang nas yong pa yin gsungs/ chos rjes nged sa stod nas 'ong dbus su 'gro ba yin zhus pas/ khyod nga'i gdul bya e ma yin gar yang ma 'gro sdod cig gsungs/ de nub dbang skur mdzad pa'i gral du khrid nas thugs la btags/ dbang skur thub nas mi gzhan med skabs/

khyod 'dug pa'i thad na dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gsal/ khyod las can zhig yin par 'dug gsungs/ de rjes skabs shig de ring rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i snang ba nam mkha' gang ba zhig byung*/ lar khyod dang phrad phyin dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas khyod skal ldan zhig yin 'dug /'dir sdod la nga'i chos 'di tsho nyams su long gsungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rab tu byung mtshan chos kyi bla ma ces gsol/ de nas spom brag dgon par dbang dang*/ sems bskyed zab khrid sogs dam pa'i chos dpag tu med pas rjes su bzungs shing pha bu 'phrad pa bzhin thugs la btags/ tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin par 'dug gar yang mi 'gro bar bsdad dgos dgongs nas chos thams cad thugs nyams su bzhes shing bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ sa ra ha'i do ha dang*/ dwags po'i phyag chen gnang nas ngo sprad skabs/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang rig ye shes rabs 'byams su ngo 'phrod de rin po che la zhus pas/ ngo bo rtogs pa yin yang thog med nas 'khrul pa yun ring ba'i phyir/ sgom med kyis dbyings su rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo bskor dgos pa dang*/ khyod la des chog kyang gdul bya sna tshogs kyi don byed pa la bka' brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams dgos shing*/ slob ma rnams la ngo sprod/ gegs sel/ bog 'don rnams shes dgos pa yin gsungs nas thams cad gnang*/ der bla ma la 'bul rgyu gzhan med pas klog rgyun tshar gcig la bzhugs nas de'i yon rin po che la phul pas/ khra spom brag 'di nor phyi bkang nas phul ba las/ sgom chen sems ngo shes pa gcig dga' gsungs/ de nas bla ma 'di sgrub pa kho na la mnyes par 'dug dgongs nas sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi don la gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor bas/ me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rigs drug gnas sbyong du ma shar zhing*/

dbyings ye gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang gis phyogs bcu'i zhing dang sku rgya mtsho rnams rtag tu gzigs/ khyad par thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa nam mkha' gang ba zhig gi zhal nas khyod kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgra phyogs med du grags par sgrogs shig ces pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i zhal nas chos 'di kun la ston/ 'dis 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa yin gsungs/ 'on kyang shar phyogs spungs rir ma phebs bar su la'ang ma bstan pa yin gsungs/ da dung mnyam rjes cung zad ma 'dres pas/ dgun sgang phyi rol du ras rkyangs mdzad nas mtshan yal rlung sems drag tu bsgoms pas sgom med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ thun mtshams rnams su rje btsun ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas zhal rtag tu gzigs/ rin po che spom brag pas/ brgyud pa 'di'i gdams ngag la khyod 'dra ba'i sgom sgrub brtson 'grus dgos pa yin/ gdams ngag gi che ba 'don cing dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa la khyod byung gsungs nas mnyes/ de nas kaḥthog pa byams pa 'bum gyis mkhan po dang*/ spyan snga mang phu pas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ skabs shig thugs rje chen po spyi gtsug tu a mi dhe ba bzhugs pa sku las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ 'od zer re re'i sna la yig drug gi rang gzugs kha dog sna lnga la dmar po shas che ba bkra lam mer gsal ba'i rang sgra nam mkha' khyab pa'i nang nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje yi//phrin las 'od zer phyogs bcur rgyas//zhes grags te/ mkha' khyab 'gro re'i mdun du thugs rje chen po'i sku dang yig drug yod pa chos rje nyid la thim pa gzigs/ de la sogs pa zhal gzigs dang gsung 'byon gyi dag snang la tshad med pa rtag tu 'byung ba su zhig gis brjod nus/ go tshang brag la lo lnga sgom par mdzad/ skabs shig rin po che spom brag pa'i zhal nas/ kho bos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa yab sras kyi bstan pa la zhabs tog bya dgos bsam kyang rgya chen po ma 'grub/

da khyod kyi ring la rgya chen po byung bar 'dug pas mtshur phu man chad rje dus gsum mkhyen pa yab sras kyi bstan pa de khyod kyis khur yin zhes rjes su gdams par mdzad/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho//'grol zhing thar par 'dod na//brgyud pa mchog gi byin rlabs//rje dang mi 'bral 'grogs 'tshal//zhes sogs kyi mgur gsungs/ rje btsun rin po che khyed sku skye ba phyi ma gar 'khrungs zhus pas/ bar do med par skad cig lag pa brkyang bskum la mgon po byams pa dang dga' ldan gyi snang ba shar ba yin/ da ni sangs rgya ba la'ang tshegs med/ dga' ldan nas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul mang po phyogs med du 'gyed cing gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'dren/ khyed bu slob rnams kyang ci byed lha'i mig gis mthong zhing khyed rnams kyi gdul bya'i smin grol yang kho bos byed pa yin pas/ byams mgon dang kho bo la lhan cig tu gsol ba thob/ ces sogs zhal gdams mang du gsungs/ chos rje karma pas/ kho bo la rje btsun tsam gyi phrin las byung na rab yin/ de bas che ba rang e yong ngam zhus pas/ bka' brgyud 'di'i slob dpon las slob ma phrin las che ba 'byung zhing kho bo yan chad bka' brgyud rin po che thams cad kyi phrin las khyod gcig pu la 'byung bar 'dug gsungs nas rin po che spom brag pa bde bar gshegs/ hor dang mi log gis yul brlag skabs/ tsha rong mgon par phebs kyang*/ mi log mang po byung zer nas zhabs tog byed pa ma byung*/ bla ma rin po che yang gshegs pas chos rje nyid thugs chad pa'i dus na/ rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyi gtsos pu 'bor gyi gzhi bdag thams cad bsu ba la byung*/ mgon po ber can gyis 'dir ma bzhugs shar phyogs su 'byon gsungs pa'i ltas byung*/ nged mi log la khyed rnams mi dgos/ 'dzam gling khyab pa'i bdag po 'ong bar yang sus shes/ zhes bris pa'i sgo yig sbyar nas sgo yul du byon pas/

sgo rig gi gzhi bdag rnams mi nag dar dkar 'dzin pa mang pos bsus/ 'bri brgyud de dag tu brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad/ nad pa dang zha bo sogs la phyag lcag gnang ba tsam gyis sos/ grub thob kyi snyan pa phyogs med du khyab pas thams cad dang*/ kam po gnas nang du byon pas zhag mang por dag snang bsam mi khyab pa gzigs/ gnas nang gi lung pa dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs/ rje dus mkhyen gyi zhal nas dag pa mkha' spyod 'di rang yin gsungs pa byung*/ rong nas yar 'byon dus/ sgo rig gi gzhi bdag dang dge bsnyen 'khor bcas 'thab cing 'dug pa la gtor ma byin nas ma 'thab gsungs pas/ dge bsnyen na re/ da res khyed rnams rgyal ba gyis/ phyis nga rang gis gdan 'dren pa yin zer/ de phyis gnas nang du bstan pa dar ba'i rtags yin gsungs/ smyon pa gcig la gtor dbang mdzad pas/ bon po rnams kyis ban+dhe pe kar gyis pe kar mi thub/ de snga gtor dbang gsum byas kyang ma phan zer pas/ thugs 'khrugs nas 'jig rten thams cad zhal du btab kyang gang snyam pa ma byung*/ gtor chen mi bzhis mi theg pa de phyag ya gcig gis 'phangs/ sngon bla ma nyag re se bo'i sgrub gnas spungs rir phebs/ 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki la sogs kyis thog char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul bstan pa rnams dbang du bsdus zil gyis mnan rtsol sgrub sna tshogs kyis phrin las re zung 'grub pa la dgos pa med/ grub rtags zhi khro rab 'byams ltar lhun grub tu ma byung na/ yul khams re zung tsam gyi slob dpon la dgos pa med dgongs nas byi ru 'ga' yod pa za ma la brjes nas dam bca' brtan pos gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo bskor bas sku bsod rgyas/ grwa pa lnga brgya tsam gyis rgyags thogs med du bkye nas sgom du bcug /ma mgon lcam dral pho nyar bkye/ lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol nas rgya 'jang yan chad la drag po'i phrin las bstan nas lam rgya mdzad/

thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang snang ba mtha' yas dbyer med pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang bas bskor ba zhal gzigs/ da phyin chad 'gro don thams cad yi ge drug mas gyis gsungs pa gsan/ zhal gzigs byang chub shing gi thang ka dang*/ de phyin thugs rje chen po phyogs med du bstan par mdzad/ nub cig gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gar mdzad cing*/ khyod kyis ma ṇi pad+me bgrang mi shes gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar bzla zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis mgrin sdebs te dbyangs su gyer nas/ da phyin chad 'di ltar dbyangs su blangs na gang thos thams cad byin gyis rlobs shing 'gro don shin tu che ba yin gsungs pa gsan/ de phyin chad ma ṇi dbyangs su gyer ba'i phrin las mdzad/ lar ting 'dzin thun gcig gi dag snang byung ba'ang brjod kyis mi langs gsungs/ da res la mi'i slob ma bas mi ma yin gyi slob ma mang ste/ rgya gar shar phyogs kā ma rū pa'i gzhi bdag gi slob ma kho na'ang dpag tu med pa yong gsungs/ yang thugs rje chen po sku mdog sngon po zhig gi zhal nas/ rnam snang gang chen mtsho yang nga'i sprul pa yin/ sems bskyed dang smon lam rgya chen po ji tsam btab bzhin 'grub pa yin pas smon lam mtha' yas tshad med pa thob cig gsungs pa gsan nas/ kun gzhi byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes pa'i smon lam mdzad/ yang spung rir thugs rje chen po sku mdog ser la dkar ba'i mdangs can/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba zhal gzigs nas/ 'gro ba kun gyi sems rgyud la nged kyi 'od zer bkye ba yin gyi/ da res yi ge drug mas 'gro don dpag med 'byung*/ de'i phyir kun la phyogs ris med par ston cig gsungs pa gsan/ de phyin chad thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi gsham na/ dbang ma thob pa dang*/ lung ma mnos pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi chos ma rdzogs pa rnams kyang phrin las thugs rje chen po dang mnyam par gyur cig ces smon lam btab yod pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/

yang rigs lnga'i zhing thams cad dus gcig la gzigs pas zhing khams lta ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ spungs rir bzhugs nas lo brgyad na thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong sogs kyis sems can gyi don la 'gro ran zer ba yang yang byung yang cung zad kyang ma 'gul bar rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo bskor te lo bcu gcig bar du der bzhugs/ de nas dmag zing gis gnas nang sogs dgon pa thams cad brlag pa gso ba'i phyir phyogs der byon nas/ kol ti'i sde chen la gser 'phru btsug pa sogs thang gsum gsos/ gnas nang du sa slong ba na/ dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal rtsegs sogs gzhi bdag rnams kyis phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gi bar du khyed kyi bu slob rnams kyi bstan pa nged kyis bsrung ba yin zer/ yang thugs rje chen po dmar po nam mkha' gang ba zhal gzigs nas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing mtha' yas pa na thugs rje chen po dang snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de khyod kyang yig drug gi phrin las sgrub mi yin pas skyo dub med par ston cig gsungs/ sgrol dkar dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ zhi khro rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo sogs lha tshogs zhal gzigs grangs med/ kha ba dkar por zla shas bzhugs/ de'i lam yig mdzad/ de nas karma'i gdan sa gso phyir sa stod na yar byon/ 'bri ldan gnyis dang*/ lho lung chen bco brgyad kyi lha 'dre mi gsum rlung sems kyis dbang du bsdus/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ karmar lo gcig bzhugs dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ ma mgon rnams kyis mtshur phu'i gdan sa 'jig la khad pas 'byon ran zhes yang yang bskul te mtshur phur 'byon par rtsam pa na sngags bdag gi nor bu rin po che phul/ lam lho rgyud nas byon pas/ dpal ldan lha mos dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa 'jig la khad pas dbus la myur du phebs zhes mgyogs bskul lan gsum byung*/

da khams la mar mi slebs gtsang mnga' ris man chad 'dul dgos dgongs tshe/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ dbus gtsang na 'gro don mang po byed rgyu yod kyang*/ khams na gdul bya'i phyed drang po yong pas der 'gro dgos pa 'byung gsungs/ gangs dkar zhol du byon nas dbus gtsang gi lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus zil gyis mnan/ skyi shod nas byon dus jo bo rje 'od zer dang bcas pa mang du gzigs te/ de'i phrin las kyi lhag ma yod pa'i brdar mkhyen/ lha sar jo bo shākya mu ni las 'od zer mang po byung nyid la thim pas bstan la phan pa'i brdar mkhyen/ mtshur phur phebs tshe dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku mang pos steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyab pa gzigs pas dus gsum mkhyen pa'i phrin las phyogs med du 'byung ba'i brdar mkhyen/ de'i tshe mtshur phu gling dang be ri'i bshig mi su'ang sdod pa med dus phebs/ lo ngo drug gi bar du bzhugs/ phrin las rnam bzhis rje dus mkhyen gyi bstan pa spel/ der grwa pa rnams chang 'thung pa sogs spyod lam mi dge ba sna tshogs byed cing 'dug pas 'gro dgos dgongs tsa na/ dpal ldan lha mos/ nged kyang byang shar mtshams nas pho brang 'dir spo ba yin khyod kyang 'dir bzhugs zer pho brang thams cad spos pa'i ltas byung*/ nga'i lha bkod 'di rnams kyis mkhyen/ yang slob dpon pad+ma sku mdog nag po a tsa ra'i cha byad can zhal gzigs/ spyir slob dpon pad+mas zhal gzigs chos gsung yang yang byung bas de'i phyir slob dpon pad+ma la gsol ba yang yang btab gsungs/ mtshur phu nas gtsang la byon skabs thang lha'i gtso byas/ kha rag gang dkar ma sogs brtan ma'i tshogs bar snang gang bas bskor ba byed pa byung*/ gsang ba ye shes kyi sku las 'od dmar po zla gam dbyibs can 'phro ba gzigs/ dbus gtsang thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar mkhyen/ kha reg gangs dkar/ kong lha sogs brtan skyong rnams bud med dar dkar gyi go zu gon pa rnams kyis phyag 'tshal/

gnam mtsho klu sman gyis gser gyi bum pa phul/ lha chen thang lha rgyun du gus pas bskor ba byed/ bu slob rnams la brtse gdung che/ mi ma yin rnams kyi nang gtor bas da gtor du ma bcug /gal te gtor na khrag gi kha phru gtor rgyu yin zer bas de phyin shin tu gnyan par byung*/ yang lha mo'i zhal nas dus gsum mkhyen pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin cing gdan sa skyong ba rnams sgrub thabs mi shes kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas kyi bar nged kyis sdong grogs dang phrin las thams cad sgrub pa yin zer ba byung*/ yang mnyam med dwags po ri tsam zhal gzigs nas nyid la thim pa dang bram ze chen po la grub thob thams cad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs pas sgrub brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa dang mchog dngos thob pa mang po 'byung ba'i brdar mkhyen/ yang sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku grangs med pa'i zhal nas/ sprul skus 'gro don byed pa la//brtson 'grus ci yang med pa yin//gsungs pa gsan te/ phrin las rtsol med du 'grub pa'i brdar nas shin tu khas drag par yang 'dug gsungs/ tshong dus mgur mor byon tshe/ lha 'dre thams cad bros nas thal/ dge bsnyen ha bo gang bzang de phyag 'tshal zhing khyed la nged shin tu skrag par 'dug pas gzi brjid chen po de mi ston par zhu zer/ rgya gar nas mkha' 'gro ma mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa byung nas do nub dur khrod du tshogs 'khor bskor bar gdan 'dren pas khyed rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed nus pas 'byon par zhu zer bas/ karti ka dang o rgyan dang*/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa gnas mang por byon/ grub thob mang po dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tshogs 'khor bskor ba dang cir yang sprul nus pa byung gsungs/ gzhan yang bde mchog /phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ thugs rje chen po/ sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyi gzigs snang dang chos gsungs sogs shin tu mang ba rnam thar chen mor gsal/

tsa ri'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtso mo khros nag tu gzigs pa dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dbang du bsdus/ kho bos brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rang dbang thob pas ci byas nyan pa yin/ nga'i bu slob rnams la'ang gzhan dang mi mnyam pa 'ga' re 'ong*/ hor 'di dga' rab dbang phyug dang gnam thel gyi sprul par 'dug pas bstan bshig byed pa la/ ngas sus kyang ma tshor bar 'dul zhing gar phyin gar bsdad kyi yul khams thams cad bde ba dang bod 'di je 'jam la 'ong yang shes gsungs/ brtan skyong rnams kyi gtso bos gzhi bdag thams cad 'dus nas/ khyed khams su ma 'byon khyed kyi gsung nged rnams kyis sgrub zer bar/ nga re zhig khams su 'gro dgos yod/ nga'i gdan sa dang bu slob skyongs shig gsungs pas kun gyis phyag 'tshal zhing khas blangs/ stod lung mdar phebs dus mkhar nag gi bsu ba byas/ klu rgyal dung skyong gi bu yin 'dug cing kho'i 'khor gyis dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab par snang*/ dbus gtsang rnams kyi mi nor 'khor bcas khyed la 'bul zer bas/ dbus gtsang du bstan pa dar nas yong ba 'dra gsungs/ yar chab gtsang por sdong gtong ma nyan tshe mkha' 'gro ma mang pos nged kyis gdan 'dren zer nas nam mkha' la btegs nas byon/ shing 'brug lor rgyal bu go dan gyis sa paṇa khu dbon gsum spyan drangs/ de rjes rgya nag hor dus kyi rgyal bu go be la zhes bya bas sngon gyi las smon dang*/ chos rje karma pa nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan rnams thos pa la brten nas/ gser yig btang nas gdan 'dren byung skabs/ 'byon nam mi 'byon dgongs tshe phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i ltas gzigs nas 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ de tshe dpal ldan lha mos khyed kyis da dung bya ba mang po sgrub long yod kyi nor thams cad mal du zhog zer ba byung*/ de nas hor yul phebs pa'i lam du bstan 'gro'i don mang po mdzad cing byon/

chos rje dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa shing yos lo/ rgyal bu go be la dmag chen po'i tshul gyis byon pa rong yul gser stod du mjal/ de nas pho brang 'u tor phebs/ rgyal 'bangs thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ der rgyal bus rtag tu bzhugs par zhus kyang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mang pos/ 'dir yun ring ma 'dug chags sdang mang po 'byung bas byang phyogs su song gsungs pa'i lung bstan yang yang byung bas zhal bzhes ma mdzad pas rgyal bu cung zad ma dga'/ de nas byang phyogs mi nyag 'ga'i yul du byon/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong mang po zhal gzigs nas bskul bas 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ ku ru skul le'i bskul bas byang phyogs ling ju'i mkhar du byon/ zin shing sogs rtog ge ba rnams btul/ yul khams de thams cad dbang du bsdus/ de nas kong jo'i mkhar du byon/ rgya hor mi nyag sogs mi rigs mi gcig pa thams cad bsdus/ 'brug lo zla ba gnyis par thang lha dang brtan ma rnams kyis re zhig bod du 'byon dgos zer/ tsong kha'i yul du byon/ de nas bla ma yi dam mang pos byang phyogs su 'byon par bskul ba dang*/ rgyal po chen po mong gor gan gyis snyan pa gsan nas/ gser yig pa spyan 'dren du byung nas der byon pa'i lam du hor dang mi nyag gi mtshams su cha ga pa'i gnod pas nyi ma 'grib pa byung ba rdo rje srin pos lta stangs kyi skad cig la med par mdzad/ lha 'dre thams cad kyi cho 'phrul bar chad sna tshogs dang khyad par pho brang du nye ba na gnam lcags kyi thog char bzhin 'bab pa/ rta mchog rgyal po'i brtul zhugs kyis zil gyis mnan dbang du bsdus dam la btags/ sngon glang chen du sprul nas sdig spyod rgyal po brtul ba de rje dus mkhyen kam po gnas nang na bzhugs dus bon 'byor ba can zhabs tog thams cad sgrub pa'i yon bdag dgon pa bar grags pa de'i skye ba/

rgya mi nyag hor bod thams cad kyi rgyal po mong gor gan du gyur pa mkhyen/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzigs stangs kyis rgyal po yab yum sras 'khor thams cad byin gyis rlabs/ rgyal pos bsnyen bkur dpag med byas/ chos rje'i ji skad gsungs pa thams cad sgrub/ klu bdud dang ra hu la sogs kyis thog ser 'beb pa sogs cho 'phrul bstan pas khro bcu'i dkyil 'khor las 'dzam gling khyab pa'i me dpung spros nas bsregs/ hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing chibs rgyug mdzad/ zin shing dang*/ ta'o gsi dang*/ er ka'o la sogs pa'i rtog ge pa rnams la rang cag stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran shog cig ces dril bsgrags pas sus kyang 'gran ma nus par zhabs la btud/ lo de'i dgun po ting nge 'dzin gyis kha ba dang lhag pa rnams bcad cing drod dang ldan par mdzad pas hor mi rnams ngo mtshar du gyur/ a la ga'i pho brang du rgyal po sogs skal ldan rnams la bde mchog gi dbang skur/ rgyal pos dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong bar byin rlabs/ pho brang nang gi chang mdzod thams cad dus gcig la bzhes pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ phrin las rnam bzhis rje 'bangs thams cad snang ba rang dbang med par 'gyur nas mu stegs kyi grub mtha' spangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud/ sa ra ha sogs rgya gar grub chen thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ sa ra ha la grub thob brgyad bcus bskor ba bris na byin rlabs shin tu che bar 'dug gsungs/ rgyal po sems gzung 'dzin las grol/ bang mdzod thams cad mchod sbyin la btang*/ btson thams cad bkrol/ lha khang dang rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ bka' bzhin rgyal po'i mnga' 'og thams cad mi dge bcu spangs shing dge bcu sgrub/ thams cad smin grol la bkod/ gsung yi ge drug pa'i rang sgra phyogs med du bsgrags/ rgyal po lam rnal ma la chud pas 'brel tshad don ldan du lung bstan/

'di skor du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pas mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga'i snga ltas su mkhyen/ 'brel tshad mtho ris dang thar pa la bkod/ then pa chen po byung ba sngags bdag la bka' bsgos pas char babs/ rje dus mkhyen seng ge la chibs pa zhal gzigs nas bstan pa la 'phel 'grib 'byung bar lung bstan/ rgyal pos sman rtse'i yul du yon mchod lhan du 'byon par zhus kyang*/ da ni bod yul du bya ba chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir 'gro gsungs nas ma byon/ rgyal pos 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ de nas yar byon tha hu chu mkhar du phebs dgon pa btab/ bzhugs par zhus kyang dus ngan 'byung bar mkhyen nas lung yang bstan/ lcags spre lo rgyal po mong gor gan sku gshegs/ a li khrir bton/ go dan sogs kyis go be la shang tor khrir bton/ de gnyis 'khrugs pas a li bo ga bkrong*/ lcags bya lor go be la 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal por gyur te se chen rgyal po zhes grags/ chos rjes 'khrugs rtsod 'di 'dra'i nang du sdod dgos pa dgongs nas zhag bdun du sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa phul/ thugs rgyud bskul bas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku tshad 'dom bcu yod pa zhal gzigs/ khyod bod du phyin nas sangs rgyas kyi sku 'di tsam bzhengs nas rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur gsungs pa gsan pas/ dus ngan 'di 'drar bod yul du nam phyin lha 'di tsam ga na 'grub dgongs tshe/ yang 'od zer gyi sgra las/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis grogs byed pa'i phyir the tshom mi za bar gsol ba thob dang 'grub par 'gyur zhes grags pa byung*/ de nas hor dang sog po'i mtshams a ras zer ba'i gangs rgyud chen po zhig gi rtsar phebs dus rmang lam na ri nag po gnam la zug pa zhig gi rtse na nyid gcig bu lhung la khad pa na rta dkar po bya'i gshog pa yod pa lta bu zhig byung ba chibs nas/

rta la mi'i lag pa'i sbar mo bzhin snang bas brag de la skad cig tsam gyis 'dzegs nas thang yangs shing rgya che la nyams dga' ba zhig tu phebs pas/ rta mchog khyod ni ngang pa gser ldan 'dra//mi mchog nga ni rgyal bu don 'grub 'dra//'jigs pa che las bdag ni khyod kyis bsgral//ces gsungs shing*/ rta dang nyid tha dad med pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sgra las/ da dung khyod la gzugs can gzugs med thams cad bdud du langs nas 'jigs pa chen po 'byung ste/ de yis che ba ston nas rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro zer ba snyam pa na mnal sad/ mnal sad ma sad khyad med pa'i dag snang bzang po byung*/ de nas hor gyi sa mtshams su se chen rgyal pos sngar mchod gnas su ma bzhugs pa'i snying nad dang*/ gzhan gyis dkrug bskyal ba la brten nas rab tu khros nas ma rung pa'i bsam pa skyes nas gshed ma rnams la de sod cig ces pa'i 'ja' sa bka' sgyur drag po btang byung ba la thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis thugs la dga' mi dga' dang skrag pa'i snang ba med par sgra grags stong brag cha lta bur rtogs/ de nas gshed ma rnams kyis bzung nas dar yug bsgril mas phyag zhabs dam du bcings nas zhags pas bcings pa rang sar grol nas sku snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ de nas dug gis bkrong bsam nas sbyar dug blud pas cung zad kyang ma gnod par rma bya'i dug zos pa ltar sngar bas gzi brjid che ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ de nas bkrong pa'i phyir lcags thur/ gri mdung sogs mtshon cha mang po sku lus la brgyab kyang nya ma nga med par gshed ma rnams rengs nas lus g.yo 'gul tsam yang ma nus/ grub thob chen po nyid rdo rje 'chang du snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ de nas da dung yang rgyal pos 'ja' sa drag tu bsgrags pa'i phyir bkrong bsam nas gsal shing bzhi'i rtse la bcings shing skyon pas bcings pa rang sar grol nas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i skur snang ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/

de nas rgya brag mthon po'i rtse nas g.yang la bskyur bas/ bya rgyal rgod po ltar nam mkha' la lding skor mdzad pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ de nas chu chen po la bskur ba na/ chu'i ma khyer mtsho'i nang du 'phangs pa na gting du mi bying bar gser bya ngang pa bskyal ba lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ de nas tsher ma'i dong dang sbal pa sogs srog chags 'jigs su rungs pa'i dong du bskyur pa na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur gyur nas srog chags rnams phyag skor byed par grags/ de nas me la gson sregs byas pa na me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa me lha drang song lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa sogs gshis skye med du rtogs pa'i dbyings su ro snyoms shing rtsal 'gag pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung gis bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngang tshul skye bo thams cad la mngon sum du bstan pas thams cad ci bya tol dang bral/ ma mgon la sogs pa'i chos skyong thams cad dang khyad par dpal ldan lha mo rab tu khros nas rlung nag ri 'gul nus pa tsam langs shing*/ bsha' bud kyi mi dang dud 'gro rtsi shing thams cad brlag pa dang nad rims smyo 'bog ltas ngan sna tshogs rlung 'tshubs pa ltar byung bas/ grub thob chen po'i zhal nas/ nga ni rang byung rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje rgyal po rang dbang che/ /zhes sogs dang*/ chos sku rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la//dus gsum rang bzhin rnam dag pas//me chu 'byung ba'i 'jigs dang bral//sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bo dag/cho 'phrul 'di la da tshur ltos// snang srid dbang du 'dus pa yis//rlung sems gnyis la 'khor lo bskor//gang du phyin kyang dgra dang bral//zhe sdang can la 'di skad smos//dus kyi tha mar gyur pa dang*//phrag dog can gyi tshig rtsub smras//sa 'dzin rgyal po rab tu khros//gshed ma pa la rang dbang med//khro 'khrug rngam pas rang sdug g.yos//rnal 'byor sems la g.yo ba med//ces sogs gsungs/

de nas sngags pa lo ston dang khrag seng gnyis kyis rgyal po la bskul nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgya nag ke'u cu'i mkhar zhes pa chu ngan zhing tshad pa shin tu che bas yul gzhan gyi mi su yang sdod mi tshugs pa'i sar bskrad pa'i tshe der zla ngo brgyad tsam bzhugs tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po zhal bcu gcig phyag stong na lhung bzed re re'i nang nas sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku re re bzhugs shing zhabs stong dang ldan pa zhal gzigs/ ma 'ongs pa na rgya nag dang mi nyag sogs rgya mtsho la thug gi bar khyed kyis 'dul zhing du 'gyur ba sogs lung bstan/ cho 'phrul mang po dang*/ zhu lan nyi shu rtsa gcig mdzad/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i byin gyis rlabs pas chos thams cad la mi mkhyen pa ci yang ma byung bas/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje yin zhes gsungs/ sgra thams cad chos kyi sgrar gsan zhing*/ bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas sogs theg pa dgu'i chos 'khor bstan bcos phal cher de nas gsal bar mdzad/ sngags bdag pho nyar bkye nas char rgyun gyis thams cad bde skyid la bkod/ thams cad yid ches pas yon tan snyan pa phyogs med du bsgrags pa rnams rgyal pos thos nas/ byon cig zer ba'i lung byung yang rgya mtsho'i 'gram du lo ngo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas pho brang cang to mkhar du byon/ rgyal po log rtog cung zad bri yang da dung tshod bgam pa'i phyir/ gsol zas med par zhag bdun spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang du bcug nas sgo lcags gzer gyis bsdams te srung mkhan bzhag pas/ lha khang shel ltar phyi nang gsal ba la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mang pos tshogs 'khor bskor shing thog zas sna dpag med drangs/ dkar phyogs kyi lha bran rnams kyis ro mchog brgya'i kha zas kyi char phab pa kun gyis mthong ba sogs rdzu 'phrul mang po dang*/ me chu rlung dmar nad yams sogs kyi bka' chad drag po dngos su phab pa sogs kyis/

se chen rgyal po'ang shin tu 'jigs shing*/ yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes/ dad pas zhabs la btud nas nongs pa bzod par gsol te bshags pa byas/ skye bo dpag tu med pas mchod cing nyin mtshan bar med chos 'khor bskor/ rgyas pos bzhugs dgos zhus kyang*/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bod du byon dgos par lung bstan pas/ nged phyogs med kyi rgyal khams su 'gro dgos pa yin gsungs nas ma bzhugs/ rgyal pos kyang gar bde bar bzhud la nged la smon lam bzang po thob cig gsungs/ de nas cong to mkhar nas mtshur phu'i bar du lo brgyad tsam mdzad nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ de'i sngon la nye gnas 'dan ma sgom chen rin chen dpal la gser dril rgyab bdun sogs bskur te/ mtshur phu lha chen sku tshad 'dom bcu yod pa bzhengs/ lha bzo ba 'phan yul na pak+shi bya ba yod/ zangs rag ram pa zangs khung nas thon bya ba dang*/ nyid kyang bod du mi ring bar 'byon pa sogs bod du 'byams yig chen mo gnang*/ 'dam cog rtse la nas gaṇajir mthong ba gyis gsungs nas brdzangs/ grub thob chen po nyid rgya yul hun ci mkhar du byon/ ma mo 'khrugs pa'i nad yams zhi bar mdzad/ rdzing dang khron pa chu mig thams cad byin gyis rlabs pas chu 'thung tshad nad gdon zhi bas thams cad dad nas mchod/ rgya bod sa mtshams shing kun gyi bar dang nye ba na rgya'i lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bstan pa rta mgrin dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad du bzhengs te rta skad bshugs glur bcas pas dam la btags/ rgya bod mi nyag yu gur sngon gar byon thams cad du nad yams chad/ 'khrugs rtsod zhi chos la bkod/ sar gnas sems dpa' bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la zhabs tog byed cing tshe bskal par thub pa rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis bskul nas gdan sa 'og mar sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku dang*/ thugs rje chen pos bskul nas gdan sa bar par rgyal ba byams pa'i sku rnams bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen dang zhal bkod mdzad/

de'i tshe nye gnas kyis mtshur phur mchod khang chen po'i dri gtsang khang khyams dang bcas pa brtsigs pas lha 'dres grogs byas te myur bar tshar/ lha bzo dang zangs rag ji ltar gsungs bzhin byung*/ lo gsum na lha chen po 'dom bcu gsum pa grub/ rgya gar du hor dmag gis gtsug lag khang zhig gi gaṇa ji ra dang gser gyi bya 'dab khyer ba cho 'phrul mang bas sus kyang bdag gir byed ma nus pa grub thob chen pos ltas ngan g.yang du blangs te rgya bod kyi mtshams ga chu'i 'gram du rdzu 'phrul gyis drangs kyang rten 'brel zhig gis bya 'dab g.yon pa las ma 'drongs par de nyid du mdzod nag chen mo da lta sus kyang reg mi nus pa zhig na yod/ phyis bya 'dab g.yon gyi chung ba de dum bu gnyis su byas te thog tu bkal/ rtser gaṇa ji ra chen mo gser bya khung gi gter nas byung ba'i gser bya gnyis bcas btsugs/ de'i tshe grub thob chen po nyid khams nas yar byon te cog rtse lar phebs/ dbus gtsang gi bla dpon che dgu thams cad kyis phebs bsu dang bsnyen bkur zhus/ tshogs chos chen mo gsungs/ zhwa nag gi bstod pa yang mdzad pas thams cad mi phyed par dad nas mtshan grub thob chen po 'ba' zhig tu sgrogs nye gnas sogs kyi nga rgyal bcog phyir/ cog rtse la/ gnam la/ sbrid la rnams nas rim par phebs skabs/ ma tshar ba e yin gaṇa ji ra ma mthong gsungs shing byon/ mtshur phur phebs tshe mchod khang yang chung*/ lha chung 'di 'dra ba gsungs nas bka' bkyon mdzad/ nye gnas dang lha bzo na re/ nyid rang lta bur ma song bas 'di las che ba blo khog tu ma song ba yin/ lar sa 'di yangs pa zhig yin na gaṇa ji ra cog rtse la bas thag ring ba nas mthong zhus pas/ da cher gtong thabs e yod gsungs/ de ma mchis lhag ma rnams la byams pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ rigs lnga bzhengs zhus pas/ shin tu mnyes te/ lha legs par grub 'dug khyed la nyams sad byas pa yin gsungs/

gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bre gang*/ rje sgam po pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i tshems/ rje mi la'i gsol zhal/ phyag mkhar skyer sgang pa'i snam sbyar/ sha ri'i bu dang mo'u gal bu'i lhung bzed/ mkhar gsil/ snam sbyar/ rje nyid kyi tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gnyis/ gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur po ti brgya lnga bcu/ tshogs dung dkar mo rgyangs grags sogs mtha' yas pa bzhugs/ lha gzhan bdun la'ang rje nyid kyi tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa re re sogs ring bsrel rnam bzhis gtams/ gzungs gzhug grub nas lha chen g.yon du cher yo ba lha bzo bas thabs med cing sdug bsngal ba'i tshe/ grub thob chen pos de 'dra mi dgos nga rlung sems rang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas bcos kyi khyod rang tshod gyis shig gsungs te/ lha chen gyi mdun du bzhugs te bum can bzung ste sku g.yon du yon por mdzad nas rim gyis bsrang bas lha chen tsheg tsheg zer nas yo 'grongs drang por gyur pa na/ lha bzo na re/ bla ma rin po che/ da ran/ da ran zhus pas shin tu legs pa byung*/ rtsa rlung bsgoms pa la yon tan de 'dra yod pa yin gsungs/ rab gnas la rgyal ba byams pa 'byon pa yod pas chos khri chen po brtsigs gsungs pas byams pa chos khri brtsigs gdugs rgyal mtshan gser 'phen dar po che bkra shis khra ring sogs chos khri nas mchod khang bar du khyab/ de'i tshe skal ldan rnams kyis rgyal ba byams pa gtsug tor dbu ri dang mnyam pa dang*/ la las chos khri de skus khyab pa'i na bza' khri las 'phyang bar mthong*/ la las grub thob chen po nyid sku lha chen las che bar der bzhugs karma pa grangs med pas bskor nas phyag nas 'thor ba mthong*/ thams cad mthun snang du grub thob chen po nyid sku sngar bas che ba zhig der bzhugs nas phyag nas mdzad pa dang*/ lha chen gyi drung na mchod pa mdzad pa dang*/

bla yel mthil du chos gsungs pa ste/ sku'i bkod pa gsum dus gcig la bstan pa dang gzhan yang du ma mthong*/ zla ba gcig tu me tog gi char dang spos dri sngon ma tshor ba rgyun ma chad/ lha chen dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du mtshan gsol/ rje dus mkhyen gyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang phyis rje nyid kyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i bkra shis lhun grub dang*/ byams pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ rigs lnga/ phyis thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang yig bcu'i khang pa mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang der bzhugs te bod yul na 'gran zla bral ba'i gtsug lag khang yin pas der rdog pa bzhag pa thams cad la ngan song med par chos rje rim byon thams cad kyis gsungs/ gzhan yang grub thob chen pos rab gnas mdzad skabs mtshur phu'i ri brag thams cad kyang rgyal ba sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du byin gyis rlabs/ khyad par so ring zam kha'i rdo ba zhig la ting 'dzin gtad 'od zer bstim pas der sku khrus gsol nas 'thung ba dang*/ zhag bdun tsam bskor ba byas na mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu'i sdig pa'ang dag pa dang*/ brag glo'i rta mgrin rdo rje srin po'i gzugs 'dra ba'ang byin rlabs pas/ mchod pa mos gus gsol 'debs byas na bdud bgegs/ nad gdon/ mdze smyo sogs sel ba dang*/ lha chen gyi phrin las kyang rgyun mi chad par je che je bzang la 'gro ba dang*/ snang ba dag pa la sku g.yo ba/ gsung thos pa/ 'od zer mthong ba/ 'bring la na tsha sdug bsngal rnam rtog zhi nas sdod 'dod pa sogs 'byung bar gsungs/ ma mgon lcam dral/ dam can/ brtan skyong*/ thang lha/ mkhar nag sogs kyang dam tshig dbang gis dkor srung yon bdag bgyid par rang dam bcas pas shin tu gnyan par yang shes par bya gsungs/ rjes btang rag mchod gtor mdzad skabs mgon po 'khor bcas kyis lha rten 'di rnams dang khyed kyi bya ba thams cad nged kyis bsgrub pa yin/

da dung ma 'ongs pa na khyed bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar len cing sems can gyi don mdzad dus kyang nged rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung zhing bya ba bsgrub gdul bya rnams thar lam la 'god gsungs ba gsan/ gzhan yang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ sa ra ha sogs bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gzigs snang 'byams klas pa sogs rnam thar chen mo las shes par bya/ grub thob chen po dgung grangs don gnyis bzhes pa me glang lo 'phags pa rin po che zhe gsum bzhes pa bod du phyi ma byon skabs gnam du mjal/ phyag dang bzhugs gdan mnyam por mdzad/ dus re zhig gi tshe chu rta lor mkhas grub o rgyan pa rin chen dpal zhes rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la chos dngos su gsan pa gsad pa gso ba dang dud 'gro la'ang sgom 'debs nus pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan gzhal du med pa de dbus gtsang gi 'gro don la byon/ than pa chen po byung ba la gar phebs su char babs phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad cing rong chen dang sil ma la nas 'byon par dgongs nas/ stag gru khar phebs tshe da res rin po che karma pa mjal dgos par 'dug gsungs nas gtsang po byang la byon/ chos rje karma pas kyang kye/ mtshur phu pa kha 'khyag nam langs/ grub thob o rgyan pa gnam sa gnyis kyi ka ba lta bu de 'byon zhing 'dug /gsungs nas grab yul cher byas/ o rgyan pa'i gsung nas/ karma pa'i grwa pa rnams brel ba byed 'dug cag mal gyis gsungs nas bzhugs cag mdzad/ yang byon te dbu ri brgal bar bzhugs nas/ mngon mkhyen e 'dug lta'o gsungs nas mtshan mo byon/ chos rjes mkhyen nas tho rangs phebs bsu btang ba byams pa chos khrir mjal bas o rgyan pa'i thugs rgyal dang po chag nang du phebs nas chos rje la gus phyag mdzad/ gdan bzang po bshams pa la bzhugs/ chos rjes/ khyed dpon slob rnams ngas dkrugs pa 'dra ba zhig bya'am gsungs mdzad par zhu gsungs/
