de ma thag rlung dang lta stangs mdzad pas khong dpon slob thams cad nyams 'ur nas bkrab pas/ da sdod gsungs te thugs rgyal gnyis pa chag /de nub khong dpon slob kyi tshogs mchod mdzad pa'i sha zan rnams khyis khyer ba ma tshor/ phyi nang sku drung du byon dus/ khyed rnams kyi tshogs rdzas khyis zos pa e tshor/ da lta bod na khyed bas grub thob che ba med ang gsungs/ de tsam gyi rlom pa mi bdog zhus pas/ 'o na khyod kyi a su ra'i brag phug tu blangs pa'i mgur de long dang gsungs der thugs rgyal rtsa ba nas chag /e o rgyan pa khyed sil ma la nas 'gro chis 'dug ste nga'i byang chub kyis sems kyis bkug pa yin e shes gsungs/ ka ṭo ra nas kyis bkang ba rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rba cag gis dkrug nas spyi bor bzhag ste dbang skur zhag gsum du gdams ngag mang po gnang*/ nyi ma nub phyogs nas zhwa nag po gyon pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs nas phyi ma'i sprul sku lung bstan/ bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams dang sku gsum ngo sprod sogs phyag dpe khyad par ba dang zhwa nag gcig rnams gtad de/ 'di rnams khyed kyis mgo 'don byed dgos pa zhig yong bas de la gtod/ khyed 'di nas lho phyogs su song dang 'gro don rgya chen 'grub/ nga dang myur du 'phrad do gsungs/ sku tshe 'dir zhag gsum las ma mjal yang pha bu 'phrad pa ltar gyur/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa yang de phyin rje rgod tshang pa dang tha mi dad pa'i rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ de rjes skyid grong gangs zhur mo'i phyogs kyi gnas bskor ba mang po 'ongs nas chos rje karma pa mjal ba la chos dang byin rlabs gnang*/ de'i nang du ston pa chos dpal bya ba snyoms chung zhig yod pa la/ khyod cung zad sdod gsungs/ zas gos gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad nas/ khyod la gnas tshang zhig g.yar dgos par 'dug pas de thong zhig gsungs/ ston pas ma go nas gzhan la bshad pas khyod rang gar sdod med pa la gnas tshang gar 'ong zer bzhad gad byas/

de nas lug lo zla ba dang por dpal mo dpal thang gi stod du rje mi la thod par bdud rtsi gsol zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na 'di nas phrin las 'byung ngo zhes ston pa gzigs te bstan bcos mdzad/ de phyin snga gzhis pa rnams gangs zhur mo'i mdun du song ngo*/ /zhes yang yang gsungs zla ba gsum pa nas brtsams te sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba yang yang byung*/ me tog gi char rtag tu bab pas/ ltas 'di dag dge 'am mi dge zhus pas byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs pa dang 'da' ba la rtags 'di lta bu 'byung ba yin shes sam gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ skye ba med kyang skye tshul ston/ /gnas pa med kyang gnas tshul ston/ /'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston pa'i phyir na/ dus gsum mdzad pa phrin las rgyun chad med pa'i kha chems sna tshogs dang 'chi rtags sna tshogs ston pa dang phyin chad ma 'ongs pa'i bye brag sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston par 'gyur ba'i phyir na rnal 'byor pa rang byung rdo rje rang byung karmā pa'i 'chi ba'i bye brag la nges pa med cing su'i yis shes/ zhes sogs rta lo tshun nas zhal gdams dang rjes su bstan pa zab rgyas gsungs pa rnam thar chen mor gsal/ dge 'dun rnams la gsungs chen pos khyed rang rnams zhu rgyu yod tshad zhus/ ma bde ba yod tshad dris/ rje dus mkhyen gyi gdan sa rnams kyi zhig ral gsos na bstan pa'i dar rgyas yun ring 'byung bar bka' brgyud gong ma'i lung bstan yod pas ngas kyang gdan sa 'di rnams la bya ba byas/ rje dus mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byas pa yin/ 'dzam gling gi bya ba bskor cig tshar/ nyi ma do nub nub kyang sang 'char ba bzhin re zhig 'di nas mi snang bar gyur kyang phrin las kyi dbang gis gdul bya dang mthun pa'i sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas pa zhig gnam nas bya babs pa bzhin myur du 'ong ngo zhes gsungs/ de nas chu mo lug gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la bsnyung ba'i tshul mi mnga' yang sku shad chung ba snyam byed pa la/

nye gnas rnams kyis drung du sku rim zhus pas/ ri bo mchog rab g.yo ba la ber gas mi brten kha rog 'dug la bsgoms shig gsungs/ yang*/ sprang po tshe 'di nyid nas 'das gyur kyang*//rtags ni nam mkha' dag la 'byung ba yin//lus kyi lhag ma sku gdung ring bsrel 'byung*//bar dor gnas pa'i rang rig rang gsal ba//chos sku dri ma med par mnyam gnas shing*//gzhan rgyud byin gyi rlobs par nus pa'i phyir//'gro don dpag tu med pa der yang 'byung*//rang cag chos sku dri med rtogs pa'i phyir//'chi la skrag pa rdul tsam yod ma yin//'pho bya 'pho byed rten dang bral ba'i phyir//chos kyi sku la 'pho 'gyur med do ang*//yang*/ dpon rin po che la/ sprul pa'i sku 'dir ma byon gyi bar du khyod kyis dge 'dun kun gyi rgan shos gyis la dgon pa'i ched gnyer dang grwa pa'i skyong bran gyis/ zhag bdun du gdung la ma reg gsungs te sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te chos kyi dbyings su zhugs par mdzad do/ /zhag bdun du gdung mchod phul/ tshes brgyad nyin gdung zhal bstan pa'i tshe/ slob ma mchog rnams kyis g.yung drung dmar po'i dbus su rigs lnga'i he ru ka sogs gar mdzad pa dang la las mchod rten/ la las dbyangs gsal yig 'bru/ la las chos rjes dngos su gsung byon pa mthong*/ la las dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod cing seng ge la chib nas nub phyogs la gshegs pa dang*/ lha'i mchod cing dga' ldan du byon pa dang*/ jo bo shākya mu ne la dngos su thim pa dang*/ 'bum thang gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kar thim pa sogs mthong tshul mtha' yas pa byung*/ skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du tshes gsum nas nyer bzhi bar nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis khengs/ rol mo dang*/ me tog gi char dang*/ dri bzang rgyun chad med pa byung*/ tshes bcu la sku gdung bzhus pas ngo mtshar mtha' yas/ thugs ljags spyan gsum lha sku mang po dang*/

yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan/ dung g.yas 'khyil sogs dang*/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon/ de'i nyin lha sa shun 'phrang na chos rje chibs pa dkar po chibs nas mgron po 'ga' la chos gsungs pa dang*/ stod lung mthil du chos gsungs pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab/ gdung dud kyi thad sor lha'i bu rol mo thogs pa mang pos bskor ba byed pa brag sgo dben pos mthong*/ gdung khang las 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas so//sku dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i slob ma'i tshogs ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rnam thar rnams su 'khod pa ni snying po'i don brgyud 'dzin pa mkhas grub o rgyan pa/ lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rgyal po mo gor gen/ rnal 'byor ye shes dbang phyug /nye gnas rin chen dpal/ rtogs ldan zhwa dkar ba/ zhwa ser ba/ zhwa dmar ba/ rtogs ldan g.yag mgo ba/ stag mgo ba/ gzig mgo ba/ gnam mtshor ras pa/ tre bo pha bong ras pa/ a ti yon tan grags/ mdog shākya byang chub/ e mye gnam thog pa/ de'i sras gzhon nu 'bum/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ spyan snga sta shod pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo seng*/ dpon rin po che/ a dbang ye shes/ tshad ma paṇ+ḍi ta/ rtse ra rdo rje grags/ gtsang pa 'dzam gling pa/ kheng ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rma bya ras pa byang brtson/ gzhon nu rin chen/ 'bu chung*/ byur chung*/ 'ba' tsha lo sgom/ ye dbang gnyis/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ g.yag ru ras chen/ bkra shis grags pa la sogs pa byung*/ de ltar 'di ni grub thob chen po'i rnam thar rags rim tsam zhig bkod pa ste/ dus gsum gyi rnam thar zab la rgya che ba rnam thar rgyas pa la gsal zhing*/ spyir ring bsrel can gyi tshems kho na'i rnam thar phrin las kyang bsam gyis mi khyab par tshems kyi rnam thar las gsungs pa dang*/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' theg pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyang rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang snying po'i don kho na la gzhol zhing 'bab par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos kyi rim pa'ang bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal nyis 'gyur tsam bstan cing de dag gi gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar mang po 'thor nas yod par gsungs pa la/

deng sang mi yul du snang ba la gsung rab po ti drug tsam las/ de byings rgyal ba'i gsung rab ltar/ dpa' bo/ mkha' 'gro/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs kyis yul du spyan drangs par don gyis gsal ba'i phyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas so// //

gsum pa chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar/ gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ skyid grong jo bo 'phags pa wa ti'i lho phyogs gangs zhur mo'i mdo len rde zhes bya bar/ yab sngon bkas gnang ba'i ston pa chos dpal dang*/ yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gyi lhums su zhugs pas yum kyang sngon ma myong ba'i dga' bdes nyin mtshan 'da' zhing dag snang mang*/ de nas yab yum de dag ding ri glang 'khor gyi nye skor du byon nas sru mo zhig gi khyim du bzhugs pa na/ shing spre'u lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la khang steng zhig tu yum la ma gnod par sku 'khrungs/ de ma thag tsog pur bzhugs/ zhal phyag gis phyis te zla ba la gzigs nas tshes brgyad kyi zla bar 'dug ang gsungs/ sru mo de rnam rtog za nas skyes ma thag smra ba 'di mi rung pas med par gyis zer/ yab yum gyis de 'dra gar 'ong gsungs/ snyigs ma'i sems can gyi blor mi shong par mkhyen nas/ re zhig gsung 'byon pa dang bzhengs pa sogs nus kyang ma mdzad/ bskal ba rgya mtshor bzod pa dang byams pa sogs tshogs gnyis bsags pa zla med pa'i phyir bu chung de sus mthong kyang ngo mtshar skyes nas/ mig bgrad ste e ma 'di rmi lam min na rung ste bsam zhing mchod pa dang snyan grags che/ dgung lo gsum pa la phying ba nag po la zhwa 'di 'dra ba zhig bzos shig gsungs te/ zhwa nag chung ngu zhig mnabs te rdo'i khri thog nas byis pa mang po la sku gsum ngo sprod gsung zhing sngon gyi de ma rjed par snang gsungs/ sna tshogs rol ba'i snang ba 'di dag kun//sgyu ma smig rgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du//snang yang bden pas stong par kho bos rtogs//ma rtogs byis pa khyed rnams snying re rje//zhes gsungs pa 'di tshigs bcad gsungs pa'i thog mar grags/ mngon mkhyen gyi thog ma yum gyi dar kha 'ga' zhig stor nas sems khral byas pa na/

khyod de tsam dar kha la dad na nga la mtshur phu na dar shing sgrom chen po du ma yod byin chog gsungs/ yab lug khyu mthong ba la brnab sems skyes tshe/ nga la khams na rta khyu yang 'di las mang ba yod pas byin chog gsungs/ yab kyis bdag gi sems mkhyen pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga ni rin po che karma pa'o gsungs/ sngon gnang sbyin dang bka' lung gnang ba dran te mig mchi ma 'don zhing zhabs la gtugs/ de phyin yab yum gnyis kas grub thob chen po karma pa dngos kyi mos gus byas gzhan la gsang*/ skabs shig yab lto chas 'tshol ba dran skabs/ 'o na grong pha ker 'gro'o gsungs te byon pas mang po 'bul mkhan byung*/ yab dga' drag pa dang chang gis gzi nas rin po che karma pa byon pa yin byas pas thams cad 'dus nas 'bul ba mang po byung*/ kun gyis byin rlabs zhus/ de dus sems dpa' chen po mkhas btsun gser khang pas mjal khong gis dris pas/ sngon du grub thob chen po 'da' tshul bstan ma thag rin po che'i khrir bzhugs pa la tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ rgyal po chen po bzhi sogs lha tshogs mang pos glu gar dang*/ gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo rnams kyis mchod cing dga' ldan du gdan drangs/ der dga' bde'i longs spyod rgya che yang*/ sems can rnams la snying rjes ma bzod nas slar mi yul du byon pas/ bu slob rnams kyis spur bzhus pa las byung ba'i sku gdung ring bsrel sogs dad pa'i rten rnams la mchod cing mos gus gsol 'debs byed cing 'dug /stod lung 'phar tshang na rgan rgon gnyis kyi bar na bu chung lo lnga drug tsam lon pa'i ro zhig bzhag nas ngu zhing 'dug /ro de la grong 'jug mdzad nas 'gro don byed dgos te zhugs nas spyan hrig hrig mdzad pa na/ shi mig gson la lta ba ltas ngan zer nas mig tu thal ba blug khab btsugs/ de nas dbang po nyams pa'i 'gro don mi nus dgongs te rnam shes thon nas/

kye ma kye ma 'di lta'i 'gro ba skal pa rab dman pa//log pa'i rgyun las bzlog pa'i thabs ni cung zad med gyur par//thub pas dgongs te thugs rje'i lcags kyus rings su spang gyur rnams//re zhig dus la bzhes par kho bos kyang ni da sdod rig/ces gsungs te/ 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la bzhugs/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma dang tshe ring mched lnga/ brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs 'ongs nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsol ba/ thugs rje'i mnga' bdag zhi la mi bzhugs par//brtse bas dag pa'i mi lus bzung du gsol//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung du gsol//nyam thag 'gro ba'i pha ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang*/ 'gro drug sems can snying re rje//'khor ba'i gnas na nyon re mongs//sems can 'gro don byed re ran//'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal 'di//cung zad bsam na mchi ma g.yo//bdag 'dras kyang ni mi phod na//brtse ldan khyod kyis phod dam ci//de phyir gsol ba 'debs su 'ong*//zhes zhu ba la/ 'khrul snang yin dgongs te der 'dzin bshig kyang ma song nas lan gsungs pa/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen len pa la//ma dag 'khrul pa'i ma gos pha ma med//sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'ang dus kyi dka'//nged kyis ma bzhin brtse ba'i sems 'chang yang*//rjes su 'dzin pa'i dpal dang skal yod nyung*//ma 'ongs byams pa'i dus su ngag bzhin sgrub/ /zhes dang*/ bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brag pas sra//nga rgyal ri bo gnam las mtho//'di la thos pa'i gzeng btsugs te//bsgoms pa'i sgyogs rdo 'phangs lags kyang*//'jig pa bas ser ka cung ma mthong*//'gro drug sku khams ci bder bzhugs//zhing skyong ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod//ces gsungs pas/ lha klu sogs thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ gsan dang rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku//lha rnams ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang*//lha ma yin 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal dang*//mi rnams skye 'chi sdug bsngal dang*//byol song glen lkugs sdug bsngal dang*//yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal dang*//dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal rnams//dran zhing bsam na glo snying 'dar//mi bzod tshor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis//shin tu nyam thag 'o dod 'bod//'di 'dra su yi bzod par nus//sangs rgyas bstan pa su yi 'dzin//'gro drug pha ma su yis byed//zhes sogs zhu ba la lan gsungs pa/

dal 'byor mi lus blangs sa med//mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed par dka'//snyigs dus mngal de grib re che//'das ma 'ongs kyi dran pa stor nas 'gro//sems can gyi 'gro don bya bar dka'//zhes sogs gsungs pas/ khong rnams kyis/ dal 'byor mi lus blangs ba bdog/mang yul bkra shis gung thang na//jo mo bkra shis g.yu chung ma// zhes sogs zhus/ thams cad kyis srog snying phul/ phrin las sgrub par khas blangs/ bkra shis brjod/ yab yum bstan pa sogs nas mthar shel gyi khang pa 'ja' 'od bkra ba'i nang du byon nas der yang sems can mang po'i don mdzad pa sogs mang du gsungs pa rnams byang sems gser khang pas phyag bris su btab pas rnam thar bar ma zhes grags pa byung*/ dag snang mang po gzigs/ yab kyis zhi byed phul/ skyid rong 'phags pa wa ti mjal tshe spyan ras gzigs dngos su gzigs shing byin rlabs/ dgung lo lnga pa la mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug o rgyan pa rin chen dpal mjal bar bzhed nas byon pas/ grub chen pa la chos rje zhal gzigs nas sang nga 'ong ba shes par gyis shig gsungs/ phyi nang de ring nga'i bla ma karma pa'i rnam 'phrul zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas bsu ba gyis gsungs/ 'ong kyang brtag dgos dgongs te khong rang gi gong du gdan mthon po zhig bshams te gal te nga'i bla ma min na 'dir sdod mi nus dgongs/ de nas tshogs pas phebs bsu dang bcas byon pa na/ grub chen pas nyams sad pa'i phyir gsang bdag gi ting 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan rung ma non/ phyag mi mdzad par khri chen po de la 'dzegs nas bzhugs/ khyod su yin gsungs pas phyag nam mkha' la brkyang ste/ nga ni ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'o gsungs/ 'o na sngon gyi mjal lugs shod cig gsungs pas/ la stod kyi jo btsun o rgyan pa//kho bo'i mdun du 'ongs nas kyang*//rgya gar shar nub kyi gleng mo gtong*//rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa byin//mkhyen pa dam chos kyi gleng mo 'chad//ces sogs gsungs/

khri las babs nas sngar nga bla ma yin yang da khyed kyis skyang du gsol gsungs nas phyag mdzad/ khyod nga'i bla ma yin na klog shes te 'ong pas thon gsungs nas dpe cha gtad pas/ la la ni thogs med du sha ra ra/ la lar tshag sdud ma byang ba/ la lar sbyar klog sna tshogs byung bas/ 'di las rgod bro ba'i klog mthong ma myong gsungs nas bzhad/ dgung lo dris nas nga'i bla ma lug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs pa yin/ khyod spre'u lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la skyes na bar na zla ba lnga las mi 'dug nga'i bla ma'i sku skye min 'dug gsungs pas/ ngas mngal gyi lus chags nas zla ba bzhi na rnam shes zhugs pa yin/ snga gzhis gangs zhur mdun na song tshar zhes yang yang byas pa ma gsan nam gsungs/ gzhan ci dran gsungs pas/ mngal du phyi rol gyi yul ma bsgribs par gzigs pa dang*/ yum gyis 'di skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'dug pas bu mor 'ong zer/ yab kyi rmi lam las bur 'ong zer ba gsan gsungs pas/ 'di brdzun rkyal zhig 'dug gsungs te yab yum bos gdong 'dzom mdzad pas kun yid ches/ rgya gar du sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang bod du khyod ma gtogs mngal gyi dri mas gtan nas ma gos pa gzhan byung ba med gsungs nga'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan rang byung rdo rje yin pas de ka 'dogs gsungs nas rang byung rdo rjer mtshan gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed gnang*/ zhwa nag dang sku gsum ngo sprod ngad la bcol ba 'di yin gsungs nas phyag tu gtad/ der dbang chos rgya cher gsan/ dgung lo bdun par khro phu shes rab kyis mkhan po dang de'i dbu che'i slob dpon mdzad de dge tshul bsgrubs/ 'dul ba gsan/ de'i tshe mtshur phu na grub thob gnyan ras pa la thugs rje chen po'i lung bstan/ la stod du grub thob pas dbang mdzad pa na bla ma bde mchog tu gzigs/ kha khyu'i la gong na byon skabs mi ngan mang po bsgugs pa mkhyen pa sogs mngon mkhyen du ma gsungs pas bla mas bkas bsdams/

spud trar mgon po ber can dang sngags bdag byung nas mtshur phur byon zhus bzhin phebs/ grong 'jug mdzad pa'i byis pa'i ma de bos nas mdzo gcig gnang bka' dri gnang bas sa zhig btab lags zer/ bla ma gnyan ras mjal skabs/ sa ra ha la bka' brgyud bla mas bskor ba zhal gzigs/ de'i tshe dam pa thams cad nges shes skyes kyang skal dman kha cig the tshom byas pa na/ brag gdong skam po zhig tu/ nga karma pak+shi yin na 'dir chu 'byung bar gyur cig gsungs pas/ de ma thag chu byung*/ yog pa phyed tshig pa zhig der btsugs nas/ nga karma pak+shi yin na 'di da lta skye bar gyur cig gsungs pas de ma thag skyais te sgrub chu dang sgrub shing du grags te da lta'ang yod/ bla ma yi dam sogs zhal gzigs mang rta lor sa g.yos byung skabs sku'i rtsa mdud phyogs med du grol chos thams cad rang sems su mkhyen pa la brtan pa thob/ lha mo dung skyong dang re ma tis bskul bas chos khrims gsar du mdzad/ sa ra ha mjal te do ha'i don rtogs/ bla ma gnyan ras la dbang chos rgya cher gsan par mdzad/ gnas brtan gzhon nu byang chub pas mkhan po/ mkhas pa dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'dul ba yongs rdzogs gsan/ slob dpon shes rab dpal/ rgya sgom ye shes/ slob dpon shākya gzhon nu/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don 'grub/ slob dpon tshul rin/ slob dpon gzhon nu 'bum/ slob dpon dzña na shrī/ bla ma ku ma ra dza sogs mkhas grub mang po yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas bod kyi yul du bka' bstan man ngag 'gyur ro 'tshal thams cad gsan par mdzad do/ /dam chos la gus pa dang bla ma med par rang bzos mi 'jug pa'i gdams ngag mig ltos su ston par mdzad/ thams cad tshar re gsan pa tsam gyis tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud kyang che chung dang brnyas thabs mi mdzad par nan tan mdzad/ sa ris kho na mdzad pas lcags smyug bdun zad par grags/

gsan yig gi chos kyi ming kho na'ang deng sang gi skye bo'i blor mi chug /tshal dpon dga' bde gshegs dus dge 'dun gyi gral dbur spyan drangs skabs g.yag sde pan chen pas mjal/ phyag ma byas par zhag shas brtags pas/ nyid dge bshes mtha' yas pa la mdo sngags kyi bshad pa dang mtshan dbang khrid rjes gnang*/ bar du gdul bya thams cad kyi don rlabs chen rnams dka' ba med par mdzad cing sku gsung thugs dal zhing lhod pa dang*/ chos kyi dka' gnas dris na de tsam dka' ba ma yin de bas 'di dang 'di zhes sngon thos kyang ma myong ba kho na gsungs shing mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan blo'i ra ba las brgal te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung*/ karma'i gdan sar byon nas bzhugs skabs bi ma la zhal gzigs nas nyid la thim pa byung*/ de phyin rdzogs chen gyi tshig don thams cad rtogs yig cha mdzad/ sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gong du phebs pa dang mjal nas gsung gleng mdzad/ lha steng gi khor yug gi nags tshal la me shor nas ci bya tol bral la bdag ni lhag bsam rnam dag dang ldan te/ sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams la tshogs bsags cing*//da ltar sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin gyur na//bden pa 'di yi bden tshig brjod pa'i mthus//me chen 'bar ba'i tshogs 'di zhi gyur cig/gsungs te se gol mdzad pas du ba las char babs te me zhi zhing sgrol ma zhal gzigs/ phrag dog can gyi sngags pa brgyad kyis phug par gshin rje bsgrubs nas mthu byas tshe/ dgra nag zhal gsum phyag drug sngags sgra sgrogs shing de'i rig sngags bzlog par gzigs/ phug pa dib pas thams cad shi/ gzhan yang cho 'phrul du ma byung bas 'khor bcas skrag ste bshags pa byas/ kha ba dkar por byon nas gnas yig mdzad/ sngon bai ro tsa na spyugs pa'i rgyal mo tsha rong de yin par gsungs/ kam po gnas nang du byon tshe rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis bsu ba byas/

kol te'i 'khrug chen sus kyang ma bzlum pa lha 'dre 'khrugs par gzigs nas ting 'dzin gyis bkug ste dam la btags pas 'khrugs rang zhir song*/ sgam por bla ma lha rje mngon sum mjal/ phyag chen gyi gzhan don 'byung bar mkhyen/ tsa rir byon skabs sogs dag snang zhal gzigs rgyun mi chad pa bgrang gis mi lang*/ chu glang lor gu ru las 'brel rtsal gyis lho brag nas snying thig gter nas bton pa'i shog ser phul/ tsa rir zla ba gsum du bzhugs te gsol ba btab pas/ o rgyan rin po che dngos su mjal nas dbang lung rdzogs par gnang*/ mtshur phur phyi nang gi gza' skar dus sbyor thams cad ji bzhin gzigs te rtsis kun btus mdzad/ mkhas grub g.yung ston sogs bu chen drug la snying thig gnang*/ so sos dbus gtsang khams rgya nag tu dar bar mdzad gsungs/ sa skya sogs su byon skabs dge bshes du ma dang chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad/ kun mkhyen dol po pa de skabs rang stong la dgyes kyang phyis lta ba khyad 'phags zhig rtogs par lung bstan/ kha ro'i lar byon skabs ha bo gangs bzang sang grang mo ma btang zhig gsungs pas hor zla bcu gnyis pa yin kyang sos tshad ltar byung*/ shing bya lo kong po'i gdan drangs pas byon nags mda'i phur mgon gnas 'debs pa yod par mkhyen nas 'gro gsungs par/ su yang mi thar zhus pas nyid kyi lam mkhan mdzad de byon pas thams cad dang*/ sgrub sde btab/ gnas shin tu grang yang dgun chu mi 'khyags pa dang me tog 'byung bar byin gyi rlabs pas da lta'ang de bzhin yod/ phyi nang gzhan gsum ji bzhin gzigs pas de'i bstan bcos dang zab mo nang don mdzad/ rgyal las gshin gyi gnas su gzigs te ngan 'gro dpag med drangs/ phrag ru gtsug lag bzhengs/ tshad ma paṇa chen gyis tsa ri ma mjal zhus pas/ tsa ri'i gnas kha bas mnan pas ngas bstan mi thub/ de'i mkha' 'gro bstan gyi gsungs/ cung zad cig na 'ja' tshon na bun 'dres pa nar byung ba'i khrod nas bu mo zhig glu len zhing byung ba la phyag dbang dang dar mdud gnang nas da song gsungs pas pha tshad du yal/

thams cad la chos rgya dkar po mdzad so chag phrang gi brag 'og mtsho chen po yod pas ri rtse nas bskor dgos pa de'i tshe bye ma'i sgang lam chen po byung ba nas byon/ zhag gnyis gsum nas lam med par mtshor 'gyur bas thams cad dad/ de nas dbus su phebs/ stod lung nyen phur rman chu ljags la bzhes nas sum gnyis chu phal pa red gsungs pa la/ mkhas pa shes rab yid ma ches pa la/ mngon du gsal bar mdzad pas yid ches/ bshags pa phul/ nga rgyal can rnams la rang rang gi rlom pa dang bstun pa'i ming nas 'bod bsngags pa mdzad snga phyir byung dang 'byung 'gyur yi ger bkod de gnang bas nga rgyal zhi nas snod ldan du gyur pa mang*/ tshal khams 'khrugs pa sdum/ de nas mdo khams su byon sog chur lcags zam btsugs/ 'jam dbyangs kyis lo gsum nas rgya nag tu 'byon dgos par lung bstan/ rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi gnad rnams mkhrol bltas bstan pas rnal 'byor snying 'grel mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gzigs nas chos dbyings bstod 'grel mdzad/ nor bzang gi bla ma bsten tshul yang yang dran nas kun bzang spyod pa'i smon lam mdzad/ yang phal chen zhing bkod kyi bstan bcos mdzad/ skyan du dgon pa lhun grub steng btab/ de nas hor rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung*/ de'ang se chen gyis lo so lnga/ tha mur gyis lo bcu gnyis/ hwa shan gyis lo lnga/ du yan gyis lo bcu gnyis/ go gan pas lo brgyad/ ra khyi phag gis zhag bzhi bcu/ gu thug rgyal pos zla gcig rnams rgyal sa rim par byas shing 'das/ thog the mur 'ja' yan du zhes bya ba sa sbrul lo rgyal sar thon nas lcags lug lor gser yig pa mgon po tshim ching sogs/ dbus su slebs pas/ chos rje kong po nas gdan drangs/ sa skya nas tshang gu'i gung kun dga' rgyal mtshan gung du byon pa dang mjal/ der chos rje gdan 'dren gyi 'ja' sa sgrags 'ja' sa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlobs kyis bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba/

bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa byang phyogs kyi rgyal po rnams la dar bar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs kyang ci rigs pa rtogs par yod 'dug /de rjes nas se chen rgyal pos kyang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang po brten zhing bkur bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sa cha 'dir dar byar byas 'dug pa kun la gsal mod/ nged kyis kyang bstan pa'i skyong bran legs par byed 'dod pa dang khyed thos pa mang po dang yon tan khyad par du 'phags shing bzang po du ma dang yang ldan zer ba thos pas mgon po la sogs pa'i gser yig pa rnams khyed len du btang ba yin/ gal te khyed snyad gzhan byas nas mi yong bar gyur na/ dad pa can gyi sems sun 'byin pa'i nyes pa dang rnal 'byor pa rang gi yul spong ma thub pa'i bag chags sa bon dri nga ba dang gzhan don phyogs med du byed par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam 'jig par 'gyur ba'i skyon dang*/ bstan pa la ma bsam par 'gyur ba'i sdig pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dka' thub sdug bsngal la ji mi snyam pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ nged kyi khrims lugs chen po'i 'ja' sa la log pa byas pa'i sgo nas nged kyi sems ma rangs par byas pa'i stobs kyis bstan pa byin po la gnod pa byas par mi 'gyur ba e yin de bas na nged kyis mgo byas sems can thams cad kyi don la bsams nas mgyogs par byon/ 'dir phebs nas bstan pa'i bya ba khyed kyi 'dod pa dang mthun par sgrub pa yin/ lug lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes bcu gsum la ta'i tu+u na yod dus bris/ zer ba dang*/ 'ja' sa'i rten la karma pak+shi la mong gor rgyal pos phul ba'i gser dam sogs phebs/ sa skya sogs bod kyi bla dpon rnams la swon chen dben rnams kyi bka' shog ni/ rgyal po'i lung gi /kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bde rgyal 'od du dben sha /ye shes dpal kun dga' rdo rje/

byang chub rgyal mtshan rnams la/ rgyal po'i lung gis/ bla ma karma pa gdan 'dren pa la mgon po la sogs pa 'di nas mngags pa'i gser yig pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gyis la/ rin po che karma pa gar bzhugs pa song na'ang khyed rnams kyis grogs dan gyis la gong du mgyogs par yong du chug /le lo dang 'dzol ba byung bar song na nyes pa khyed rnams la len te 'ong*/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ zhes zer ba 'dug pas gung kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis kyang*/ chos rje phebs pa'i zhu ba mdzad pa la zhal gyis bzhes/ gung sngon la byon/ chos rje'ang 'dam du byon skabs/ rgyal po la bar chad 'ong mi 'phrad par 'dug gsungs tshur phebs/ dgun mtshur phur bzhugs/ rgya nag tu byon pa la 'u lag stong tsho tsam dgos kyang*/ mi sde la gzan par dgongs rang rta rang mdzo mdzad nas chu spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la mtshur phu nas bteg nas byon/ mdo khams su phebs/ rgya nag nas bsu ba la/ ra dza ta tshe dben dang*/ zam bha'o gnyis slebs/ 'ja' sa ni/ rgyal po'i lung gi/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba/ nged kyis mgon po mngags nas khyed len du btang ba yin pa la/ nged kyi lung la log pa ma byas par yong gi yod zer ba thos pa'i don la/ ra dza ta tshe dben dang*/ zam bha'o gnyis mngags nas/ yi ge rten dang bcas pa bskur yod/ shing kun tu ma bzhugs par zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i khongs su pho brang du sleb par byon/ spre'u lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin ta'i tu na yod dus bris/ zer ba dang*/ lam yig zhing gi mi chen rnams kyi bka' shog tu'ang*/ rgyal po'i lung byon nas/ karma pak+shi rang rta la 'byon gin yod zer nas gser yig yong 'dug pas/ rang rta la rtswa chas byin/ bla ma chen po 'byon pa'i lugs bzhin mi dpon rnams kyis bsu ba gyis/ sogs/ zer ba 'byor/ mdo smad nas bzung*/

bsu ba dang*/ bkur sti chen po rim par byung*/ rgya bod kyi lam du 'gro don chen po'ang thogs med du mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la rgyal po gshegs par mkhyen nas sgrib sbyong cho ga mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen por byon/ mchod pa'i bye brag du mas phebs bsu byas/ rgyal bu rat+na shrī blon po dang bcas pas bkur sti chen po byas/ rgyal po btsun mor bcas la dbang mdzad/ rgyal bu la'ang bar chad 'byung bar mkhyen nas blon po la gsungs/ ti shrī chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis chos rje gdan drangs/ bzhugs gdan chos rje gong du bkur/ de rjes rgyal bu'ang gshegs nas sgrib sbyong mdzad/ de'i pho bo tho ga na thi mur zer ba rgya nag chen po sman rtse'i yul du bzhugs pa zla ba drug nas rgyal sar bskos na se chen dang mnyam pa rtsis pa rnams zer/ chos rjes kyang lung bstan/ bya lo la sme rtse nas pho brang chen por phebs pa'i bsu ba la/ mi bye ba phrag du ma 'tshogs pa'i khrom la sus kyang lam mi phyed pa la/ chos rje thugs rje'i bdag nyid zhwa nag gsol ma ṇi'i dbyangs mdzad cing byon pas khrom thams cad kyis phebs lam phye/ rgyal po chen po nyid gur chen mo'i mdun du byon nas phebs bsu dang gus pa chen pos zhabs la btugs/ rgyal po btsun mo blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis chos lugs su dbang khrid zhus/ 'jig rten lugs su gros dris/ chos 'jig rten gyi re sa thams cad chos rje rin po che la byas/ 'bul dang bkur bsti bsam gyis mi khyab/ skabs shig mi dpon 'ga' 'khrugs pa la/ chos rjes zhal ta gnang bas nyan/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la pho brang chen po shong tor rgyal po khri 'don byas/ shis brjod mdzad/ chos rje nyid der bzhugs ring rgyal khams bde ba'i khag khur mdzad/ nye gnas grags brtson bod du 'bul ba skyel bar brdzangs/

pho brang chen por yon mchod gnyis/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi gsung 'phros mang du mdzad/ shing khyi lor spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan pas/ bod la 'byon pa'i zhu ba mdzad pas/ re zhig byon nas lo gnyis nas 'dir pheb par zhu gsungs pa la zhal bzhes mdzad/ tshal pa si tu dge sbyong chen po la go bo shrī'i ming dang shel tham/ mtshur phu sogs karma pa la gtogs pa'i lha sde mi sde rnams dar rgan du phul/ bod spyi la phan pa'i 'ja' sa gsum/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i cha skyen sogs 'bul rdzong rgya cher mdzad/ mchod yon rten 'brel 'grigs/ 'gro don che/ sku khams bzang*/ bod spyi la dar rgan tshal pa la gnang sbyin sogs dang bcas yar byon/ lam du lha khang bzhengs/ btson bkrol ba/ 'khrugs pa sdum pa/ dbang bskur chos sbyin sogs 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ shing phag zla ba brgyad par 'dam du phebs/ phebs bsu bod kyi bla dpon kun 'dzom sar sku skyos la 'ja' sa gsum po bsgrags/ gzan cha chung*/ sku skyos che bas thams cad dad/ gser dngul gyis bstan 'gyur po ti brgya drug bcu bzhengs/ lha sa bsam yas sogs su byon mchod 'bul dpag med mdzad/ slar yang gdan 'dren gser yig snga phyi gnyis slebs/ bsam yas mchim phur zla ba drug bzhugs/ gu ru rin po che sogs zhal gzigs ni rtag par

'byung*/ tshe chu bton/ me byi lor slar yang gdan 'dren gser yig pa gsum pa slebs/ 'ja' sa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs la brten nas/ tha'i hor tha'i hu ded kyi e ji/ chos rje rin po che karma pa'i drung du/ na ning bla ma yar byon dus thugs dgongs bzang po'i sgo nas rang re la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po sgrubs nas myur du phyir 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ bla ma byon nas lo gnyis song ba la/ bla mas gsungs pa'i chos dran cing*/ bla ma la mos gus dang dad pa yod pa'i don la/ sngar yang gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa btang na yang*/ da bar du 'dir nam chags phebs kyi tshig kha gsal ma thos pa'i don la/ yang bla ma gdan 'dren pa la dge bshes don rin gyi mgo byas gser yig pa rnams btang yod pas/ rang re la bsams nas bstan pa'i zhabs thog la dgongs te myur du 'byon pa bla ma mkhyen/ gal te myur du ma byon par gsung thog tu ma phebs na/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i bu slob rnams kyi yi chad pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos la log pa rnams kyis thos nas/ khong lta bu gsung thog tu ma phebs na gzhan rnams gang na bden zer cing bstan pa la gnod pas/ gser yig 'di rnams sleb pa dang nged la bsams nas bstan pa'i zhabs thog dang sems can gyi don la dgongs nas myur du 'byon pa bla ma mkhyen/ yi ge gzigs pa'i rten/ nam bza' cha tshang ma gcig /gser bre chen gcig /mchod pa'i chas bskur bdog /byi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nyin ta'i tu nas bris zer ba phebs/ de nas bod kyi bla dpon thams cad kyis zhabs tog bkur sti bcas byi lo zla ba brgyad par 'dam du byon/ ti shri chen po'i lugs kyi skyel bsu dang rdzong ba gyis zhes 'ja' sa phebs kyang*/ gser yig pa'i cha rkyen ma rtogs gzan cha ci yang med par mdzad pas bod dang bod chen po'i mi dpon 'ja' mo thams cad lhag par dad/ rim par byon pas slar yang*/

gong mas mgyogs bskul zhu yig tu/ myur bor byon 'dir nyi ma snga phyi la'ang bla ma pheb pa la khyad che ba yin/ zer ba sogs 'byor/ glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la pho brang chen por byon/ pheb bsu sogs mthong bkur sngar bas kyang che/ rgyal po nyid kyang pho brang nang mī sgor bsu ba la byon/ /gus pas phyag dang zhal mjal gyi 'bul ba byas/ zhag mang por dbang chos mdzad/ skabs shig rgyal po/ blon po tha'i shrī/ chos rje rin po che ste yon mchod gsum gyis bstan pa'i skyong bran dang rgyal khams bde thabs kyi bka' gros rgya cher mdzad/ bsam yas nas bzhes pa'i tshe chu rgyal po la gnang*/ gser bre bzhi sogs 'bul chen mdzad/ dbyar than pa chen po byung*/ gong ma nas char 'bebs gnang dgos zhus pas/ char chen po babs/ kar sde du ma btsug /mtshur phu sogs dbus gtsang rnams la 'bul skyel yang yang brdzangs/ sa g.yos chen po 'byung bar mkhyen nas mchod yon thams cad thang du gzim gur mdzad nas bzhugs pas nyes skyon ma byung*/ rgya dang mdo smad kyi ban+de 'ga'i spyod ngan la brten nas chos mi dga' ba'i mi dpon rnams kyis dgon sde mang po bshig /btsun pa ngan pa rnams mi skyar phab khral dmag gi lung bsgrags pa la/ pho brang gi khrims ra chen po 'u mon gdong du bla ma mi dpon thams cad 'tshogs pa'i sar/ chos rje rin po che byon nas khyi'u la bzhugs te khyod rgyal blon rnams/ ti shrīs gtso mdzad/ nged chos pa rnams dbang med du bos nas/ 'dir bstan pa'i bya ba mi sgrub pa'i khar bstan pa bsnubs lugs 'di 'dra byed pa ci yin/ nged tsho tshe 'di'i lto gos ma phyis par khyed tsho la zhur yong snyam mam/ sngon gyi se chen rgyal po la sogs gong ma tshos bya ba nor nas da khyed tshos mchos pa yin nam/ rgyal po'i sku tshe dang rgyal khams kyi khag khyed blon po re re tsam gyis theg na khur/ nged thams cad bod du 'gro ba yin/

zhes sogs bka' bkyon mang po byon pas thams cad skrag nas lha khang rnams gsos/ ban+de bzang ngan thams cad dar rgan 'don pa'i 'ja' sa bsgrags/ bod chol kha gsum la dkar thog me tog lo gsum phyed 'jag gi 'ja' sa dang*/ de'i rgyab gnon chos rje'i bka' shog dang bcas pa bsgrags/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bla mchod gzhan thams cad la sbyin bdag dang sa cha'i zhal ta zhu rgyu 'dug /khyed la de 'dra med dam gsungs/ nged la'ang kong po'i rgyal khams mi khyim 'bum phrag tsam yod gsungs pas/ 'o na de'i mi dpon la nged kyis gnang sbyin sogs byed zhus pas/ de nged rang gis thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab nas chos kyis 'dul ba yin/ yul de mi dpon gyis 'dul mi nus gsungs/ slar yang nag phyogs kyi blon po ngan pas gnam mchod la gnod pa byas pas/ chos rje rin po che'ang cung zad thugs chad/ stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la rgyal blon kun 'dzom sar/ rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra gar 'gro mi shes pas rgyal pos gtso mdzad khyed rang rang gi chos kyi don sgrub par 'dod pa rnams myur du sgrubs shig gsungs kyang*/ bod du 'byon gsungs pa'i 'phro yin der 'byon dgongs pa yin 'dug bsam pa ma gtogs sku 'da' ba'i gsung du ma go/ sa yos lo than pa chen po byung ba la kun gyis char 'bebs mdzad par gsol ba btab pas char chen babs/ chu tshan khar sku khrus mdzad/ khu ba rnams 'khor slob skyel bsu dang bcas par 'thung ba na byin rlabs kyis nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa sogs rtags chen po mngon du gyur/ de nas pho brang shang tor ma phebs kyi bar du 'ja' tshon dang*/ me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ 'khor rnams kyis ci yin zhus pas/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gshegs 'dod pa yin 'dug gsungs/ pho brang du rgyal po/ dpon mo/ blon po'i tshogs thams cad chos kyi bdud rtsis char babs pas thams cad tshims par mdzad/

blon chen tha'i shrīs phyag 'tshal nas sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab kyang zhal gyi ma bzhes/ go bo shrī dkon mchog rin chen gyis chos rje gshegs na sku skye ba phyi ma/ yul khams gang du 'khrungs/ gang du 'byon yong*/ bdag kyang zhabs drung du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs zhus pas/ nged shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams dang nye ba shig tu 'dun pa gtod 'ong*/ khyed rang der 'dun pa gtod gsungs/ slob ma tshos zhal ta zhus pas/ chos la brtson par gyis/ bod kyi gdul bya kun la'ang*/ sngon phag lo nas byi ba lo'i bar sngar kha ta byas tshar dpon slob myur du 'phrad par bya'o gyis gsungs/ dgung grangs nga drug bzhes pa sa yos zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin ma phyed yol nyin bde mchog gi blos slangs la phyag bskor mdzad nas bzhugs te thal sbyar bcas bka' brgyud bla ma dang yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang po byon 'dug pas/ mchod pa phul gsungs/ chos rje nyid kyis bde mchog gi bdag 'jug bzhes par mdzad nas bdud rtsi phyag mchod gnang*/ bdud rtsi de kun la drongs gsungs nas thams cad la bkye bar mdzad/ bde mchog gi rtsa sngags gsung bzhin ḍā ma ru dkrol te/ rnal 'byor nga zhing khams gzhan du 'gro bas khyed rnams chos la brtson par mdzod/ ces gsungs te de nyid du gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/ sang tshes bco lnga'i dgong mo zla ba shar pa'i tshe zla ba'i nang na chos rje rin po che zhal bstan pa sgo srung gis mjal bas/ rgyal po'i nyan du gsol gzhan rnams la sbran pas rgyal blon sogs phal cher gyis mjal/ rgyal pos de lta bu'i thang sku bzhengs nas rang byung zla zhal ma zhes sku dngos dang byin rlabs mtshungs par byed/ de skabs bod du rtogs ldan grags seng bas kyang zla ba'i steng du chos rje phar tshur bzhud par gzigs shing rtse lnga'i slob dpon seng ge sogs sgom chen nyi shu tsam dang*/

sngon nyid nas srog bskyabs pa'i sog po dpon g.yog gsum dang*/ sngong hud dpon g.yog rnams so sor mjal tshul mi 'dra ba re re bstan pa byung*/ gdung zhag bcu bzhir rgyal po'i 'byor ba chen pos mchod/ de nas tsan dan dang a ga ru nag pos sangs rgyas dang 'khor lo brgyud rgyal gyi gdung ltar sbyangs/ 'ja' tshon gyi nam mkha' khyab pa'i gseb nas chos rje'i sku mang du snang ba phal cher gyis mthong*/ tshangs bug tu bde mchog /smin mtshams su chos 'byung bsnol ma yi ge lnga dang bcas pa/ srin mdzub la thugs rje chen po sogs lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan du ma dang*/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha dog lnga ldan dpag tu med pa byon te rgya hor mi nyag gi yul thams cad du mchod pa'i zhing mchog tu gyur to//slob tshogs ni/ nyid kyi bla ma kun kyang gus pa tshad med pas chos tshur gsan pa dang*/ gsang ne'u gung gsum/ chos bde zur gsum sogs kyi gdan sa pa snga phyi dang*/ zhwa dmar grags seng*/ mkhas grub g.yung ston pa/ o rgyan pa'i sprul sku/ grub thob bsam rin/ bram ze mgon po/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal/ rgyal ba ri khrod ba/ rtogs ldan kun gzhon/ phug po che/ lha rje rnam gnyis/ chu sgom pa/ kho ye dge slong*/ khu yor rtogs ldan/ rtogs ldan khrag skyug /rtogs ldan tre ho/ rtogs ldan kre bo/ hor rtogs ldan/ rdza ras gnyis/ ye rgyal/ lha phu ba/ bla ma dar zhwa/ rtogs ldan dbang bzang*/ rtogs ldan mgon ye/ nye gnas dge 'dun dpal/ nye gnas ye rgyal/ stag zhig ras pa/ nags mgo rin 'byung*/ dwags po shig nad pa/ rtogs ldan lha ras pa/ gtsang pa tshul mgon/ shākya rdo rje/ a brag chos rgyal/ tshong dpon yon rgyal/ gzhon nu 'bum/ shes rab rin chen/ rdzogs chen pa tshul blo/ he ru ka pa/ ldong ston gzhon nu/ rdo rje rin chen/ zha lu dharma pa/ bla ma dar 'byung mkhan rdza par ba/ mkhan gro mo/

bla ma shes don/ rgyal sras kun byams/ slob dpon 'jam nyan/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mngon pa ba/ sman lung pa/ go shrī dharma rā' dzā/ rta rna gsod rin go shrī kun rgyal/ ta'i dben go shrī/ tshal pa si tu dge sbyong chen po/ gling drung pa/ rgya ston kun brtson/ ne ring ba shākya mgon po/ g.yag sde pan chen/ mkhan po mkhas btsun sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i khyu chen po dang*/ stag lung kun spang*/ kun mkhyen dol po/ g.ya' bzang ba/ dus 'khor grags seng*/ rngog seng ge sogs chos kyi 'brel ba'i skyes chen mang po ste/ gzhan yang dwags kong*/ dbus gtsang*/ mdo khams sogs yul gru mang po'i dben gnas dag na/ 'dir chos rje rang byung pas lo gsum dang bcu gnyis sogs bzhugs/ zer ba sogs yul gru re re na yang mtha' yas par snang bas thun mong gi sku che'i mthong ba dang shin tu ma mtshungs pas sku'i bkod pa kho na mtha' yas pa zhig bstan par snang zhes kun mkhyen dharma ka ras gsungs/ sgrub brgyud kyi slob ma la bltas na khrid kho na bskyangs 'dra/ mkhas pa'i slob ma la bltas na bshad pa kho na mdzad 'dra/ grub gnas tsho la bltas na sgrub pa kho na mdzad 'dra/ bstan bcos la bltas na thugs rtsom kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba blos gzhal dka' ba kho na'i phyir slob ma'i grangs sogs 'di tsam zhes tshad 'dzin pa su zhig gi nus/ ma 'ongs drug pa seng ge'i mdzad pa bstan nas kyang*/ snang mdzad kyi bar du sprul pa rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ mgon po kun tu gzigs pa'i zhing du'ang 'byung zhing*/ nyid kyi 'khor dang zhing khams sogs kyang de dang mtshungs par dngos dang shugs nas rje 'dis lung bstan par snang ngo*// // bzhi pa chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bzhi pa chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar rags rim ni/ pho brang shong tor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas 'dzam gling la gzigs te skad cig gis dga' ldan du lha'i drang srong legs skyes su gyur pa na/

rgyal ba byams pas khyod 'dzam gling du skyo bar ma byed par da dung sems can gyi 'dren pa la song zhig ces su lung bstan pa dang*/ de ma thag tu 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don bya dgos dgongs tshe/ rta mgrin sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bdud rtsi drangs shing rab gnas mthor ba'i gzigs snang sogs dang bcas/ sum pa'i yul lho lung chen bco brgyad dang mi ring ba rngod a la rong du yab bsod nams don 'grub dang*/ yum brtson 'grus rgyan zhes gzhan snang du skye bo phal pa dman pa'i tshul bzung ba las lcags 'brug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ de ma thag tsog pur bzhugs te yig drug dang dbyangs gsungs pas yab the tshom/ yum gyis nga la nyi zla khong du chud pa dang*/ nyi zlas phrag pa brgyan pa dang*/ chu chen la zam pa btsugs pa sogs kyi rmi lam dang*/ dngos su skabs 'gar lus rang dbang med par 'phar ba sogs ngo mtshar mang bas the tshom mi dgos gsungs/ lte ba bcad tshe dri bzang gis yul khyab pa byung*/ dgung lo gsum par yum la/ nga karma pak+shi yin 'dzam gling na gdul bya mang du yod pas 'ong ba yin ltos shig 'chi med 'khrul 'khor bya'o gsungs nas mdzad/ ngas khyod kyi khog tu 'di ltar byas pas khyod 'phar ba dang hub bo ba yin/ zho kha brag phyi nags phu rnams su phyin nas lta dgos/ gshin rje dong kha'i 'og na dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod pa nas sems can mang po 'dren dgos pa yin/ 'di rnams da dung pha la ma bshad gsungs/ khyed karma pak+shi yin na rang byung rdo rje min nam zhus pas/ de gnyis gcig yin nga'i zhal mthong ba la yang ngan song med/ da dung rgyal po'i pho brang gi bar du 'gro/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa gdul rgyu yod gsungs/ skabs shig yum gyi mig la ling thog byung nas smre ngag ston pas/ mig zhar dog med/ khyod ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin/ gzugs ngan yang bzod/

nges gnas g.yar ba la bzang po ma rnyed pa min/ sang phod da tshod khyod la phyag 'tshal ba mang po 'ong*/ byi ba lo nas kho bo la gdul bya chen po yong*/ zhes sogs gsungs/ yang*/ dwags lha sgam por 'gro dgos nga'i gdan sa bar pa yin/ bka' brgyud kyi pho khrom yang der bzhugs gsungs nas byon/ mchod khang du yab la khyod kyi 'di rnams zhal mthong ngam gsungs/ ma mthong ji ltar lags zhus pas/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'dug gsungs/ 'ba' nang du chu phran zhig la yab kyis khur nas byon pas/ de ring rang re dbyug brdung 'ong sar 'gro ba e yin gsungs/ yab kyis khar thal ba thob zhus/ 'bri khung dpon skya sogs mang po yod/ sngags pa gcig gis mo btab pas dgra mi yong zer/ tho rangs kha dgra byung nas mang po brdung*/ khal ma dang chas ka 'phrog pas/ dpon skya na re/ bu chung bden par byung zer sha zhig byin/ dgung lo lnga par nags phur byon dus chos rje gong ma'i dus mchod byed pa dang 'dzom pas/ khong rnams nga'i mchod pa byed zer nas rang re la ci yang mi ster bar 'dug gsungs/ gcig gis khyed karma pa yin na bla ma kun dga' byams pa 'dir nam byon zer/ kun dga' byams pa byon rgyu 'dug pa ma mthong rus thum zhig byung 'dug gsungs pas/ mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ khyod rang byung rdo rje yin na 'dis mi gnod zer nas dom gyi khar 'phangs pa na/ dom des zhabs la lces ldag pa byung*/ mtsho rdzing 'di o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnas yin zhabs rjes yod/ der 'gro zhag gsum sdod gsungs nas der byon nas zhabs rjes bstan/ ngas kyang byas na 'di 'dra 'ong*/ da lta dus la ma babs gsungs/ brag gsum du dkar dar zer ba zhig gis/ khyed karma pa yin na nga'i khang pa'i sgo shes sam zer/ shes gsungs nas gzhan gyis ma bstan par de'i khang pa'i sgo mkhyen te nang du byon pas/

kho shin tu dad nas bsnyen bkur byas rta gcig phul/ 'bul ba snga ma byed pa 'di yin par grags/ nad pa zhig ces kyang ma phan pa la byin rlabs mdzad de zhag nyer gcig na phan gsungs pas de ltar gyur/ skabs shig yab dang a gu rang yul du song bas yun ring 'gor su la dris kyang ma tshor zer bas yum dang sring mo mya ngan byas pas/ zhag bzhi nas sleb yong mya ngan mi dgos gsungs pas der slebs/ nad pa du ma la byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis phan pas thams cad ngo mtshar de nas rtogs ldan ye rgyal dpon slob kyis mjal te nags phur 'byon par zhus pas/ da lan mi 'gro rjes nas rta ba mang po byas nas dar phyar dung 'bud cing yong ba yin gsungs/ phyis de kho na ltar byung*/ dgung lo drug par brag phyi lha khang du byon nas/ chos rje rang byung pa'i sku 'dra la phyag rgya mdzad de phu bo khams bzang ngam gsungs gzhan rnams la phyag mdzad cing*/ phyag dang zhe sa'i mchod pa 'bul gsungs/ 'gro mgon la/ khyod kyi lag na nga'i zhwa dang zhabs rjes yod khyer shog gsungs/ med zhus kyang ma gsan par jo bo'i zhabs rjes phul pas/ 'di min nga rang gi de khyer shog gsungs/ der dbu zhwa dang zhabs rjes phul nas zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas/ de'i sang 'gro mgon la/ nga su yin shes sam gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa yang nga yin/ karma pak+shi nga yin/ rgya yul du phyin nas hor btul ba yang nga yin/ da rung 'dul 'phro yod/ sprin gyi mthong nas bstan pa yang nga yin/ nga'i bla ma stong pa nyid yin/ khyed rnams kyi bla ma nga yin nga la sprul pa gsum yod/ gcig byang sems blo gros rin chen gyi drung na yod/ gcig shar phyogs mngon dga' na yod/ 'dzam gling 'dir nga rang yong ba yin/ zhes sogs gsungs/ de ltar lags na rnam thar zhig gsung par zhu zhus pas/ bar do'i rnam thar gong du smos pa rnams gsungs/ gcig gis zhal du legs par bltas pas/

ltos shig ltos shig nga la ltos//da res mthong ba don ldan yin//dmus long rnams kyi dpal du shar//sangs rgyas bstan pa nub nas shar//gsung yi ge drug ma'i nyi ma shar/ /gsungs/ sngags pa dkon skyabs zer ba zhig la/ khyod kyis nga la zangs zhig gi nang du mar bcug ste phul ba dran nam gsungs/ des cung zad bsam blo btang nas/ khyed la phul ba mi dran chos rje rang byung rdo rje la lung pa 'di'i mda' nyi zla thang du zangs dang mar zhig phul de lags sam zhus pas de ka yin mod gsungs pas dad/ yon bdag mgon po'i khang par byon nas lung bstan du ma gsungs/ khyod kyi nga la gos shig phul gsungs/ sang phod 'bul ba lags zhus pas/ sang phod nga la 'bul mi mang po yong gsungs pas 'phrug phyam zhig phul/ dgung lo bdun par lkog 'phrang du 'byon par zhus pas/ yab dang khu bos mi 'gro zer ba la/ 'gro bas chog rta mang po 'bul mi yod gsungs pas de bzhin byung*/ me tog gi 'dab ma zhal du brlan te zhal tshom ltar mdzad nas karma pak+shi la 'di 'dra ba yod pa yin gsungs/ sras po lhun grub la/ nga'i zhwa nag khyod la yod khyer shog gsungs/ med lags zhus pas yod khyer shog gsungs/ sngar yab kyi rta brgya 'bul sogs byas dus gnang ba'i byin rten dbu zhwa de phul bas/ dpal sa ra ha'i dbang zhu yin pas thams cad long la phyag 'tshol gsungs/ dbu la bzhes nas chos gsungs pas thams cad dad/ de nas snyan grags pas khyab ste/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal dang*/ tshal bas ja 'dren sogs byung*/ mtshur phu/ ba yo lkog phrang*/ nags phu/ karma sogs su gdan 'dren kha ma 'cham pa na/ lkog 'phrang du 'gro gsungs nas byon/ me chen po bus pa'i drung du bzhugs nas rgya yul gyi tshad pa 'dra gsungs/ bde bar gshegs skabs zla ba'i steng nas zhal bstan pa lags sam zhus pas/ nga'i snying rje dang khong rang rnams kyi dad pa la brten nas mthong ba mang po byung 'dug

/de'i tshe hor sog rnams 'di ltar byed 'dug gsungs nas/ dbu zhwa phyag g.yon du bzung pus mo btsugs/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mos zla ba ston pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ de nas bzhugs gdan du bzhugs nas/ zla ba'i steng na 'dug pa yang nga yin/ seng ge'i steng na 'dug pa yang nga yin/ zhes sogs gsungs*/ nged rnams la thugs rjes gzigs nas mi bzhugs par gshegs pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga la bsam pa bzang po yod kyang*/ snyigs dus sems can gyi bsod nams la mi 'grub par 'dug gsungs/ gzhan dga' ldan du byon tshul yang gsungs/ der phud cig drangs te/ dga' ldan na phud yod lags sam zhus pas myos byed kyi chang med/ lha'i bdud rtsi yod gsungs de nas co 'dri'i zhu phod cung zhig zhus te/ lha'i bdud rtsi nag po de bzang zer ba

'dug /de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ bdud rtsi nag po'am de ngas ma mthong*/ dkar po 'o ma lta bu ro mchog sna tshogs bro ba yin gsungs*/ dga' ldan na rang re mi yul gyi mchod pa'i yo byad gdugs la sogs 'di 'dra med 'gro zhus pas/ bla ma pa mi yul gyi 'dod yon kun g.yas chung*/ dga' ldan gyi me tog re re la'ang lkog 'phreng tsam yod de la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa yin gsungs/ yang*/ rang re mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po tsam gyi chu yang med/ kong po gsang dang rta mchog gi khang pa 'dra ba yang med zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyi rang re mi yul gyi sgyed rdo ring mo can 'di 'dra'i rdo legs po yang med pa 'dra zhus pas/ bla ma pa/ dga' ldan gyi chu thams cad bdud rtsi yin/ mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba min/ dga' ldan sa rdo 'di 'dra med/ sa rdo thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ byang sems blo gros rin chen gyi pho brang ngam/ sum cu rtsa gsum na rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sogs lha yul gyi gzhal med khang rnams rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yin/ mi yul gyi mkhar khang 'dra ba g.yas chung gsungs/ yang*/ dga' ldan na rta rag pa 'dra ba'i rta bzang po yod dam zhus pas/ chos la dus tshod med na ban rgan 'chol pa yin de la mdzod gsungs/ de nas rtogs ldan mgon rgyal gyis dbang chos mang du phul/ yon tan rin chen gyis zhib chang phul skabs/ khyed rnams nyon/ nga'i pha byams pa mgon po yin/ sems can la phan phyir 'ong ba yin/ zhi ba byas na dus gsum mkhyen pa yin/ drag po byas na karma pak+shi yin gsungs/ yang*/ nyid kyi sku'i rim gro la ci 'dra byas na 'thad lags zhus pas/ nga'i rim gro bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ gu ru pad+ma rnams kyis byed cing yod/ khyed rang rnams kyang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs rim gro byas kyang 'gal ba med gsungs/

rigs gsum mgon po rta mgrin/ gu ru rin po che sogs zhal gzigs ni mtha' yas/ skabs shig /nga karma pak+shis lung bstan pa yin/ khyed rang rnams sgrub pa gyis/ zhwa nag po can la mos gus gyis gsungs/ /yang dbu la phyag mdzub gtad de/ /nga ma brjed par gyis gsungs/ yang phyag mdzub spyan g.yas pa la gtad nas cis kyang ma brjed par dad pa dang mos gus gyis gsungs/ dbyar zhig than pa chen po byung*/ char 'bod mang pos char ma phebs te/ slob dpon sgom rin sogs dang yul mi rnams kyis char 'bebs zhus pas/ yan lag bdun gyis gsungs nas byas pas/ de tshar ba dang*/ nga karma pak+shi'i skye ba yin na zhag gsum gyi nang na char chen po 'bab par gyur cig /ma yin na char 'bru gcig kyang 'bab par ma gyur cig gsungs pas char chen po babs/ tshogs 'khor gyi gral du rin brtson gyi lta sgom spyod pa'i mgur zhus pas/ dben gnas ri khrod 'grim pa la//mtha' brgyad bral ba'i lta ba gces//'pho 'gyur med pa'i sgom pa gces//sna tshogs lam khyer spyod pa gces//zhes gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu par/ slob dpon gu'i gung ba la/ rtogs ldan grags seng gshegs pa e yin zhes yang yang gsung ba la/ de 'dra mi gsungs par zhu sku khams bzang ba lags zhus pas/ sku khams e bzang cha med nga'i snang ba la 'das snyam pa byung gsungs/ de skabs gnas nang du rtogs ldan grags seng sku gshegs/ rin brtson gyis gdan 'dren zhus pas ma phebs pa la kho ngus pas/ ma ngu rang gi sems la ltos//kha dog gzugs su grub pa med//sna tshogs ma nges cir yang char//bden med rdzun med glod la zhog /gsungs/ yang*/ zang zang ne ring pa'i zhu yig lan du/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs na lta ba yin//snang stong zung 'jug rtogs na sgom pa yin//gang shar dbyings su rtogs na spyod pa yin//rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs na 'bras bu yin/ /gsungs/

rtogs ldan ya rgyal/ dge bshes blo gros sogs kyi nges don zhus pa la/ dang po'i tha mal shes pa 'di/ /chos sku yin par shes par mdzod/ /ces sogs dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsum rnams zhus pas/ rdo rje'i gsung tshigs su bcad pa mkhas pa rnams kyi dran pa'ang dka' ba kho na gsungs/ de nas rtogs ldan ye rgyal las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa sogs/ chos mang du gsan/ gzhan yang*/ bla ma shes rab dpal/ slob dpon blo gros seng ge /slob dpon ston sngon sogs la/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi gtsos mtha' yas pa gsan/ re zhig bla ma mgon rgyal bas/ rtsed mos grub thob 'ong ba lags sam zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po ma bsgom kyang*//mtha' bral ngang la gnas shing gda'//gtum mo'i gdams pa ma bsgom kyang*//bde chen sems la 'char zhing gda'//zhes sogs gda' bdun dang*/ 'ong ba brgyad kyi mgur sogs gsungs/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi zhal gzigs grangs med/ zab don thams cad mngon du gyur pas rdo rje'i mgur mtha' yas/ dgung lo bcu gsum par mtshur phur gdan drangs pas lam du 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ bla ma mkhas grub pas chos kyi dri ba'i yi ge zhig phul nas/ 'di'i lan cig gnang rogs zhus pas ci yang mi gsungs/ phyag 'tshal nas yang yang zhus pas/ 'di'i lan khyod la lhas lcang thang du btab tshar gsungs pas/ dad pa bla lhag tu skyes nas zhabs la gtugs shing mchi ma shor the tshom zad/ si tu byang rgyal gyis bkur sti chen po byas/ ta yis dbus gtsang bdag nas lo bzhi par grags/ lha sa'i jo bo mjal/ dag snang dpag tu med/ gung thang du dge sbyong chen pos spyan drangs/ da ni rgan po shi yang sems lhag med gsungs/ gnas nang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bsu ba byas/ mtshur phur phebs/ rgyal ba sras bcas bka' brgyud bla ma mtha' yas pa zhal gzigs/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar mngon du gyur/

mkhan rin po che don 'grub dpal dang*/ slob dpon bsod nams 'bum las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes gsol 'dul ba sogs mang po gsan/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams yang yang gzigs nas mgur gsungs/ rnal lam du a tsa ra mang po byung ba/ chos rje nyid chos skyong du byas te gri gug gis de rnams rke bcad pas mgo rnams sdig sgra dang bcas nas 'gril ba byung*/ nad yams yod pa chad/ bla ma dar rgyal la/ ngas sgom chen rnams dge sbyor ci byed bltas pas/ khyod 'di 'dra byed 'dug /gzhan rnams kyang de dang de lta bu byed 'dug sogs zhib par gsungs/ yang rnal lam du bde ba can du byon/ tshe dpag med kyi bum pas dbang skur ba byung*/ phung po ri bo che nas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug chu brod rgod sgros bcad kyang mi 'bo zhing nus mthu pad 'byung dang phyogs mtshungs pa rgyal ba g.yung ston pa gdan 'dren du btang pas byon/ chos rjes zhag mang por zhi khro'i lha tshogs skar tshogs ltar mngon du gzigs/ nga rgad por song yang chos rje gong ma sku drin che ba la bsam nas thag ring po nas 'ong ba yin pas/ chos rjes gong ma kun gyi yin lugs shig gsungs par zhu gsungs pas/ chos rjes/ rje dus mkhyen dang*/ chos rje gong ma gnyis kyi dus ni gsal sing nge ba mi dran par 'dug /nga karma pak+shi'i dus su rgya mtsho la thug gi bar gyi hor dang sog po sogs gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams gang la gang 'dul bgyis nas thams cad dbang du bsdus nas zil gyis mnan pa kun ni legs par dran gsungs pas/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pas chos rje'i zhabs la 'jus nas bshum/ bla ma 'di'i drung nas dbang chos dpag tu med pa gsan/ nub cig bya khyung du sprul nas dga' ldan du byams mgon mjal/ de'i drung na lha'i bu dri ma med bya ba zhig 'dug /khyod su yin byas pas/ nga grags seng yin zer/

sa tshod gar sleb byas pas/ sa dang po pa yin zer gsungs/ gzhan yang o rgyan/ ri bo ta la/ bde ba can sogs byon nas chos gsan pa dang de dag gi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba dang*/ rgya gar gyi grub chen mang po dang*/ bka' brgyud gong ma mang po mjal nas chos gsan pa sogs mtha' yas/ skabs shig byams pa'i drung du byon pas byams pa'i zhal nas/ 'dzam gling nas 'dir 'ong tsa na rin po che pad+ma las brdzus te skye ba yin gsungs/ de skye ba'i pad+ma de nges pa zhig bya dgos dgongs te 'dun pa gtad pas rin po che'i pad+ma kha dog rgyas pa'i rtsa na 'dug /'dun pa de gal che 'dug gsungs/ bla ma dar rgyal la khyod la da lta'i snang ba 'di cir snang gsungs/ sgyu ma rmi lam lha sku gang dang gang bsgoms pa der snang*/ dran pas ma zin tshe snang ba rang ga ma 'di kho na gda'/ nyid la ji ltar snang zhus pas/ kho bo la dus rtag tu chu zla ltar gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang nas dag snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu yod pa yin/ 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la kho bos gcig tu bsdad na legs snyam pa 'dug ste/ kho bo rgyal khams thams cad du 'gro dgos pa zhig yin/ kho bo gang dang gang gis mthong ba dang thos pa thams cad kyang dga' ldan nam bde ba can du 'dren pa la the tshom med pa yin gsungs/ mnal lam la dbang 'byor pas/ phyag dpe gzigs bzhed pa'i po ti mang po zhal phye ste sku 'khris su bzhag /mnal lam du gzigs pas mnal sad dus thams cad thugs su chud pa 'byung*/ mnal lam du rigs lnga'i zhing sbyong mdzad pa sogs dag snang zhal gzigs skad cig re re'i gzigs pa'ang bgrang bar mi nus pa 'phags chen rnams kyi chos nyid yin 'dug cing rnam thar du 'khod pa ni mtshon pa tsam du zad/ chos rje nyid kyis/ dang por phyogs bcu re rer lus kyi bkod pa bcu bcu bkye/ des sangs rgyas bcu bcu la chos mi 'dra ba bcu re nyan pa la sbyangs pas dang po ni dka' ba ltar byung*/

'bad rtsol skyed pas myur du 'byongs te/ da lta ni phyogs bcu re rer yang lus kyi bkod pa grangs med 'gyid cing sangs rgyas grangs med mchod chos grangs med 'dzin pa la dka' ba med/ mdor na nga'i rmi lam sprul bsgyur dang*/ sgyu ma shin tu byang bos sgyu ma ston pa la khyad med pa yin gsungs/ rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas te tha na yig rigs kho na'ang drug cu tsam mkhyen par gsungs/ phal cher mnal lam gyi rtsal kho nas mkhyen pa shas che/ rgya nag gong mas dbus 'gros slebs nas dris pas/ tshal pa si tu sogs thams cad kyis chos rje gong ma yin nges red gleng 'dug byas pas/ gong ma phyag thal mo sbyar nas mchi ma byung*/ 'khor thams cad kyang de ltar gyur/ byang rgyud sogs su 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ me bya lo sngar gyi mkhan slob dang gzhon nu dpal gyis gsang ston mdzad/ de dge 'dun nyi shu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ sha chang gi dri tsam yang nye 'khor dang gzigs sar mi 'grim/ sku 'khor rnams la sha chang gi ston mo mi byed pa sogs theg chen so thar dang thun mong gi 'dul ba'i bcas pa shin tu phra mo yan chad la nan tan mdzad/ sku 'khor yang dge slong chos dang ldan pa rig grol gyi spobs pa can kho na tshogs/ dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ phyag rtse sprod mdzad/ chos 'brel gsan/ skyor mo lung la 'bri nang gis dmag drangs pa'i tshe byon nas thams cad zil gyis mnan te zhi bar byas/ snye thang du rgya gong ma'i sku rim la khrom tshogs pa khri khrag mang po tshogs/ khri gsum gyi dbus mar chos rje/ g.yas su dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ g.yon du gzhi thog pa bzhugs/ rgya nag gi yul khar rgya khyon/ dbyibs mtho dman sogs gsal snang du gzigs nas slob dpon sgom rin la gsungs pas phyis de kho na ltar byung*/ de nas rgya gong ma ji gin gan gyi brgyud pa bcu bzhi pa tho gan the mur/

rgyal bu a yu ta ra hwang them tshe zhes pa'i chos rgyal byang sems yab sras kyis gdan 'dren gser yig pa 'byor/ 'ja' sa ni/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong la bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol pa/ nged kyi mgo byas gdul bya mang po la dgongs te/ khyed bod phyogs su skye ba bzhes nas mtshur phu'i dgon par bzhugs zhes thos/ de'i don la sngar gyi yon tan dang phrin las la bsam nas/ sems can mang po'i don la ding ju dang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mgo byas gser yig pa rnams gdan 'dren du btang yod pas/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i sems can la dgongs te/ 'di phyogs kyi skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa dang*/ lam gol lam stor ba'i sems can rnams kyi 'dren pa mdzad pa'i don la/ rang yul spangs nas sku lus kyi tshegs la mi lta bar myur du 'byon par zhu zhing*/ yang thub pas gzhan don du dgongs nas sdug bsngal dang du blangs te yul khams tha dad du sems can gyi don mdzad pa thugs la gsal mod/ sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong*/ chos kyi bshad nyan/ bod phyogs rkyang pa la zhen par ma mdzad par/ 'di nas mngags pa'i gser yig par der sleb pa'i 'thad du nged la bsam nas/ 'di phyogs su mjal dus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya cher ci nus su dar bar byed cing sems can mang po thar lam la 'god pa la dgongs la/ snyad mi mdzad pa myur du 'byon pa slob dpon chen po rol pa'i rdo rje mkhyen/ mchod pa'i chas dang 'ja' sa'i rten la gser bre gcig /dngul bre gsum/ gos phyi nang dgu tshan gnyis yod/ sprel lo zla ba 10 tshes 11 la ta'i tu nas bris pa'i 'ja' sa bkra shis par gyur cig /bya ba slebs dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa khyi lor lha sa gung thang du gdan drangs/ zhabs tog cher byas/

zla ba lnga par mtshur phu nas phyogs phebs chen por btegs/ dbus gtsang gi mi chen rnams kyi bsu rkyel zhabs tog byas/ rkong dgon du phebs/ chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ chos rje gong ma las kyang non dang thugs zhib che bar grags/ lam gyi gros dang sku rim zhu bar byas pa mkhyen nas khyed rang tsho gros mang mi dgos nga'i rjes su shog gsungs/ char che bas nag chu la mi thar zer ba na/ chu chung du 'gro gsungs te chu chung bar byung*/ gzhi bdag gi chos yon du chu bsgyur pa yin gsungs/ gsar yig pa rnams kyis 'u lag chibs pa zhus pas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'u lag ma zhon gsungs/ khal gzhon za ma thams cad nang nas gnang*/ za ma 'u lag ma dgos pas 'ja' mo thams cad dga'/ 'byon lam rnams su chos kyi char phabs/ srog sdom dang ma ṇi 'bum ther bye ba dung phyur sogs dge rgyun mang po gtsugs/ rgya 'bul stong 'bul khri 'bul sogs mtha' yas/ mjal tshad ngan song dang 'khor ba gang rung las thar par mdzad/ zhal gzigs sogs ni rgyun mi chad pas ci smos/ rgya gar gyi dzo gi lngas byang chub shing la klu sgrub kyi phyag bzo'i sku phul/ de mchod yul gyi gtso bor mdzad nas thun bzhir mchod pa dang phyag bskor mdzad/ des sku 'khor thams cad bskul te dge ba la brtson/ dzo gi lnga chos skyong gi sprul par grags/ rdzogs chen thod rgal gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te/ rang sems snying po stong gsal kun tu bzang*//gdod nas dag pa rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings//gzhi lnga'i gdangs las rang gsal kun tu khyab//'od lnga'i gdangs la rang gnas mnyam par bzhag/ces sogs gsungs/ byang lam nas 'byon par zhus kyang 'gro don che gsungs lho lam nas byon/ de skabs ti shrir kun dga' rgyal mtshan hor yul du gshegs/ bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lngar rma chu gling khugs su byon/ der chos khri brtsigs nas chos gsungs/

phyis chos khri'i rtsar sngar ma mthong ba'i me tog rtsa ba gcig la sdong bu brgya/ sdong bu re rer me tog brgya re/ me tog re la 'dab ma ser po stong re lte ba dmar po ge sar ser po yod pa zhig skyes/ thams cad ngo mtshar/ skyu ra ston pas de'i rnam pa spar du btab nas phyogs su 'grim pas 'gro don che/ phag lo gnyis pa'i tshes la bya khar/ rgyal bu sang ga shrīs bsus/ cha ga pa'i nyi ma 'grib pa byung ba la bka' shog bsgrags pas zhi/ dmag 'khrug thams cad zhi bar mdzad/ btson thams cad grol bar mdzad/ yul phyogs kha cig gis lo nyer lnga'i bar du 'khrug pa che chung thams cad phul te bde bar 'jags/ gnang bar gser srang nyis stong rta bdun brgya ja lnga brgya sogs song*/ gong ma chen po nas mgyogs bskul yang yang slebs/ skabs shig mgur cham zhig byung bas/ nga gnyid ma skrog gsungs nas mnal sad pa dang dngas 'dug /ji ltar mdzad zhus pas/ po ta lar phyin/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bum chu gnang ba 'thung bas phan gsungs/ byi lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen po ta'i tur phebs/ gong ma yab sras gus pa mtha' yas/ rgyal po yab sras kyi gtsos thams cad dbang chos kyi tshim par mdzad/ lhag par rgyal bu la rgyud rgya gzhung gi bshad 'grel mang po gnang*/ nyes can spyi thar pa'i 'ja' sa dang*/ khyad par rgyal bu chen pos ban+des gong ma la phyag mi dgos par bkur ba la phyis mi dpon rnams kyis ban+de'i phyag blangs pas rgyal khams ma bde ba des len/ phyis de 'dra ma byed zer ba sogs bstan pa shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa rnams gnang bod du'ang sgrogs pa la btang*/ thugs byams pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis ngo log thams cad zhi/ nad yams thams cad chad/ lo legs/ rgyal blon 'bangs bcas thams cad lhag par dad/ rgyal pos chos rje'i ji ltar bzhed pa rnams sgrub/ rgyal bu chen po ni mkhyen rtogs zla med pas bstan bcos mkhas pa dgyes nus du ma mdzad/

lo gsum bzhugs/ de nas 'byon pa'i zhu ba gong ma yab sras la yang yang mdzad pas/ ma gnang bar zhu ba drag tu phul/ rgyal bu chen pos spyan chab bton nas bla ma cis kyang bzhugs pa thugs rje 'dzin par zhu zhes gsungs/ rgya'i dpon chen rnams kyis phyag 'tshal pus mo btsugs nas/ bla ma lags/ sngar sman tse nas kyi 'dab sgo lo dgur chad/ dngul bre la 'bru 'jag lnga las med/ bla ma khyed byon nas nad yams chad/ rgyal bu chen po la sras 'khrungs/ ngo log thams cad zhi/ da lta dngul bre la nas 'jag brgyad cur song*/ gong ma yab sras kyang spyan chab bton nas zhu ba dang*/ thams cad kyis 'bru 'phel zhing bkra shis pa'i bla ma zhes mtshan gsol ba'i skabs 'dir/ de tsam zhu ba nan can mdzad nas bod du ci mdzad du 'byon/ sngar bla ma 'phags pa dang sa chen rgyal po yon mchod bzhin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas dang rgyal khams bde thabs mdzad na mi 'thad dam thugs bsam legs por thong mdzod/ ces zhus pa'i lan du/ rtsed mo de 'phror bzhag na legs/ nged la gong ma yab sras kyi sku rim du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtogs/ rgyal khams kyi bya ba la kha gtogs pa'i dgos ched shes sgo gang yang med/ ban+de bya ba de yul gang la'ang zhen chags med pa zhig byung na bzang ba yin/ ces sogs gsungs pa rnams mi dpon tshos yi ger 'debs shing 'dug /de ltar nan tan mdzad pas re zhig gnang tsam byung nas/ rta lor

bteg /'byon lam du bstan 'gro'i don mtha' yas/ zla lam gnyis tshun chad phyogs phyogs nas mjal mkhan khri phrag mang po pha ma rgan rgon rnga mong la bskal nas byung*/ phal cher dad mos kyi gom pa bdun re bor nas phyag gsum re 'tshal zhing 'ongs/ skabs shig thugs dam gyi khrig dang tsha dro gsol tshe ma gtogs bsdu ba rnam bzhis tshim par mdzad/ byin rlabs bskyar du med pa'i khrims bcas nas bshar bas zhag bcu na re zhig rdzogs tsam byung*/ de dus stod hor rgyal pos kyang gdan 'dren 'bul ba mang po 'byor rung ma bzhud/ nad yams chen po zhig byung ba la/ slob dpon gu'i gung pas/ 'di lta bu la thabs 'dra mchis sam zhus pas/ thabs bya'i nga gnyid ma skrog gsungs/ mnal ba'i tshul mdzad/ slob dpon sku drung du bzhugs pas zim khang steng du tshegs sgra chen po byung*/ mnal sad nas khang steng 'dir ltas 'dra byung ngam gsungs/ byung zhus pas/ nad bdag zang zing mang po 'dug /ngas sa 'di thams cad gshog pas khebs pa'i bya khyung chen por sprul nas/ nad bdag thams cad zos shing ye shes kyi mes bsregs nas khang steng 'dir babs pa yin/ sems kyi sprul bsgyur la'ang phyi rol du rtags mtshan 'ong ba 'di mtshar bar gda' ang gsungs/ nad yams thams cad chad par gyur/ dbyangs can mas zho bum pa gang drangs pa gsol bas snyan ngag me long sogs thams cad thugs su chud/ yang 'brum nad byung ba'ang bya khyung chen por sprul nas bcad/ lha sa'i jo bor dngul bre bcu gcig las brdung pa'i kong bu/ lha chen la gser bre lnga'i gser shog /dngul bre so gcig gis kong bu lnga sogs/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi lha khang 'dus sde rnams la mchod sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad pa'i dgongs pa bzhin slob dpon chen pos phyag len la thems par mdzad tshul rgya cher rnam thar chen por mjal/ tsong kha'i yul du dpal blo bzang grags pa dge bsnyen du bsgrubs te mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol skyes bu dam par lung bstan/

zu gun du dgon pa btab/ yang mgur cham thu mo zhig byung tshe slob dpon la nga gnyid ma skrogs gsungs nas mnal log pa'i tshul gyis po ta lar byon/ sad pa dang sangs kyis song*/ lo rgyus rgyas par gsungs/ skabs shig nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi khengs me tog gi char babs pa sogs kun gyi mthun snang du byung tshe/ chos rjes nga la'ang dag snang mang po byung rgyal ba g.yung sku gshegs pa'i ltas min nam gsungs de kho nar gshegs/ dpon mo puṇ+ye rda rī mjal du byung nas/ kho mo'i rmi lam du sangs rgyas kyi sku ri tsam bzhengs dang grub par 'gyur zhes pa zhig byung*/ rgyal bu rat+na'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bzhengs par 'dod/ de 'grub thabs chos rje nas mkhyen zhus pas/ gzhan thams cad ha las/ chos rje zhal mdzum mdzad nas thabs yod gos dar la bzhengs gsungs/ bzo rigs mang po bsdus te bsgo ba na rgya nag gi bzo rig shes rab che yang de 'dra'i bkod pa blor ma chud nas yang*/ chos rje la zhus pas thams cad kyis chu rdo dkar po khu tshur tsam khyer la thang pha kir shog gsungs/ chos rje chibs pa bcib nas byon pa'i rta'i rmig rjes la rdo sgrigs/ chags tshad de dang bstun nas dpon mos gos chen 'phang med du bzo bo la sprad nas/ sku sha hor gos gser mdog la na bza' gos dmar sogs gos bzang 'ba' zhig bsgrigs pa'i sku/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das snyan g.yas g.yon gyi bar du 'dom bcu gcig yod pa tshad des mtshon/ g.yas g.yon du byams pa ( kha ) dang 'jam dbyangs ( ka ) bzhengs stabs/ steng nas lhas mchod pa pad gdan sogs thang sku ltar gong sham dang sham bu ze'u kha can bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa zla ba bcu gsum gyis grub/ chos rjes rab gnas mdzad tshe 'ja' 'od sa g.yo me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar mang kun gyis mthong*/ dpon mos de chos rje la phul ba bod du gdan drangs/ mdzo nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi rgyab non pas de res gsor byas pas mdzo zhe bzhi'i rgyab tu gdan drangs/

gtso bo zho khar bzhugs/ 'khor gnyis 'bri gdan gnyis la gnang*/ de nas zha jur byon der byams chen gnyis sogs lha khang sum stong bdun brgya yod pa la/ la la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pas bzhengs/ la la rgya nag dang hor gyi rgyal pos bzhengs/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyis bzhengs pa'ang yod par grags/ der yu gur mi nyag sogs kyis 'bul ba rgya cher byung ba thams cad der mchod rgyun du btsugs/ dpon mo paṇ+yes lu pan shan du lha khang khyad par 'phags pa bzhengs/ mchod rgyun 'jag nyis stong gi sa cha/ mi sde dud khag brgya dang bcu bdun sogs dpag tu med pa phul/ de nas bod du byang lam nas byon pas lam rgyus shes pa med pas thams cad sems las che skabs/ chos rjes mdo stod du 'gro lugs 'di ltar dgos gsungs nas byang rma bya bya ba'i gangs gsebs du zhag mang por phyin pas nor chug med par 'dan du phebs/ rong po/ khyung po/ dkar shod/ nag shod/ brgyad shog sog stod smad/ kong po sogs ban skya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ mdo khams kong po sogs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsu ba 'ong ba mang pos mthong*/ chu yis khyer ba du ma rdzu 'phrul gyis bton glo lam dkar nag bya ba'i lam 'phrang dam por mdzo rta khyu ded byas nas byon/ kong ral sum du mi sde khri phrag gi phyogs su gtsang po yo nas yul spo ba la thug pa bden pa brjod par mdzad pas gtsang chab phar log /phrag dog can gyi mthu mkhan mang pos ser ba cog sgong tsam phabs pa/ chos rjes phyag mdzub gtad pas ldog /yul khams mang por 'khrug rtsod sdum pa/ btson dkrol ba/ nad yams bcad pa/ chos dang zang zing gi thams cad tshim par mdzad pa rnams smos kyi mi langs/ rab byung rnams thos bsam sgom gsum byed tshul/ phal pa rnams kyang gnas skabs kyi bde skyid sgrubs lugs/ tha na sprang po yan chad rang rang gi bya bzhag 'di dang 'di lta bu byed dgos zhes zhib la rgyas pa gnang*/

rgya gong mas gdan 'dren byung yang ma byon/ 'bul ba yang yang slebs/ mdor na sku drung du mang dus 'bum phrag nyung dus lnga brgya tsam 'tshogs pa la/ rab rnams nyams rtogs khyad 'phags skyes pa/ 'bring rnams gzhung lugs rnam dag gi tshig don khong du chud pa/ tha ma rnams kyang ma ṇi rgyun mi chad par bgrang du bcug gnang sbyin dang*/ spro ba skyed pa dang*/ mtshang nas 'bru ba sogs gang 'dul gyis ma ṇi dung phyur/ bye ba/ sa ya/ tha ma nyin rer brgya stong 'di 'don gyi dam bca' rang rang gi nus tshod len par mdzad/ tha ma'i rab rnams srog sdom/ 'bring dus tshod 'di dang 'dir srog sdom/ tha ma sems can 'di dang 'di mi gsod srog kyis sdom pa len pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan bsgrags pa sogs sgo du ma nas thabs du mas mtho ris thar par 'god par mdzad/ thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis skal pa bzang ngan mkhyen/ gsung rjes bstan cho 'phrul gyis de mthun chos gsungs/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis skal ldan gar yod du byon/ sku 'khor rnams dkar gsum gyi 'tsho bas bskyangs/ dpon slob rnams bzhugs pa'i shul du/ sha dang rus pa gzigs na bka' bkyon zhing chang gi dri tsam yang sger khong der bro ba med pa sogs kun spyod rnam dag la 'god par mdzad/ ye nas sangs rgyas dngos yin kyang gdul bya la spyod pa rnam dag bstan pa'i slad du/ spyod lam rnam bzhir phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin nam langs nas nyi dros bar ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ de nas nyin phyed bar chos gsungs/ de nas sku gsung thugs rten la brgya phyag mdzad cing bshags pa mdzad/ bskor ba brgya rtsa mdzad cing ma ṇi bsgrang ba sogs kyis dus 'da'/ srod nas mtho rangs bar rmi lam sprul sgyur gyis sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'di lta bu khor yug las bar stong cung zad kyang mi 'jog /shi dge gson rim gang la'ang sha khrag gi ston mo mi bya de ni ming dge bar btags kyang sdig pa rang yin pas/

za mkhan/ gsod mkhan/ 'dren mkhan gsum ka dmyal bar 'gro gsungs nas/ yon mchod kun la dam bsgrags che bar mdzad/ dgra gnyen bstod smad la dbye ba mi mdzad kyang ngan spyod sdig can la thugs gnag pa ltar dang*/ chos pa la mnyes tshul gyis dor len ltar yang mdzad/ yo byad ci tsam phul kyang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mi mdzad/ go rtogs gang rung chos mthun re'i tshig phul na mnyes par mdzad/ yo byad la chags pa med kyang phra mo tsam yang chud zos ma song bar mchod sbyin mdzad/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid kyi lta ba mngon du mdzad kyang rgyu 'bras phra 'u la'ang gal po che mdzad/ chos kyi gsung gleng min pa gsung mi 'byon pa sogs mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar blo'i ra ba las brgal bar bzhugs/ bdag nyid chen po de skye 'chi la rang dbang thob kyang rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas tha ma'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed nas/ karmar phyag dpe sogs la do dam sngar bas che bar mdzad/ chos gsungs pa'i zhor du/ rgya yul du yin na bla ma dge bshes chen po rnams 'das nas spur a ga ru dang tsan dan gyi mes bzhu ba yin 'dug /sngon chos rje gong ma bde bar gshegs dus tsan dan a ga ru shing rta gang bas bzhus pa yin 'dug /bod 'dir tsan dan dang a ga ru'i tshab shug pa 'di yin/ byang du me shing dkon po byung dogs yod shug pa khol gsungs/ tsan+dan dang a ga ru sogs nad pa sogs la glo bur du mkho mi shes thams cad khyer shog gsungs/ nag shod du gcig gi lag pa chag 'dug zhus pas/ de kun rnga ma chung*/ gyod chen po da gzod 'byung dogs yod gsungs/ chos rar snyigs ma'i rmu rgod rnams la legs pa'i lam bstan kyang 'jug dka'/ nges 'byung dang skyo ba skye thabs 'dra byas na phan pa'ang srid gsungs/ ras dkar bya bas phyag 'tshal nas/ rin po che de 'dra mi gsungs par dbu lo dkar yer gyi ma song bar du bzhugs pa mkhyen zhus pas/

chos nyan pa rnams kyis smyon pa 'di zhes bzhad gad byas/ skabs shig 'ja' 'od shin tu gsal ba byung bas/ 'ja' legs 'on kyang dus min gyi 'ja' 'di byang sems gshegs bzhud byed pa'i ltas su snang*/ sngon chos rgyal 'phags pa bde bar gshegs dus su glo bur 'ja' 'di 'dra byung bar snang gsungs/ chos rje'i chibs rkyang dkar de rtsa ma zos pas/ na ba yin snyam sman dpyad byas pas/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ bdag po dang bral bas ma dga' ba yin bcos mi dgos gsungs/ dgung grangs zhe bzhi bzhes pa chu phag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga la shag stod zer ba'i sa char srod la sku gsung thugs rten la bskor ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun mdzad de zhal nas/ byams chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang kun tu bzang*//spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs//ces sogs mang du gsungs/ de nas skya rengs bar mnyam par bzhag /skya rengs tha ma shar skabs sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs gcig bsdus te chos kyi dbyings su snyoms par zhugs par gyur/ de'i tshe sgra dang sa g.yos sogs cho 'phrul mtha' yas/ la res bud med sngon mo mang pos nub phyogs su gdan drangs pa dang*/ la res 'ja' 'od kyi gong bu chen po zhig nam mkhar 'phags pa sogs mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung*/ nyer gcig la gdung bzhus pas steng du 'ja' gur phub/ karma rgyal ba dpal gyis 'ja' nang nas chos rje zhal bstan pa mjal/ der mchod rten byas pas karma sku 'bum du grags/ re skabs klo rnams kyi nam mkha' nas lho phyogs su bzhud pa mthong nas kong po rnams la bshad pa dang dus 'grigs/ de nas gdung mtshur phur spyan drangs pas/ gang du gdan drangs pa'i sa phyogs dpag tshad gsum tshun la 'ja' 'od dang me tog kha dog sna lnga'i char kun gyi mthun snang du 'bab pa byung*/ mtshur phur gdung byon skabs 'ja' 'od kyis nam mkha' gang*/ rnam par du rdzi bo mang po yod pa'i pad+ma skyabs zer bas chos rje 'ja' 'od kyi nang nas mjal/

don rgyal bya bas sku skad yan mthong*/ gcig gi dbu zhwa mthong*/ gzhan rnams kyis 'ja' 'od las ma mthong*/ rtse lha sgang du dpon slob bdun byas nas byon pa mang pos mthong*/ lha sa'i jo bo'i drung du byon pa'ang mthong*/ mtshur phu sgar pa phal cher gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa mthong ba sogs/ mthong tshul mtha' yas/ khyad par nyang 'dam gyi phyogs su seng ge chibs nas byon pa bla ma zhig gis mthong*/ rje de'i nang rten sku dang dngul gdung rnams bzhengs skabs nyin mi dang mtshan mi ma yin pas mgar ba dang*/ bzo bo rnams sngar bas shes rab rno zhing lag bde ba dang stobs nyis 'gyur gyi che ba sogs byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to//rje 'di'i slob tshogs kyang*/ gtso bo grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po chig brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams yi ger bkod pa'i lung chen thob pa zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po dang*/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal dang*/ mkhan chen mgon blon po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mtshur phu kun spangs/ karma dkon gzhon/ 'brang bu rin po che/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar/ ras dkar ri khrod/ yang nge sgom seng*/ ri khrod sgom grags/ do bo sangs rin/ 'ga' tsha sgom chen/ chos skyong dpal/ phyug mo byams sar/ si tu drung chen/ nang pa thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ yol ye dpal/ zhwa dmar pa/ bla ma brag gong pa sogs dang chos kyi 'brel ba'i skyes chen 'bri gung chos rgyal/ kun spang ye rgyal/ 'bri gung lo tsā/ zang zang ne ring*/ 'be byams chos/ ka bzhi rin dpal ma se ston pa/ ye shes rdo rje/ lho rin chen grags yon/ spang mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rgya ston chos bzang*/ bka' bzhi pa grags rdor/ tho ka pa chos 'od/ rje rin po che blo bzang grags pa la sogs pa'i skyes chen rnams so// // lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar/ lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/

rje gong mas lung bstan pa bzhin de nyid gshegs pa nas bzung ste/ nyang 'dam gyi phyogs der 'khrungs khang la 'ja' zug pa dang*/ mi mang po'i rmi lam du chos rje der byon pa dang nyi zla shar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rgyun mi chad par byung bas thams cad kyang chos rje rin po che nged rang gi yul 'dir 'khrungs par thag chod 'dug zer ba byung zhing*/ der yab sngags pa gu ru rin chen dang yum lha mo skyid la gzigs par mdzad de lhums su zhugs/ de'i tshe yum gyi rmi lam dung dkar mang po thu ba gang bar bsdus te che ba zhig 'bud par brtsams pa dang*/ nyi zla'i 'od kyis thams cad gang ba dang gser gyi me tog mthu ba sogs ngo mtshar ba mang po rmis/ lus yang shing bde zas kyi sred pa med/ skabs su khong pa nas yig drug dang*/ dbyangs gsal dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsungs pa'i sgra yang yang grags/ bud med mang po dang mnyam du yur ma byed skabs kyang de ltar gsung ba thams cad kyis thos te g.yas g.yon du lta zhing the tshom/ yum ngo tsha ba dang gzhan la mi grags pa'i phyir pha tshad du gcig pur yur ma byas pas/ gsung che bar grags pa thams cad kyis thos nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar can zer zhing phyag 'tshal/ khyod kyis ci thos byed mi nyan zer/ yab la'ang rmi lam ngo mtshar ba byung*/ sngar lus la nad gzhi zhig yod pa'ang sangs/ khyim der rtag tu 'ja' zug pas de nyid du 'khrungs par thams cad kyi shes/ shing byi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyi shar la sku bltams/ me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang yul khams khyab pa byung*/ 'khrungs ma thag phyag gnyis kyis zhal phyis nas/ rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ nga ni karma pak+shi yin/ gsungs/ yab la 'gran sems byed pa'i sngags pa zhig yod pa de'i bud med kyi rmi lam du/ bud med rgyan bzang mang pos gzim khang la phyag skor dang mchod pa byed pa rmis pas de phyin gus par gyur/
