de ltar lhums su bzhugs pa nyid nas chos rje nyid der 'khrungs par thams cad yid ches pas/ 'khrungs ma thag kun gyis bkur sti mtha' yas shing*/ zla phyed tsam nas mkhan chen mgon blon gu'i gung pas ja 'dren du btang nas/ phye mar na bza' sogs sku'i nyer spyad rnams phul/ yum gyi pang na bzhugs pas zhal 'dzum dang mnyes tshul mdzad nas mkhan chen gyi mdzub mo la 'jus nas pang du byon/ 'khrungs nas zla ba lnga song skabs slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa nyid byon te mjal/ ja phur zhus pa phyag gis reg cing bzhad/ lkog 'phrang ri khrod du gdan drangs te bla ma shāka 'od dpon g.yog sku'i rim gro par bzhag pas zla rer yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs klog cing rnam 'joms tshe chog ma chag pa mdzad/ zla ba dgu la gzhan la mjal ka ma gnang*/ 'di dag gi tshe gog ye mi mdzad glang lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la ji ltar mdzad ma tshor bar bzheng nas phar cham tshur cham mdzad nas bzhad cing 'dug pa la/ gog ma mdzad par 'byon thub pa lags sam zhus pas 'gro thub gsungs/ yang khang pa'i ka slog gi bar lag pa thar tsam zhig la sku rtsed kyis phar thal tshul thal 'byon pa la/ shākya 'od kyis de ltar ma mdzad sku bsnad 'ong zhus pas/ bla ma pa thug khral mi dgos nga rang bde mor 'gro 'gro yod pa gsungs/ ser ba byung dus sdigs mdzub mdzad cing phu shar mdzad pas ldog pa yang yang mdzad/ mtshur phu/ karma/ nags phu sogs phyogs 'di dang 'di na yod sogs nges pa dang bcas te gsungs/ 'khrungs nas lo gcig dang zla ba gsum song tsam na/ rje dus mkhyen/ karma pak+shi/ rje rang byung*/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje rnams gang na bzhugs zhus pas/ thugs kar phyag mdzub gtad de 'di na gsungs/ khyed lags sam zhus pas/ yin yin gsungs nas bzhad/ dang po mtshur phur 'byon nam/ karmar 'byon zhus pas/ nged karmar 'gro ba yin gsungs/ sgar pa nyang por byon nas yun ring song*/

da byon ran ja 'dren la 'gro zhus pas/ 'gro ma ran gsungs/ de nas zla phyed tsam na shāka 'od la/ da song khyed la gser zhig ster bar 'dug gsungs/ song bas de bzhin byung*/ slob dpon chen po sogs phebs nas mjal/ bzhugs khri chung chung zhig yod pa de mtho bar gyis gsungs/ byas pas der bzhugs nas thams cad la phyag 'tshol gsungs zhing phyag dbang yang yang mdzad cing bzhad/ dgung lo gsum pa'i dus/ slob dpon la/ rang re rgya nag tu phyin dus/ rgyal po yum sras la dbang bskur mdzad skabs/ gser bre dngul bre sogs 'bul ba byung tshul sogs lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ zhal brdzun mi mdzad par zhu/ rang re rgya nag tu byon pa ma myong zhus pas/ rdzun min/ rang re byi ba'i lo la gung du phebs/ zhes sogs lo rgyus mang du gsungs pas slob dpon mnyes/ shāka 'od la tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dra dang nga'i sba lcag khyer shog gsungs/ nged la med zhus pas/ zho kha thang gi gzim chung na sgam nang du yod gsungs/ shāka 'od shin tu dga' nas/ bsod nams rin chen btang ste blangs nas phul/ yang khri thog tu bzhugs nas bla ma shāka 'od la/ khyod kyis nga la phyag 'tshol gsungs/ khyed la mi 'tshal chos 'brel med zhus pas/ nga rdo rje 'chang yin khyod kyis nga la sngar chos zhus pa yin/ cis kyang phyag 'tshol gsungs/ de nas phyag 'tshal bas/ yang 'tshol gsungs/ mang du 'tshal bas byin rlabs mang po mdzad/ nga yang 'tshal lam zhus pas/ da sdod gsungs mnyes tshul mdzad/ shes rab brtson 'grus bya ba'i sgom chen chos rje gong ma'i zhabs tog yun ring byas pa zhig mtshams la yod skabs sprul sku dang e mjal bsam pas rmi lam du mjal chos gsungs pa rmis pas/ mtshams hur 'don byas nas byon te mjal bas rmi lam bzhin byung ste phyag phyir 'brang*/ skabs shig phebs lam du rlung chen po byung ba phyag mdzub gtad pas zhi/ mgyogs par dgongs nas shāka 'od kyis bcibs gong du pang nas 'byon rtsis la/

de 'dra mi nyan nga la brnyas pa ma byed gsungs khong rang gcig pur bcibs nas byon/ dgung lo lnga par nags phu la byon skabs shāka 'od chab rom la 'grad nas rtsib ma gsum chag pa la/ phyag gis byin rlabs mdzad nas ci yang mi to gsungs pas/ na ba tsam yang ma byung*/ 'di dag gi dus/ chos khrir bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ dgon pa 'debs pa yin dang*/ zam pa 'dzugs pa'i tshul dang*/ nga mdo khams su 'gro ba yin gsungs nas/ rde'u shing bu mang po mdzo rta yin tshul sogs dge ba'i sku rtsed kho na mdzad/ grwa slob dang yon bdag du ma ming mkhyen nas gsungs pa dang*/ 'grul pa nam slebs sogs lung bstan pa mang po rnam thar rgyas par gsal/ khyad par du grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po snying po don brgyud kyi mnga' bdag zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po byon skabs/ dge bshes shāka rdor gyis/ rtogs ldan de ring 'byon pa yod zer yang yang zhus pas/ de ring mi 'ong sang nyi dros tsam na mjal gsungs/ de bzhin byung ste/ nga bden par e 'dug gsungs/ kho dad nas bshags pa byas/ rtogs ldan zhwa dmar pas/ 'bul ba mang po dang sngon gyi dbu zhwa phul yang skabs shig de ring bla ma mkhan po yong pa yod gsungs/ ci cha zhus pas/ yong mi 'di 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar yod gsungs zhal yo ba'i tshul mdzad/ gos dang 'bul ba 'di 'dra byed gsungs pas/ dgongs mo zhal yo ba'i tshul du byung zhing*/ gos dang 'bul ba sogs gsungs bzhin byung*/ skabs shig nam mkha' la gzigs nas khyed tshos e mthong gsungs/ ma mthong ci 'dug zhus pas/ phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ ya ki na rdo rje 'chang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol ma sogs 'dug gsungs/ ci 'dra 'dug zhus pas/ sku mdog zhal phyag 'di dang 'di 'dra 'dug gsungs sku'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ re zhig a ma shi a ma shi yang yang gsungs nas bsngo ba mdzad/ de yum gshegs pa dang dus mtshungs/ than pa byung skabs char 'bod zhus pas zan la gzugs brnyan byas pa cog rtse'i steng du bzhag nas chus bran pas char babs/

nyin cig dngul gyi spos phor zhig la gzigs pas/ slob dpon gyis bzhed na khyed la 'bul zhus pas/ khyed kyi phul mi dgos nga la mi chen pos phul ba yin gsungs pas slob dpon shin tu mnyes nas bzhad/ de nas rgya nag rgyal pos zhu yig /dbu zhwa/ phyag phreng*/ gsol zhal/ na bza' sogs kyi 'bul ba dang*/ dbus phyogs kyi gdan 'dren mtshur phu go shri sogs dang*/ karma si tu sogs mang po 'byor rang rang gi phyogs su 'byon dgos zhus pas/ nged sngon la karmar 'gro gsungs/ mtshur phu go shri pas cis kyang mtshur phur 'byon dgos/ mi 'byon na nga khri thog tu sdod pa yin zhus pas/ khyod kyis ci yang mi shes/ nga gar 'gro nga rang shes mod gsungs nas bka' bkyon mdzad/ shes rab me lces/ khyed rtsed mo rang mdzad 'dug pas/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku skye min pa 'dra zhus pas/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i skye ba nga min na khyod kyis log nas tshol gsungs/ tsa ri'i sgom chen rnams kyis sgom cig gnang bar zhu/ zhus pas/ gzhan du ma lta rang gi sems la ltos//rang gis rang sems bltas pa'i tshe//mthong ba'i rnam pa ci yang med//lta ba sgom rgyu gang yang med/ /he he/ gsungs/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar pas rje rol pa'i rdo rje gshegs dus la las 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil nas mthong ba dang la las seng ge chibs nas byon par mthong sogs snang tshul mang po byung ba de kun da dran nam zhus pas/ nga'i snying rje dang khyed rang chos dad pa la brten nas mthong ba yin/ ngas kyang dran/ khyed kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing mchi ma phri li li 'dug pa de yin/ lar mthong lam thob na skad cig la lus brgya ston nus pa yin gsungs/ bsod nams rin chen gyis/ drung bzhugs pa la dbang thob pa la dgung lo de tsam las mi bzhugs pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga dbang ma che ba min te sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis gang la gang 'dul du lus brjes pa yin gsungs/

yon blos/ khyed karmar byon ma myong zhus pas/ nga sngar karmar phyin nas 'gro don byas pa dran gsungs pas/ thams cad mi phyed par dad/ skabs shig bsod rin la/ pha ri'i sku dkar po de khyed rnams e mthong*/ khyed kyis mthong ba min spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yin/ ngas skad cig re re la rgyal sras rnams kyi sku gnam gyi skar ma tsam mthong gsungs/ de dag gi skabs su rtogs ldan zhwa dmar rin po che dang*/ slob dpon chen po rnams kyis bka' chos rgya cher nar mar phul/ sangs rgyas gling pas mjal nas chos rje gong mas gnang ba'i dar khang dang gser gyi pa tra phul/ nga'i phyag mkhar sba lcag yod pa de khyer shog gsungs/ med zhus pas/ yod khyer shog gsungs/ phyag tu phul bas/ khyod kyi sba lcag bcad 'dug ang gsungs khong shin tu dad nas zhabs la gtugs/ dgung lo bdun pa la/ mkhan chen snyag phu pa bsod nams bzang po dang*/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan dpal sogs las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dharma shrī bha drar gsol/ mkhan slob de dag dang*/ rtogs ldan ye shes dpal/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal sogs la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pas mkhas pa thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/ kong po'i phyogs su 'gro don dpag med mdzad nas dgung lo dgu par mdo khams karma'i gdan sar byon/ gzhan yang 'dan ma/ go 'jo/ 'bom nyag sogs su byon/ rdo rje dpal brtsegs sogs kyis bsu ba byas/ skabs shig nyid kyi rnam thar zhig gsung rogs zhus pas/ skye 'chi med pa'i sems la dbang thob kyang*//dbang med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba bsgral slad du//snying rje'i dbang gis srid par nying mtshams sbyar//srid pa ci srid mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad//nga'i rnam thar de la gyis gsungs/ than pa byung nas char 'bebs zhus pas/ oṃ swasti/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi lung*/ dharma shrī bha dra'i gtam 'khom che chung tshun chad la yod pa'i lha 'dre rnams la bzlo ba/

sang gong phan chad nas char gyi chil gyi phob cig /gal te ma phab na rtsa ra byed pa yin/ yi ge'i rten ri lu'i rgyu ma gzungs 'dam dang bcas pa yod pas bkra shis par gyur cig /ces bka' bsgo bar mdzad pas char babs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par gdan sa chen po mtshur phur phebs/ dbus gtsang rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ jo bo rin po cher mchod 'bul mdzad/ slar yang kong po'i phyogs su byon/ chu rta lor 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ba ku la'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen snyag phu pa dang*/ slob dpon yon tan blo gros kyi gtsos sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa brgyad cu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ bod du dge slong gi las gral la mang bar grags/ so so'i phyag gi tshe bar bar 'ja' li la sku brten pa'i ngal gso mdzad dgos pa byung skad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char byung*/ mkhan chen 'di chos rje gong mar chos mang du gsan zhing rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma yin kyang slob ma gzhan las dad/ lhag bsam ma'i bstod pa mdzad/ klo lam nas brgyud pu 'bor phyogs su byon/ de nas dbus phyogs su byon nas bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ 'di skabs sngar gyi rgyal po tho gan the mur gyis lo so lnga rgyal sa mdzad/ chos rje gong ma phebs nas lo lnga nas rgya'i ngo log byung*/ tha'i jus rgyal sa cung zad dang*/ de nas dpal karma pa nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul ta'i ming g.yun lo chen pos rgya hor mi nyag thams cad kyi rgyal po mdzad/ chos rje rin po che'i snyan pa gsan pas thugs phra gos te spyan 'dren yang yang btang*/ 'ja' sa zhu yig /rten dngul bre chen gsum/ gos yug mdog phyi bcu/ nang dar bcu/ tsan dan dum cig /spos dkar/ ku'u hang spos/ ja dkar sogs rgya cher 'byor/ phan bde'i 'gro don 'byung bar mkhyen nas zhal bzhes mdzad/ dbus gtsang gi sku rdzong skyel ma dang bcas dgung lo nyer gnyis par dbus nas bteg

/sog /nag shod/ sgom sde/ lha steng*/ karma/ nye stod/ smar khams/ 'bri chu/ 'dan gling tshang nas tshugs sum cus shing kun du byon/ mgyogs bskul gdan 'dren yang yang slebs/ de nas 'jam tshugs drug cu re brgyad dang*/ chu chen snang ba sal le bar nyi shu'i tshod grur byon nas pho brang chen por phebs/ glang po che sum brgya tsam rgyan gyis spras pa dang*/ dge 'dun khri tsho sogs kyis bsu ba byas/ me phag zla ba dang po'i nyer gcig la/ gong ma nyid kyang pho brang phyi'i lcags ri'i nang bar byon nas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong yod pa phul/ gong mas mngon mkhyen yod na mjal dar gcig pa bsnams 'ong dgongs nas phyag shub kyi nang du dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bcug nas thog mar phul bas/ chos rjes kyang sku 'phrag nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bton nas gnang bas lhag par dad/ phyis gnyis ka la gser gshog sbron nas phul bas da lta gan dho la'i mchod rdzas gnyis po 'di yin par grags/ mjal khang du rgya lugs g.yon che bar byed pas chos rje g.yon phyogs su bzhugs/ sku 'khor rnams la gos bzhi re lham re mi grags la zhwa theb re gnang*/ de'i phyi nyin pho brang chen por gdan drangs/ bsu bar/ glang chen dkar po gcig dang gsum la gser rgyan/ gzhan rgyan ldan glang chen sum brgya tsam/ dge 'dun khri tsho lnga tsam gyi lag tu mchod rdzas sna tshogs/ ta'i zhing stong tsho gsum/ mi chen 'bum tsho gcig /dmag mi 'bum tsho bcu gnyis go khrab mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsus/ pho brang gi sgor gong ma nyid bsu ba la byon/ bsu ba'i bkod pa phyi'i de tsam nang la'ang yod pa dang*/ lhag par gser gyi khrab rmog can nyis brgya tsam 'dug /mjal khang sgo rim pa lnga nang ma gser 'ba' zhig la byas pa/ gser thog gser ka can ka ba so gnyis kyi rgya khyon phyogs bzhir sgo gsum re yod pa der/ zas sna mang po'i gung tshig gnang 'byon dus gong mas pho brang gi sgo'i bar dang*/

bsu ba rnams kyis bzhugs gnas bar bskyal de'i phyi nyin gong ma tshur byon pa bla ma rnams kyis bar sgo dang chos rjes nang sgo nas bsus/ gong mas/ chib sga sgron pa gsum gyi gtsos rta ye dkar bco brgyad/ gser bre bdun/ dngul bre sum cu rtsa bdun/ gos chen yug brgya lhag tsam ja par sig sum cu/ gser gyi rdor dril bco lnga/ gser bum gnyis/ dngul bum lnga/ gser dngul ting mañdzil cha pad sder lnga sogs mchod cha sna tshogs/ gsol zhal sder sogs phul nas gan dho la'i 'bul ba yin gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin bla grwa rnams pho brang du shog gsungs nas phyag re res chog pa'i lung byung*/ 'brong bu go shi/ bka' bzhi pa rin dpal/ mkhan mgon blon te bla ma gsum la so sor/ dngul bre phyed gsum pa re/ gser gyi mchod cha rgyas pa re/ phyar dar gtor cha/ gos sbyar/ gsol zhal sder/ gos phyi nang bcu gnyis re/ cha'u nyis stong re rdor dril cha bzhi re/ phreng dkar re rnams gnang*/ grwa pa rab rnams la dngul bre chen re/ cha'u brgya re/ gos yug drug re/ dar yug drug re/ 'bring rnams la dngul bre sum nyis re/ gos dar yug drug re/ cha'u bzhi brgya re/ tha ma rnams la dngul bre phyed re/ gos dar yug bzhi re/ cha'u sum brgya re dang*/ grwa pa thams cad la rdor dril cha gnyis re/ gos sbyor re/ phreng dkar re rnams gnang*/ de'i phyi nyin gong ma tshur byon nas/ tsan dan dkar po'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong bskyang khru do yod pa zhig dang*/ shel dngul gyi mchod cha mtha' yas pa phul/ de nas zla ba gnyis pas tshes lnga nas bco brgyad bar/ rgyal rgya ma mi tra/ rdor dbyings/ chos dbyings gsung dbang*/ dgyes rdor/ rje btsun ma/ kun rig /sman bla/ sgrol chog /thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sgrub sogs dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas nyin re bzhin gong ma yab yum byon pa la/ dbang bskur re mdzad/

dang po dbu btsugs nas mthar ma rdzogs kyi bar du nyin thams cad la 'ja' 'od sna tshogs dang*/ me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas pa kun gyi mthun snang du byung*/ gong ma mchod yon gyi gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal gzigs/ rgya'i mi dpon gsum gyis kyang

mthong*/ shing sdong las bdud rtsi babs/ shugs pa la gser gyi me tog skyes/ nyin re bzhin ngo mtshar mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung ba rnams gong ma'i bkas ri mor bkod pa dang rgya hor bod yu gur tu ruṣ+ka ste yig rigs lnga'i kha byang btab/ de 'dra sgar chen du'ang yod par gsungs shing rnam thar chen mor yang 'byung*/ 'dir mang drag pas ma bris/ phyag chen chos drug gi khrid mdzad nas gong mas nyams len mdzad pas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i nyams mgur lta ba'i skor sogs rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis lung 'dren gnang ba'ang yod/ gser bre dgu dngul bre bco brgyad sogs 'bul chen mdzad/ gzhu'u la'i tā ba'u hwā wang gsi th+yan tā shan tsi tsa'i ha/ ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che chos kyi rgyal po nub phyogs kyi byams pa chen po zhi ba dbang phyug gi sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gser srang brgya las brdungs pa'i 'ja' sa gser tham dang*/ shel tham yid bzhin nor bu phul/ bla ma gsum la'ang go shrī las ka dang gser tham gnang*/ rgya ban nag can sum brgya sogs btson shin tu mang ba rnams chos rje nas zhu+u ba nan tan mdzad pas snga rting tsam ma gtogs thams cad thar/ bstan pa shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa bsgrags/ spyir tha'i ju rgyal bsod nams can des/ birba pa dang gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs/ sku gshegs la nye skabs chos rje karma pa gdan 'dren par bzhed pa de'i sras ta'i ming g.yun lo chen pos spyan drangs pa ste/ de'ang rgyal po nyid 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin na'ang bya ba mang pos g.yeng ba na btsun mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa des yang yang bskul pas dpal karma pa spyan drangs thub pa yin phyir/ nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni btsun mo 'di yin zhes rtag tu bsngags/ spyir gong ma'i bzhed pa hor dus ltar dmag gi bod khrims zhabs su gzhug par 'dod kyang chos rje rin po che nas chos bzhin bstan pas mdzad ma bde nas/

bod na chos lugs sna tshogs yod 'dug pas rtsod pa 'ong*/ dmag btang na chos rje mi mnyes 'dug pas/ gser thog gi gyo mo ga chur lus pa rnams skyel ba dang sbrag rta pa kha shas gtong*/ chos lugs khyed rang gi lugs su dril/ lo lo ltar dbus gtsang khams phyogs rnams chos 'khor chen po bskor ba byed pas gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ chos lugs gcig kho nas sems can mos pa sna tshogs mi thul/ so so'i mos pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'jug pa yin gsungs nas ma gnang*/ phyis kyang gser yig pa bod na bcom pa dang*/ phra ma dkrug skyel la brten rgya dmag yong la khad la/ chos rje rin po che thugs byams pa chen pos ni khyab khe grags dang dbang che 'dod pa'i rnam rtog mi mnga' thams cad phan bde 'ba' zhig dgongs pas bka' rin po che yang yang gnang bas/ rgyal pos kyang bla ma'i gsung spyi bor blangs te dmag bshol pas/ rgya bod gnyis char 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med kyang bka' drin go ba ni su yang mi snang zhes si tu paṇa chen gsung*/ zla ba bzhi par ri bo rtse lnga'i kar sder byon/ rgyal po yab sras kyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram bar phebs skyel zhus/ der 'jam dbyangs sogs zhal gzigs/ rin chen dmar po'i gter gsar brdol/ de nas bod du 'byon dgos tshul gsungs/ rgyal po chen pos/ lar 'dir byon pa sku drin che ste yun ring ma song zhabs tog kyang cher ma thengs/ spyir bla ma rtag tu 'grogs kyang gsung ma bsgrub na byin rlabs mi 'byung*/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs na byin rlabs la nye ring med pa ni ngas go ba yin/ hor gyi dus na rgyal pos dbang che byed par 'dug /khyed nged kyi bla ma yin pas khyed dbang che ba yin pas re zhig 'byon la nam gdan 'dren byung pa'i tshe 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad dgos zhes gsol/ de ltar rgya nag hor yu gur mi nyag sogs la 'gro don mtha' yas par mdzad/

rim par gdan sa bar par glang lor byon/ bka' 'gyur rin po che las bzhengs/ rim par yar byon lam 'khod skye bo gnam mtsho tshun 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas cog tse lar phebs tshe/ rgya nag gi mnga' thang la bltos na bod kun bsdoms kyang rgya'i mi dpon chung ngu'i 'byor ba las med mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba'i phyir/ sa skya/ dge ldan/ 'bri gung*/ stag lung sogs/ bod yul so so'i lugs gnyis kyi bdag po chen po rnams nas bsu ba 'bul nod rgya cher byas/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos/ jo bo'i thugs dam rten byams pa me brdugs su grags pa'i sku khru gang gis gtsos 'bul ba dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid du bstod bsngags/ zhabs la phyag bgyi bar spro yang lo gsum mtshams kyi dam bca' zhig byas pas sgrub par ma nus gsungs pa'i zhu yig /kun mkhyen rong ston sogs kun gyi sangs rgyas su bsngags pa'i zhu yig phul/ 'dam du sa g.yos shin tu che bar byung bas/ chibs gzhol te sa gnon mdzad nas bzhugs pas zhi/ mtshur dang lha ldan du phebs/ jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam sbyar sogs dbus gtsang gi sde dgon thams cad la mchod sbyin rgya cher mdzad/ bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis ne'u gdong du spyan drangs/ dbus phyogs kyi lha mi'i sde kun tshim par mdzad/ mdo smad yongs kyi gdan 'dren dang*/ khyad par nyid kyi zhal slob mkhas pa mi lnga la rab sgang mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa spyan 'dren la byon/ chos rje'ang mnyes/ khong gis dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa la brgal brtag 'phangs kyang su'i yang lan 'debs ma nus/ de nas kong po tsa ri sogs la byon te slar dbus su phebs/ dol tshal min du mkhan snyag phu ba dang lhan rgyas/ tshal pas rje rang byung par phul ba'i dol gyi mchod gzhis rnams mkhan chen la gnang*/ des gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ mtshur phu'i zhig sos dang bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ bdag po sne'u pas po ta la phul nas der bzhugs/

rgya gong ma nas 'bul chen thang gsum slebs/ sngon pho brang du byon skabs gsol dkar du me tog gan dkar zhes phyi nang sgrib bral dar las srab pa phul yang gsol dpon gyis shad ches pas 'thor/ de nas cung 'thug pa khyad dkar du ma phul ba 'ga' rje chos kyi 'byung gnas sku na gzhon dus gzigs da mi snang gsung*/ de la ltos na da lta'i nang dkar sogs snyigs mar 'dug gsungs/ bzhes ja la pad+ma'i ge sar dang rgya mtsho phara'i ja phul bar grags/ gan dril zhes gser dmar po las rdza ma dang*/ gser ser po las mgo rdor blugs pa pha lam rwa rtse dang rwa logs su phra byas pa dang*/ zi khyim las dril bu byas pa sogs khyad nor du ma phul ba da lta'ang phyag tu du ma yod par gsungs/ gan dril 'di 'di min gong ma rgyal rab gzhan la ma byung bar grags pa'ang zhar 'phros so/ /mdor na gzhan las rmad du byung ba'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bstan par grags so//skabs shig sgar pa kha cig nas mi srun pa'i spyod pa byung ba na/ rma se rtogs ldan gyis 'di pa la bka' bkyon re tsam zhu zhus pas/ kho bo la zhe sdang skye ma myong bas khro mi shes par 'dug /'on kyang khyod kyi bsam pa gang ba zhig myur du bya zhes gsungs pa 'dis sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang bar ngag sgros las 'chad/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag nas mdo khams gdan 'dren pa rnams la'ang myur du phrad par bya'o gsungs/ gdung lo so gnyis pa shing lug zla ba brgyad par sku 'brum bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ brtan bzhugs phul kyang*/ mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa gtad zin gsol ba thob thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsungs pa dang*/ gzim dpon la dpe mchod rten gsum ma 'thor bar gyis bdag po zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs te zla ba brgyad pa'i bco lngar dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad/ mkhan bsod nams bzang po sogs kyis mchod pa'i bya ba mdzad/

sku gdung rin po che bzhus pas sku dang ring bsrel dpag med byon/ zla ba du ma'i bar du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ dngul gdung dang snang brnyan rin po che nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gser gyi bka' 'gyur rnams mtshur phur bzhugs/ gdung skal gong ma chen po la phul ba rnams la ngo mtshar gyi ltas lhag par rgya che bar gsungs/ zhal slob kyang*/ snying po don gyi brgyud 'dzin bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ go shri sangs rgyas rin chen/ go shri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ go shrir rin chen dpal/ go shri don grub 'od zer/ go shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ go shri shākya bzang po/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ ngom pa bya bral/ sgam po pa chos rgyan/ rma se rtogs ldan/ mi nyag 'jam grags/ mi nyag rtogs ldan/ kong nag ral gri /la phyi pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs skyes bu dam pa grangs med brgya hor bod mi nyag thams cad du byung zhing*/ gong ma tā'i ming g.yun lo chen po dang*/ btsun mo dam pa gnyis kyang nyams rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma'i thu bo dang*/ gzhan yang spyan snga bsod grags/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri khung don rgyal bla paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rje shāka mang*/ jo dan dbu yon/ zha lu slob dpon tsan+d+ra pa sogs chos kyi 'brel ba'i skyes chen rnams te mtha' yas so// // drug pa chos rje mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar/ drug pa chos rje mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ sngon chos rje gong mas mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa gtad zin gsungs pa dang*/ khams kyi gdan 'dren rnams la myur du 'phrad par bya'o gsungs pa ltar karma dang nye ba ngom stod kyi sa'i char/ yab go 'jo bsam grub rdo rje dang yum ldong bza' pad+ma mtsho gnyis kyi sras su me sprel zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs pa na tsog pur bzhugs te yum la gzigs cing bzhad/

dri bzang gis yul khams khyab/ yab kyi rmi lam du skye shing zhig btsugs pa dpag bsam gyi shing du gyur nas lo 'dab kyi 'jig rten khyab pa byung*/ yum gyi rmi lam du phrag gong nyi zlas brgyan pa/ nyi zla khongs su zhugs pa/ dung dkar bus pas khams gsum du grags pa sogs rmis pa rnams phyis byis par zhus pas rmi lam brda bkrol gsungs/ ngom pa bya bral mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la yang sprul sku 'khrungs pa'i rtags byung*/ 'khrungs nas zla gcig dang zhag bzhi'i nyin yab yum slong mor byon pas/ ngom pa bya bral ba gzigs ma thag mnyes tshul mdzad/ dbyangs gsal gsungs/ khong gis byis pa la lkog tu khyod su yin gsungs pas/ bya bral ba'i mdzub mo bzung nas/ nga ni skye med brjod pa kun dang bral//gnas med gnas bral 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams//ma lus thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i phyir//skye 'gro kun gyi dpal du bdag gyur to//nam tshar bar yul gzhan mi spo 'dug/zhes pa'i tshig 'di re zhig gsang*/ /gsungs pas the tshom bral te zhabs tog mdzad/ zla ba bdun bzhes pa na khri thog tu bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mang po gsungs/ yig drug gi sgom lung mdzad/ nya khang du phebs skabs zhwa nag can gyi sku la gzigs nas bzhad/ de su lags zhus pas/ thugs kar phyag mdzub btsugs nas nga yin nga yin gsungs/ bla ma gcod dig pa la dag snang mang du byung bas dad nas thams cad la bsgrags/ karma nas gnyer pa ja 'dren la 'ongs bas ming nas bos phyag nas gnang bas nas 'bru bdun zug /'brum yams chad/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhal gzigs/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma gsungs pas thams cad yid ches/ drung pas thog mar mjal dus/ ngas phyag mdud byin pa de yod dam gsungs/ sngon chos rje gong ma gshegs khar phyag mdud gzhan dang mi mtshungs zhig gnang pa de phul bas bzhengs/ sku la tshad pas mnyam pa byung*/

sngon lung bstan du dgongs nas spyan chab shor/ zhal gzigs mang du byung*/ mkhan chen mgon blon pa la thugs rje chen pos lung bstan nas/ nga'i bla ma khams su yab yum 'di dang 'di 'dra ba la 'khrungs yod pa 'dra gsungs nas byon/ sprul pa'i skus kyang nga'i phyi gzhis yong gi yod gsungs/ yang dgon du mjal nas ja gral dus karma kun spangs pas khyed rang gi thugs 'thad pa zhig la gsol ras gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ ston pa gsungs nas gnang*/ yum 'da' ba na dga' ldan du 'phrad do gsungs/ lha steng du zla ba 'o brgyal ba na/ rgya nag rgyal po'i zhal ras 'dra gsungs/ go 'jo bdag pos zhwa nag la bltas pas/ 'di rgya zhwa min hor dus kyi zhwa yin gsungs/ dgung lo gsum ma zin tsam yin yang skya ser khri phrag mang po la chos 'brel thogs med du gsungs pas thams cad kyi 'dra bar thos/ gzhan la ku re dang co 'dri'i rnam pas chos kyi tshigs bcad thogs med du gsungs shing sus kyang lan lon par mi spobs/ dga' ldan sogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa gsungs/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu ma'i bstod pa mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa dang*/ sang ga lak+ṣa'i rnam 'phrul snying po don gyi rgyud 'dzin mkhas pa dang grub pa'i khyu mchog sog dbon rat+na bha dra dang*/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mkhan chen snyag phu ba sogs yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas/ bka' bstan 'gyur 'grel pa 'grel bshad/ bka' brgyud gong ma dang rgyal sras thogs med sogs kyi bka' 'bum/ dbang rgyud man ngag sogs gsan pa mtha' yas/ de dus karmar dge lugs kyi sngags chog mang po 'don pa la/ chogs dbur phebs skabs 'di 'dra dgos don ci gsungs/ nged rang gi yig cha mi 'dug zhus pas/ yig cha ngas brtsam chog gsungs nas/ rdor dbyings/ sdom pa/ phag mo sogs mang du mdzad/ mgon po'i rnga 'chams dang dbyangs sogs lhag pa'i lhas gnang bzhin gsar du mdzad/

ser ba dang rlung nag sogs la sdigs mdzub gtad pas zhi/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs kyis zhal gzigs mtha' yas pa rnam thar chen mor gsal/ dgung lo dgu par mkhan chen snyag phu ba dang*/ sog dbon rin po che/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan chos grags dpal bzang por gsol/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po'ang zhus pas zhal bzhes yod mod phyis dgung lo nyi shur nye ba na gcig gis sprul pa'i sku bsnyen par rdzogs zin zhes brdzun zhus pas zhal ngo nag ting mdzad nas zhag gsum nas bde bar gshegs skad/ chos rje nyid sngon yul 'khor srung dang*/ drang srong dga' byed dang*/ drang srong dka' thub can sogs su skye ba bzhes pa'i rnam thar gsungs/ rgya gong ma'i gdan 'dren gser yig pa rnams kyis mjal 'bul rgya cher phul/ lha sa'i jo bo'i drung du kun mkhyen rong po sogs skya ser khri phrag du ma la chos 'khor bskor/ kun mkhyen shin tu dad nas gzigs snang dang mthun par/ steng na lha'i gdugs dkar/ sogs bstod pa mdzad/ chos rjes kyang nga la sangs rgyas slob mar yod pa yin gsungs tshur la'ang chos du ma gsan/ mdo khams/ kong po/ lho rong*/ dbus gtsang sogs kyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ chu dkon sar bden tshig brjod pas chu mig gsar du brdol/ zhal gzigs shin tu mang pa la brten nas sgrub thabs dang bstod pa mang po mdzad/ bka' 'gyur gser la bzhengs/ bstan 'gyur gos dar gyi na bza' dang bcas pa'ang bzhengs/ gzhan dag gi skye ba snga phyi mang po lung bstan/ dgung lo so bdun par rtse lha gang du bzhugs skabs lkog 'gyur gyi ltas shes pa rnams kyis sku keg shin tu che zer bar slob dpon sangs rgyas seng ges brtan bzhugs phul ba na/ da lo nged la skyon mi yong zla ba dgu nged rang gi khag theg gsungs/

de nas gsa' phur byon phyag dpe rnams phyag dam gyis mnan/ zhwa nag dang bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams kyi phyag dpe sogs go shri rin po cher gtad de lung bstan bka' rgya can mdzad/ nged ma slebs par rten 'di rnams rgya ma nyams par gyis/ sham+bha la dang ma kha pa rtsod par yod pas rigs ldan gyi grogs la 'gro dgos par yod gsungs/ brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang*/ mgur du ma mdzad cing khyad par ka bzhi seng chen ma byang nas dbu tshugs gsungs te yang yang bzhengs/ sa g.yo ba dang nyi zla la 'od med pa dang*/ 'dab chags thams cad so so'i sde tshan du ma 'dus nas/ mi bzod pa'i ca co dang 'phur lding byed/ sngar bka' lung gnang ba'i zla ba dgu song ba'i chu bya lo gsar tshes kyi tshes brgyad kyi snga dro da ni kho bo yang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gral du sdod pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rin po che//thugs rje'i bdag nyid mthong ba don ldan la//gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs//zhes gsol ba thob cig gsungs te sprul pa phyogs gcig tu bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ sku gdung rin po che zhugs su zhus pas 'ja' dang me tog gi char babs/ thugs ljags spyan gsum/ ring bsrel chu shel gyi mdog can/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi rnam pa/ ring bsrel kha dog lnga ldan ches mang bar byon no//rje de'i slob tshogs bzang la mang pa'i gtso bor/ go shri dpal 'byor don grub/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ stag lung zhabs drung sogs mang du byon pa las snga ma ni/ dgung lo lnga bzhes dus chos rjes mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug dang zhi ba 'od kyis sprul par ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bcu bzhi par mkhan chen mgon blon gshegs pa'i go sar gu'i gung par mnga' gsol/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par dgongs te/ bka' bstan 'gyur gsar snying gi dbang lung bod 'dir bzhugs so 'tshal zhu bar mngags/

gong ma tā ming cing thung rgyal pos gu shrī'i las ka 'ja' sa gser tham las zhwa mthon mthing rnams phul kyang*/ las zhwa chos rje nyid dang rnam 'gyur 'dra bas 'gal bar gzigs nas rdo rje 'chang gi nang rten du bzhugs/ chos rjes sku gdung gi mchod rten dang sku tshab bzhengs pa dang*/ gser thog gi zhig gso/ rgyal tshab tu bzhugs nas sgar gyi 'dzin skyong sogs kar bstan gyi khur bzhes pa'i mdzad pa rgya che zhing mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i yongs 'dzin dam par gyur to// //bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/

bdun pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ chos rje mthong ba don ldan gyis zhal chems bka' rgya bcu gsum dang bcas pa go shrī chen por gnang ba las/ byang phyogs spyi lha zhes bya bar sprul sku 'byon par yab yum dang bcas lung bstan cing*/ mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen pos kyang ja gral cig tu nga'i rmi lam ltar na da res sprul sku'i yab la dpal grub bya ba zhig yong ba 'dug gsungs/ kun mkhyen ban sgar pas kyang mtshur phu nas shar phyogs drang por sprul sku 'byon zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ rngod spyi mda' zhes par yab grags pa dpal grub dang*/ yum lha mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su shing khyi zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dro 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ de ma thag a la la gsungs shing bzhad/ sku la me tog gi rnam pa mang po dang*/ dbu ltag tu rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ thugs kar tsa ris kyis a yig /gsang gnas su chos 'byung dang 'khor lo/ zhabs la 'khor lo ste sku la rang byon drug gsal/ gsang chab 'o mar 'babs dri bzang gi ngad kyis thams cad khyab/ zhag bdun na gsung mang po byon pa yab yum sogs der yod pa rnams kyi go lugs du ma byung*/ yab yum gyis gsang bar dam bcas kyang*/ nyid kyi thugs rje'i rang 'od mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar bshad mkhan med kyang spyi nang du bya bral pho mo gnyis la chos rje sku 'khrungs zer ba'i grags pas khyab/ phyogs phyogs nas mjal du 'dus pas gsang bar rngo ma thog /snye po gdan sa pa chos dpal 'byor gyis thos nas mjal du 'gro bsam pa na rmi lam du yum gyi pang na bzhugs 'dug pa la dbu zhwa sogs phul ba rmis pas/ bla ma bsgres po la rngod nas skad cha 'di 'dra 'dug ci byar 'os zhus pas/ nga'i rmi lam na spyi lha'i la khar nyi zla shar ba rmis pas the tshom mi dgos/

drung gong ma'i dbu zhwa sogs khyer la song gsungs/ phyin pas sku 'khrungs nas zhag bco lnga'i thog tu slebs/ khong gzigs pas bzhad/ rje gong ma'i dbu zhwa sogs phul bas phyag gis bzhes/ khyed thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan yin na nga la byin rlabs gnang zhus pas phyag gnyis ka spyi bor bzhag ste byin rlabs yang yang gnang*/ zla ngo gnyis bzhes pa na rngod pa'i skya ser rnams kyis a rig thang du gdan drangs/ chos rje gong ma'i chos khri la bzhugs nas phyag rten la reg /thams cad la byin rlabs gnang nas kun la dal bus gzigs/ phyag g.yas pas zhal dkyil phyis nas mnyam zhag lta stangs mdzad de/ sku gzi brjid dang ldan par bzhugs pas thams cad dad/ de nas zla ngo gsum bzhes pa na/ khyed karma pa min pa 'dra/ rje gong ma rnams kyis gsung 'byon pa dang grub rtags mang du bstan 'dug/nyid mthong ba don ldan gyi sku'i skye ba yin na gsung gcig 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ nga ni karma'i ming can te//nga lta'i gang zag dkon pa yin//nga dang 'brel ba gang yod pa//nga'i mi bslu'i smon lam yod//bcu gsum zla ba ma rdzogs par//tshig 'di gsang chen rgya dang ldan//de nas kho bo rtsod bral ba'i//rtags rnams rim gyis gsal bar 'gyur//zhes gsungs/ de nas snye bos gdan drangs/ karma si tu'i zhu yig lcags mo dbon po sogs kyis phul bas/ zhu yig bzhes nas klog tshul mdzad/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsungs nas lcags mo'i pang du byon/ gzhan yang sngar slob mang pos ming gsungs pas/ thams cad sngon dus dran nas dad pa'i yus kyis ngus/ 'khrungs nas zla ngo lnga par sku mdun der kha cig tho co 'dra byas pas/ a haṃ bde stong sgyu ma'i rtsal//sna tshogs ye shes rol pa la//byis pa rnams kyis bden par mthong*//nga ni skye gnas dang bral */ /gsungs/ de nas zla ba dgu bzhes pa na/ go shrī rin po che nas mjal/ phyag rten rnams phyag tu rim par bzhes/

rje gong ma'i dbu zhwa phul ba mnabs shing rdor dril phyag gis bsnams pad kor dril stab mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab par dgongs te/ rang byung kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol/ sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi seng khrir mnga' gsol/ gcig gis bsngo yig phul bar dga' ldan du skye bar gyur cig gsungs/ gzhan gyis co 'dri zhus pa na/ the tshom mi dgos bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyis zhal la ltas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis phrin las sgrub cing yod/ sa ra ha/ birba pa/ ku ku ri pa gsum nam mkhar bzhugs 'di gsum gyi rnam thar 'dzin mi nga yin gsungs nas phyag mdzub nam mkhar gtad/ yum gyis kyang de rnams mjal/ mdo chen phu na gcod la 'byon gsungs/ gcod ji ltar byed zhus pas/ sems nyid rtsad nas gcod pa yin gsungs/ rtsad nas ji ltar gcod zhus pas/ sgom gyis gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas/ nam mkhar phyag mdzub gtad de mtha' dbus med pa cig yin gsungs/ yum sras bla ye na bzhugs dus/ yum la/ phyag 'tshol rdo rje 'chang dang mi la seng ge la chibs pa nam mkha' la yod gsungs/ nyid nas kyang phyag dang mgur gyi lad mo mdzad/ yang 'khrul 'khor mdzad cing yum la ngas khyod kyi lto bar 'di ltar byas pas khyod kyi hub po ba yin gsungs/ tsa ri la 'gro gsungs/ yum gyi tsa rir 'gro ba'i don ci lags zhus pas/ gang zag byin rlabs nus pa'i gnas yin gnas sgo yang phye rgyu yod/ tsa ri'i gdul bya kho bos skyong*/ kho bo'i bar chad gnas kyis sel gsungs/ yang gcig gis mjal bas a la gsungs/ drung mthong ba don ldan gyis gnang ba'i ming zhig yod zhus pas bkra shis yin gsungs/ gsa' phu gang na yod zhus pas/ gsa' phu ya ki yin/ pha ri sham po'i ri yin gsungs/ gsa' phur nga'i mchod rten yod mgyogs par rta rgyug nas 'gro gsungs/ der drung gong ma'i gsol lcog steng 'og can rgyus med kyi mi shes pa cig yod pa sku mdun du bzhag pas/

steng ma de yar khyog gsungs/ thang sku la gzigs nas/ mthong ba don ldan dang 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs rnams nga yin/ 'di sgrol ma/ 'di phyag drug par 'dug gsungs/ de skabs dgung lo gsum pa ljags klog ma phul yang*/ yig drug dbyangs dang bcas klog par mdzad/ dpon ma ṇi bsgrongs/ kho bo spyan ras gzigs yin/ 'khor ba 'dren oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ gsungs nas dbyangs mdzad/ dge 'dun khri tsam 'dus pa la ma ṇi pad dbyangs gsungs pas thams cad dad/ zhal gzigs mtha' yas shing lhag par spyan ras gzigs mar pa mi la gsum yang yang zhal gzigs de gsum nyid yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ yon bdag lhun grub rgan gog gnyis mjal du yong bas ming nas bos te yar shog gsungs gsol ras gnang*/ dgung lo bzhi par rta mgrin gling gi gnas sgo phye/ rta mgrin zhal phyag tha dad pa du ma bstan/ thams cad kyis sngags thon gsungs nas sngags gsungs tshogs 'khor mdzad/ rtsi ma la khar chibs thog gzim yur ba na/ 'phrang ngan pas chibs pa 'gred 'ong zhus pas/ gzims sad nas slob dpon pad+ma gar yod gsungs/ mi shes 'phrang ngan 'di 'drar thugs sgrim zhus pas/ slob dpon pad+ma nga rang yin pas chog 'phrang ngan yang skyon mi 'ong gsungs/ zhing skyong spyan sngar byung nas bla ma bsam gtan pa la bstan pas khong gis kyang mthong*/ dgung lo lnga par go shrī rin po che nas bka' chos 'bul ba'i dbu btsugs/ yi ge phyi mo phul/ rjes gnang zhig gi tshe gar zhig mdzad dgos zhus pas/ bzhengs nas stang stabs dang pad kor zhig mdzad/ sngar ngas khang dmar dang*/ zur mang*/ karma rnams su byas pa de yin/ de dus nga chen po yin/ da nga chung ngu red zin pas mi shes par gda' 'o gsungs/ than pa byung nas char 'bebs zhus pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs kyis da lta nyid du char phobs shig /gsungs pas de dgongs nas bzung char babs/ kar dpon 'gro dus si tu pa la zhal ta cig zhu zhus pas/

khong la go chod par gyis smros zhal ta de yin gsungs/ dgung lo lnga par zla ba drug pa'i skabs na/ bya bral zur mang ba zhwa khra can ag tshom dmar po yod pa des karma pa mkhyen zer bas 'chi 'dug smon lam byed gsungs nas bsngo smon mdzad/ phyis de'i bsngo rten 'bul mi byung bas de skabs shi bar 'dug /blo bzang gi ma bde ba can du drangs pa sogs bar do'i don mdzad pa mang*/ sngon rje rang byung pas btul ba'i kla klo'i rgyal rgyud kla klo mang po mjal du byung*/ karma pa karma pa zer nas dad pa'i shugs skyes/ rat+na gling pas gter nas bton pa'i dam rdzas dang rje nyid kyi lung bstan bcas phul/ kho bo la sprul pa spyir rgya bod kun la mang du yod/ bye brag pu rang du shākya bya ba dang*/ sham+bha lar rgyal po/ kha cher nya pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad pa sogs dpag med yod gsungs/ rten sgam chen po bzhi sku drung du gdan drangs pas gan dho la'i sgo phye gsungs gang lags zhus pas 'di gsungs nas phye ste grub chen pak+shi la byon pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sku gzigs su phul nas su la byon pa lags zhus pas/ karma pa min pa 'di 'dra su la byon gsungs pa sogs mngon mkhyen gsungs pa shin tu mang bas brir mi langs/ dgung lo brgyad par slar yang rat+na gling pas gter byon tshe ril dang*/ rta nag shog ser las/ chos rje nyid chos bdag tu lung bstan pa rnams phul/ bla ma/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro /chos skyong gi zhal gzigs 'byams klas shing bstod pa dang gsol 'debs kyang mang du gsungs pa rnam thar chen mor mjal/ go shrī chen po la/ sdug bsngal chos kyi dbyings su dag/stong nyid ye shes dbyer med la//ma 'gags sna tshogs rol pa'i rtsal//rang byung nga'i rnam thar yin//zhes don gyi rnam thar gsungs/ de nas grub thob rdzong pa'i brgyud pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam thar tshad med pa kun mkhyen ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang pos thog mar mjal/

tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan phul bas/ da dung slob dpon pad+ma'i sku yod 'dug pa'ang phul dgos gsungs pas shin tu dad/ dgung lo dgu par karmar byon/ go shrī rin po che nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang sems sdom phul ba'i tshe/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ bstan pa'i bdag po zhal gzigs/ rtsar gshis su ri bong gcig la chos gsungs/ dga' ldan sku skye bar lung bstan/ gzhan yang rten bzang ngan sna tshogs pa'i lung bstan mang*/ tshems brjes pa rnams la sku dang yig 'bru sna tshogs byon/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par jo bo gan dho la dang thub pa chu lon sogs kyi drung du/ kun mkhyen ban sgar pas mkhan po/ go shrī chen pos slob dpon mdzad dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan chos grags rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol/ de phyin bslab gzhi phra mo'ang khyad du mi gsod par phyag bzhes mdzad/ chos 'byung steng gi pha waṃ zhig la zhabs rjes drug /rga lo phyug tu zhabs rjes drug /chos khri sar kun gyis mthong bar zhabs rjes gnyis shin tu gsal bar bzhag /nyid kyi zhabs rjes lta ci smos/ chibs chen lhun grub zer ba des zhabs rjes gcig byung*/ rgya nag rgyal po ching hwa'i lung gis/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag khyad par can dang*/ mu tig gi snam sbyar yol ba bla bres sogs mchod rdzas mang po/ gser bre gos dar shin tu mang po 'byor/ se chen brgyud pa rgyal bu dbang sogs nas kyang 'bul ba rgya cher slebs/ chibs pa lhun grub 'das pa'i so la dung dkar mchin pa dang rgyus pa thams cad yig 'bru dang ring bsrel du song zhing 'ja' 'od kyis thams cad khyab/ sma ri dwags su bzhugs skabs dgun sgang chen la me tog sdong po sngon po gcig la me tog bdun/ re re la ge sar ser po 'dab ma ut+pal ltar sngo ba bcu gsum re skyes te thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ mdor na kong po/ li thang*/ gnas nang*/ kha ba dkar/

dar mdo/ a mdo/ 'bom nyag sogs mdo khams sgang drug rnams su byon/ dgon pa dang*/ sgrub sde mang po gsar du btsugs/ 'khrugs rtsod thams cad bsdum te/ 'khrugs chen rnams lo nyer lnga tsam dang*/ jag rkun lo gsum sogs mi byed pa dang*/ ma ṇi dung phyur/ bye ba/ sa ya sogs kyi dam bca' byed pa'i yul sde dang yon bdag grangs las 'das pa byung*/ gar byon gar bzhugs thams cad du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char lang long du babs/ nyid dang tha mi dad pa'i rgya bod grub thob rig 'dzin sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi zhal gzigs la rgyun chad med par 'byams klas/ bu slob yon bdag mang pos/ chos rje nyid/ la las bstan pa'i bdag po/ la las rta mgrin/ la las rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ la las 'khor ba dong sprugs/ de bzhin du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi/ bcu gcig zhal/ 'jam dbyangs sogs su mjal ba shin tu mang skal ldan rnams la zab khrid mdzad pa/ rlung pa rnams la ras 'bud/ phal pa rnams kyang dge ba sna tshogs pa la bkod nas ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las ltar mdzad nas rim par dbus su chib spyod mdzad pas/ 'dam gzhung du dgun 'brug sgra dang char babs/ chos grar nas kyi char pa mngon sum babs/ chu mig brdol/ de nas mtshur phur byon lha chen la sa g.yos kyi cung zad gnod pa zhig gsos dang rab gnas mdzad tshe bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs/ lha sar byon/ sne'u rdzong pas lha'i 'byor ba lta bus bsus/ jo bo rin po cher mu tig gi snam sbyar/ jo bo mi bskyod pa la snam sbyar gser mdog sogs mchod sprin mtha' yas pa dang smon lam mdzad/ ngo mtshar gyis ltas mang*/ de nas 'dam gzhung gnam mtsho sogs su byon/ slar zhwa dmar bzhi pas spyan drangs nas sne gdong du byon/ yar rgyab dpon gyis bsu ba dang*/ sne'u gdong du spyan snga pas 'byor pa chen pos bsus/ byams gling dang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos mjal/

yar stod pa dang bya ba gnyis kyi 'khrugs chen bsdum/ byar khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas kyis 'byor pa chen pos bsus te chos rgyal lhun por phebs/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste rgyal srid blos khrol te 'bul chen gsum phul ba'i dang po la chos lhun dgon pa'i thog drangs/ g.ye/ rong*/ mon shal tshun mnga' zhabs kyi dgon sde thams cad dang gnyal sde drug /byar chos sde/ lho brag mkhar chu sogs che phra thams cad phul/ gnyis par rang gi sras chos rgyal nor bu dang*/ bkra shis rnam rgyal mched gnyis dbu skra phul nas mnga' zhabs kyi mi ser thams cad phul/ gsum par chos lhun shel rdzong*/ yang rtse/ shar gzhis sogs rang dbang rdzong gzhis thams cad phul/ zla phyed re la 'bul chen dngos po re re'ang khri grangs kyi mi tshad pa phul nas smon lam dang gsol 'debs mdzad/ sras che ba ra lung rgyal dbang rje'i sku skyer mtshan chos kyi grags par btags go shrī'i las ka gnang*/ gcig la karma phrin las du btags nas chos lhun gdan sar bskos/ sngags mtshan nyid bshad grwa sgom grwa mang du btsugs nas so sor slob dpon bskos/ rje dus mkhyen gyi yon bdag mon gyi rgyal rgyud mon rgyal po mjal du slebs/ 'bul ba rgya cher dang sras gcig phul te mon du dgon gnas 'debs par zhus/ gnas ngo mtshar rong gi sbyin bdag bgyid par byas rdor 'dzin bskos/ slar spyan snga rin po che nas phebs bsu bcas zangs ri dang thil du phebs/ de nas bsam yas mchim phur sngon chos rje rang byung bas sgrub sde btsugs mkhas pa klong chen pa bskos pa de nyams gso sgrub sde gsar du mdzad bla ma bskos/ lha ldan du phebs/ lhun rtse rdzong pas phyag nas zhus pa la de nas gnang bas rdzong nang du sleb thum po byas nas phyogs med du bkye/ rgyal ba byams pas lung bstan lan gsum du jo bo shākya nag grong gi dbus su bzhugs pa bstan pa spyi nyams shing rgyan gyi rten 'brel gyis bod 'ban btsun mang ba ste/

sku 'khor dge 'dun gtsang sde byung na bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur zhes gsan kyang gzhis ka sne'u drung na rim gsum gyi sbyin bdag yin rung gzhan dbang gis bka' ma sgrubs bka' ma bcag tsam du karma grwa tshang chos sde btab/ der bdud kyis dkrugs pa'i ser dmag g.yul shom pa na/ dad ldan du mas sgar pa rang la nyis stong tsam 'dug pas phyag mdzod du 'bul ba'i gri khrab kyi dos bshig nas lan bya bar 'os zhus kyang*/ 'o skol su la'ang gnod pa mi byed pa sangs rgyas kyi ring lugs pa yin phyir/ mtshams med pa'i las kyis rgyal bstan la rma mi 'byin/ nga'i 'khor yin na cog ge sdod cig gsungs/ phyir nang ser dmag lnga brgya tsam rmog med pa lhung bzed mgor gyon nas byung rung sgar chen rnams bka' bzhin g.yo med du bsdad pas gnod ma nus/ chos sde mkhar pas re gnyis zin ma zin pa rnams bshig /'di thos pas skye bo lha mi thams cad yid 'khrugs/ drung zhwa dmar pa'i lha 'bang*/ bya pa khri dpon/ kong po rgya bdag thams cad/ sa skyong don yod/ lcags mo 'od zer sogs mang po nas tshar gcod byed par zhus pas/ nged su la'ang phan las gnod pa mi byed/ khyed grwa yon bdag rnams kyang chos bzhin byas na nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs/ nged la dmigs nas gzhan gnod byas na nga'i zhabs tog ma yin gsungs pas/ kha cig lhag par dad/ zhwa dmar pa'i sku 'khor dang*/ khri dpon sogs nas khyed bstan pa'i bdag pos bstan pa mi srung na nged tsho la 'dra nyan chung zer nas thugs chad mdzad/ khri dpon nas yar gong sne gsum dang srid bshig ste gtsang srid mdzad nas skyi shod du dmag bteg pas/ khong rnams rje zhwa dmar la skyabs zhus pas/ chos rje nyid la zhus gsungs ltar rtse lha sgang du pho nya btang bas bka' shog gnang pas khri dpon yi chad cher mdzad kyang*/ byed po rnams kyi lus srog longs spyod gnas dang bcas par mi 'jigs pa sbyin/

'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog ni//nyes pa'i lan yang legs pas ldon//zhes pa mngon du mdzad/ de nas 'bri khung du bstan pa'i nyams gso dang sgrub sde btsugs/ rin po che khu dbon la bka' gnang*/ kong po'i gdan 'dren mang du byung*/ khyad par chos rje kho na bsam zhing kong lung kha lo bsgyur nus pa sa skyong don rdor gyi grogs po 'bro la hu res/ chos rje rin po che khyed 'jag gi sar byon pa yin na 'jag la be rgan gyi me yod/ nas rgan gyi chang yod/ phag rgan gyi sha yod/ ma byon na khyi rgan sgug yun ring na bshang ba grang thag chad smra ba de yong ba yin zer ba phul der khri dpon rnams kyis bltas nas 'bul ma nus par zhu yig gsar du byas nas phul bas/ kong po de sngar ma bcos pa cig yod pa yin/ de 'gyur 'dug mi 'gro gsungs/ dngos de ka phul bas bzhad cing 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ brag dkar lta chu'i gnas sgo phye zhabs rjes bzhag /da dung kun gyi mthong sar zhabs rjes zhus pas/ 'o na 'di na yig drug 'dug /gsungs phyag mdzub kyis brag la bri tshul mdzad pas yig drug 'bur dod du khyur gyis byung*/ nags phur byon skabs chibs chen gwa pa gcig shi bas ring bsrel du ma byung*/ zho khar 'phan chen cung zad nyams pa gsos/ sngon byang du byon skabs rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bodhi la mchod rdzas dang bstod pa smon lam skṛ ta'i skad du bris nas dzo gi 'chi med mgon po brdzangs/ skabs 'dir rdo rje gdan pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan yid kyi shing rtas rgya gar du bstan pa spel bar 'byon dgos pa'i zhu yig 'byor/ de mtshungs mang gha dha'i rgyal po dang ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta sgra gcan zin rnams kyis kyang spyan 'dren zhu ba byung*/ zhu yig bod skad du bsgyur pa rnam thar chen mor gsal/ ngo ma mtshur phur yod par gsungs/ bka' lan legs sbyar du mdzad pa dang rdo rje gdan du mchod pa sogs gnang ste brdzangs/

tsa ri dang tsa gong gi phyogs su dgon pa dang sgrub sde du ma btab/ rgya nag gong ma snga ma gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus/ phyi ma khri 'don gyi shis brjod zhu bar gser yig dang*/ ja brgya lnga bcu/ mdzod gos brgya/ tsan sdong sum cu so grangs/ dngul rkyen gnyis sogs slebs/ pho brang gi mi chen so so nas kyang zhu yig mang*/ thams cad kyis re ba bskang*/ karma sogs su si tu bkod bzhag mdzad/ spyir rgya nag rgyal po'i ma gtogs las tshan bkod bzhag mi chog kyang*/ gong ma tā ming gis chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa la rgya bod sa khad 'gyangs bas chos rje nyid nas lha mi'i dpon po ji 'os bkod bzhag mdzad par zhu/ rgyab gnon nged kyis byed zhus pas/ da phyin go shrī dang si tu bkod par mdzad/ smon lam gyi cho ga yan lag nyi shu pa mdzad de/ dus chen bzhi dang khyad par cho 'phrul gyi yar ngo la 'dzam gling tsam na zla med pa'i rten ngo mtshar can gzhal du med pa las ci rigs pa bshams rin po che a li mig /shel spyad kha dog sna tshogs/ gser dmar smug ser gsum sogs rin po che'i mchod rdzas bod yul du sngon mthong thos med pa'ang du ma nyin re bzhin brje zhing bshams snga dro chos rje nyid srab stan nas gus phyag sogs mdzad cing da lta chos spyod du yod pa'i smon lam nyid kyi zhing sbyong 'di chos rje nyid kho nas gsungs/ de tshe thams cad kyis nyan cing zhal lta phyi dro sangs rgyas byang sems kyi skyes rabs du ma/ rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams byon tshul/ rgya bod hor gsum sogs kyi rgyal po/ brgya byin dang 'khor los sgyur ba sogs pa'i tshul gyis rtsed sna sna tshogs mdzad/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mngon du 'byon pa'i mtshan ma 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa byung*/ spyir chos rje 'di rtag tu skyil krung mnyam zhag lta stangs kyis bzhugs pa las/

'jig rten gyi gtam dri mol sum 'brel phan mi mdzad/ chos kyi 'brel gtam cung zad ma gtogs gsung cher mi 'byon/ gzim sgar gar byon du mjal mkhan mang dus zhag gsum lnga bdun sogs nas zhal mjal ja gral byin rlabs tsam ma gtogs phal cher thugs dam kho nar bzhugs pas/ skyo seng dang ri gzigs la mi 'byon/ de'i phyir thams cad zhal mjal shin tu dka' zhing dkon pa'i 'du shes kyis cho 'phrul ring snga dro sgar pa thams cad phyi dro khrom kun gyis mjal du yod pas dad can rnams zhal mjal kho na'i ched du 'ongs/ thams cad sgar pa lo sar zer nas 'dus/ phyis rgya zam 'ba' zhig la byas pa'i gur chen gnam sngo leb zhes khang pa ka ba brgya'i tshad yol ba/ skar phibs sgo zur gyi lcog gaṇa jir/ gser bya gser 'brug can byed chas mchod shoms/ gan dho la'i thog tu tā ming rgyal pos phul ba mu tig che ba the bong tsam nas chung ba sran ma tsam mdog dkar dmar ser sngo sogs bsgrigs pa'i gdugs bcu gsum brtsegs pa'i bdun pa yang pho 'dom gnyis kyis 'khor tsam dang*/ dbu thog dang sku rgyab sogs su mu tig gi bla bre yol ba sku mnye bzhugs 'bol 'phan chen sogs thams cad mu tig kho na sogs mchod rdzas khyad par ba rnams bshams tshe dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i bdag po sa skyong don yod rdo rje sogs kyang ha las te lha yul du mngon sum slebs 'dra'i ngo mtshar gyis dri ba'i spobs pa tsam yang med pa dang*/ gzhan yang ches che bar grags pa'i bla dpon rnams kyang 'di ci rmi lam mam mngon sum/ rnam sras kyi khang par slebs sam/ mig 'khrul yin nam zhes bsam mno yang yang gtong dgos byung skad/ rten mchod rgyas pa rgya nag gnas bcu sogs mchog rnams mdzod nag na bzhugs te gong gi de rnams byes mdzod rags bsdus tsam yin kyang 'di skabs mchod shoms chen mo mi the ba gan dho la'i skor kho na la rten sgam rgyab tshad ma bcu drug tsam yod pa

dang*/ sngon chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus rgyab tshad ma sum cu so gnyis yod par grags shing*/ phyi dus su ni bdun brgyad tsam du snang zhes rje kun khyab gsungs/ rten mchod yongs kyi byung ba ji bzhin pa ni chos rje rim byon gyi ye shes kyis mkhyen par zad mod/ gu'i gung pa sogs kyi rags pa tsam las mi mkhyen par grags/ spyir chos rje gar bzhugs su 'ja' dang me tog gi char ni rtag tu 'babs/ nad yams 'khrugs rtsod zhi/ skya rgyal/ rtag tu mjal mkhan khri phrag las mi nyung*/ nyin mis bskor lam las mtshan lha 'dres bskor lam byang phul che khal mdzo gzim khyi gzim dril sogs shi yang 'ja' dang me tog gi char dang ring bsrel 'byung*/ sgar dpon rnams kyang tshong mi byed/ yo byad mi bsogs/ nang brtag rgyud gsum dang rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi gar thig dbyangs rnams chig rkya pher zhing bu slob thams cad bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams rtogs dang ldan/ bu tsha 'bring yan chad/ yig bcu/ bai ro tsa na/ yig drug sogs kyis sngags thung rab rnams kyis dung phyur bzhi/ 'bring gsum/ tha mas kyang gang rung dung phyur gcig ma thon na mi grangs su mi rtsi/ gdan sa khag sogs bla ma/ go shrī /dpon che chung sogs sgar pa gral pa dang bu tsha thams cad shog dgos nas zla ba gsum re tsam go shrī res khrims dpon byas nas khrims pa sum cu tsam res mos su bsko/ khrims rar tshul dang mi mthun pa'i sdod lugs spangs te mi chen gyi sdod lugs kho na dang*/ phyogs kyi zhu 'os rnams mgron gnyer/ dpon gzim dpon/ gu'i gung pa nas rim par zhu/ 'gron po rnams thog mar khrims res pas gzhi len byed/ sgar du sha mi 'grim/ sgar nang du sha chang mi khyer bud med mi 'jog /khrims res pa brje dus nga'i ring la khrims la 'das ri shi'i mna' 'bul/ de'i dbang gis sgar pa shin tu rgya che yang 'thab rtsod dang g.yo khrams med par thams cad dul/

tshe dpag rta mgrin/ dgongs 'dus/ rnam 'joms/ mgon po ste sku rim khang lnga/ las byed rnams kyis byed sgo/ stan gyi thob chibs rags kyi dus skya dar rol mo sogs snga 'gro rnams dang rta dkar po re la rten gan dho la bkal pa la gser thog phub pa rnams mdun dang*/ chibs kyi rgyab nas/ gu'i gung pa sogs go shrī bla ma dpon chen sogs go rim nges can du byon/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du bsil g.yab nyi zla kha sbyor 'khyer/ las 'dzin pa rnams g.yo na gnon gtsag zha g.yon gnon gtsug zhwa gu'i gung sogs las ka can rnams las zhwa/ bla ma sga shub stan dmar thog pa rnams dang dpon chen rnams gos zlam gtsug zhwa sogs mi chen kho na chibs rags su'o//spyir bsgrigs khrims shin tu dam pas thos bsam sgom pa smar/ dge sbyor mtho ba rnams tsog pur mtshams ltar bzhugs pas ri pa dang*/ de bas kyang dben pa la yang ri par grags/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ zur mang bya bral/ rgya ston bya bral sogs mang po ri khrod la theg pa'ang yod/ gzhan rnams la dbu mdzad re bskos nyin bzhin gzim gur gyi phyi nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sku mtshams dngos med dus zhag gsum re nas dmigs pa re zhu/ de lta bu'i chos sgar de las nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa ches mang pas rang sras grub pa thob pas sa chen khyab ces pa de byung ste smon lam chen mo las 'phros pa'i mdzad spyod zur tsam ste zhib par rnam thar chen mo rnams su mjal/ zing por byon skabs char pa sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba babs/ phyag nas zhus tshe sa thag ring thung la khyad med par der char ltar 'bab cing rten la zug pa shin tu mang po byung*/ byar khri dpon yab sras dpon g.yog bzhi brgya tsam mjal du 'ong nas gser srang brgya phrag /byi ru'i sdong po khru tshad sogs khyad nor du ma dang*/ khri dpon nyid spyan chab bcas gser ga sogs lus brgyan thams cad kyang phul/

rab tu byung bar zhus kyang 'khor rnams kyis zhu nan dang*/ rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs na lam chod gzhan phan che bar bkas gnang*/ las nad snyun gzhi drag po yod kyang bshags pa dang mos gus drag pos sangs/ mdzod nag gi rten mjal chen mo zhus/ 'bral mi phod bzhin du bka' lung gis phyir theg /chos rgya dkar po la zhib cha byas/ sngon rje rang byung pa seng ge la chibs te byon nas btul ba'i klo gra dkar gyi rgyal po mjal du byung*/ srog sdom dang 'bul ba phul/ gzhan yang ma ṇi bgrang pa dang*/ tsa ri gnas bskor la ngan pa mi byed pa dang*/ 'khrugs pa mi byed pa sogs kyi dam bca' phul/ lha mo rang byung ma'i bsnyen sgrub btsugs pas rlung thog dang*/ gtor len 'jigs rung mngon du mthong ba snying tshal khrag thun du slebs pa sogs rtags mtshan ches mang*/ rnam thos rir bzhugs skabs/ dbus gtsang*/ mdo khams/ bya ba/ spo rdod ske gsum sogs kyis gdan 'dren dus gcig slebs/ spo bor byon/ sngon phyag lcags btsugs pa shing rtsa ba gcig la 'bras bu mi 'dra ba gsum smin/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos 'bul chen dang spyan 'dren slebs/ dus sgrigs nas phyag nas gnang bas char bzhin babs pa dang 'bro la hu res ka ba la phyag nas phyed zug pa de 'dra du ma byung*/ snur rje rgyal pos dung dkar mgo dgu phul/ rgya la'i nags gseb seng ldeng sdong po lnga tshom yod par lung bstan btsal bas rnyed nas dbus ma la gaṇ+ḍi mdzad/ lkog phreng nas tshe chu tshe ril gter nas bzhes gter tshab bzhag /gu ru zhal gzigs gdams pa lung bstan du ma gsungs/ spyir zhal gzigs ni rgyun mi chad pa ste smos kyi mi langs/ byar chos lhun du byon/ bla ma dpa' bos mjal/ dro bo lung du sgrub sde 'debs par bka' gnang*/ 'di skabs sa skyong don rdor pas snel pa'i sa thob nas lo shas song ba des 'byor pa chen pos bsus/ ser 'bras dge gsum gyi phebs bsu bcas lha sar byon/

jo bo la rnga chen mtha' 'dom nyer bzhi pa dang jo bo gnyis ka la lcags khra bra mig sogs phul/ rgya ston dpon g.yog gi gser ka ṭo ra gang sogs 'bul chen mdzad/ smyug lar mkhar gsar byas pa la/ nas dkar ka to ra gang phul nas phyag nas zhus pas/ gzhu snye'i la kha nas gtor bar gnang bas/ smyug lar sgo phye nas bltas pas skya chag ge 'dug pa bsdus pas sngon las mang mang ba byung*/ nas khang du btab pas nas 'phel/ de'i bka' drin sab phyir gser khang la yum sras kyi karma grwa tshang la phog nar mar 'debs par zhus/ gtsang du gdan drangs chos sde ris med kyi dge 'dun khri phrag du mas bsus/ lhag par paṇa chen shākya mchog shin tu dad nas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las 'phros pa'i zab bshad zla ba tsam gnang*/ thugs rgyud gcig pa'i zhal bzhes dang bzhugs khri mnyam par mdzad/ pad gling gis mjal/ gter byon dam rdzas dang chos rje lung bstan sogs phul/ mon rgyal po/ kha che rgyal po/ bal po rgyal po/ pu rang rgyal po/ gu ge rgyal po/ mang yul rgyal po/ glo bo rgyal po/ las stod lho byang gi rgyal po/ gtsang stod rgyal po sogs kyis 'bul ba dang gser yig /mtha' nor khyad par can ches mang slebs de dag don ldan du mdzad/ slar kong por byon pa sogs bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa ni bod yul tsam du ma zad rgya dkar nag sogs 'dzam gling phrin las kyi khyab par mdzad/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos rgya gzhung thams cad kyi don gsal zhing bsdus pa yig cha la gzigs pa dang bod gzhung gang la'ang ma ltos par rang stobs kyis rigs gzhung rgya mtsho zhes pa shugs byung du brtsam par mdzad/ mkhas dbang dwags ram pas/ 'jig rten gsum sgron la zhu ba po nga 'dra zhig med pas lan/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho ngas rtsom par gsol/ yi ge rang gis byas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa de gzhan dang mi 'dra/ tshad ma'i gzhung tsam sku 'khris su med/

phyag dpe ni mi gzigs/ rtag tu lta stangs dang ting nge 'dzin las g.yo ba med pa'i ngang nas/ bka' chos sogs mdzad skyong zad mi shes pa gnang ba'i gsol lcog gi 'khris su bdag gis snyug gu nag tung nge bzung nas bsdad/ gseng nam byung du thugs rtsom zhus pa na/ gang na yod gsungs pa tsam las thogs pa med par spyan lta stangs kyi ngang nas sha ra ra gsungs/ rang gi blo gros nyi tshe bas khong du ma chud pa 'ga'/ ci 'di dag zhus pa na/ rtsom phro bcad de ci yang mi gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i gsung la yid ches dgos tshul sogs bka' gnang*/ phyis de ltar ma zhus par gang gsung de ka bris pas de'i rtsod spangs sogs ha las pa re gnang ba ni mkhas pa'i rtog ge pa sus kyang gsung sgros gcig gi zur gyi cha shas tsam la'ang dpyod cing co 'dri'i go skabs nam yang mi rnyed/ go la'i rtsis kyi skabs cung zad go tshod zhus pa na/ de 'dra min pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs nas phyag g.yas pa nam mkhar cung zad bskyangs nas nged bgro gleng de ltar byed pa yin gsungs nas zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad/ chos rje'i phyag brkyang pa rdzogs par mthong mkhan sku mdun pa la'ang nga las med gsungs/ gzur gnas mkhas pas bltas na tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'di mtshungs 'phags bod gang du'ang ma byung ba zur mang mkhas grub kun khyab pas gsungs/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel 'jig rten gsum sgron las 'khor lo gsum skabs de der nges don yin kyang*/ mthar thug dgongs pa nges 'grel/ gzungs dbang klu sgrub kyi dbu ma tshogs gsum las bstod tshogs/ thogs med kyis bkral ba ltar 'khor lo tha ma nges don yin par na ro mai tri pa lo tsā ba chen po mnyam med dwags po/ dpal karma pa rang byung zhabs kyis bzhed pa dang*/ srol gnyis dgongs pa gcig par bzhed par grags/ de ltar bstan 'gro'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad nas dgung lo nga gsum pa me stag lo gsar tshes la zhal mjal dgos pa nan zhus byas pas/

khyed tsho 'o ma nur gyis mi gzho bar bsad pa'i sha za ba 'dems pa yin nam gsungs/ zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la nang mjal dang*/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin khrom mjal chos khrir byon nas skya ser 'bum phrag longs pa la kho bo'i sprul pa'i sku bsdus zin 'di longs sku yin gsungs nas mu tig gi rgyan drug bzhes te 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad kyis thams cad la zhal bstan/ sprul sku gang du 'byon yab yum dang bcas gsal bar phyag bris drung si tu pa la snga nas gnang zin mod/ der dgongs mo zhal chems phyag bris mi gsal tsam zhig gsol lcog gi steng du gnang ste mtho rangs longs sku yang chos kyi sku 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad dang rnam dbyer med pa'i ngo bo nyid skur bzhugs so//de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char cher babs kyang*/ chos rje gar bzhugs su ngo mtshar gyi ltas rgyun du 'byung bas gzhan dag the tshom kyang ma skyes/ de nas rje btsun skyabs rje rin po che nas gser zho re'i ser 'gyed sogs dgongs rdzogs rgya chen dang*/ sgar dang*/ sa skyong don rdor sogs dad 'byor rnams kyi dngos rdzas kyis mchod sbyin chen po rje phrin las zhabs sogs kyis phyag len btab/ sku gdung rin po che zhugs su zhus pas ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs sran rlon tsam mang po dang*/ khyad par sku'i sgal tshig sku rtsibs bcas ma nyams par 'brel ba nya byus kyi kha dog lta bu mgrin pa yan gyi sku tshig zhal bcu gcig tu dod rtsib rnams re re'ang phyag mang po'i ri mo mthil du spyan dang bcas pa ste spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong shin tu gsal bar byon pa rtse lha sgang du gser gdung rin po cher bzhugs su gsol/ rje brgyad pa'i bka' las de lta bu ni rgya bod gang du su la'ang ma byon pa'i rten mchog tu snang bas/ phyi rol du zhal ltar yong na 'gro don che bar gsungs/

spyir sangs rgyas rnams kyis skad cig rer sems can smin grol bkod pa ni stong gsum gyi rdul phra rab kyis mi bsgrun la/ gzhan snang du sku gsung thugs btang snyoms su gnas pa ltar gyi tshe'ang gdul bya grangs med pa'i don mdzad na chos 'khor bskor ba'i phrin las kyi lta ci smos/ de'i phyir bu slob 'di tsam mo zhes tshad 'dzin mi nus kyang*/ tshur mthong gi yul tsam du na/ rgyal tshab bkra shis rnam rgyal/ zhwa dmar spyan snga chos grags/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor/ phag gru'i spyan snga tshes gnyis pa/ 'bri gung dbang rin po che/ 'bri gung chos rje kun rin mched gsum/ sgam po'i spyan snga gdan sa khag lnga'i khri zur rnams sogs khri gnon gyi skyes chen rnams dang*/ rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan/ grub chen chu phur pa/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob/ bzhag bla kun dga'/ zur mang bya bral/ rgya ston bya bral/ gsi dkar kun spangs/ bla ma grags rgyal sogs grub thob rnams dang*/ paṇa chen shāka mchog /mi nyag rab 'byams mgon po/ ngo khro rab 'byams dbang phyug /dul mo bkra shis 'od zer/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang*/ karma phrin las chen po/ dwags po rab 'byams chos rgyal bstan pa/ dwags po rab 'byams gsung rab mang thos/ sde mdun dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dus zhabs shākya dbang phyug /karma bka' bcu pa/ gtsang nge rab 'byams pa/ rta'u nor bzang*/ ra ti mkhas grub/ dge bshes rab bzang*/ nyag rong chos dpal/ a ba se grags pa/ byams mgon pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du ma/ dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub/ mkhan chen shāka bzang*/ 'grus khang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ khre kha don rnams/ ra sgreng bsam gling pa/ cham dgon grags dpal sogs bstan 'dzin du ma/ 'brong bu go shrī/ go shrī chos grags/ lcags mo go shrī 'od zer/ 'dan ma go shrī bsod bkras/ lho rong go shrī kun rgyal/ gling si ting 'dzin 'od zer sogs las ka can du ma/

dom tsha nang so chen shri du gang sogs gser yig pa du ma/ byams chen sna tshogs rang grol/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal/ nang ya gnyis kyi gdan sa pa sogs rgyal rigs mkhas grub du+u ma/ bya btang thar pa rgyal mtshan/ ma ṇi pa lhun grub rgya mtsho sogs yig drug gi phrin las pa du ma/ chu dka' thub pa/ grub thob tshem bu pa/ rtogs ldan 'dan chung sogs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du ma/ smyug la'i nang so 'brom pa/ khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas sogs khyim pa'i tshul can rnal 'byor du ma rnams ni chos rje nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa dang*/ dad thob chos kyi 'brel ba ni/ lhun bde rab 'byams/ 'bri khung mkhan chen/ stag lung ka drug /chos grwa chen po 'bras gling*/ rtse dang*/ gsang phu/ ne'u thog /bde skyor zul gsum/ ser 'bras dge gsum/ byams chen chos lung sogs dbus gtsang gi bla ma rnams dang*/ rdo ring kun spangs/ pa pom zhwa dmar rna sna bka' bcu/ mkhas pa mi lnga/ 'gos lo gzhon dpal/ lo chen bsod rgyam/ chag lo rin chos/ zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po sogs skad gnyis smra ba du ma/ shar rab 'byams pa shar kha ras chen/ 'khrul zhig sangs bsam/ gtsang smyon/ dbus smyon/ 'brug smyon kun legs sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma ste rgyas par rje brgyad pas stsal ba'i bu chen tho yig tu gsungs pa rnams so// //

brgyad pa kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje'i rnam thar/ brgyad pa kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje dbyangs can dga' ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ chos rje gong mas sku skye ba phyi ma mdo khams karma'i nye phyogs su yab byams pa dang yum bla ma zhes par 'khrungs pa'i lung bstan phyag bris mdzad nas si tu pa dang go shrī gnyis la gnang ba bzhin/ dom chu rgyud g.yas lung kar ti phug pa tam du/ yab a byams dang yum bla ma sgron gnyis kyi sras su me yos zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la lhums su zhugs nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi la bltams/ lhums su bzhugs dus skar khung nas sil sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis nang gang ba dang*/ yum gyi rmi lam du me tog gi thang du gur chen po'i nang du sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar bas gang ba dung gi mchod rten kha ba ltar 'bab pa gcig tu phyin nas rus pa'i rgyan drug dang bcas gar byed pa/ mchod gral nas gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig blangs pa/ bud med ral pa kham sha re ba zhig gis dung chen po zhig 'bud cing 'dug pa de blangs nas bus pas skad cher byung*/ khri thog na bla ma zhig 'dug pa na re/ dung skad de rgya dbus thams cad du thos nas thal zer/ yab kyis ma ṇi lag 'khor chen po cig thogs nas khrom la ma ṇi bskul zhing 'dug /bla ma des dung gi mdo 'dzin byas pa'i phreng ba zhig gnang nas ma ṇi bgrong zer/ 'dren bdo ba la mnal sad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang*/ 'khrungs ma thag spyan hrig hrig mdzad nas karma pa'o zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe khang thog tu 'ja' zug /me tog gi char babs/ dri bzang zhag du ma'i bar du byung*/ lha rnams kyis bsgrags pas snyan pas phyogs thams cad khyab/ drung si tu pa phyogs der byon pa yab kyis mjal nas nged la byis pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig yod zhus pas/ sngar rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i gnang ba'i phyag bris rten sgam nas bton te gzigs nas/

khyed yab yum gyi ming ci zer/ khang pa'i ltag 'og na shugs phung dang chu mig shar du bstan pa e yod gsungs/ yod tshul zhus pas/ yab byams pa dang a byams/ yum bla ma mtsho dang bla ma sgron zhes phyogs mthun tsam yin pa 'dra/ zla ba gsum la gsong*/ rten bsdus ril bu bdun/ ras kha gang*/ ja mar/ gu gul sogs bskur nas 'di karma si tu pas na bza' dang ja 'dren yin zhus/ ril bu dang bdug pa phul dang*/ sprul sku min na ci yang mi 'ong*/ yin na rtags shig ston pa yin/ de'i tshe mang na tshig bzhi nyung na gsum gsung ba yin/ de byung na khyod 'dir shog gsungs/ yab kyis de rnams byas pas/ ja 'dren yang bag 'phyis tsam/ e ma ho nga la the tshom ma byed dang*/ nga ni karma pa ces bya/ gzhan kha shas gsungs pa ma zin/ ja skol zhing yod tshe sprul sku 'khrungs nas zhag bcu gsum lon pa de bzhengs nas gar mdzad/ de nas zhag gnyis na dpon nya skyabs kyis nga'i phas chos rje gong ma sku chung dus na bza' zhig phul/ nges kyang sprul sku la na bza' zhig 'bul zhes phul bas legs so gsungs zla ba gcig lon dus sgom chen gser phu pas mjal/ ja zhus tshogs 'khor byas/ khong rang gi ḍa dril phul bas dgyes te 'khrol zhing thams cad la phyag dbang mdzad/ khyed karma pa yin na rtse lha sgang du nga la chos gnang ba de gang yin zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drug yin gsungs/ thams cad kyis karma pa'i sprul sku yin par yid ches/ a khu a thar gyis/ 'di karma pa yin na 'dis mi gnod zer nas btsan dug mar la sbyar nas drangs pas ma gnod/ gcig gis/ ldag mi'i bu karma pa yin na cir thal yang phyag mi 'tshal zhes kha ngan 'phangs pas phyis khrom la phyag dbang gnang dus kho la ma gnang*/ kho dad nas bshags pa byas/ yum bal 'khel dus 'phang bzung nas 'khel ma bcug pas/ khyod da lo mi kha rgyang grags zer nas thal lcag brgyab pas/ a ma rang dal por sdod ma ṇi thon/

nga la bdag po zhig myur du 'ong la yod gsungs bzhin/ ri bo che dang lho rong pa'i spyan 'dren byung*/ zla ngo bdun bzhes pa na ri bo cher byon/ bsnyen bkur cher zhus/ de nas bzung la lar bslab ston/ la lar mngon mkhyen/ la lar yig drug bskul ba sogs mdzad pas thams cad dad/ de nas lho rong brdzong du spyan drangs pa ltar byon/ don ldan zhabs kyis dbu zhwa ngos 'dzin mdzad/ skabs der brag gsum na bla ma a mdo ba zhig la sras rtags mtshan can zhig byung ba karma pa'i sprul sku yin rgyur bsgrags pas/ sgar pa phal cher der 'dus pa la/ longs spyod kyis mgu bar byas/ de'i rkyen gyis rgyal tshab rin po che yang sprul sku ngom du 'khrungs pa de yin par dgongs kyang*/ sgar pa mi mang gi kha ngo cung zad gzigs dgos kyi brag gsum du byon/ a mdo'i sras re zhig sku mtshams la bzhag nas/ lho rong du mchog gi sprul sku mjal ngos 'dzin du ma gnang*/ bla ma bsod rin pas/ khyed karma pa yin na nga la gsung zhig 'byon zhus pas/ nga lan re pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /lan re sa ra ha pa yin/ /sogs gsungs/ dgung lo lnga pa la a mdo'i bu zur mang sku skye yin/ nga'i grwa pa yin gsungs/ 'o na rtse lha sgang du 'das pa de yin nam rtsar gshis su 'das pa de yin zhus pas/ rtsar gshis na 'das pa de yin gsungs*/ rgya ston bya brag pas mjal o rgyan chen po zhal gzigs/ sgar nas bla ma yang ri ba sogs spyan 'dren la 'byor/ de nas sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs phyir lho rong go shrī ri bo che'i mi sna rnams 'byon pa'i snga 'phar btang*/ nam zla dgun yin yang 'brug dang khu byug lan gsum gsum grags/ sgar dpon rnams sprul sku su yin ma nges bar du phyag mi 'tshal ba'i khrims byas kyang*/ dbang med du snang ba 'gyur nas phyag dang mjal dar phul/ de skabs rgyal tshab la bud med dkar mo zhig gi dung chen po zhig khyer byung*/

nges 'di phyogs thams cad du bsgrags kyang khyod kyis tshags byed ma nyan zer/ bud med dmar mo zhig gis khyod rdzun ma'i ngag la nyan pa zer ba gzigs/ lho rong dang rgya ston pa'i mnga' zhabs rnams kyis kyang sdigs pas/ sgar pa rnams rgyal tshab rin po che nas gang gsung yin zhus/ de nas mchog sprul bya lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi rgyal phur 'grub sbyor la sgar du seng khrir phebs bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol/ sgar pa thams cad ngo mtshar nas nged rang tsho sngar de 'dra 'khrul pa ci byung ngam zhes gleng*/ mchog sprul chos rjes/ stag yos lo'i bar bde ba can dang byams pa'i drung du bsdad skyid por byung*/ de nas rgyal ba byams pa'i bka' bzhin 'dir 'ong pa yin/ dmu rgod kyi yid skyo bar byung gsungs dgung lo bdun par/ bdag gis byang sham+bha lar song*/ rigs ldan chos rgyal seng ge zhes bya ba dang/ mdun na 'don rnam gnon bzhugs pa yin gsungs pa mtshur lugs bstan rtsis dang 'grigs/ nga'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ da lta dbus gtsang na yang bcu drug tsam yod/ nub phyogs na bod ston gcig yod pa nga rang dngos yin gsungs/ de nas gdan sa gong 'og kun tu gtam snyan gyi yi ge dang*/ o rgyan chen pos btags pa'i mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes yongs su grags/ o rgyan pad+ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ rta mgrin/ karma pak+shi/ mi la/ dus mkhyen sogs bka' brgyud gong ma rnams dang*/ sa ra ha/ birba pa sogs rgya gar grub chen rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das sogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rnams dang*/ bde mchog sogs yi dam lha tshogs/ ma mgon dang 'khor lnga sogs chos skyong gi tshogs te zhal gzigs ni rtag par 'byams klas pas brjod kyis mi langs/ zhib par rnam thar chen mo rnams dang mgur 'bum du gsal/ bkra shis sgang du pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes byon/ rgyal tshab rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal las theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa bzhes/

mtshan chos kyi grags pa dpal bzang por gsol/ rta nag gi dbang phul yi ge 'bri klog sogs tshegs med du mkhyen/ bla ma gcod pa 'di rab tu byung dus/ nga zhwa nag cig gyon nas der yod/ mkhan po drung go shrī yin/ khong tsho rab byung byed mi bcu yod gsungs pas drung pa dang bla ma gcod pa thugs ches/ mgon 'cham la g.yas skor g.yon skor 'di ci lags zhus pas/ chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa yin/ don ldan zhabs dus med/ po ti/ sku 'dra rnams kyi 'byung khungs sogs mngon mkhyen gsungs pa dpag tu med/ 'bang chung thod nag gis char ser btang bas 'bang rje thod dkar zhes btags/ der yang zhabs rjes byon/ rnam rtog chos sku'i legs bshad dang*/ gnas lugs ngo sprod du ma gnang*/ bde ba can du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog ser po can dang dga' ldan du byams pa mjal/ de nas 'dir skye srid bzung ba yin gsungs/ yang bcom ldan 'das sogs zhal gzigs/ rdo rje gdan phyi rol pas bzung zer gsungs/ de nas mdo khams shar phyogs su byon/ rje bdun pa zhal gzigs phral yun gyi bslab ston du ma stsal/ chos kyi grags pa dang phyogs glang zhal gzigs chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad/ 'khrungs yul du gu ru rin po che zhal gzigs/ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te//khyod ni rgyal ba mchog dbyangs so//dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ /gsungs/ byams pa zhal gzigs nas byams chos gsan/ dgung lo brgyad pa la zur mang du byon/ spyi 'byams su zhabs rjes bzhag /sde gu dgon du phebs/ 'dir smri ta'i rnam 'phrul snying po don brgyud kyi mnga' bdag 'dan ma grub thob sangs rgyas mnyan pa bkra shis dpal 'byor dang mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dul mo bkra shis 'od zer rnam pa gnyis kyis mjal/ 'dan ma grub chen pas byang chub gling du gdan drangs/ zhwa khra can stong phrag lhag gis bsu ba mdzad/ shar kha'i rol chen bco brgyad kyis mjal mkhan tshogs/

de nas kam po gangs rar phebs/ ka ka ri/ 'ja' tshon gling*/ chos 'byung gong 'og rnams su zhabs rjes re re bzhag /rgya'i gdan 'dren gser yig pa bla ma bsod rin sogs byung ba mngags/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung pas rim par byon/ byi ba lor ja kwa bzhis gtsos dmag mi khri mtsho tsam gyis bsu ba dang bcas pho brang dang nye skor du sgar phabs/ glang chen thag pa bcad nas sgar du phyin te phyag 'tshal/ phyi nyin snga mor rgyal po nyid gyam khrir phebs/ khu bo dang nu bo gnyis glang chen re re zhon/ glang chen gcig yan par khrid/ rta ba mang pos gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs thogs pas skor nas byung*/ gur sgor thams cad babs/ phyag 'tshal/ la kha tsha smon gyi lo tsā byas/ sku khams zhus/ 'bul ba 'phul/ glang po ches phyag 'tshal zhing skad chen po btang*/ glang chen skad 'don pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ glang rdzis sangs rgyas byon pa la kho dga' ba red zer/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ nub re bzhin sgar mtha' nas rol mo phul/ sku gzugs/ mdo sde/ rgyal ba'i ring bsrel/ rgyal lag /bse ru/ gser chas/ chibs pa sogs bcos mar phul/ bsu ba dang bcas chos rje 'gyog khrir bzhugs pa dang dpon slob rnams pho brang du spyan drangs/ rgyal po'ang rgyal sgo bar mar byon nas mjal dar phul/ pho brang du gser khrir bzhugs/ sku 'khor rnams kyang khri dang rgya khrir bzhugs/ mdun lcog rnams gser dngul gyi me tog gi brgyan nas gsol ja zhu ba dang sgrag rin chen gos dar sogs brgya 'bul phul/ gsol zas sna tshogs zhus/ gser gyi nor bu ka ba gnyis khyon tsam sogs rgyal srid sna bdun dang mdzod khang rnams la phyag nas zhus/ btsun mo gsum gyis rgyan rnams phul nas sems bskyed zhus/ rgyal pos skyel ma bcas sgar du phebs/ phyi nyin yang de bzhin du pho brang gcig tu spyan drangs/ lo bcu gsum par bod la dmag mi byed pa dang*/

lo ltar bu khral lnga brgya re phul/ dgon pa brgya 'debs par khas blangs/ zhag bdun bzhugs/ de yan chad 'jang rgyal po 'di rgyal bstan la mi gus pa zhig yin kyang*/ de nas bzung rgyal bstan spyi dang kar bstan la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par grags/ lo bdun mtshams nas 'byon par zhal bzhes/ skyel ma dang bcas tshur byon/ rgyal tshab gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub par dge 'dun la gser zho re 'byed/ dbus su zhwa dmar pa la 'bul chen dang*/ gdung rten bzhengs rgyur gser zho lnga brgya/ ja lnga bcu zangs ngos bcu sogs dang*/ thub chen gser thog rgyu zangs dos sum cu/ gser zho stong rwa can/ ja brgya sogs gnang*/ mkhas pa mi lngas gdan drangs rab sgang du byon/ nyag rong gru khar zhabs rjes/ phag mo rir phyag mdzub gsum rjes rtsal/ chos rje gong mas si tu par yi ge gnang bar grub chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa bla mar 'os zhes 'dug pa dang*/ rje nyid sku chung dus nas nga'i bla ma 'dan ma grub chen yin gsungs pa sogs kyis sangs rgyas mnyan pa gdan drangs/ dgung lo bcu par dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang*/ sems bskyed srol gnyis/ rgyud sde rnams kyi dbang sogs dang*/ 'dul ba mdo sde rgyud man ngag 'grel pa sogs dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sogs mtha' yas par gsan/ phar tshur 'bul chen bstabs res mdzad/ 'dzam thang sogs su rta stong phrag sogs kyi 'bul ba rgya che sog yul du gdan 'dren byung yang da res dus la ma babs gsungs/ 'dan byang chub gling du byon/ sangs rgyas gnyan pa nas sgar pa stong phrag gi phog phul/ lo gsum du dbang lung khrid gsum gsan pas gdan ma grub chen mnyes/ nga ni kho bo shi yang mi 'gyod gsungs/ yos lo zla ba dang por grub chen zhi dbyings su gzhol/ dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrub pas zhal gzigs nas gdams pa mang du stsal/ de nas dul mo bkra shis 'od zer bsten par mdzad nas gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/

nyi steng du byams pa'i sku la nas bre gsum gyis phyag nas gnang bar bre bdun du 'phel/ nas 'bru mang po zug /de nas dom tsha hū tsing sogs gsar yig pas mjal/ mu tig gi rnam sbyar dang gser yig 'ja' sa sogs phul/ dom tsha na re/ nged rgya nag tu rta 'bul la song dus brdzun ma red gsungs nas btson du chud skabs/ gong mas gser khang du rje nyid zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas yin na zhabs la 'khor lo sogs yod thang bsam pa na phyag zhabs la 'khor lo'i ri mo yod pa bstan/ de'i 'drar sku bzhengs/ bya tshe ring la bya tshe ring khri phrag mang pos bskor ba gzigs pas nga btson las thar rgyal po mjal chog pa byung*/ bya tshe ring 'di 'dra bod du yod dam gsungs/ med zhus rje'i rnam thar zhib tu bris byung bas sngar gyi gong ma dang karma pa yon mchod yin tshul sogs zhus pas/ nged la hu tsi'i las ka gnang*/ nyi ma nub phyogs na 'od dpag med kyi sprul sku nged kyi don du byon pa de spyan 'dren pa yin zhes dril bsgrags song zer/ de nas nyag chu la mnyan pas gru bla rtsed pas rong tshad pa can du chu la dar chags nas sgar chen 'gro chog pa byung zhing thon nas zhig /der zhabs rjes byon/ chos rje nyid nam mkha' la 'phur nas byon pa rgya bod kun gyis mthong*/ 'dra yul du zhabs rjes gcig byon/ seṅge dgon du karma pak+shi sku 'dra la gsung mol mdzad/ tha'i can sogs gser yig pa gdan 'dren du byung*/ 'ja' sar/ nyi ma nub phyogs na lha rang byon chos rje'i drung du lus spos chus bkrus/ pus mo sa la btsugs nas zhu ba/ nged karma pa snying nas 'dod pa la skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar/ khyed dang nga las 'phro yod pas/ la chen chu chen rnams la rdzu 'phrul gyis byon shog /ces sogs dang*/ btsun mo/ rgyal/ blon sogs kyi zhu yig dang 'bul ba mang po dang*/ rgyal pos 'bul chen bcas phul skabs/ kho bo'i ltas la nyi zla cha gnyis shar nas gling bzhi gsal ba la/
