cha gcig sar lhung nyams shar bas da lan nga mi 'gro gsungs/ gser yig pa rnams khros nas 'bul ba rnams ma phul nas song bas lam du gzhan gyis bcom/ rgya gong ma'ang gshegs/ spyir gong ma cing ngo rgyal po 'di rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i sprul pa yin par khong rang gis kyang dran zhwa nag 'di 'dra zhig gyon nas nga karma pa yin gsungs skad/ chos rje brgyad pa khri 'don cung zad 'phyis pas rten 'brel ma 'grigs par grags/ phyag mdzod dang gser yig pa bgros nas btsan thabs su spyan 'dren par shoms yang dus mkhyen sku 'dra dang thugs rje chen po rnams kyis gong ma la tshe med pas ma byon par legs zhes lung bstan pas sku 'khor nyung bsdus bcas bod du gsang thabs kyis byon/ atsar+ya zhig sgar du lan gsum tsam byon nas gdams ngag mang po zhus gsungs pa de mi tṛ dzo gi yin par grags/ tshe grub zla gsum mdzad pas 'khor la thugs ma sun na ci 'dod bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ bu chu na rgyal tshab sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan grags pa dpal 'byor du gsol/ bde mchog phug tu zhabs 'dred pas phyag rjes byon/ rgyal po mtshan ldan la/ khyod kyi bu nged la phul gsungs/ bu chung zhig yod 'bul rtsis yin te/ da lta chung chung nu zho 'thung mkhan yin tshul sogs zhus pas/ de 'dir khyer shog gsungs/ de nas nyin re bzhin drung mkha' spyod dbang po de nam pheb kho na gsungs/ phrug gu de sku mdun du khyer byung bas/ dkon mchog yan lag tu btags/ dbu skra bzhes rnal 'byor dri med dpal de da lta byis pa'i tshul du byung gsungs mnyes tshul skyo tshul lta bu'ang mdzad/ na bza' phyag mdud sogs gnang nas gtsang sbra gyis gsungs pa tsam las yab yum la sprul sku yin tshul re zhig ma gsungs/ nub gcig mtshan phyed tsam na rtog med du song sku 'khor rnams kyis sku stim par go nas sku rim byas/ rtog med de las sad nas dbu ma'i skor mang po gsungs/

da ni don 'di la rngog lo jo nang*/ sa paṇa/ bu ston/ rong po rnams byon kyang mi 'jigs gsungs/ de nas bzung thal rang gzhan stong dbu ma'i don thams cad thugs su chud/ rje btsun ngal bso sogs bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ nye gnas kyi mig nad la rten 'brel gyi sngags kyis phan/ sngags de pha dam pas gnang ba yin gsungs/ mon rgyal pos mjal/ gser ljang rdung gis pad zhu phul/ dgung lo nyer gcig par mkhan chen chos grub seng ge dang*/ slob dpon karma phrin las pa chen po sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal bstan mtha' dag la de bzhin gshegs pa dang tha mi dad par gyur/ mtshan chos grub grags pa dpal bzang por gsol/ mkhan slob las bka' chos mang du gsan/ lhag par slob dpon las gzhung chen nyer lnga sogs gsan pa mtha' yas/ thams cad bde blag tu thugs su chud/ de dag gi bar du dbang man ngag mdo rgyud sna tshogs pa gsan/ gsan yun lo gsum la gsol ja'ang cher mi bzhes par thugs brtson mdzad/ slob dpon nas kyang mkhyen brtson la cher bsngags/ mdor na thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan 'bod pa tsam min par mkhas pa dang grub pa'i don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'gran zla med pa ste/ mkhas pa rnams zil gyis non te dri lan zhu mi nus shing zhus pa rnams kyang phyis 'gyod pa'i gnas su 'gro bar grags/ spyir dgung lo bcu nas nyer gsum bar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang thugs mnyam gzhag gi sgo nas thos bsam la gtso bor mdzad cing de nas rtag par thun mtshams ma gtogs mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo mi skyong ba thun tshod gcig nam yang byed ma myong gsungs/ rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi yon tan thams cad mthar phyin/ gdams ngag btab pas byi'u yang mchi ma 'don zhing nyan/ rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes byon pa ni ches mang ba dang*/ gzhan gyi skye ba snga phyi sogs mngon mkhyen gsungs pa ches mang ba rnam thar chen mor gsal/

sangs rgyas byang sems dang rgya bod kyi grub thob mang po mjal zhing dam chos gsan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srung dus kyi pad 'byung yin zer dge slong bsgres po zhig mjal nas gdams ngag gsan/ 'od srung gi dus kyi pad+ma 'byung gnas lags na yul gang du pad+ma las 'khrungs da lta gang na bzhugs zhus pas/ nam mkha' 'di da lta gang na gnas 'od srung gi dus kyi nam mkha' de gang las byung zer te mi snang bar gyur/ 'o na sangs rgyas stong re re la pad 'byung kyang stong 'byung bar 'dug dgongs pa na de de bzhin zhes pa gsan/ spyir zhal gzigs dag snang la mtha' yas shing rdo rje'i mgur gsungs pa'ang rje btsun chen po mi la'i mgur 'bum tsam yod/ yar rgyab dpon chen rab tu byung*/ karma lo tsā rin chen bkra shis las sgra dang sum rtags sogs gsan/ lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan nyi zla lta bu'i thugs sras gnyis las zla ba lta bu dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku phebs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang*/ 'dul ṭīka kyi dbu brtsams tshe rnal lam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa zhig rmis/ dbyar gnas sogs 'dul ba'i phyag len rnams dar bar mdzad/ phyag yul pa sogs yon mchod thams cad gros mthun pas kong yul gyi dge dgon brlag par rtsam pa na/ chos rje'i zhal nas khang chung gcig la gnod pa byed pa dang mgul breg pa khyad med pa'i bkas bzlog /kong po nas phyag nas mdzad pa 'bri gung du phebs pa byung*/ tshogs par bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang mdzad sgar du smyung gnas kyi srol btsugs/ paṇa chen rdor rgyal la sde pa bco brgyad kyi lta ba sogs dri ba gnang ba la lan cher 'bul ma shes/ de rjes paṇa chen na re/ spyir nged rang gzhung lugs la byang khul dang*/ khyad par kha sang nas lta rtog mang du byas pa yod kyang de rnams dri ba mi gnang 'dug pas mngon mkhyen gyis dgongs par 'dug zer/

than pa byung skabs sku khrus mdzad pas char babs/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dngul sku la rab gnas mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das dang rtsa gsum lha tshogs mang po zhal gzigs/ ra sgreng du sha ra ba'i phyag dpe rnams ko thum lcags gzer gyis bsdams pa bden stobs brjod pas kha rang bye nas gzigs rtog gnang slar rgyas btab/ de ltar khams kong phyogs su bsdu bzhis 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo so gcig par mtshur phur byon/ smyug la sogs su gdan drangs/ dbus gtsang gi 'khrugs pa chings mdzad/ rje grol mchog pas mjal/ 'di pa slob ma'i mchog tu 'gyur rgyu la rten 'brel cung ma 'grigs par grags/ chibs pa zhig shi bar ring bsrel mang po byung*/ zhang g.yu brag pas byin gyi rlabs pas dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs su bzhed nas 'jug ṭīka mdzad par thal 'gyur pa'i gzhung 'dzugs par mdzad cing mthar thug gi nges don rje rang byung zhabs kyi dgongs pa gzhan stong du gnas shing zla ba'i zhabs kyis kyang bzhed la/ 'di ni gang zag phal gyi spyod yul ma yin par gsungs/ rgyal tshab sprul sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs gnang*/ dgung lo bzhi bcu par rje nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i gsung byon pa la/ zhwa dmar dpa' bo rnam gnyis nas zhabs brtan phul bas lo brgyad bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes/ rje dpa' bo la brtan bzhugs rgyas par gnang*/ gnas chung rgyal pos rgyud bskul nas 'bras spungs pas dmag bsdus nas sgar pa bkag pa'ang byung*/ mtshur gyi zhig gso mdzad nas gtsang du byon/ rgyal tshab sprul skur byin rlabs mdzad/ sprul sku gong ma de sgar pas stod smad du gdan drangs pas sku tshe ma byung*/ da res lo bcu gnyis su khyed rang tshang gi zhabs phyi zhus gsungs/ rje zhwa dmar sgar du phebs/ sku gsung thugs rten sku chas grwa pa chibs sga 'khor sogs gnang*/ bzhugs khri 'dra mnyam mdzad/ nang rten thams cad zhal mjal dang rtsis sprod lta bus ngo sprad mdzad/

zhwa dmar nag dgongs pa mnyam shing ston 'khor tha mi dad pa'i zhal bzhes bcas/ rje zhwa dmar lnga pa la chos rje nyid kyang rdor 'phreng gi dbang nyer brgyad po gsan par mdzad/ don gyis na 'di skabs rang nas rgyal tshab tu dbang skur zhing mchog sprul phyi ma'i 'dren par lung bstan pa ste/ rje nyid ri khrod mdzad pa dang sgar pa rnams rje zhwa dmar pa la skyabs zhus na legs tshul gsungs/ de nas yar klung phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug zhi phyir gdan 'dren byung nas byon pas 'khrugs pa zhi/ gdan sa thel du byon skabs bka' gdams pa'i dbu zhwa sne ring bzhes/ de la gnad ka zhig yod gsungs/ sku 'dra rin po che dang gsung gleng gnang gzhan dag gis kyang mjal/ gsang sngags rnying mar skur ba btab pa'i rtsom byang chos rje'i mtshan g.yar ba de lan gyi yi ge mdzad/ mgron gnyer dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gshegs pa la gdung ring bsrel mang po byon pas sku 'khor rnams kyang 'di 'dra zhes ha las/ yar klung dpon sogs du mas sa gzhis dang rdzong phul ba ma bzhes/ dge lugs pa'i dge bshes du ma la rje'i lta grub bshad pas dad/ byis pa lkug pa la gsang chab blud pas smra shes par gyur/ skabs shig phyag g.yas cung zad snyung tshul bstan nas/ da ni nga yang tshe'i rting pa yin/ dri dgos yod na dris gsungs/ da lta nga'i zhal la ltos spur thal yin zhes thal ba 'gam dgos pa'i dus 'ong gsungs/ thugs rtsams rnams kyi mtha' bsdus/ 'jigs byed kyi khrid yig brtsams grub pa'i dga' ston du e ka dza ṭir phebs nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/ de skabs rje zhwa dmar pa dmag 'khrug gi dum la 'byon dgos byung zhing rkyen med par thugs mi bde ba dang tshems phud pa rmis rje dpa' bo spyan drangs/ rje 'di bas kyang tshe dpag med kyi sku gzugs mang po dbang med 'gom dgos byung ba'i rmi ltas sogs byung*/ sku 'khor rnams kyis zhus nas tsa ri nas bteg/de skabs zhabs snyung thu bar yod kyang skabs shig bde nas har bzhengs phar cam tshur cam mdzad/

sku rab tu phebs/ phyag sgam rnams phye nas/ 'di rnams karma pa'i spyi rdzas yin/ 'di rnams karma pa'i rus bu'i snod yin gsungs/ mjal du byung tshad ma bkag par thong gsungs nas mjal ka gnang*/ klu bdud kyis gnod pa shin tu thu ba de phyogs su song tshad shi ba zhig yod pa de'i kha gnon lha khang bzhengs shing klu nad lhag ma rje nyid kyis bzhes pas phyis gnod pa med par mdzad nad pa rnams phan/ rje zhabs cher snyung pa'i tshul gyis mdo le la spyan drangs/ mdo mi de la gsol ba btab tshad klu nad las grol bar 'gyur ba de da lta mtsho dkar na yod pa grags/ tshogs rdzogs phyir sman pa kun gyi sman nas en rtsam re bzhes/ dbu rgyan sogs longs sku'i rnam pa mdzad/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i lung bstan/ nga skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du//shar tre shod gangs kyi rang ba'i stod//dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byon drung*//chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan pa yod//sa de dang ha cang mi ring bar//der skye ba len pa'i mtshan ma mthong*/ /zhes dang*/ shar tre shod gangs kyi ra ba ru//mi kho bo'i pha ma rnam gnyis mthong*//khyed dbyings na bzhugs pa'i srung ma'i tshogs//mi kho bo'i bstan pa'i gnyer kha mdzod/ /ces dang*/ kho bo myur du 'ong de bar thams cad chos dang mthun pa gyis/ zhes gsungs te/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa shing stag zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum la yar klung du sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs gcig bsdu bar mdzad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas/ sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur spyan drangs/ zhugs 'bul dang dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod 'bul rgya chen rnams kyi thugs khur rje dpa' bos bzhes/ rje zhwa dmar lnga pa rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ dngul gdung dang snang brnyan rin po che mtshur phur bzhengs/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa des bka' brtsams kyi bskor la po ti nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/

chos sde dang lha khang rten gsum gsar bzhengs snying gso ches mang bar mdzad pa rnam thar rgyas par gsal/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma ni/ chos rje nyid dang mtshungs par zhal gyis bzhes pa zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag /mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ rgyal tshab grags pa dpal 'byor/ si tu chos kyi go cha/ ngo khro rab 'byams rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams rnam rgyal grags pa/ phyogs glang*/ ngo khro chos mdzad/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byang sems nyi bkras/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ karma phrin las legs grub/ thob rgyal karma don dam/ rim gro ba sangs rgyas dpal grub/ dbon rab 'byams pa rin legs/ dpal khang chos mdzad karma phrin las/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po/ a gnyan dpon po/ lha mthong lo tsā/ yang ri bla ma rtogs ldan kun bzang*/ zur ri bla ma don grub rin chen/ g.yung rtogs ldan rin chen dgon po/ chu bo ri sangs rgyas seng ge /shar pa ye shes dpal bzang*/ bya bral rgyal mtshan bzang po/ bya btang thar pa'i sku skye/ dbu ma dpon chung*/ bla ma mtha' phu pa/ rab 'byams dpal 'bar/ ljang pa chos mdzad/ 'ja' mo dge slong*/ bla ma karma bstan 'dzin/ mtsho byed phan bde 'od zer/ sku rab lha btsun don dam/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho sku mched/ sprul sku nam mkha' bkra shis/ karma srid bral/ byang sems kun dga' rin chen/ 'bri khung rin chen rnam rgyal/ gdan sa thel gyi spyan snga pa/ karma bdud rtsi sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i slob ma ches mang ba'o// //

dgu pa chos rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar/ dgu pa chos rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rjes/ nga skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu//tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod//dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byon drung*//chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan pa yod//sa de dang ha cang mi ring par//skye ba len pa'i mtshan ma mthong*//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ yul tre bo smad du yab a rdor dang*/ yum gling bza' a lod kyi sras su sprul sku 'dzin par mdzad pa na/ yum gyi rmi lam du pang par gser gyi maṇ+ḍal las 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ dung dkar bus pas sgra phyogs thams cad du khyab pa dang*/ nam mkhar 'phur nas khrom la yig drug bskul pa sogs du ma rmis/ yab kyi rmi lam du'ang seng phrug sngon po pang du blangs pa sogs byung zhing*/ grong gi nang du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char dang dri bzang ngad pa dang*/ khang pa'i phyi nang kun tu yig drug gi rang sgra grags/ skabs skabs rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs grags pa nye 'khor rnams kyi mngon sum thos/ yum lus sems bde bas zas ma zos kyang bkres pa med pa byung*/ me 'brug zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyi shar la sku 'khrungs ma thag zhal ras phyag gis lan gsum phyis nas spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs te nga ni karma pa yin no gsungs/ skyil krung bcas nas yun ring du bzhugs/ yab kyis mjal bas bzhad cing bzhengs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ā li kā li sogs gsungs/ skabs shig yum gyis pang khebs sku la gsol bas a ma a kha gsungs nas rgyang du 'phang*/ sku drang por bsrangs te bzhugs/ res gar dang phyag rgya sna tshogs mdzad/ karma pa'i sprul sku 'khrungs so zhes nye 'khor ba kun gyis gleng*/ mtshan nam mkha' rgyal por gsol/ 'khrungs nas zhag bco brgyad tsam nas gzhan la ma brten par 'byon bzhud mdzad thub pa byung*/ go shrī chos skyong bkra shis kyis ja zhus dang bkra shis kha thags rten 'dus ril bu rnams 'bul bar btang zhing zla ngo gsum tsam phyin skabs mjal du phyin/

mjal dar phyag gis bzhes shing phyag dbang mdzad pas dad/ de nas mtshur phu nas zhwa dmar rin po che sogs kyis btang ba'i ja 'dren rnams rim par 'byor/ dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad du rje karma pa'i sprul sku 'khrungs nas ngo mtshar gyi snang ba ston to zhes grags pas khyab/ zla ngo bzhi tsam bzhes pa nas bris sku sogs la phyag nas zhus tshe oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bsngo ba zhus tshe/ sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ sgar chen nas shang dkar ba sogs dge slong mang po dbu zhwa na bza' phyag tham sogs nyer mkho rnams 'bul du phyin pa sleb tu nye ba na shang dkar ba gsungs nas phyag 'dzub kyi zhag grangs rtsi tshul mdzad/ rta lo zla ba gnyis par 'byor rje zhwa dmar gyi zhu phrin dang sku'i nyer spyad rnams phul/ rje si tu pa'ang phebs/ dbu zhwa sgron pas nam mkhar 'ja' gur byung*/ mjal mkhan thams cad zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa cher skyes/ lha mgon sogs ngo mkhyen pa dang*/ mdzo mo/ mdzo mo/ mdzo mo zhar ma gsungs pas sang*/ rgan rgon gnyis kyi mdzo mo zhar ma phul ba sogs byung rgyal du gsungs pa rnams thog tu 'bab pa dang*/ gal chen rigs lung bstan zhus tshe ji ltar gsungs pa rnams thog tu babs pas thams cad nges shes 'drongs/ jo bo me tri pa dang*/ o rgyan sogs zhal gzigs/ drung si tu pas bka' chos kyang ci rigs pa phul/ rje bdun pa'i phyag dril phul nas 'di mi bskyod rdo rje dang chos grags rgya mtsho su'i phyag dril lags zhus pas/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i red gsungs/ lug lor yang ri ba dpon slob rnams kyis mjal/ 'bul ba dang zhu yig rnams phul bas rje dpa' bo rin po che'i zhu yig phyag tu bzhes nas sku 'phag tu bcug/de skabs zhabs rjes gsal po zhig byon/ dbus su bang chen 'gro skabs zhal ta gnang rgyu e yod zhus pas/ zhwa dmar pa la mgyogs po byon/

khyed nga la rtsis med pa e yin zhus gsungs/ skabs shig de ring gtam snyan yong ba yod gsungs pa na/ bang chen 'khor nas rje zhwa dmar 'bri chu khar phebs yod tshul zhus pas shin tu dgyes/ bya lo zla ba gnyis par sgar chen 'byor/ phyi nyin dge slong dbu ma rig pa btang nas/ nga sgar du nam gdan 'dren rgyu yin gsungs/ de phral rje zhwa dmar sku 'khor bcas phebs nas chos rje gong ma la ji lta ba bzhin phyag dang bkur sti mdzad/ rgyal phur 'grub sbyor la sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan du spyan drangs te seng khri chen por mnga' gsol/ rten sgam sogs phyag rdzas rnams rim par rtsis 'bul zhus pas/ sku chos snam sbyar sogs la lhag par dgyes tshul mdzad sku la bzhes/ dbu skra bsil ba la thugs rings pa'i zhal ta yang yang phebs pas rje zhwa dmar pas gtsug phud bzhes/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang byang sdom phul/ mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug tu gsol/ de nas bzung ste chos rje gong mas nyid dang mtshungs par zhal gyis bzhes shing mkhas grub btsun gsum gyi rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal sogs mdo rgyud man ngag gi dbang lung rgya mtsho dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum rnams sogs gsan pa mtha' yas pa rnams rim par mdzad/ sngon gnas rjes dran du ma gsungs/ nang so drung la rnam rtog chos sku yin gsungs pa'i gsung 'phros bgro gleng mdzad pa la nang so nas sku rtsed nyams nyul lta bus bgro gleng phul bas/ da de 'dra'i bgro gleng su'i lugs yin gsungs pas skrag cing zil gyis non pa byung gsungs/ bde mchog sogs lha tshogs du ma zhal gzigs/ rgya 'jang yan gyi mjal mi dang 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ bsdu ba bzhis 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas rim par dbus su byon/ dgung lo bcu par yangs can dang mtshur phur phebs/

de nas mkhas grub chen po dpal gtsug lag phreng bas gdan 'dren byung ste lho brag tu byon/ yab sras mjal phrad mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gcig par mkhan po rje zhwa dmar pa/ slob dpon rje dpa' bo sogs las rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje gar dbang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i snying po khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes gsol/ rje dpa' bo'i drung nas phyag chen chos drug sogs dbang chos mang du gsan dbus gtsang gi phyogs 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag /de nas tsā ri dang kong phyogs su byon/ dgon pa chos sde ri khrod snying gso dang gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa dang*/ zhabs rjes du ma stsal/ dgung lo nyer bzhi par mkhan po zhwa dmar rje dang*/ slob dpon rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs dge 'dun grangs ldan las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gra ma gru bzhir byon skabs chibs pa'i zhabs rjes byon/ rje zhwa dmar rin po che dgung grangs nga dgu par bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher sgrub gdan sar gos sku khams sum mdzes rgyan gyi bzo mgo btsugs skabs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang*/ gtsang sde mched rnams nas gdan drangs/ sde pa lha rdor mched rnams kyi bsu ba chen por bcas lhun rtser phebs/ lha sde mi sde thams cad chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ mtshur phur bcad rgya yun ring tsam bzhugs/ gos sku chen mo'ang legs par grub/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul 'khrul bral 'bri khung skyu ra'i gdung rigs su 'khrungs pa sgar du bsu bkod chen pos spyan drangs/ chos rje nyid kyang bzhugs khri'i steng nas bzhengs te byin rlabs dbu thug gnang ba sogs bkur sti cher mdzad/ dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug tu mtshan gsol/ rim par yangs can du byon seng khrir mnga' gsol/ de nas tsā rir byon ka la dung mtsho'i lam 'phrang rkang 'gros kyis kyang thar dka' ba kun la chibs g.yag ma gzhol bar rdzu 'phrul lta bus byon/

spo kong phyogs su 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ rgya nag gong ma ta'i ming dpen li rgyal po dang sog po dang 'jang rgyal po sogs chen po rnams kyi gser yig dang 'bul ba rgya cher 'byor/ rgya gar nas dzo gi badz+ra nā thas mjal chos 'brel dang rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i lam yig bka' shog stsal/ rgya la sogs/ gnas gzigs byon skabs phyag rjes dang zhabs rjes du ma bzhag /mtsho dkar sogs dben gnas rnams su sku mtshams yang yang mdzad/ lha tshogs du ma'i zhal gzigs/ slar dbus gtsang gi gdan 'dren pa yang yang byung bas rim par byon/ gtsang sde lha dbang rdo rje sogs kyis bkur stis mchod/ sa skya bdag chen khri rin po che nas kyang ja zhus pa 'byor/ rje tā ra na tha la dbang chos du ma gnang*/ slar phebs khar rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rba lcag gis ka ṭo ra 'brus bkang ba yang yang dkrugs pa gnang nas/ 'u cag thugs rgyud gcig pa yin gsungs/ de nas gsung rab gling du gan dho la'i rten bshom gnang ste/ gzhi byes dge 'dun rnams kyi smon lam tshugs/ 'dus pa tha ma lta bu'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub dgos ches mang du byung bas bka' drin stsal/ de nas ring por ma lon par sku khams cung mi bde ba'i tshul bstan/ sku rim brtan bzhugs lhod med bgyis kyang rnam 'phrul de nyid kyis mdzad par zhig zin pa dang skye bo rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul slad dgung lo zhe brgyad pa chu yos zla ba dang po'i nyer brgyad kyi tho rangs dgongs pa chos dbyings su snyoms par zhugs te ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sogs 'byung ba ni gzhir bcas/ sku tshe der chos sde dang ri khrod rnying gso gsar 'dzugs rgya cher mdzad pa dang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes 'byor gyi khrid yig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dbu ma 'jug pa dang*/ mngon pa'i 'grel pa sogs gsung rab po ti bcu skor bzhugs/ rjes sgrub dgongs rdzogs kyang jo bo rin po cher gser zho sum brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs dbus gtsang khams gsum rten gsum la mchod pa dge 'dun la mang 'gyed rgya che ba dang*/

dngos po mtha' yas pa las grub pa'i gser gdung mchod rten chen po 'gran zla bral ba dang snang brnyan rin po che rnams bzhengs shing slar yang*/ zangs khal drug brgya so bdun/ gser zho nyis stong dgu brgya/ dngul chu zho chig khri brgyad stong bdun brgya sogs las bshad sgrub gling gi lha khang gi gser thog legs par bsgrubs te bzo bo rnams la'ang gser zho chig stong nyis brgya sum cu'i rtsis kyi dngos po bzang dgu'i yon sbyar ba sogs chos rje de nyid kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par byas so//rje de'i zhal slob ni/ gtso bo zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi dbang phyug /dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi sprul sku/ glo bo sprul sku/ rje tā ra na tha/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'bri khung rin chen rnam rgyal/ stag lung kun dga' bkra shis/ grub thob blo gros nor ldan/ ri bo che'i mtsho skyes rdo rje/ karma grags rnam/ tre ho bslab gsum rgya mtsho/ zur mang legs bshad sgra dbyangs sogs lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i yon tan gyis phyur bur gtams pa'i skyes chen mang du byung ngo*// //bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bcu pa rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ chos rje gong ma bde bar gshegs khar gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du mchog gi sprul sku phyi ma gang du byon pa'i bka' shog zhib rgyas gnang ba ltar/ mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las smad rol deng sang 'gu log tu grags pa'i yul na yab dhi tsha khyi ku thar dang*/ yum a mtsho gnyis kyi sras gsum gyi che ba nam mkha'/ 'bring ba a 'bum/ chung ba rje 'di nyid ste/ shing 'brug nag zla'i nyer brgyad nyi shar dus yum la gnod pa med par 'khrungs/ lhums su zhugs dus yum gyi rnal lam du gu ru pad+ma'i sku 'od zer dang ldan pa lus la thim pa sogs ngo mtshar du ma rmis pas/

yum gyis mtshan o rgyan skyabs su btags/ sku 'khrungs ma thag tsog pur bzhugs pa dang*/ de nas phyogs phyogs su gom re 'dor ba dang*/ yig drug dang rdo rje gcod pa'i snying po gsungs/ dgung lo gcig bzhes skabs bla ma zhig la yum gyis dbang zhus kyang sprul pa'i sku nas gsan ma 'dod/ gu ru'i sprul pa khyi thul dga' rab rdo rje zer ba la/ 'di khyi thul min/ rang byung dga' rab rdo rje yin gsungs nas phyag mdzad dbang dang byin rlabs zhu ba gnang*/ chos rje gong ma lha bris la cher mkhas pa mi bzhugs pas/ sku 'khor lha bris sprul sku phan bde sogs kyis 'phyas pas/ slad nas khyod rnams la skyengs pa ster ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku chung ngu nas lha sku bri ba dang*/ bal skud kha dog sna tshogs pas si'u grub pa mdzad/ bkra shis zer bas rgyab tu khur nas sog ma'i pi pi bsgyur pas/ nga karma pa yin rgya gling legs par bus cig gsungs/ thugs snying rje chen po rang 'khrungs su mnga' bas/ lug gi bal 'breg skabs/ 'di 'dra sems can la gnod pa ma byed gsungs zhing bshum/ sems can rnams la yid byams pa//mdza' bshes dam pa'i skye bo bzhin//phyugs lug khyu rnams gang du yang*//mthong bar byas pa nga yin zhes//sdug cing yid la bab par gyur/ /gsungs/ nyin cig yab kyis rta pang du khyer nas byon pas/ rta lcag ngang srab skyog nga la gtod gsungs/ phul bas/ bag med kun tu 'gro ba 'di*//yang dang yang du bskul byas nas// kha lo dag kyang legs bsgyur pas//thar pa zhi ba'i grong du deng*//'gro rnams kun tu bskul ba yin/ /gsungs/ yang chu rgyun dang char pa'i chus khrus mdzad nas/ lus ni dag byed chu yin te//gsung rab chu bo'i rgyun gang gis//yid kyi snyogs pa dag par byed//zhes sogs gsungs/ bza' btung gi tshe yang phyag phreng bsnams te yig drug gsungs/ skabs der karma pa'i sprul sku 'gu log gi yul du 'khrungs so zhes yongs su grags pas/

lcags mo bla ma khu dbon gyis g.yo sgyus ngan bshams kyis 'gu log dpon pad+ma dang*/ yab yum bcas la nor mang du byin nas sprul pa'i sku yab yum dang bcas pa lcags mo'i bla mar sbyin dgos byas nas gdan/ dgung lo lnga par dkor rdzas 'dod nas rma chu'i phyogs su khrid/ rma spom ra'i bsu skyel byas/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ ri dwags mang po rjes su 'brangs/ 'bul ba mang du byung ba rnams lcags mo khu dbon gyis hab thob byas/ skabs shig karma pa'i sprul sku 'bri khung du 'khrungs zer ba'i sbir gtam byung ba na/ lcags mo ba rnams kyis rang re'i khang steng gi phrug gu pha bu 'di rnams gar 'gro yang song zer nas kho rang rnams dbus su chas/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa tsa ri mtsho dkar du+u bzhugs skabs gzim dpon mngon dga' zhabs phyi bcas gsang kho gnas btang te/ o rgyan chen pos rdo rje'i gsung gi stsal ba'i chos dbyings rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan dang*/ zhabs brtan bden tshig dang*/ stan dkar sogs dang sku rim sogs kyi phyag ris gnang*/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po dang dbus gtsang rnams nas ja 'dren dang bkur sti rgya cher slebs/ dgung lo bdun par yang ri drung pa shag rog pa zhes me tog zhub can dge slong du brdzu ba des tshogs gur du spyan drangs shis pa brjod pa'i khul byas/ de nas rgyal zla'i bcu bzhi la zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgar chen dang*/ zur lcog /nyin byed sogs kyi dge 'dun sum stong lhag pa der phebs/ bco lnga'i nyin rgyal phur 'phrod la yab sras lhan rgyas/ lo gsar mchu zla'i nyer gsum la gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis spos 'dzin mdzad de sgar chen du spyan drangs seng khrir mnga' gsol shis brjod mdzad/ zhwa nag gser mdong*/ phyag tham/ dbu gdugs sogs nyer spyad dang mchod sprin spros/ chos sde khag so so nas kyang bkur sti bgyis/

dbu zhwa sgron nas bsngo smon mdzad/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas/ sprul pa'i sku yab yum bcas nged la 'bul dgos tshul gsungs pa la yang ri drung pa dang lcags mo ba blo mthun gyis sprul pa'i sku zhwa dmar la gtad na dkor rdzas rnams la dbang bya mi yong par dogs nas 'bul du ma 'dod/ der si tu rin po che phebs pa la'ang*/ yang lcags gnyis nas zhib mjal gnang du ma ster/ sog po rgyal po kho lo jis yab sras gdan 'dren byung bas/ sog po dang sgar pas sprul pa'i sku 'phrog par dogs nas phyogs gzhan du bros thabs su spyan drangs/ skabs der tshe dbang brgya rtsa tsam las yab sras lhan rgyas su+u phebs pa'i 'brel bcad pas rten 'brel gyi sgo thams cad phyin ci log par gyur nas kar bstan la nyams chag chen po byung bar grags/ nyin cig chu 'gram nas rdo mi mgo tsam zhig bcag pas khog nas 'bu ljang khu mang po byung ba la sems can dmyal ba snying re rje oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ gsungs lta stangs mdzad pa'i mod la 'phos/ dgung lo brgyad par rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams rtsal bzo dang*/ sku gzugs mang po bris 'bur gyis bzhengs pa thams cad mig gi bdud rtsi kho na grub/ gong ma dpen la'i 'bul chen tsan dan dkar po rgya ma lnga bcu/ phyi nang gi gos yug nyis brgya sogs rgya cher 'byor/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi dad 'dus mang pos mjal 'bul rgya chen byas/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung*/ skabs de rnams su zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag phreng la gces spras dang gsol 'debs sogs myur du mjal ba'i thugs smon kho na gnang*/ dbus gtsang gi zhu yig legs pa la dper mdzad nas rtsal ris mdzad pas yi ge 'bri klog la zla med par gyur/ 'bum nyag tu rdo la zhabs rjes stsal/ kam po rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis bsu ba byas gnas nang du byon/ kong po dang ri chab sogs kyis 'bul ba byung*/

'khrugs rtsod rnams bsdum/ 'di skabs 'phral dgos kyi 'don chog phal cher thugs 'dzin mdzad/ slar yang 'jang rgyal po dang*/ sog po rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung nas sog yul du byon/ rgyal po nga'i ching sogs skya ser thams cad srog sdom la bkod/ ri la me shor ba phyag nas gnang bas zhi/ dgung lo bcu gcig par dbus phyogs su thegs/ pha bong zhabs chen du zhabs rjes gnyis byon/ tsher lung drung pa dang gar dbang pas spyan drangs nas zur mang du byon/ bde mchog gi tshogs dbur phebs/ dbu zhwa sgron skabs de dag du'ang kar zur rnams kyis zhwa dmar gyi phyogs byas nas 'phrog dogs nas yang lcags gnyis kyis dgra zon cher byas/ spam gzhung du rngon pa'i sha khyis rkyang zhig dad pa gzim gur sgor skyabs zhu bar slebs pa/ g.yung nor bzhin rje nyid kyis phyag dbang gnang*/ phyag mdud btags tshe thar bar mdzad pas sha khyi dang ma bu ltar gyur/ rngon pa la rin gnang*/ khos srog sdom phul/ rim par 'byon lam gyi skye 'gro thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas dge bcu la bkod pa sogs 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ gnyen chen thang lha nyid bsu bar byung ba khye'u dkar po zur phud lnga ldan lag na shel gyi spos phor thog pa zhig phal cher gyis mthong*/ gzim gur 'ja' 'od kyis gang me tog gi char babs/ bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya cher bcas yangs can dang mtshur phur phebs/ seng khri chen por mnga' gsol/ mtshur nang gi lung pa thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa sogs sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rgya nag pho brang du byon skabs kyi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar tshul mthun pa byung*/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par rten gan dho la'i drung du rje dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho nas gtsug phud mchod de yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa sku bzhi lhun grub chos dbyings kun tu khyab pa'i phrin las rtag pa'i rdo rje 'gyur med yid bzhin snying po rgyas pa zla med mngon par mtho ba'i dpal zhes mtshan gsol/

brtan bzhugs dang sgrol dkar rjes gnang gis sna drangs te rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang*/ rgyud man ngag 'grel ba 'grel bshad/ dbang rjes gnang bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i dbang lung khrid gsum mtha' yas par gsan pa ni zhib par rnam thar rgyas par gsal/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rnam 'dren dpa' bo rin po che la/ nyid sku tshe ji tsam bzhugs 'ong zhus pas/ bdag la mngon shes sogs med pas mi shes lags zhus pas/ nyid dgung lo drug cu re gsum par bzhugs pa des khas theg gsungs/ mdo sdud pa thugs dam chag med mdzad/ gtsang sdes spyan drangs pa'i 'byon lam du/ mtsho mo nag ring la mtsho rdzas phul bas mtsho nang nas rol mo'i sgra grags/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs/ zab phu lung du o rgyan chen po 'khor bcas zhal gzigs/ gtsang sde phun rnam pas bsu ba chen pos rnam gling klu sding du sgar phab/ 'bul chen bstab/ gsung rab gling du rje dgu pa'i phyag ris sdeb ris mjal bas lha bzo'i bris pa dang mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar che bar 'dug gsungs/ yang lcags gnyis nas lho brag sgar par thugs yun mang po zhus par rje nyid nas slad nas de 'dra mi byed pa'i bkod 'dom gnang*/ pa nam du byis pa g.yu mdog can zhig byung nas btud pa/

sngon rje rang 'byung pas dam la bzhag pa'i klu bdud mched gsum las g.yu gar cang yin par rje dpa' bos gsungs/ gtsang sdes bsu ba rgya chen pos bsam rtse klu sding du phebs/ dbu zhwa sgron/ 'bul chen bstabs/ las zhwa gos gser tham sogs gnang*/ rgyal sras karma bstan skyong dbang pos mjal mchod sprin spros/ 'di skabs ka la pa'i ri mo gsan/ snyan ngag ni rje dbon nam mkha'i thugs 'dzin byed pa gsan pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ rten gsum gyi sku rgyu dang chag tshad sogs la mkhyen pa zla med/ kha che'i li ma la lhag par mnyes/ yab yum dbon gnyis bcas yang lcags gnyis kyis gtsang sder phra ma zhus nas sgar nas dbyung bar byas/ byang pa bdag po sogs kyis mjal 'bul slebs/ rgya gong ma ta ming wan li'i gser yig /phyi nang gi gos yug brgyad cu sogs 'bul chen 'byor/ lho brag tu rje dpa' bos 'bul chen bstabs/ rong po'i rdza la byon skabs zhabs rjes stsal/ sa skyong khri drung dpon blon gyis bsu bkod chen pos sne'u gdong rtser phebs/ de skabs sa tham rgyal pos gser yig dang*/ rgya 'jang gi khyad nor mang po phul ba slebs/ tsa ri phyogs su byon/ dga' ma mor/ gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom khri dang drug stong bzhi brgyas bskor ba bzhengs/ spyir gar byon rnams su gdul bya thams cad sbyin pa gsum gyis tshim par mdzad/ ri khrod 'dzin pa'i khas len zhus na rje mi la'i sku re dang*/ yig drug dung 'don pa'i khas len zhu ba rnams la 'phags pa'i sku re phyag bris mdzad pa gnang*/ khyim pa phal cher srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa la bkod sha chang gi mgron ston mi bzhes/ gzhan la'ang mi gnang*/ tshe ring 'dod na srog gcod spong*/ bsod nams 'dod na dkon mchog mchod gsungs pa ma gtogs bon sngags bos nas 'dre mchod gyis mi gsungs/ kong por rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos mjal/ chos bdag tu gter lung bzhin dkon mchog spyi 'dus dang rta phag

/gter rdzas sogs phul/ smyung gnas ras chen sku na ches smin pas khyogs la gdan nas/ 'khor smyung gnas pa brgya phrag du mas bskor ba mjal du byung*/ na bza' sogs gnang sbyin du ma mdzad/ rje dpa' bo sku bsnyun pa la rim gro dang bsnyun g.yog kyang chos rje nyid nas mdzad/ bsnyun las grol/ bka' chos ni lo grangs mang por nar mar gsan pas smos med/ yang lcags gnyis kyi ngan mtshang rnams rje dpa' bo nas brtol bar mdzad pas/ sku rab dang gtsang sde bka' bgros nas gnyis ka so sor mtshams la sdod du bcug /lcags mo ba gzhan rnams rang yul du brdzangs te sgar chen gyi gegs tshogs rnams rgyang bsrings/ de rjes sde pa spel dmar nas bskul te gtsang sdes yang lcags gnyis btson du bzung*/ zhwa dmar rin po ches gnang cha bcas zhus kyang rtsi 'jog med khar gtsang sdes sku rab pa la dmag drangs/ chos rje nas/ zhwa dmar rin po che la myur du mjal ba'i skal bzang stsol phyir 'byon pa dang*/ sku rab pa dpon 'bangs nyes med rnams la 'jigs skyobs gnang du gsol zhus pas/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa byon/ zhwa dmar nag dpa' bo/ tre ho bcas yab sras lhan rgyas pa'i legs tshogs byung*/ chos rje'i yab yum dang dbon gnyis kyang sgar du chud/ gtsang skur gnyis la yab sras lhan rgyas kyis bka' nan stsal yang gtsang sdes ma nyan/ skabs der gtsang sde rgyal ba ltar byung yang bla ma'i bka' bcag pas/ mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las//zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par las//gsungs ltar yar lam gtsang sde phun rnams brum pas grong*/ yab sras gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs kyang ma byon pas/ sku tshab rnams nas skur zhus mang po byas/ yang ri drung pa shag ram 'di 'phral du lugs gnyis 'dzom pa ltar snang yang sngon smon lam ma dag pa'i dbang gi zhwa dmar rin po che la sdang drag pas yab sras lhan rgyas dang legs tshogs kyi gegs chen yin par grags/

skabs der yu gur nas cha gar rgyal po dang khar kha'i rgyal po rnams kyis 'bul skyel 'byor/ zhwa dmar rin po che nas sku chas sgar gzhis grwa 'khor tshang ma rgyal ba'i dbang por phul/ rgyal tshab sprul sku ngos 'dzin mdzad/ de nas gtsang sdes yar 'dren du spyan drangs pas lhan rgyas byon/ 'bul chen phul/ dgung lo nyer gcig par/ zhwa dmar rin po ches mkhan po dang*/ dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho slob dpon/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsang ston bcas dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ lha sa dang gnam mtshor byon nas mtshur phur phebs/ zhwa dmar nag lhan rgyas nas lcags ri bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul bum gter sogs mdzad/ rje gar gyi dbang po nas dbang chos mang po gsan/ rje dpa' bo nas bka' chos 'phro rnams gsan/ chos rje nyid kyis phyag bris lha sku du ma sogs phul/ slar yang gtsang sdes spyan drangs te byon/ chibs bsu ser sbreng bcas rgya'i rtser phebs/ 'bul chen phul/ btson thams cad bton/ de nas rim par sa skyar phebs/ bdag chen dang zhal 'dzom gnang*/ rtsib rir grub thob rnams zhal gzigs/ ding ri glang 'khor du thugs dam 'phel/ dam pa kun dga' zhal gzigs/ tshe ring mas bsu ba bcas chu dbar du phebs/ rje mi la snam sbyar bzhes pa zhal 'dzum can zhal gzigs/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs par yab sras gnyis kas sa rdo sku rgyab tu bsnam pa mdzad/ ri me shor ba bden tshig gsungs pas zhi/ de nas zhwa dmar rin po che bal yul gnas gzigs dang*/ chos rje gangs ti si la gnas gzigs su byon/ zhal gzigs sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang*/ 'brog pa'i dud 'gro phul ba thams cad tshe thar la btang*/ skyid grong du byon skabs zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa rgya gar du 'byon pa'i spring yig 'byor bas chos rje nyid thugs skyo ba'i spyan chab phyung*/ rje dbon nam mkhas bshol thabs bka' gros zhus bzhin zhwa dmar rin po che la zhu yig gser bcas bskur/

dpal mo dpal thang ding ri glang 'khor du yon bdag tshogs pa rnams kyis/ 'di ltar rgyal po'i bla mchod du mi bzhugs par gnas nges med du 'byon pa'i ci zhus pas/ so sor tshigs su bcad pas lan stsal/ chu dbar du phebs thang sku mang po phyag bris mdzad/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa phebs bsu la byon pas spro bde bkra shis sgang du yab sras mjal/ mtsho ma pham gyi chu rin po che'i snod bcas phul bas khrus mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar nas rgya bal gyi khyad nor mang po gnang*/ rje zhwa dmar gyi phyag dpe dang dra phed sogs chos rje'i sku rgyab tu bsnams te chu dbar du phebs/ lho brag nas dpa' bo rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa'i yi ge slebs pas chos rje nyid thugs khral shin tu che bar mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar zhwa dmar rin po che'ang sprul sku phyi ma gar 'byon gyi zhal bzhes mdzad nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/ skabs der chos rje'i zhabs phyir rje tre ho rin po che byon/ sku gdung rin po che nyin ltar mchod pa bcas mtshur phur gdan drangs/ 'jang rgyal pos dngul srang nyis brgya dang mu tig gi phreng ba du ma sogs dang dad can mang pos dngos rdzas bcas dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/ sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i mchod rten chos rje nyid kyis phyag bstar mdzad de bzhengs/ de'i lha khang bzhengs pa'i sa rdo 'ang sku rgyab tu bskyed/ dgongs rdzogs su thang sku mang po phyag bris mdzad/ tshogs pa'i ja thug gi chu yang sku rgyab tu len par mdzad/ spro ba dris nas sgrub pa brgya dang brgyad chu dbar du brdzangs/ dbus gtsang du bstan pa'i 'pho 'gyur la gzigs nas mdo khams su 'byon pa'i thugs 'dun mdzad/ skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi mgur mang po gsungs/ sog rgyal gdug pa can ar pa lang dang*/ chog thu sogs nas mjal kha zhus kyang ma gnang bas/ be ri rgyal po bon po yin kyang sog po'i sne len mi byed pa de karma pa rang yin 'dug ces sngar phebs lam bkag pa la bshags pa phul/

de nas zhabs thang du tsa ri'i gnas gzigs la phebs/ slar lho brag tu byon nas sku 'dra rtsa ris ma'i drung du+u phyag 'bum mdzad/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang phyogs med du mchod mjal dang gdul bya thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ mon rgyal po sogs che dgu rnams kyi khyad nor sna tshogs phul ba sogs smos kyi mi langs/ lha sar phebs jo shāka so sor phyi nang gi bskor ba 'bum phrag re mdzad/ jo bo rin po che la dar leb rgan kha gsum phul ba phyi nyin jo bo rin po che nas phyag mdud gsum gnang ba mgul du bzhes/ dad ldan rnams kyang jo shāka rnam gnyis la dad pa lhag tu 'phel bas phyag bskor sogs dge las la bkod par mdzad/ sa tham rgyal pos spyan 'dren slebs/ rje dbon gnyis kyang rim par gshegs pas/ rgyal tshab chen po grags mchog spyan drangs nas rjes sgrub mdzad/ o rod bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dmag dpung gtsang phyogs su lhag /de gong sog dmag byung skabs gtsang sdes zhus nas rgyal tshab chen po grags pa mchog dbyangs nas ldog par mdzad thub kyang*/ skabs 'dir yab sras gnyis ka nas bka' nan stsal kyang las dbang gis ldog ma thub/ paṇa chen rin po che brgyud nas lnga pa chen por zhu don phul ba la/ paṇa chen nas rgyal ba'i dbang por kar dge'i don la thugs khag med pa kho bos khag theg cing kar lugs pa 'di dag mdzad pa mi mkhas pas lan tshul zhus pas/ kar lugs pa rang 'jag chog pa'i bka' shog phebs kyang nag phyogs kyis rgyud dkrugs pas g.yul 'khrugs chen po'i mgo tshugs pas lho brag tu byon/ rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku kun tu bzang po ngos 'dzin mdzad/ skabs der rim gro pa kun tu bzang po la gsol zho phor gang sag dril smyu gu lnga shog stong dril ba rnams gnang nas nye gnas dgos pa'i bka' stsal/ gtsang sdes bya ba ngan pa la chos rje yang thugs khrel/ bka' blon dga' res drung skor de dag gi zhabs 'dren byas pa'i skor la gtsang pa mi the ba'i dag pa phul kyang don du ma gyur/

kong dmag tsho gcig slebs pa la/ chos rjes/ khyod rnams sngar yang sdod ma tshugs pas 'di byung*/ da sdod thub par gyis la phyir log /gal srid mi nyan na mtshur phus gtsos pa'i kar bstan gyi khag khyed rang tshos khur/ nged rgyal ba lnga pa chen por mgo 'dogs pa yin gsungs pas/ kar lugs kyi byed lte rnams kyi khog par 'dre zhugs te/ karma pas gtsang pa blos btang kar bstan gyi khur bor zer nas/ rje lnga pa chen pos kar lugs rang 'jag chog pa'i bka' shog rtsi med du btang par grags/ chos rje ni rgyal po'i rgyal srid dug dang 'dres pa'i sbrang rtsi ltar gzigs nas kar gtsang chos srid gcig tu bzhed nas dmag 'khrugs kyi bya ba ngan pa la 'jug pa ga la srid/ spyir snying po'i bstan pa'i khug so 'di lta bur 'byung ba o rgyan chen pos yang yang lung bstan pa'i phyir/ skye 'gro'i skal pas bya thabs med pa yin/ de nas lho brag tu yab sras gnyis sku mtshams cung zad bzhugs/ lha sku mang po phyag bris mdzad/ dngos rdzas thams cad dbul 'phong rnams la sbyin par btang*/ mtshur phu/ gnas nang*/ gtsang nyin byed gling sogs su byon/ rim gro pa dang chos rje nyid khams phyogs la 'byon pa'i skar gnon mdzad/ chu lug gsar tshes la rgyal tshab chen po dang rdi tsha sku skye bsnyen par rdzogs/ dpa' bo sprul sku rab byung mdzad/ spre lor stag lung bkra shis dpal grub phebs zhal 'dzom mdzad/ gzhung mchod yon nas kar lugs kyis dge lugs phyogs la log pa mi byed pa'i dbu rtsi gnang dgos phebs pa la/ chos rje nas/ de byed mi dgos/ sngar kar dge'i 'gal ba'i las nged kyi log pa byas re'i mna' byed gsungs pas/ gtsang sde phun rnams kyi skabs su sku rab pa'i don la bka' bcag pas thugs khrel zhing*/ de skabs gtsang pa dang sgar chen thugs 'dod mi gcig nges pa'i phyir/ chos rjes slad nas log pa mi mdzad pa lta ci smos sngar yang log pa ma mdzad dbu bsnyung gnang chog dgongs pa la gzhung mchod yon gyis go ba log par gzung nas thugs 'khrugs/

de nas skyid shod pa dang sog dmag gis sgar chen bskor/ chos rje nyid dang rim gro pa sgar nas thon te mkhan pa ljongs su bzhud pa na/ dmag mi 'ga' res sha bar mthong*/ 'ga' res bya rgod du mthong rjes su rgyug kyang ma zin/ sgar chen dmag gis gtor/ grwa pa la la rmas/ la la bsad/ phal cher bros skabs der chos rje dpon slob lnga bsam yas su phebs pa dang*/ lha sar phebs pa dang*/ kong po rgod tshang du phebs pa'i mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung*/ dmag gis btsal kyang ma rnyed/ bya sprel lo mtshams su zhag bcu gnyis bar chos rje dpon slob gnyis la na bza' gsol chas med kyang o rgyan rin po ches bdud rtsi gnang bas sku bkres pa dang bsil ba ma byung*/ rim gro pa kun tu bzang pos 'di nas bzung ste lo gsum skad rag ma bshig cing lo so lnga'i bar du zhabs phyi zhu ba la lhod pa med pas/ phyis chos rjes gdan phyed bstabs te nyid kyi phyag bstar ma'i rten gsum mang du stsal zhing brtan bzhugs mdzad pa sogs thugs kyi rtsis po che mdzad/ de nas rim par tsa rir byon/ yang steng skor gyi sku'i nyer spyad sogs phul/ klo mi khyim bdun par byon skabs sbrang rtsi sogs mang du phul/ phar gos dmar yug gcig dang la ba zhig gnang nas 'dam bcug pas srab 'thug lta zhing la ba 'dam pas/ klo ni klo rang red gsungs/ gla ba zhig phul ba sku'i rjes su 'brangs/ spre'u brgya phrag gis mjal rtsed mo'i gzigs phul/ mtsho dkar du byon zhal gzigs mang me khyi lo gsar tshes la ka nam se ba sgang du phebs/ zang zing 'bul ba char ltar babs pa rnams phral du mchod sbyin mdzad/ zhwa dmar sprul sku 'khrungs pa mkhyen nas/ zhabs brtan/ ljags mdud/ stan dkar/ phyag phreng*/ yab yum la bka' shog gser srang bcas bskur nas karma snying rje dang*/ karma don grub gnyis brdzangs/ phag lor sa tham rgyal po nas spyan 'dren byung*/

kha ba dkar por byon/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i mdun na 'don karma stobs ldan sogs kyi bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas rgyal thang du phebs/ rgyal po karma 'chi med lha dbang yab sras btsun mor bcas pas chos rje la shing byi lo gsar gyi mchod sprin 'byor/ 'bul ba mtha' yas/ dbu zhwa sgron dge bskul mdzad/ me rtsed gzigs mo phul/ de nas la thog tu chos rje ras dkar gyi gur du khri stan bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs su gsol nas/ rgyal pos thog mar mjal rten du gser gyi 'khor lo/ dung dkar gser shog can sogs phul/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ yab rgyal po karma mi pham tshe dbang gshegs pa thugs rjes bzung zhus/ phyi nyin rgyang grags gsum tsam du lam gyi g.yas g.yon du skye bo stong phrag mang po pus mo btsugs te rang rang gi mdun du lcog rtse'i khar yon chab spos dang me tog bshams/ lag pas rol cha sna tshogs kyi sgras mchod pa'i bsu ba bcas bha she'i skyed tshal du sgar phab/ de nas pho brang gi phyi nang legs par brgyan nas blon po lnga tsam gyi bsu bkod chen pos pho brang du spyan drangs nas gser khrir bzhugs/ gser kho nas bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ gser bre dngul bre gos dar sogs 'bul chen phul/ dbu zhwa sgron/ yig drug gi bzlas lung gnang*/ dam chos pad dkar nas gsung ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan rnams brjod cing de ni rgyal sras gzhan las ches lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan

dang*/ da nas bzung ste yi dam 'di dang yi ge drug pa kha ton dgos tshul sogs chos sbyin rgya chen po rtsal/ de nas blon po che dgu rnams kyis so sor spyan drangs nas bkur sti zhus/ thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ 'bul zhabs longs spyod kyis sprin gtibs pa rnams yar mchod mar sbyin du stsal/ yi ge drug pa bskul/ thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ 'jang rgyal po 'di rje bdun pa yan du 'jang rgyal po 'di gnam mchod cing dmar mchod byed pa zhig yin kyang*/ kun mkhyen mi bskyod zhabs yul 'dir phebs dus glang chen gyis phyag byas/ chibs dus sa la nyal bas lha yin 'dug bsam nas ci gsung la nyan pas dge ba bcu la bkod pa nas bzung da lta'i bar karma pa'i gdul byar gyur pa yin/ yul der mi khyim khri phrag bcu gnyis lhag tsam yod par grags/ de nas rgyal pos rim gro pa kun tu bzang po sogs ston 'khor thams cad la dngos po rgya chen po bstabs nas/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di lta bu dbu thon du spyan drangs pa legs tshul gyis gsung bzang gnang*/ yab kyi dgongs rdzogs gser zho brgya sogs phul/ lha lus thob pa'i lung bstan stsal/ rgyal pos yun du bzhugs par zhus kyang 'du rdzi la mi dgyes pas rgyal thang phyogs su byon/ bya rgod dgon du spo 'bor sga 'dan sogs kyis mjal mkhan shin tu mang*/ thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ de nas zhwa dmar sprul sku spyan 'dren par dgongs te sku chas tshang ma rim gro pa la gnang*/ chos rje nyid mu to'i cha lugs mdzad nas rta gcig la nyer mkho bkal nas gcig pur 'gu log gi yul du byon pas/ chom rkun pas chib pa na bza' sogs yod tshad phrog /zhabs rjen du slong mo mdzad cing byon pas zhabs gnyis kha bas phyid nas rma byung*/ gsol zhal dang na bza' med pas gcig gis phor ba dum bu lngar chag nas skud pas 'dzer ba zhig phul/

gcig gis kho rang gis phying pa'i gos phul bas de dag la longs spyod par mdzad/ khyim bdag gcig gis zhabs kyi rma ma sos par gsol chas drangs/ nyin cig gsol zhal chag po'i nang du thal ba byugs te byang chub sems dpa' stag mo lus sbyin gyi bkod pa phyag bris gnang ste phyag mchod mdzad/ de nas rim par byon pas kha cig gis shes nas mjal mkhan mang du byung*/ 'brog sde rnams kyi rta brgya skor sogs 'bul ba rgya che/ zhwa dmar sprul skus mkhyen nas nye du zhig bsu bar btang ba 'byor/ de nas sprul sku nyid phebs bsur byung te phyag 'tshal mu tig gi phreng ba phul/ chos rje nas sprul pa'i sku la gser dngul sogs thugs la gang dgyes pa'i dngos po thams cad gnang*/ nye du rnams kyang nor gyis tshim par mdzad/ sngon nyid kyi 'khrungs yul du byon pas/ khang pa zhig yul sde rnams 'thor ba sogs 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzigs/ me tog gi tshal zhig tu mdzad bcu'i bstod pa 'di gsungs te gnas tshul bcas rim gro ba la spring*/ phyogs phyogs nas mjal mkhan shin tu mang*/ sngon rkun ma'i phrog pa'i chibs pa'ang phyag tu 'byor/ rim gro pa'ang li yul nas sdod ma tshugs par 'ong*/ yab sras lhan rgyas nas bka' chos ci rigs pa gnang*/ pha bong zhig la zhabs rjes bzhag /rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku'ang ngos 'dzin mdzad/ zhwa dmar sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes/ 'ga' re rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ gso sbyong ni gar dbang drug pa dang rje 'dis chag med mdzad pa yin/ dgung lo lnga bcu par rgya nag nas spyan 'dren byung yang ma phebs pas/ slar 'bul chen slebs/ chu 'brug lor lnga pa chen po rgya nag tu byon nas 'di lo yar byon pa yin/ shing lug lor chos rjes mkhan po/ rim gro pas slob dpon sogs kyis si tu sprul sku chos rgyal mi pham phrin las rab brtan bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo der 'jang yul gyi grwa pa stong tsam la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/

de nas sa tham rgyal pos spyan drangs mchod yon lhan rgyas nas dbang khrid du ma stsal/ 'di skabs mtshur phu nas rgyal tshab chen po zhi bar gshegs pa dgongs nas sprul pa'i sku yang 'di phyogs su phebs par 'dug gsungs/ lcags byi lo gsar du bzhad skabs/ chos rje karma pa/ zhwa dmar/ si tu/ dpa' bo/ phag mo/ zhabs drung*/ zhwa sgom sku skye sogs la rim gro pas lo sar ston mo zhus/ sa tham rgyal pos kyang lo sar phul/ gong ma shun rtsis zhu yig dang bang mi 'byor/ zhwa dmar sogs mang po la phyag chen dang chos drug blo sbyong sogs zhib khrid gnang*/ slar yang gong ma shun rtsi btsun mo sras blon bcas pa'i 'bul ba dang*/ gong ma nas tham ka brje ba dang tā ming hu dbang gi dus ltar bdag rkyen yod tshul zhus kyang*/ tham ka gsar pa len pa'i 'jig rten phyogs kyi zhu 'dod ci yang med gsungs/ sku 'khor rnams kyi zhus kyang*/ de 'dra'i dgos pa med/ khyed rang tsho gos chen 'dod pa yin 'dug mod/ ngas shes na rgya yul 'ga' rer khrag mtsho 'khyil ba mthong gsungs/ lhag par si tu sprul skus kar bstan nyams chag che ba thugs kyis ma bzod nas bdag rgya nag gi rgyal bur skye ba blangs nas bstan pa gso chog pa zhus pas/ deng sang ji ltar byas kyang bstan pa rnam dag ni mi 'ong*/ bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan ni dgos pa med/ de 'dra'i bsam pa 'chang na nged dang gtan tu mi 'phrad pa'i gegs yin zhes 'gog par mdzad/ rgyal tshab sprul sku ngos 'dzin mdzad/ de'ang sngon sog dmag gis sgar chen bcom/ kar dgon thams cad blangs skabs/ rgyal tshab chen po grags pa mchog dbyangs dang rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub gnyis nas thabs mkhas kyis zhu don sbyar bas/ mtshur phu'i gtsos byas yangs can/ nyin byed gling*/ legs bshad gling*/ 'od zer gling sogs chos sde nyer gcig tsam gnang zhing kar sde kun gyis 'dren pa mnga' gsol bas/

mtshur phu rtsis bzhes dang*/ chos sde so sor 'go 'dzin bkod bzhag stsal/ bstan pa'i me ro gsos/ gzhung sa nas phebs bsu bcas lha sar phebs/ gzhung mchod yon nas bsnyen bkur rgya cher gnang*/ chos rje karma pa nyid kyang mtshur phu'am lho brag tsam du bzhugs te rgyal tshab rin po che 'di nyid kyis ji ltar mdzad pa ltar gnang na thugs dgyes pa'i mchod gnas su gsol ba 'debs pa'i gsung rgyal dbang lnga pa'i bka' shog rtsal ba stag lung zhabs drung bkra shis dpal grub nas phul kyang sems can rnams kyang las dbang gis legs pa zhig 'ong ma btub pas/ stag lung zhabs drung dang chos sde rnams la bka' skyon cher byung skabs/ rje 'di lha sar byon nas yin lugs zhus/ zhabs drung nas dbu mna' 'bul dgos byung*/ de rjes gzhung mchod yon du dbyen zhus 'ga' re song ba'i dag ther du lha sar byon/ lnga pa chen po mchod yon mjal bas thugs dag par ma zad gnang cha mang po stsal/ gtsang sde dang*/ o rod rgyal mo'i bsngo rten 'byor/ lnga pa chen po rgya nag nas phebs skabs lha sar byon pas rtse shod nas skya thabs kyi bsu ba bcas gong sa mjal/ thugs phebs pa'i gsung gleng mang du gnang/ o rod rgyal rgyud mkhan hu thug thus mjal dbang zhus/ phyi ma 'khor du skye ba'i smon lam byas/ rje 'di kar bstan la mdzad pa'i phyag rjes shin tu che zhing stag lung zhabs drung kyang de dang phyogs mtshungs pa'o//dgung lo zhe gnyis par sa khyi lor mtshur phu'i zhal ras lha khang du bde bar gshegs/ skye ba la rang dbang thob cing dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis bla ma karma pa chen po bzhugs pa'i 'jang yul du khyim bdag zhig gi sras su 'khrungs kyang*/ chos rje nyid kyi sku skye ba phyi ma'i mchog sprul nam 'byon la mtshur phu'i gdan sa 'dzin dgos pa'i rten 'byung dgos dbang gis sku'i rigs sras yin pa'i zhal bzhes kyang mdzad/

'khrungs nas cher ma son skabs sngon gnas rjes dran mtshur phu'i lo rgyus du ma gsungs/ dgung lo gsum par khri 'don mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad par dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang*/ dpal nor bu bzang po 'gro 'dul kun tu dga' ba'i rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa dgos 'dod char du 'bebs pa bzang po'i dpal zhes mtshan gsol/ zhwa dmar/ si tu/ rgyal tshab rnams la chos rje nyid kyi phyag gis grub pa'i dmar ser gyi cod pan re gnang*/ zhwa dmar/ si tu/ dpa' bo/ rgyal tshab/ phag mo karma rin chen/ sprul sku chos skyong bzang po/ sprul sku bskal bzang snying po sogs mang po la bka' 'gyur rin po che'i ljags lung stsal/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rjes thog mar mjal te rang gi gter byon gser gyi zla tshes rang grub phul/ gter ston tshad dang ldan pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang*/ 'bul bar byung ba'i phyag rdzas thams cad mchod sbyin rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas zhwa dmar sprul sku/ rgyal tshab sprul sku/ dpa' bo sprul sku rnams khri 'don dgos stabs rim par dbus su byon/ lam gyi lha sde mi sde thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ spro lung du zhabs drung dang mjal thugs gshin pa'i nang lugs gsung 'phros smar/ po ta lar byon lnga pa chen po mjal/ 'byon lam dang chos kyi bka' dri mang du mdzad pa la/ chos rje sku na sgres pas snyan thag ring stabs rim gro bas lan phul/ gsol ston dang gnang cha bzang po mdzad/ lha sar jo mjal mdzad pas dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ chos rje nyid sngon srong btsan sgam por gyur cing jo bo'i thugs kar thim pa'ang dran/ gong sa'i bkas sgrags su phebs de nas mi ring bar sprul pa'i snang brnyan bsdu bar mdzad/ de'ang dgung lo don gcig pa shing stag dbo zla'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar bzhugs/ de skor gzim khang thams cad 'od dkar pos khengs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni smos ma dgos/

sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur spyan drangs/ thugs sras sprul pa'i sku rnams dang*/ rim gro ba kun tu bzang po sogs kyis 'od zhu/ dngul gdung*/ mchod sbyin/ rab gnas sogs dgongs rdzogs yang dag par sgrub pa la gzhol bar mdzad do/ /rgyal mchog dam pa 'di'i rnam thar gyi mdo rtsa thugs snying rje chen pos sems can grog sbur tsam la'ang gnod pa byed pa lta ci smos bu gcig pa ltar brtse/ khyi dang sprang po sogs 'phong rgud nyam thag thams cad la lhag par brtse bas rang nyid kyi phyag gis sbyin pa lhug par mdzad nas tshim par mdzad/ gnod byed la khon med par ma zad gnod lan du phan 'dog cing brtse bar mdzad/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs te snang srid sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pas skyid sdug dar rgud la dga' sdug gis snang ba gtan nas mi mnga'/ yi dam thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la mnyam rjes 'brel ba'i ngang nas yig drug gi bzlas pa kho na ma gtogs drag sngags dang mngon spyod sogs thugs la mi 'bab/ sha chang ljags thog tu mi 'jog /zla phyed gso sbyong mi chag /rten gsum bzhengs pa dang mchod pa'i bya ba'i dus 'da' bar mdzad de thang sku phyag bris mdzad pa ni bgrang gis mi langs te/ de'ang zhal snga nas/ snyan ngag dang ri mo bri ba na bod yul du kho bo las lhag pa mi yong*/ kho bo spyan ras gzigs dgyes pa'i mi zhig yin zhes sogs gsungs te mig gi bdud rtsi lta bu kho na phyag bstar mdzad do//rje de'i slob tshogs ni/ rtogs pa don gyi rgyud 'dzin mchog sprul phyi ma'i 'dren par gyur pa zhwa dmar ye shes snying po/ kar bstan 'dzin pa'i phrin las zla med du grub pa rgyal tshab chen po grags mchog de dang phyogs mtshungs zhabs drung bkra shis dpal grub/ sku'i zhabs tog zla med du grub pa rim gro pa kun tu bzang po/ si tu chos rgyal mi pham phrin las/

dpa' bo kun tu bzang po/ de'i sprul sku phrin las rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab sprul sku nor bu bzang po/ mkhas grub rā ga a s+ya/ mkha' reg karma bstan srung*/ khyab bdag grub dbang*/ phag mo zhabs drung*/ zhwa sprul skal bzang snying po/ sprul sku karma chos skyong*/ sa tham lha btsun karma rin chen/ rgyal sras kar phun/ karma bstan skyong*/ karma bsam grub/ karma chos 'phags/ karma don grub/ 'bam chen dbon/ jo stan mkhan po/ ri bo che'i chos rje/ rdi tsha sprul sku/ ne ring chos rje/ yol mo sprul sku/ zur mang gar sprul rin snying*/ rtogs ldan blo gros/ bya btang bstan rnam/ che tshang sprul sku/ rtse le sprul sku/ tshe ra lung drung pa/ rgod tshang sprul sku/ nor bu rgyan pa/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po/ zhabs drung dkon mchog /gong ra lo chen sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen rnams las phal cher rtsa slob dang 'ga' zhig dam chos kyis 'brel zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'o// //bskal pa'i khug so rtsod dus 'gro ba'i mgon//snying rje'i mthu yis zas gtsang ston mchog ltar//bstan pa'i khug so mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs kyis//yangs pa'i sa chen ro yis dog por gyur//rten gsum bshig cing skye 'gro nyam thag dus//snying rje'i dbang gis mgon med skye 'gro'i mgon//snying stobs bzod pa 'gran pa'i zla med pa//shākya'i rgyal po gnyis pa 'di min su/ /zhes smras so// bcu gcig pa chos rje ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bcu gcig pa chos rje ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ de yang rtsod dus snyigs ma lnga bdo bas snying po don gyi bstan pa ches nyams dma' ba'i skabs su snyigs 'gro nyam thag rnams la snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis gzigs pa rnam pa lngas bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba bzhes pa'i yul mdo smad smar khams kyi sa char/ yab yum rigs dang ldan pa'i sras su me pho 'brug gi lor sku 'khrungs/

de'i tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs mang pos zhal gzigs shing*/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i dus gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes gsungs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa ci yang bstan pas/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje gtso byas/ mi dang mi min kun gyis chos rje karma pa'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'khrungs so zhes phyogs med du bsgrags pas sgras thams cad du khyab par gyur/ de nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bdun pa dang*/ rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po sogs kyis dbus phyogs su spyan drangs te rim par byon pa'i phebs lam gyi skye 'gro thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad nas/ rta thabs kyi bsu ba dang*/ ser sbreng bcas bde chen yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ yab sras gser zhal 'dzoms te lhan rgyas pas rten 'byung mchog tu 'grigs/ de nas mi ring bar bsu ba ser sbreng bcas 'jig rten dbang phyug rim byon gyi bsti gnas 'og min mtshur phu'i pho brang du phebs/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po la seng khri chen por mnga' gsol dang shis pa brjod/ mthon mthing gser gyi mdongs can gyi cod paṇa dbu la bzhes te snying po don brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po chen por bzhugs/ rigs kyi bdag po gar gyi dbang phyug zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa ye shes snying po las phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro chos drug sogs rang lugs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang*/ khyad par du slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha wa'i rdo rje'i gsung gis ye shes rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter dang*/ stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i zab gter thams cad du chos kyi bdag por lung bstan pa ltar rnying lugs kyi dbang lung man ngag mang po gsan bsam mthar phyin mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhan po karma phrin las gsum pa dang*/ rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas mdo rgyud man ngag gi dbang lung sogs gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/

bshad pa dang grub pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i sgron me sbar/ gar dbang bdun pa dgung bgrang re bzhi bzhes pa shing khyi dbo zla'i nyer bdun la bde bar gshegs pa'i tshe/ dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod 'bul dang*/ sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ gdan sa'i nyams gso mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten du ma gsar bzhengs mdzad/ tre ho rin po che karma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ gong sa lnga pa chen po'i gzigs pa che zhing zhabs phyir po ta lar bzhugs pa/ lcags spre lo lnga pa chen po gshegs kyang*/ chos rgyal sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dbu blar bzhugs dgos byung ba sa stag lor dgongs pa khrol nas mtshur phur phebs/ chos rje ye shes rdo rje mjal/ bka' chos kyang ci rigs pa zhus/ rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po gshegs par thugs dam gsol 'debs mdzad/ gnas nang du rje dpa' bo phrin las rgya mtsho mjal/ slar mtshur phur byon skabs/ chos rje karma pa nas/ sku chas phyag rdzas tshang ma gnang nas phyag nas mdzad te 'thor mi nyan gsungs/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ rje dpa' bo phrin las rgya mtsho dgung lo lnga bcu pa sa yos lor zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ 'di gong shing phag lor gar dbang brgyad pa bal yul du 'khrungs nas/ zhwa dmar pa'i sprul sku yin tshul sa cha yul ris kyi ming sogs sngon gnas rjes dran du ma gsungs/ de skabs zag med kyi mngon par mkhyen pa la dbang 'byor pa chos rje karma pas/ zhwa dmar pa'i yang srid sku 'khrungs pa'i sa yul gyi bkod pa shog khra phyag ris mdzad de bang mi'i lag tu sprad nas mngags pas bal yul yol mo gangs rar sprul pa'i sku 'khrul med du ngos zin pas/ bal po rgyal po man+t+ra sing ha ma l+las 'phrog thabs su yam bur spyan drangs pas/ chos rje ye shes rdo rje'i bka' ltar gzhung sa nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mgo 'dren dang phyag mdzod rgyan lu mngags te dgung lo drug par lcags 'brug lor bal yul nas rim par spyan drangs nas thog mar gtsang gzhung brgyud nas lha sar phebs dgos rgyu la/

tre ho rin po che nas/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la shang brgyud nas mtshur phur phebs chog pa zhus pas don smin/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lngar chibs bsu bcas stag snar phebs/ gzim chung mngon dgar zhag shas bzhugs/ tre ho rin po che nas phyi nang gi rten 'byung legs tshogs thams cad bsgrig par mdzad/ shang brgyud nas yangs pa can dang*/ dpal sa spyod 'og min mtshur phur chibs bsu bcas phebs/ yab sras zhal rgyas kyi legs tshogs 'grigs/ chos rje nas sprul pa'i sku'i gtsug phud bzhes/ dpal chen po chos kyi don grub rgyud sde rgya mtsho gar gyi rnam rol phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ dpal 'byor srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun gyi gter/ /sogs kyi zhabs brtan/ stan dkar rdo rje'i ri mo can sogs phul/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan dbu la gsol te seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol shis pas skyong bar mdzad/ si tu chos rgyal mi pham gyi sku skye gling tshang dpon mgon lhun pa'i sras su 'khrungs shing*/ chos rje nas ngos 'dzin mdzad cing mtshan btags mod gling tshang rang gi 'dod phyogs sa skya'i chos sgor btsug pas phral du sku gshegs/ rgyu mtshan des brgyud pa 'dir ma chud cing si tu'i go sar ma 'byor pas si tu na rim gyi grangs su mi bgrang bar gsungs/ de'i sprul pa'i sku kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyang*/ chos rje nyid kyis bstan rtsis kyi re'u mig zhig gsar bsgrig gnang bar/ si tu lcags 'brug lo ba a lor 'byung*/ /zhes bkod par mdzad/ de rjes khams smyon sku skye dbus su byon skabs mtshur phur/ chos rje zim chung chos dbyings pho brang du bzhugs pa mjal/ a lo kun mkhyen gyi zhu 'phrin snyan du phul skabs nyi ma shar ba dang 'grigs pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ da lan rten 'brel shin tu legs/ si tu rin po che sde dger 'khrungs zhes tre ho chos rje yang gsung gi yod tshod 'dug

/gsung ba tsam las chos rje nyid kyis de sngon mkhyen nas phyag bris su bkod zin pa'i sgros ma gnang*/ khams smyon sku skye thon khar si tu sprul sku la ril nag si tu'i khug ma gang gi nang du mu tig mig med rdog gcig bcug pa dang*/ so 'brang 'khor lo/ phyag mdud bcas bskur ba gnang*/ phyis bstan rtsis kyi ri'u mig si tu nyid kyis gzigs skabs/ 'phags chen rnams kyi dus gsum gyi bye brag skad cig la ma 'dres par sgrib med du gzigs pa yin pa'i phyir tha shal kho bo lta bu'ang 'khor bar 'phyan pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du gzigs pa dus las mi yol lo snyam pa'i dka' ba thug med du 'phel/ zhes kun mkhyen si tu nyid kyis gsungs/ gzhan yang zag med kyi mngon par mkhyen pa la chags thogs mi mnga' bas/ rje dpa' bo'i sku skye gtsug lag don grub sogs sprul pa'i sku du ma ngos 'dzin mdzad/ ding ri'i sgrub chen 'gyur med rnam rgyal spyan gnyis long ba la zhal chab btab pas de ma thag shin tu gsal bar gyur/ shog shing gi spir yu+u la phyag mdud mdzad nas slar gong bur sgril ba dang*/ dus gcig la gzims chung rer sku'i bkod par sprul nas bzhugs pa sogs grub pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas/ gangs can gyi yul du mkhas pa dang grub pa kun gyis gus pas mchod/ mchog dman bar ma'i skye dgu ma lus pa theg pa gsum gyi byang chub du smin pa dang grol bar mdzad/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa dpal chen chos kyi don grub rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol te snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad/ sprul pa'i sku phyi ma gang du 'byon pa lung bstan nas/ rtag 'dzin can gyi gdul bya rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir chu rta lor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la sprul pa'i bkod pa phyogs gcig bsdu bar mdzad/ de skabs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'ja' sprin gyi bskor ba'i dbus su sku'i bkod pa gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par bstan pa skal ldan kun gyis mthong ba byung*/

zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa dang tre ho rin po che nas dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang*/ sku gdung rin po che 'od zhu mchod sdong bzhengs shing bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas par mdzad do//rje 'di'i zhal slob ni/ gtso bor don brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa dpal chen chos kyi don grub dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug tre ho karma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ mkhan chen karma don yod snying po sogs mang du byon mod kyang rje 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa de sngon bdag gis ma mjal bas/ 'di ni zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs kyi dngos bstan rnams gzhir bzhag shugs bstan cung zad kyis mtshams sbyar/ gzhan nas phran tshegs gsal ba rnams kyis kha bskang pa'o// //

bcu gnyis pa chos rje byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bcu gnyis pa chos rje byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ mdo smad sde dge'i sa char/ bod chos rgyal gdung rgyud grub thob chen po karma pak+shi'i dbon rgyud yab karma tshe brtan dang yum dkar mo skyid kyi sras su chu lug lor sku 'khrungs/ de'i snga lo tsam du yab rdza ma 'tshong du song bas rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje mjal bas/ gter ston nas khri mthon po zhig gi steng du bzhag /khyod kyis rdza ma 'tshong mi dgos gsungs nas rdza ma thams cad bcag nas btang ba'ang*/ rje karma pa'i sprul sku sras su 'khrungs par mkhyen pa'o/ /bla ma 'dul ba zhes pa zhig gis sprul pa'i skur khrus zhig phul bas mig la na tsha chen po byung ba gter ston la ci phan zhus pas/ khyod kyis rgyal ba karma pa la khrus byas pas dpal lha mo khros nas mig nang du tsha dang thal ba btab pa yin gsungs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'khrungs nas zla ba gnyis tsam song skabs/ nga karma pa yin gsungs/ dbus nas mgron gnyer phan bde rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin la brdzangs pa lha thog tu gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje mjal bas/ mchog gi sprul sku yod pa'i sa cha dang yab yum gyi ming bcas ston par mdzad pa bzhin sprul pa'i sku mjal/ rje gong ma'i phur mdud/ sku 'dra/ phyag phreng rnams ngos 'dzin mdzad/ tshes brgyad la sku srung phul/ de'i rjes zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa nas rtsal ba'i mtshan dang*/ zhabs brtan smon lam sku'i nyer spyad sogs phul/ de nas si tu rin po che dang sde dge bla ma sogs kyis mjal/ khra leb/ zur mang*/ mnyan pa sogs sprul sku rnams kyis mjal/ tha skar zla ba'i nyer lngar gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje pad+ma 'od du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'byor/ dgung lo brgyad par chos rje gling pa'i bang mi dang zhu shog 'byor/ yos lo gsar bzhad la si tu rin po che nas spyan drangs te chibs su bcas a lo dpal 'byor dgon du phebs/

'bul chen bstabs/ si tu rin po ches bdag gi lhag lha dang srung ma gang yin zhus pas/ rta mgrin dang zhing skyong yin gsungs/ chu 'brug lor dbus nas spyan 'dren pa slebs pas si tu dang yab sras lhan rgyas khrum zla'i tshes bdun la 'og min karmar phebs/ rim par lam gyi skye 'gro rnams 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas/ zhwa dmar rin po che chibs bsur byon pa 'ba' 'brom gzhung du mjal/ yab sras gsum lhan rgyas zhal 'dzom pa'i rten 'byung 'grigs/ rim par chibs bsu/ ser sbreng bcas 'og min mtshur phur phebs/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge bar gser khrir mnga' gsol mthon mthing gi cod pan bzhes karma pa zhwa dmar si tu bcas par tre ho zhabs drung nas zhabs brtan dang 'bul chen bstabs/ gsum ka'i dbu zhwa sgron/ gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nas bka' chos kyi thog mar 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang bsam 'grub ma'i lung gsungs/ dbang gi thog mar grub rgyal tshe rta zung 'brel gyi rjes gnang mdzad/ de nas bzung ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs mdo rgyud man ngag rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi bstan bcos bka' 'bum mang po dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin gsar rnying gi dbang lung khrid rim mtha' yas pa gsan pa'i tshul zhib par rnam thar rgyas par gsal/ rmi lam sprul sgyur la mnga' brnyes pas sham bha lar byon nas dus 'khor gyi dbang lung rigs ldan dngos la gsan par gsungs/ me sprel lo chos gling pas mjal/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub dang*/ bdud 'dul drag mo'i dbang lung sogs gsan/ jo hang gar gyis lha sa blangs/ lha bzang bkrong*/ sa khyi lor rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'od zer gtsug phud bzhes khri 'don mdzad/ lha sar byon skabs tshe ring don grub kyis mjal spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang gnang*/ lcags byi lor rgyal po'i dpung bcas gong sa bskal bzang rgya mtsho po ta lar phebs/ jo hang gar rnams bros/

'di skabs lha sar byon/ sde srid stag rtse dang*/ bkra shis rtse ba sogs kyi yar 'dren mdzad/ khar kha don wang*/ a pho dpas li/ cha dkar sogs rgya sog gi mi chen rnams dang*/ khang chen/ mi dbang pho lha tha'i ji yab sras sogs bod kyi mi bdag rnams kyis mchod/ mtshur phur kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po mjal du byung ba la phyag chen chos drug sogs dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ mtshan karma bstan pa mthas rgyas su gsol/ zhal ras lha khang du chos rje zhwa dmar nag /si tu rgyal tshab bcas yab sras bzhis a rā ga'i lugs ltar par bu zhag shas gsungs pas rtags mtshan ngo mtshar ba byung*/ de rjes yab sras bzhi ka bal yul du byon pas/ yam bu rgyal po'i phebs bsu byung ste dar gyi mdo lir spyan drangs/ rgyal po dza gad dza ya glang chen la zhon nas ru dar dang rol cha mang pos bsus te rgyal khang du byon/ zas sna shing thog so rtsi mang po phul/ gser dngul gyi me tog mang po gtor zhing me tog gi phreng ba dbu dang mgul du 'bul ba dang*/ dri bzang gi lde gus dpral ba'i mdzod pur thig le byed pa dang*/ gang phul thams cad rgyal po nyid kyis phul nas yab sras kyis phyag gis bzhes dgos pa ni rgya gar gyi lugs yin zhing rgyal mchog bcu pas mdzad pa ltar legs zhes si tu paṇa chen gsungs/ der dbyar dus yams nad drag po zhig lo ltar 'byung ba sus kyang ma phan pa de gcod dgos pa'i zhu ba rgyal pos mdzad pas/ rang byon mched lnga'i ya gyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku byin chen zhig la zhag shas khrus gsol dang dgongs gtad mdzad/ yab sras bzhi grang chen la chibs te rgya gar pham thing du grags pa yang le shod du phebs/ gro lod dang trag shad kyi bzlog pa me hom mdzad/ kho khams rgyal pos mjal/ kho khams sgrol ma/ stag mo lus sbyin/ mchod rten rnam gnyis/ snye shang phug dang rje btsun mi la'i zhabs rjes sogs mjal/

phyag mchod smon lam mdzad/ de nas yab sras gnyis glang po che re dang*/ si tu dang rgyal tshab rta mchog re chibs nas grong khyer gyi mtha' bskor zhing khrus chu 'thor bar mdzad/ de nas ring zhig gi bar yams nad zhi zhing grong khyer rgyas pa byung*/ dbang phyug gi zlos gar shog bu'i rta glang rgyug pa sogs la ltad mo gzigs/ bal yul gyi rgyal blon 'bangs bcas kyis mchod nas thams cad la mtho ris dang thar pa'i sa bon stsal nas rim par gangs ti ser byon/ glo bo rgyal po yab yum dang bcas pa'ang spra bdun du mjal du byung*/ gangs ri'i lho phyogs dgra bcom lnga brgya'i zhabs rjes sogs gzigs/ ras sbar btab/ 'brong pa/ gtso gzo phyin gyi skye 'gro thams cad kyi re ba bskang*/ skyid grong*/ snye nam/ ding ri/ la phyi/ bkra bzang*/ cung ri bo che sogs su sgrub gnas lha khang rten gsum thams cad la gnas gzigs mdzad dbus gtsang du phebs/ bde chos yongs 'dzin sprul sku la dge tshul dang*/ mtshan karma thub bstan ngag dbang dge legs bzang po'i dpal du gsol/ bsam yas su phebs skabs/ dpe har dkor mdzod gling du rtsi dmar khog zhugs kyis bsus nas/ rgyal khang du pe har khog zhugs kyis mjal/ zhal chab sogs btung zhing phrin las sgrub par khas blangs kyang*/ chos rje nas/ sems can la gnod pa mi byed pa de phrin las rang yin gsungs/ sa spre lo mi dbang gis dpung chen slebs/ po ta la bcas bzung*/ de skabs lha sar byon pas rtse shod kyis chibs bsu bcas lha ldan du mi dbang gis mjal 'bul chen bstabs/ rtser gong sa sku zhabs la mjal thon sbrag ma zhus/ gsan tā zhing*/ tā lo ye sogs rgya'i mi dpon rnams kyis mchod/ rje dpa' bo gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs dang*/ de'i sprul pa'i sku dpal ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug phrin las chos rgyal gtsug lag dga' ba khri dpon mdzad/ dbang lung khrid gsum stsal/ slar yang bal yul nas rgya gar rtsa mchog grong bar zhabs kyis bcag

/rje tre ho zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ rgya gong ma chen po'i spyan 'dren byung bar 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ mi dbang dang sde srid sogs nas 'bul chen dang phebs rdzong bstabs/ zhwa dmar nag yab sras lhan rgyas mtshur yangs nas bteg /rje dpa' bo dang*/ mi dbang sogs bla dpon rnams phebs skyel bcas rim par byon/ zur mang sogs su rol pa rdo rje'i sprul sku/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sprul sku/ ras chung sprul sku sogs rab byung nyis brgya bsgrubs/ gar dbang sprul sku/ ras chung*/ drung pa/ bya btang bstan 'dzin sogs nyis brgya bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ de rjes si tu'i rje dbon karma/ bsam gtan/ tshab tsha bla ma sogs brgya skor bsnyen par rdzogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dharma ka ra la snying po'i bstan pa gtad/ rang lugs kyi bstan pa skyong dgos tshul sogs zhal bkod lhug par stsal/ si tu nas so sor zhabs dbang zhus te/ zhwa dmar nag yab sras rgya nag tu byon/ de ltar mnga' ri skor gsum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ mdo khams sgang drug /bal yul/ rgya dkar nag sogs su zhabs kyis bcag /gdul byar gyur pa'i skye 'gro thams cad mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas chu byi smin zla'i gnam gang gi nam lang skabs rgya nag gi yul du re zhig sku'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad cing de 'phral mgo zla'i tshes gnyis la gar dbang brgyad pa'ang*/ zhi dbyings su gzhol ba'i tshul bstan/ sku gdung rin po che 'od bzhu dang*/ dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang*/ mtshur phu lha chen gyi drung du so so'i dngul gdung bzhengs te/ rgyal tshab dang si tu lhan rgyas nas rab tu gnas par mdzad do//sngon rgyal ba'i dbang po mdo khams nas spyan drangs te zhwa dmar nag lhan rgyas mdzad pa nas/ bde bar gshegs kyi bar du rtag par mnyam du 'byon bzhugs mdzad pas thun mong gi zhal slob kyi gtso bo bstan pa gtad cing rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba si tu thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas/

dpa' bo gtsug lag don 'grub/ de'i sprul sku dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'od zer/ tre ho chos rje/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ yongs 'dzin karma thub bstan/ chos mgon sprul sku/ sding po che'i sprul sku sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan gyis thugs brgyud gtams pa'i skyes chen mang du byung ba'o// // bcu gsum pa rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bcu gsum pa rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus ni/ gter kha du ma nas lung bstan cing chos rje gong ma byang chub rdo rje'i lung bstan phyag bris gu ru dharmen+d+ra la stsal ba dang*/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma khyung rdzong du bzhugs skabs o rgyan rin po ches lung bstan tshigs bcad drug dang*/ slar yang*/ dge ri gzhung ri'i nye ba'i phyogs na 'byor bas cher dben cing*//rigs rus rnam dag dge la brtson zhing de na karma ka/zhes sogs lung bstan pa ltar/ bod yul dbus ljongs kyi lho phyogs snyen lca ba grong zhes par rigs rus phun sum tshogs cing dge la brtson pa'i yab yum rnam par dag pa sogs gzigs pa lngas bsam bzhin du chu mo glang gi lo khrums zla ba'i yar tshes la sku 'khrungs/ nam mkha'i nor bu mngon sum du gsal ba na yin min gyi rtog dpyod bya ma dgos kyang*/ snyigs ma'i 'gro ba log shes kyis slad pa dag som nyi bsal phyir/ rig 'dzin chen por lung bstan byung ba rnams kyang kun mkhyen dharma ka ra'i snyan du phul/ shing stag gnam lo gsar bzhad skabs kun bzang 'jigs bral sogs kyis sprul sku ngos 'dzin spyi babs ltar byas pas 'khrul pa mi mnga' bar ma zad sngon gnas rjes dran du ma gsungs pas thams cad rgyal ba karma pa'i mchog gi sprul sku yin min the tshom bral ba'i nges pa rnyed pas snyan pa phyogs med du bsgrags/

de skabs rdo rje ber can byis pa'i gzugs dar dkar gyi na bza' can shel gyi sder ma me tog gis bkang ba bsnams pa zhig gis glu gar rol rtsed ston pa gzigs nas khyod nyid su yin gsungs pas/ nga ni rdo rje ber nag can zhes bya rngam brjid nga ro can//ye shes dbyings las khro bo'i skur ston las bzhir dbang bsgyur don dam du//nyid kyi sems las gzhan snang gud du med pa lta ba'i yang rtse mchog/ces gsungs shing*/ me tog 'thor ba dang ha ha'i gad rgyang bsgrags pas yul mi kun gyis 'brug sgra ltar thos pa byung*/ sku la mi 'gyur ba'i brda rtags thugs kar sme ba dbang gi mdog can dang ljags la a yig dkar po rang byon mnga'/ de skabs rdo'i ril bu zhig rnyed pa la ring bsrel mang du 'phel/ sku chung ngu'i dus ngo mtshar can gyi gzigs snang sna tshogs dang*/ sngon gnas rjes dran mang du gsungs pa rnams bla ma dharma rā dzas phyag bris su bkod par gsal/ pha yul bdud kyi btson ra ltar gzigs shing stod lung mtshur phur byon pa la thugs ring che ba'i tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi pa me 'brug rgyal zla'i gza' skar bzang por rgyal tshab rin po che dang*/ gra zur dpon slob/ sngon gyi gsol dpon gzims mgron gyi gtsos phebs bsur 'byor bas shin tu mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad/ rgyal rir lo gsar dga' ston bcas rgyal ba dang po la rta thabs kyi chibs bsu ser phreng bcas 'og min mtshur phur byon/ thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang*/ mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal dang*/ bka' brgyud yab sras rnams kyis dbu byas bla dpon che dgu dang lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gus pas mchod sprin bcas seng khri chen por mnga' gsol/ dpal ldan 'jigs med bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje phyogs kyi go cha mi shigs snying po'i dbang phyug nges don bstan pa'i rtsa lag phrin las rgyas pa'i dpag bsam mngon par mtho ba'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gyi sgra dbyangs 'og min gyi bar du grags par gyur/

mkha' 'gro 'bum zhu'i cod pan bzhes shing 'brel tshad don ldan gyis rgyas btab/ de rjes nges par thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyang sngon dmar nag cod pan 'dzin pa zung gis snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad pa sogs kyi bka' lung rjes su sgrub phyir mdo smad sde dge'i phyogs nas rim par byon pas shing glang lor mtshur phur phebs te yab sras zhal rgyas pas rten 'brel legs tshogs 'grigs/ dngos po'i mchod sprin dpag tu med pas khri 'bul bcas mthon mthing gi cod pan sgron/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bsngags pa yan lag bdun pa dang shis brjod rgya cher mdzad pas rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan par dkar po'i snang bas khyab par gyur/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi drung du kun mkhyen si tu rin po che las rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pas thog drangs mdo rgyud gsar rnying gi dbang lung khrid gsum zab rgyas mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan nas rigs kyi bdag por bzhes/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i chos skor gsan skabs bla ma kun mkhyen rta mgrin mar gad mdog can du gzigs/ gsang mtshan dbang chen rdo rje zhi ba stsal zhes gsol/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma las gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ slar yang kun mkhyen dharma ka ra lcags sbrul lo dbus phyogs su byon skabs kun mkhyen si tus mkhan po dang*/ dpal gtsug lag dga' bas slob dpon mdzad de mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dge 'dun grangs ldan las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ chos drug sogs zab khrid gdams ngag gi lhag du ma gsan/ o rgyan rin po che/ rje btsun mi la/ mi tra dzo ki
