/gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde rnams zhal gzigs nas dam pa chos kyi bgro ba rgya cher mdzad pa sogs dag pa'i gzigs snang 'byams klas/ skabs shig lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por chu'i 'jigs pa byung ste thabs gang gis kyang bzlog ma nus tshe/ o rgyan rin po ches bstan pa spyi lung 'od kyi drwa ba can las lung bstan pa bzhin/ gzhung sa nas spyan 'dren byung bas rta thabs kyi bsu ba bcas lha sar byon/ 'gro ba'i mchod sdong jo bo shākya mu ne'i drung du yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas gdengs can bsu bzlog smon lam mdzad pa tsam gyis chu'i 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzad/ skyabs mgon 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang mjal 'phrad mdzad cing*/ po ta lar skyid grong jo bo dang byin rlabs mtshungs par grags pa'i thugs rje chen po 'phags pa wa ti la snyan shal phul ba 'phags pas phyag g.yas kyis mngon sum du bzhes te/ sngon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya nyid phyag stabs 'gyur te/ da lta skyabs sbyin gyi tshul du yod pa 'di kun gyis mthun snang mngon du gyur pas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i snyan pa phyogs med du grags/ dgung grangs so dgu pa lcags yos lor mdo smad sde dge'i phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed dpon slob hrag bsdus phebs bsur byon pa/ de nas dpal spungs gdan sa bar du nyin bzhin sgar pa tshugs mal babs tshe lta ci smos/ 'byon lam du'ang chibs gong nas chos kyi bka' mchid kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nas dbu ma'i lta ba dang thugs dam nyin mtshan khor yug mnga' ba'i rtogs 'bul mdzad/ dpal spungs su byon nas gzims chung yid dga' chos 'dzin du bzhugs/ sa dbang sde dge'i 'bul chen sogs dngos 'bul mtha' yas/ mdo khams kyi gdul bya thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas chu 'brug lo yar byon pa na kun mkhyen si tu rin po che nyid/

phebs skyel du byon/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nas bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs nas dad gus drag pos sku'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi brgya rtsa len pa mdzad/ phan tshun thugs yid 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur 'bral mi phod pa tsam dang thugs gshin pa'i gsung gleng sna tshogs kyi mthar dar gyi g.yab g.yug sogs rten 'byung phun sum tshogs par mdzad nas 'byon lam gyi gdul bya thams cad bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis tshim par mdzad nas rim par mtshur phur chag phebs/ gsan bsam yang rgya chen mdzad mod gtso chen sgom byung gi mkhyen gnyis la mnga' dbang 'byor bas shes bya thams cad thugs su chud/ gdul bya dbang rab rnams nas rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad gsang sogs zab pa dang*/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod kyi shes bya sogs rgya che ba gang dang gang nas dogs gcod zhus kyang the tshom gyi dra ba gcod pa'i gsung lan thams cad dpe la ma ltos par thogs med du shar shar gsungs pas mkhas pa rnams nga rgyal bral zhing som nyi zad/ daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung sogs rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ gzugs can sogs don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga sogs snyan dngags sdeb sbyor la mnga' brnyes kyang gsung rtsom zhal gdams thams cad gdul bya mchog dman kun la sman pa'i thugs bskyed kyi tshig rna bar snyan zhing don go bde ba kho na gsungs/ gser dang gseg ma ro mnyam pa sogs 'khor 'das kyi dngos snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur nges par mngon du gzigs pas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri ma gtan nas mi mnga'/ na bza' gsol chas dag kyang gang byung gis chog shes mdzad cing*/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la gser zho lnga brgya las grub pa'i ting bdun dang*/ lha chen la dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu las bzos pa'i ting bdun maṇ+ḍal/ rdo tshad drug cu las mthong grol lha khang bde gshegs mchod rten rnam brgyad rin po che las grub pa dang*/

gser zho lnga brgya las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku brnyan/ gser dngul srang grangs stong phrag du mas chos rje bcu pa'i bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung lha khang gi steng du phun tshogs mkhyil la span bad gan jir dang bcas bzhengs pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten dang*/ slong ba po la nyid kyi sku la bzhes pa'i mnab gzan gser ljangs brdungs kyi mgul srung dag kyang sbyin par mdzad na dngos po gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ sprang po rnams la gser zho lon pa yang yang stsal ba'i lo rgyus bka' 'bum du gsal/ srid zhi yongs kyi gtsug rgyan khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gyur kyang khengs pa dang che ba rdul tsam mi mnga' zhing sems can mchog dman thams cad la ma gcig pa'i bu ltar thugs byams brtse chen pos bcos min du khyab pas sku drung gi byi la dang byi'u rnams ma bu'i tshul du nyi ma 'de zhing sdod/ spyod 'jug las/ smra na yid phebs 'brel ba dang*//don gsal yid du 'ong ba dang*//chags dang zhe sdang spangs pa dang*//'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya//mig gis sems can lta na yang*//'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag/sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes//drang zhing byams pa'i tshul gyis blta/ /zhes dang*/ 'di dag mgu byas mang po zhig/'di ltar phun tshogs pha rol phyin/ /zhes dang*/ phan pa dpag med mdzad rnams la//sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa//gzhan gang zhig gis lan lon 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa nyid phyag bzhes su bstar te/ long sprang mu lto ba nyam thag gzhan dag gis brnyas shing khyad du gsod pa rnams kyi gan du zhabs kyi pad+ma bkod nas byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs te snyan pa'i gsung gis sku rtsed dang nyams mtshar gyi lo rgyus sogs thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyis de dag gi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon 'debs par mdzad pa dang*/ sprang long 'khrug pa byed pa rnams la zhal ta gnang bas dum par gyur nas phan tshun bshags pa byed pa dang*/
tha mal skye bo glen pa rnams la'ang 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin par gsungs pa na/ ci yang mi go

'dug /sgyu ma de sems can gyi rgyu ma e re zer ba'i blun po rnams la'ang thabs sna tshogs kyis sgo nas dge ba'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad pa dang*/ tshong pa dag la rin po che'i rigs dang sku gsung thugs rten gyi rgyu/ rol sil ting dril sogs kyi nor nyams gcod tshul dang rin thang*/ mo ma dang rtsis pa dang sman pa rnams la de dang de'i dogs gcod dang zhal ta/ tha na hor rgan rnams la yi ge 'bri lugs kyi zhal ta sogs gdul bya mchog dman bar ma thams cad gnas skabs so so'i yid kyi re ba khengs shing rab tu mgu bar 'gyur ba dang mthar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyi dkri bar mdzad pa ni 'phags chen rgyal ba'i sras po'i rnam thar rmad du byung bar nges/ gzhan yang snang srid thams cad bla ma dang dpe char shar 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur gyi sgra skad thams cad chos su gsan pa dang*/ sku lus kyi bkod pa du mar sprul pa dang*/ zag med kyi mngon par mkhyen pa la thogs pa med pas sngar byung ba dang phyir 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan la 'phyug pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ mtshur phu nas spo bo rgya rdzong du bla ma dpal dar gyi rten gsum la rab gnas mdzad pa'i me tog thogs med du phebs pa dang*/ gzhan dag 'chi 'pho dang skye ba'i gnas skabs mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa dang*/ bde chen yang ri'i rtser byon skabs gnyan chen thang lha 'khor dpag tu med pa'i skor nas dngos su mchod pa dang*/ ji skad du/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad//grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*//'gro ba kun gyi sgra skad ji tsam par//thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to//zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs drug so so'i skad du chos bstan nas smin grol la bkod pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ skabs shig mi gnyis sku drung du byung nas gcig gis sna ba g.yas pa gcad de maṇ+ḍal du phul/

gcig gis gser sder ma gang gtor zhing bka' chos zhur byung ba'i tshe 'di gnyis chos kyi skal pa yod pa yin 'dra dgongs tshe nam mkha' nas paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad can cig gis 'di gnyis theg chen gyi snod ldan min par gsungs pas skyabs sems dang yig drug gi lung gnang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta de zla grags kyi slob ma gu h+ya iṇ+ḍa yin par gsungs shing de las gso sbyong gi gdams pa'ang gsan/ de rjes bra ba zhig rtswa chun zhig khyer nas maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du bzhag pa'i tshe/ thugs dgongs la srog chags phra mo 'di ji ltar yin dgongs tshe nam mkha' nas 'di slob ma snod ldan yin zer ba byung bas/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bcas phyag chen gyi sgom khrid btab pas/ bra bas skyil krung bca' ma shes pas rkang lag so sor blang*/ de brnol nas me thabs grub ching gi tshul byas/ skud pa dum bu zhig gis sgom thag dang 'jag ma sor bzhi pas sgom shing byas nas bsgom pas 'od gsal 'khor yug tu song*/ bya rog mang pos 'tshe ba byung ba rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyis bskrad pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ yang chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la 'ga' zhig la dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang mdzad nas gzims chung nyi 'od du bzhugs skabs ldum ra'i me tog la stag bye ma lheb dang*/ gser sbrang g.yu sbrang mang po 'khor zhing skad snyan sgrogs skabs sprang slong pha ma'u bzhi byung ba la chos bshad ci rigs mdzad/ de nas char babs pas byi'u 'chil pa rgan po zhig char yibs su 'dug pa la kha zas gnang bas de sgrugs shing*/ ci byed ci byed/ da ci phyogs kyi sprang po ngan pa//las ngan sna tshogs byed pa'i tsho gcig/dam pa chos kyi snang ba de dag/nam yang de tshor bag tsam ma mchis//chos bshad byas rung nyan pa mi 'dug/ci byed ci byed/ ces sogs zer 'dug pa la/ byi'u 'chil ba smra mkhas khyod//khyod gre lce shin tu bde ba byung*//byung kyang nged kyi me tog tshal du rgyu ba'i bung ba dang gser sbrang g.yu sbrang sogs la khyod kyis gnod pa ma byas sam gsungs pas/

kho na re/ lar khra sdig chen kha la byis ro/ /byis sdig med kha la 'bu ro/ /zer mod kyang*/ de ring tshes bco lnga la gser sbrang sogs la gnod tshe byed pa'i las ngan ci la bsags phod/ khong tsho da lta char pas thugs bzhugs ma spro bas rang rang gi gnas su song ba lags/ slar nyi ma shar dus 'byon pa yod/ de phyir bdag la dam pa'i chos shig zhu zer ba la/ khyod kyi de bden pa yin nam gsungs pas/ nged chos zhu ba dang khyed kyi sbrang ma la gnod pa byed pa gnyis chos dang 'gal bas brdzun zhus g.yo khram ci la phod zer ba la/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang po gsungs pa'i skabs zhim bu se bo der sleb byung bas/ byi'u skrag nas yar lang tsam mar sdod tsam 'dar yang yang byed pa la/ zhim bu 'di rgyud dul bar yod pas khyod rang zhed mi dgos/ bar dor 'jigs skrag mthong snang mang po yong pas de dag sgyu ma ltar sgom dgos zhes sogs zab chos mang du gnang bas/ byi'u na re/ nged byi'u tsho lto nyin re bzhin tshol bas gsog 'jog mi byed pas ser sna med/ khang steng du skad snyan sgrogs shing gnod pa mi byed pa 'di la phan yon zhig los yod/ byi ba zer ba lha'i na bza' dang yo byad chud zos la gtong*/ gtor ma dang zhim tshad za ba 'di la nyes dmigs chen po yod dam zer ba la/ rtsig spyang zer nas kun gyi ngan dpe 'jog pas bzang po ga la yin te/ khyed rang byi'u rnams kyang gsog 'jog mi shes pa yin pas lung ma bstan bya ba yin/ zhing la sa bon btab skabs khyed tshos brkus te sgrugs/ sbrang bu rnams snying rje med par za/ lha khang gi nag rtsi rnams brdzod/ rang skyon mi mthong bar gzhan skyon smra mi rigs gsungs pas/ mgo zhum nas bsdad/ yang ske yar bsring nas zhu ba zhu len mang du byas pa'i mthar/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod nga la bsnyad bsko mkhan 'dra mo'i zhe sun rang btang byung*/ da chos rang byed rgyu yin na 'di ltar nyams su long zhes sgom khrid gnang nas/

rgya khra hor ba'i bar chad med par smon lam mdzad pas/ byi'u na re/ rgya khra hor ba kho la 'jigs rgyu gang yang med/ sngar nged tshos g.yag ru'i nang du bsdad nas dpa' gtam mang po bshad/ de las 'chi bdag gshin rje de rang 'jigs zer/ gus 'dud bcas 'phur song*/ de rjes shing sbrul lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la byi'u mang po 'dzings nas skrog kyang mi 'bros bar spu thul thul byed 'dug pa la/ nas spar gang phyag gis drag tu gtor bas byi'u rnams 'thor gcig ma shi tsam 'dug pas/ chu thur mgo gang gnang nas rim gyis sos nas dri smad mdzad pas/ 'chil pa rgad po de'i nu bo yin/ khong gis sngar bka' chos rnams sems la phan par byung*/ da rung de'i 'phros rnams nga la zhus shog zer bcas pa'i don rnams tshigs su bcad de zhus pas/ sngar khyod kyi jo jo de ha cang lab rgyu mang drag pas sun po rang byung*/ da lan mdor bsdus zhig smros/ lhag tu zhim bu se bo de bzhin gzhan la gnod pa mi byed kyang*/ zhim bu ser chung 'di ha cang sdig la mi rngams kyang na phra stabs rtsed mo'i snang bas khyod rang gzung na thugs sun bcos yong gsungs pas/ byi'u na re/ jo jo'i sngar gyi chos 'phro rnams zhus pas lan rnams dang gdams ngag gnang bas/ byi'u na re/ don ji bzhin rtogs lags/ zhag bdun song mtshams rtogs 'bul du yong chog pa dang chos ming zhig dgos zer ba la/ sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin gyis gsungs/ de nas byi'us yan lag bdun pa zhig bton nas/ da ni chos phral du ma sgrub na mi rtag pa sogs chos la bar chad mang bas ri khrod du 'gro zer har te langs nas 'phur/ mda' rgyang gang tsam slebs skabs gshog skor zhig byas nas/ pho rgod po zer na nga 'dra ba cig la zer ba yin zer/ yang 'dom nyi shu tsam 'phur nas gshog skor zhig byas nas 'ga' zhig smra 'dug kyang ma thos gsungs/ de nas gnam dang 'dres nas mthong rgyu ma byung gsungs/

yang skabs shig ri bong gcig sku drung du byung nas chos zhus pas/ khyod rang chos kyi las 'phro yod med de ring rmi lam rgugs shog gsungs pas/ phyir nang kho na re rna ba gnyis chad pa'i ngan ltas zhig byung zer/ khyod kyi rmi lam de gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba bral ba'i bzang rtags yin/ blo mi bde na 'di la ltos gsungs nas me long bstan pas kho na re/ res 'ga' 'di 'dra ba mtshan mo nam mkha' la yong 'dug pa de ci lags zer ba la/ de ni sngon byang chub sems dpa' ri bong du 'khrungs skabs lha rnams ngo mtshar skyes nas khang brtsigs dang zla ba la ri bong gi gzugs bkod pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par gsungs/ de nas ri bong de mig phor gog tsam bgrad nas lag pa thal mo sbyar nas chos zhu ba la/ sgom khrid btab pas kho la gnas pa brtan po byung nas/ nyin gsum pa la rtswa nyag ma gsum maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du phul nas rtogs 'bul zhus sems kyi ngo bo de spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang du gnas shing*/ phyi'i lus yod du mi tshor/ nang dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba mi tshor/ gsang ba rtog med kyi bde ba'i ngang du gnas lags zer/ de skabs rlung chen zhig langs pas rtswa nyag ma rnams gar song cha med du khyer/ ri bong yang spu zing nge ba dang*/ chos rje yang mnab gzan gyi zhal 'thum mdzad nas bzhugs/ thams cad thal ba long nge ba'i dus der mi rtag dpe drug gi mgur gsungs pas/ kho na re/ de de ltar du lags so/ /sgom gyi ngo bo de la lta rgyu ci 'dra yod zer ba dang*/ du ba lta bu zhig mthong zer ba rnams la/ ngo sprod dang gdams ngag stsal nas ri bong de log song*/ phyi nyin snga mor 'ongs nas gzims sgo la sbar mos drag tu brad skabs/ chos rje myur bar bzhengs nas sgo phye bas sku drung du slebs byung*/ khyod la nang rtsa rlung gi gegs dang phyi nyon mongs rang mdangs kyi cho 'phrul sogs ma byung ngam gsungs pas/

de ltar ma byung ste/ bdud byi la slebs nas sgom du ma bcug /'thab cing rtsod du byung ba la bzod pa bsgoms kyang tshod med kyi zhe sun btang ste smra ra yang gsum tsam byi ba bcas nad ma theg pas 'dir yong ba lags zer/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ a kha kha/ de bdud ma red sngon las shig red/ /ces sogs gsungs nas ri bong gi mtshams khang du phebs pas/ /der byi la rgya 'grun bsdad 'dug pas/ sdig can khyod kyis ri bong byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dam skrog pa'i las ngan bsags 'dug gsungs nas phyag gis thal lcag gsum brgyab gsungs/ de nas yang ri bong gis/ chos la gnad 'gag gang che zer ba la/ gu ru bung+ngha bo dhi satwa la blo rtse gcig gis dad pa byed pa gal che/ zhes sogs dang*/ nged kyang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po yi ge drug pa la bsgom bzlas byed pa yin/ phan yon ni ma ṇi bka' 'bum du gsal/ zhes dang*/ phyag chen ngo sprod zhib par btab pas ri bong song*/ phyi nyin sleb ma byung bas/ chos rjes gzigs su byon pas/ kho rang rdo phug tu mgur zhig byed 'dug pa la/ chos rjes phag nyan mdzad pas/ gnas ri bo shan+ti'i dgon pa na//phyi 'dul khrims kyi kun sbyang yon tan brgyan//nang gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs//mnyam med sgam po pa la 'dud//bdag gza' gtad bral ba'i ri bong nga*//da bsam zhing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*//dus snga phyi mi rtag tshul rnams dran/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bdag tshogs bsags rnal 'byor ri bong nga*//da dung lta ba'i gdengs kyi glu//mkha' 'gros ko long mi 'tshal zhu//spyi bor mdongs gcig yod pa 'di//dam chos gcig shes kun grol brda//rna ba ring po gnyis ldan 'di//thabs shes zung dang ldan pa'i ngang*//thar pa'i lam sna snyegs pa'i brda//mig gnyis nam yang mi 'dzum pa//lha mig mngon par thob pa'i brda//sna ni dal med bskyed pa 'di//yi dam 'gog bzlas 'grub pa'i brda//sma ra phyogs bcur 'phro ba 'di//yongs la snying rje ldan pa'i brda/

/zhes sogs nas/ brda bcu ldan pa'i rim pa 'di//sa bcu'i dngos grub thob pa'i brda//'on kyang bsod nams ye shes kyis//tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// 'gro ba kun la phan slad du//lus 'di dum bur btang bar bya//sngon tshe thub pa'i dbang po yis//dbu ni stong phrag sbyin stong mdzad//de bzhin 'gyur med ye shes bdag/ma rgan mkha' mnyam sems can la//zhum pa med pa'i sbyin pa gtong*//glad pas rgyu gzer nad sel zhing*//snying gis smyo 'bog nad las grol//zhes sogs zer zhing the tshom med par mchongs rgyug byed pa la/ der chos rjes/ rna ba gnyis nas phyag gis bzung ste/ khyod byol song gi rigs su skyes kyang byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa ngo mtshar che lags/ sang nged kyi rtsar nyams rtogs kyi rim pa gsung bar 'byon pa rigs so gsungs nas gzims phug tu byon nas bzhugs/ sang ri bong ma slebs pas gzigs par byon pa na/ bya rog zhig mgo sgur zhing shog pa sa la bsnyal nas/ chos zhu rten sbal pa'i ro zhig bzhag nas/ kyai/ drang srong ri bong 'gyur med ye shes lags//bdag ni las ngan bya rog lus blangs te//lo tshags bgrang bya stong dang brgyad brgya song*//bkres shing phongs pa'i ngang nas kun tu rgyu//bskal pa bzang dus bsang mchod bgyid pa'i tshe//mda' dar sna lnga g.yab g.yug rgyab nas 'bod//nged cag rdo rje 'gros kyi gar dang bcas//de tshe phye mar chang phud la sogs 'thor//gzhan yang bza' btung tshogs ni bsam las 'das//bskal 'bring dus su btang snyoms ngang du dor//zas kyi lhag dang nor mi nyan rigs ster//da lta dus kyi yang mtha'i skabs 'di ru//bza' ba btung ba'i re ba bca' ba na//mtho dman kun gyi rdo dbyug char ltar dbab//ces sogs nas/ gtan bde'i go 'phang thob pa'i chos shig zhu/ zer ba la/ ri bong gis/ byas tshad thams cad sdig dang 'dres pa khyod//sbal pa'i ro 'di ma rgan yin pa'i phyir//'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus dag nas//ma ru ma gyur 'gro ba gcig kyang med//de phyir 'di dag sdig pa tshab chen te//'dag pa'i phyir du stobs bzhi'i bshags pa gyis//khyad par snying rje byang sems gtso che'o//zhes sogs dang las rgyu 'bras mang du bshad pa la/

chos rje'i zhal nas/ de de ltar du yin 'dug /'on kyang khyod la chos kyi blo zhig skyes pa de yang legs 'dug /da phyin chad dbug bral gyi sha ma gtogs srog bcad nas sha za khrag 'thung ma byed de la phan yon cig yod do gsungs/ de nas ri bong gis chos zhus pas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni//sems kyi rang bzhin ngo bo yin//snang ba lhan cig skyes pa zhes//de las byung ba'i rnam rtog yin//nyi ma'i 'od dang tsan dan dri//zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus ches mang bas 'dir bri bar mi langs/ 'di dag gdul ba'i dbang po bye brag gis dgongs don mtha' drug gi tshul du gnas pas bsam mi khyab par nges/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang po rgan rab ngag rgyun du'ang*/ rlung ltar grags pa ches mang mod/ 'dir ni bka' 'bum sogs nas 'byung ba mdor bsdus pa tsam bkod pa'o//karma'i gdan sar rab gnas mdzad skabs/ da lam rab gnas 'di'i sbyin bdag zla nang nas bgyis dgos gsungs pas/ zla nang sde bas kyang yon bdag zhus te gser dngul spel pa'i bum pa sogs dngos po'i mchod sprin spros/ phyir nyin char chen po babs pa'i thigs chu gzims chung gi bla bre'i steng du 'khyil ba zla nang gis phul ba'i bum pa des gzhal bas bum pa bcu bzhi byung ba rten 'brel legs gsungs/ kho bo da lan karmar yun ring sdod rgyu ma byung bas slad nas yun ring sdod rgyu yod pa byed/ /ces dang*/ zla nang sde bas mjal phyag zhus skabs/ rang re gnyis mi ring bar 'phrad cing zhib cha 'byung bas yid 'jag gyis gsungs/ de ltar sprul pa'i snang brnyan de'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod pa'i phrin las re zhig zin nas rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul phyogs gcig bsdu bar bzhed nas snying po don gyi bstan pa'i rgyal tshab si tu rin po che pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la gnang zhing mchog gi sprul pa'i sku phyi ma gang du 'byon pa'i yul dang yab yum sogs lung du bstan pa'i phyag bris phyag rtags kyis rgyas btab pa stsal/

de bar gyi rgyal tshab rje dbon karma dpal grub la bkod bzhag mdzad/ sku'i rim gro ba gsol dpon karma dpal ldan dang phyag mdzod karma nor bu sogs la gdan sa'i khur 'dzin rjes sgrub sogs slab ston zhib rgyas su gdams nas/ dgung grangs re lnga pa me sbrul mchu zla'i nyer bzhi la sprul pa'i snang rnyan re zhig bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ de skabs nam mkha' las rol mo'i sgra dang me tog gi char babs/ rtogs ldan karma yan lag sogs mos gus can rnams la slar yang zhal mngon du bstan nas byin rlabs dbang bskur mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas/ der dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod sbyin rgya cher spros pa dang*/ gser rdo tshad nyis brgya dang bdun/ dngul rdo tshad bdun bcu sogs las grub pa'i mchod rten sku gdung rin po che dang ring bsrel rnam lngas phyur phur gtams pa dang*/ gser rdo tshad brgyad kyi gser skong*/ dngul rdo tshad bco lnga'i sku 'dra rin po che rnams bzhengs pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro bas mchod sdong dam par gyur pa ste/ de dag gi zhib cha deb yig chen mor gsal lo//rje de'i bu chen slob ma'i gtso bo/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ 'brug chen kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba/ dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal/ rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po/ ras chung sprul sku shes rab rgya mtsho/ gnas mdo karma yan lag /he ma rgyal sras rin po che/ mkhas grub zur mang kun khyab/ yongs 'dzin rin po che/ lha lung gsung sprul/ khams sprul 'jigs med seṅge/ chos kyi mgon po/ do skya sprul sku/ lho pa 'chi med/ dpal spungs rje dbon rnam gnyis/ don grub chos rgyal/ sga khra gnyan sprul sku sogs mang du byon cing de thams cad kyang mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan gzhal bar dka' ba'i thugs rgyud phyur phur gtams pa kho na ste/ sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa rin po che yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin 'phel bar mdzad do//

bcu bzhi pa rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rje'i rnam thar/ bcu bzhi pa rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rje'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjes/ stag tshang ngo mtshar yid du lhung*//seng ge dkar mo'i 'dzum mdangs ston//thabs shes legs tshogs chos dpal ldan//rmi lam sgyu ma'i sprul pa ni//a ti khyab brdal klong yangs por//rang snang me long gtsang mar 'char//theg mchog rdo rje zhes byar 'bod//ces sogs rgyas par lung bstan pa bzhin mdo khams zal mo sgang zla zhang yid lhung bkra shis mthong smon zhes pa'i sa char yab mgon po lha dar dang yum bsod nams lha mo gnyis kyi sras su me sbrul rgyal zla ba'i dbang phyogs tshes bcu'i nyin sku 'khrungs te/ de'i gong du yum gyi rmi lam du mtshur phu yin 'dug zer ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig tu rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje zhwa nag gsol zhing gser khrir bzhugs pa mjal bas phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus pas dgyes bzhin byin rlabs gnang man 'khor zhig dang*/ mchod zhal shing 'bras kyi bkang ba zhig stsal ba'i snang ba dang gnyid sad skabs dga' ba dpag med skyes/ gzhan yang sku pang du nyi ma gsum shar ba dang khang thog nas dung dkar bcu bzhi dus gcig tu 'bud pa dang*/ mngon sum du'ang zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du sa cha 'dom gang gru bzhi tsam la me tog sna tshogs bkra ba dang*/ sku 'khrungs pa'i snga phyir 'ja' 'od sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas pa bltams ma thag sku drang por spyan gzigs stangs bcas zhal nas dbyangs gsal gsungs/ mi dang mi min kun gyi dpal karma pa'i mchog sprul byon no zhes phyogs med du bsgrags/ 'brug chen chos kyi snang bas chos rje gong ma'i lung bstan dang mthun pas nges pa rnyed nas bsngags brjod bcas grub chen pak+ṣi dang chos rje gong mas lung bstan bzhin/ dpal ldan rigs kun lhun grub theg pa mchog gi rdo rje nges don bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal kun tu dga' ba rgyas pa'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/

mi ring bar sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi zhabs 'brengs chibs bsu'i bkod pa phun tshogs bcas 'og min karma byon/ dus mkhyen gsung byon ma'i drung du/ grub pa'i dbang phyug si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po las rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang*/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi smin grol zab rgyas rnams rim par gsan/ mthon mthing gi cod pan bzhes/ bod chen phyogs kyi skye 'gro thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas rim par 'og min mtshur phur phyag phebs/ 'brug chen chos kyi snang ba dang si tu rin po che nas mkhan slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i yongs 'dzin mang po las gsan pa rgya cher mdzad de/ rgya bod kyi yig rigs/ lha sku bris 'bur blugs tshem sogs bzo rigs mtha' dag la mkhas pa bi shwa karma lta bu/ rtsis rigs thams cad thugs su chud pas rigs ldan pad dkar lta bu/ ka tsan dbyangs gsum sogs sgra rig/ snyan ngag /sdeb sbyor/ gso ba rig pa sogs rig gnas che chung thams cad la mkhyen rtsal phyogs med du rgyas shing nang don rig pa sde snod gsum la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang*/ zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor gyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa gzhir bcas nas gtsug lag khang gi zhig bsos/ tshe dpag med dang*/ gu ru rin po che sogs sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs du ma dang*/ khyad par du'ang ras bris/ lugs ma/ gos sku sogs bzo ba gzhan gyis byas pa ma 'dres par rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kho nas phyag bstar mdzad pa mig gi bdud rtsi lta bu du ma dang*/ sa ga zla ba'i dus chen la tshes bcu gsang 'dus dang rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen gar 'cham chen mo gsar 'dzug mdzad pa dang*/ rgya bod hor sogs yul dang skad rigs tha dad pa'i che dgu dregs pa can rnams kyang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis dbang med du dad nas zhabs pad spyi bor len pa dang*/

gdul bya'i rgyud tshod khams dbang dang mthun pa'i chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa sogs bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad pa dang*/ nag can gyi btson pa dang*/ ri dwags g.yung bdag rnams kyis srog skyabs pa'ang smos kyi mi langs/ snang sems gnyis med kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur pas grub pa'i sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'ang brjod kyi mi langs te/ skabs shig 'dam gzhung du phebs skabs sgar chen du dbu zhwa sgron cing chos sbyin mdzad skabs de dang dus mtshungs kha cig gis btsan rgod gnas pa'i ri zhig yod pa de'i rtser sku 'khor nyung shas byon nas dam bzhag mdzad par mthong ba dang mnga' ri skor gsum du byon skabs mtsho 'gram zhig tu bzhugs skabs/ kha cig nas mtsho'i dbus gzims gur sngon po zhig phubs nas zhag bdun bzhugs par snang ba dang*/ dad ldan rnams la las sku dar la babs pa dang la las sgres nyams che ba sogs mjal tshul du ma dang*/ mchog sprul rin po che rnam gnyis sogs sku gam pa rnams la'ang mjal tshul sna tshogs dang*/ dbyar zhig byang 'brog gis spyan drangs nas 'byon lam rkyang du'i nang dan can khrab rdzong zer ba 'byung po ma rungs pa gnas pa'i ri gzar zhig gi ngos nas chibs gyam gyis byon skabs/ tho 'tsham pa'i phyir pha bong shin tu che ba gcig dang chung ba mi mgo tsam du ma'i rbab char babs pa bzhin byung bas sku 'khor na yod pa thams cad 'jigs nas tab tab por gyur cing kar mkhyen sgrogs pa na/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos spyan gyis 'bru tshugs su gzigs pa tsam gyis pha bong chen po de rten med spang ri gzar po'i ngos su rang tshugs bzung nas bsdad/ rdo ba gzhan rnams gar song cha med du deng ba dang*/ tsa ri mtsho kar du sgrol ma zhal gzigs skabs snang brnyan phyag bris su bstar ba da lta der nang rten du bzhugs shing*/ rdo bar zhabs rjes mdzad pa dang*/

rdo ba'i bzhugs khri sa 'og nas byung ba dang*/ dge rgyal mtsho grang dro zer ba de gnas sgo phye nas sgrol ma'i bla mtshor lung bstan pa dang*/ de skabs 'ja' tshon gyis dra ba 'khrigs/ shel gyis char babs/ sgrol ma dang rdo rje phur pa zhal gzigs/ zhabs 'breng du sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin chos rgyal rdo rje la bkas gnang nas zhabs rjes byon/ der chu gnas rnams la ril nag phyag gis 'thor bar mdzad pa deng sang 'phel zhing rdo bar 'gyur nas kun gyis dad rten du len pa dang*/ kong por byon skabs nyin cig thugs rgyal bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis chibs stegs kyi rdo bar chibs lcag gis bsnun pas gris gras pa ltar mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gnas ches mang zhing zhib par sku gsung thugs kyi gsang mdzod la mnga' dbang 'byor pa bdag cag gi 'dren pa skyabs rje mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi dgongs par bsti bar snang bas skal ldan dag gsol ba gdab par 'os/ ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can la 'das 'khrungs kyi mtshan ma mi mnga' zhing*/ chos gling gter byon rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe mda' sor gsum tsam mngon sum ring ba sogs tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin brnyes kyang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul phyir tha ma'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed pa'i gsung ci rigs pa 'byon pa na dgun zla ra bar se ba'i me tog shar/ bu chen rnams nas brtan bzhugs gsol ba nan tan gdab rung re zhig mdzad pa des gdul bya ches mang ba zhig gis don mdzad par dgongs te zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ sngon bar skabs shig gdul bya'i las dbang gis snying po'i bstan pa ngal 'tsho ba lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur kyang kun mkhyen dharma ka ra yab sras kyis sgrub bstan gyi me ro gsos/ dpal pad+ma nyin byed dang rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa yab sras kyis gzhir bzhengs su mdzad/ snying po don gyi bstan pa 'brug chen rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho la gtad nas mchog gi sprul sku nam byon rgyal tshab tu dbugs dbyung*/

khyad par 'og min mtshur phu'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi zhal bkod zhib gsed bdag cag gi rnam 'dren rje dbon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis la stsal nas gtad/ der ma zad sku gdung rin po che'ang*/ kho bo'i gdung ni gdul bya'i slob ma rnams chos srid kyi dpal 'byor blo nas blar 'phel ba dang*/ ma 'ongs par mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i sku tshe'i rten 'brel gyi phyir zhugs la ma bzhen par hril bu nyid du rin po che'i mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhugs par byos zhes gdams nas dgung bgrang don gcig pa sa 'brug cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer gcig la gzugs sku'i snang brnyan phyogs gcig bsdu bar mdzad/ de skor snga phyi kun tu sngar ma myong ba'i dri bzang rgyang grags su mnam pa dang*/ nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyi phreng ba dar yug sna lnga brkyang 'dra dang*/ me tog gi char dang skal ldan kha cig gi snang bar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i tshul can dang*/ kha cig gi dge bshes sgres po'i tshul can dang*/ kha cig gis tsog pu'i bzhugs stangs kyis bdud rtsi gsol ba dang*/ kha cig gis mkha' 'gro ma du mas lha rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ kha cig gis zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo zla dkyil du gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam pa shin tu gsal bar snang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas/ skyabs rje mchog sprul sku mched kyi thugs 'gan lhur bzhes nas/ skyes chen du ma dbu bzhugs kyis 'dus pa rgya mtshos rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phyes pa dang*/ jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu/ 'phags mchog rang byon lnga ldan/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan sogs dbus gtsang gi rten gsum dang*/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams la mchod 'bul/ mang 'gyed sogs dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs shing*/ bka' bzhin sku gdung rin po che nyid ka shi ka dri bzang gis sbags pas legs par dbyib pa la chos gos rnam gsum dang rang rtags kyi cod pan gsol te seng khri dbu gdugs sogs mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pa dang bcas bzhugs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ring bsrel rnam lngas gtsos gzungs gzhug gi go rim ji ltar 'os pa bzhin phyur phur gtams shing bum pa'i nang du skyabs rje don grub sprul pa'i sku'i phyag bstar snang brnyan dngos mtshungs ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bcas mchod sdong dam pa skye dgu'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog 'di bskrun par mdzad pa ste zhib gsal rnam thar chen mo dang dkar chag las rtogs par bya'o//mkhas pa dang grub pa'i slob tshogs mang du byon pa las gtso bor snying po'i bstan pa gtad cing mchog gi sprul pa'i sku phyi ma'i yongs su 'dzin pa chen por byin gyi rlabs pa skyabs mgon 'brug chen 'jigs med mi 'gyur dbang rgyal dang*/

deng dus mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam thar 'dzam gling tsam na 'gran par dka' ba kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu chen po mchog gyur gling pa dang*/ dpal ldan dpa' bo gtsug lag nyin byed dbang po/ ra ga'i mdangs can gyi cod pan 'chang ba si tu rin po che pad+ma kun bzang dang*/ rgyal tshab ye shes bzang po/ kar bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba la 'gran zla bral ba rje dbon chos dbang sprul sku dang*/ don grub sprul sku rin po che sku mched/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin zla sprul nges don bstan pa rab rgyas dang*/ chags med sprul sku gsang sngags bstan 'dzin sogs bka' brgyud kyi skyes chen ches mang ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang*/ mkhas pa'i dbang po klu 'bum dge bshes sogs grub mtha' gzhan gyi skyes bu dam pa'ang mang du byung ba rnams te thams cad kyang lung rtogs kyi yon tan gzhal du med pa dang ldan pa'o// //de ltar mtshungs med bla ma chos rje karma pa rim byon gyi thun mong gi rnam par thar pa'i mdo 'gag kyang*/ drang pa'i don bsam bzhin srid par skye ba bzhes pa'i dbang du byas pa na'ang*/ rgyal ba ma pham pas/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de//sems can sred phyir brtser ldan zhi thob min//de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs brten nas//'phags pa 'khor ba mya ngan 'das mi gnas//zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba bzhes kyang chu nang gi pad+ma ltar srid pa'i skyon gyis rdul tsam yang gos pa mi srid cing thog mar yongs 'dzin bsten pa skad/ slob sbyang mdzad pa skad/ sdom gsum bzhes pa skad/ yon tan skyes pa skad mdzad pa thams cad kyang gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa kho nar nges te/ mnga' bdag me tri pa'i zhal nas/ ji ltar dpa' bo thogs med 'gro ba yang*//dman pa'i don phyir ngal gso rim gyis 'jug/de bzhin mkhas pa chags pa'i gnas med kyang*//blo dman don phyir grub mtha' rim gyis skyongs/

/zhes dang*/ chos rje karma pa nyid kyi zhal nas/ skye gnas grangs mtha' yas pa yi//slob dpon slob ma'i 'brel ba dang*//dam chos rnam pa sna tshogs kyis//lung dang brgyud pa du ma yis//gdul bya 'dul byed bsam mi khyab//gnas dgon gtsug lag khang la sogs//ya mtshan sku gsung thugs kyi rten//sna tshogs rten gyis 'gro ba'i don//dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang*//tshe rabs gong ma'i dge tshogs rnams//brjod mi langs pas 'gro don mdzad//'dzam gling 'jig rten 'di nyid du//da res skyes par gyur pa yang*//don med 'khrul bas skyes pa min//tshe rabs mang po'i sbyangs stobs dang*//rtogs pa dang ni smon lam stobs//ye shes rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis//theg chen rigs su sku 'khrungs shing*//sangs rgyas rnams kyi che ba 'don//'gro drug sems can smin grol mdzad/ /ces dang*/ da lta skye ba 'di nyid kyis//cho 'phrul rnam 'phrul mdzad spyod de//gzugs can mi yi mthong snang tsam//gzugs med 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la//smin grol ci mdzad su yi shes//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku skye ba re la'ang de lta bu'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas zag pa med pa'i tshogs gnyis tshad med pa bsags pa'i phyir sku skye ba snga ma snga ma bas phyi ma phyi ma mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan je cher 'gro ba ni gzu bor gnas pa'i blo ldan sus kyang rtogs sla la/ de ltar du mthong ba'i nges pa'ang med de/ dus je snyigs su song bzhin gdul bya ma dag pa'i skal mnyam 'ba' zhig gis rang skyon du zad/ nges pa'i don gyi dbang du byas na/ bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon du sku gsung ye shes lnga ldan mngon du mdzad zin nas/ thugs bskyed smon lam ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthus/ brgya byin/ tshangs pa/ lha rnga/ nyi ma/ nam mkha'/ sprin/ sa gzhi/ nor bu rin po che sogs kyi dpes rtog pa dang 'bad rtsol mi mnga' bar gang la gang gdul gyi 'gro don phrin las rgya mkha' khyab tu dus 'khor ba ji srid par lhun grub tu 'byung ba chos nyid yin 'dug cing*/

sangs rgyas byang sems nas ngan song gi 'gro ba'i bar gdul bya dag ma dag gis snang tshul yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ da lta gangs ljongs 'dir rang cag snyigs 'gro'i 'dren pa rgyal ba karma pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar kyang hril te mdor bsdus na/ phyi so so thar pa'i 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu sogs ji bzhin phyag bzhes su btab pas ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dgra bcom chen po dang*/ nang thugs bskyed bsam mi khyab pas/ chags pa med pa'i sbyin pa/ gos pa med pa'i tshul khrims/ 'khrug pa med pa'i bzod pa/ g.yel ba med pa'i brtson 'grus/ g.yo ba med pa'i bsam gtan/ mtshan ma med pa'i shes rab/ gzhan dring med pa'i thabs mkhas/ 'gran zla med pa'i mthu stobs/ tshad bzung med pa'i smon lam/ chags thogs med pa'i ye shes rnams kyi pha rol tu son pa'i sems dpa' chen po dang*/ gzhi rgyud dbang gzhis smin cing lam rgyud rtsa rlung thig gsum gnyug ma sgrib pa bral ba'i ye shes kyi bde ba chen pos 'pho ba'i bag chags yongs su bcom pas 'bras rgyud sku bzhi lhun grub bde chen rdo rje mngon du mdzad pa'i rtsal gdangs snang srid thams cad phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor dbang 'byor pas grub pa mchog gi rtse mor son pa ste gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yongs kyi yang rtse rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su nges pa'i phyir 'pho 'gyur bri gang mi mnga' yang de tshul mtha' dag gdul bya'i snang ba kho na ste/ rgyal ba byams pas/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang*//rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs//las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye//de la de med phyir na med//ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir//skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*//snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang*//'chi dang rga dang na bar ston/ /zhes dang*/ chos rje karma pa nyid kyis kyang*/

skye ba med kyang skye tshul ston//gnas pa med kyang gnas tshul ston//'gro 'ong med kyang 'gro dang 'ong*//'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston//zhes sogs gsungs pas ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngor/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang pos mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa dang chos mtshungs te/ bka' brgyud gong ma dag gi zhal nas kyang*/ bla ma 'di rang rgyud kyi me long yin//sku 'gyur ba mnga'am mi mnga' ltos//ji srid du 'das grong yod kyi bar//da dung du gus par rang rgyud sbyong*/ /zhes gsungs so//khyad par du'ang chos rje nyid kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na thugs bskyed smon lam bsam mi khyab pa'i mthus/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad grol ba bzhi ldan gyi mnga' bdag chen por nges pa ste/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog skyabs rje chos dbang rin po ches/ mthong grol cod pan gzi 'od 'bar//thos grol mtshan mchog karma pa//dran myong reg grol phrin las bzhis//'khor ba dong sprugs khyod la 'dud//ces gsungs te/ de 'ang chos rje karma pa nyid sngon ri rab kyi byang phyogs su drang srong dgon pa skyes zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ rgyal ba rnams kyis mkha' 'gro ma bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis dbu skra nyag ma re re las grub pa'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba de sgrib pa bsrabs pa rnams kyi ngor rgyal ba'i dbang po'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba thams cad kyi dbur 'bral med du yod kyang rang re ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i mi mthong*/ de la phan gdags phyir ngo bo de mtshon byed rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhwa nag po gser gyi mdongs can bzhes pa yin cing*/ mi dang zhwa gnyis zung 'jug tu/ /sus mthong tsam la ngan song med/ /ces yongs su grags par ma zad/ chos rje karma pa nyid kyi phrin las kyi byed por dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ rje zhwa dmar/ rje rgyal tshab/

rje si tu/ rje dpa' bo rin po che rnams la'ang dbyibs de dang 'dra ba'i cod pan dbang gi mdog can 'ching bar mdzad pa'ang dgongs pa brda thabs la sogs kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs khyad du 'phags pa'o/ /ma dag pa 'ga' zhig rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis dbu zhwa sgron pa 'di zang zing bsdu ba'i ched du'o snyam mod/ rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis thugs bskyed pa dang smon lam gyi khyad par las mthong thos don ldan gyi phrin las bslu med du 'byung ba zhig mkhas pa la rlung ltar grags 'dug pa blun po skal med rnams kyi blor ma shong ba der zad/ ces kun mkhyen dharma ka ras gsungs/ mdor na/ bla ma'i nang nas bla ma mchog gyur//skyabs gnas rnams las 'gran zla bral ba//zhes gsungs pa ltar nges pas/ mos blos yar gzhal ma dgos pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs su byon pa'i bla ma 'di lta bu'i zhabs pad dngos su brten pa'i skal pa can gyi rjes 'jug rnams nas kyang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba spangs te/ tshul bzhin bsten pas bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin 'dug /tshul bzhin bsten pa'ang mdor bsdus na bka' ci gnang dang thugs dgongs la gang yod sgrub pa la 'dus par kong sprul rin po ches gsungs/ rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog /'bring lus ngag gi zhabs

tog /tha ma zang zing gi zhabs tog ces grags mod/ sems can gyi las tshul bsam mi khyab cing khams dang dbang po tha dad pas gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las mtshungs med chos rje nyid kyi ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ma gtogs/ rang cag rnams kyi blos dpyad pas ji bzhin shes pa dang byang chub kyi lam du 'gro bar dka' bas bla ma'i dgongs pa dang bstun nas mnyes pa'i thabs la mkhas par bya ba ni gal po che yin 'dug/ de'ang ji ltar mkhas par bya zhe na/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i zhal nas/ de phyir blo dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten la mkhas pa ni/ /sgrub la mnyes pa'i dus su sgrub la 'bad/ /lus ngag zhabs tog mnyes dus de la 'bad/ /sgrub dang lus ngag zhabs tog mi mnyes shing*/ /zang zing kho na'i zhabs tog mnyes dus su/ /ci 'byor zang zing kho nas mnyes par bya/ /zang zing kho nas mnyes par byed bdo la/ /de ma thag tu sgrub pas mnyes pa na/ /skad cig de la zang zing zhabs tog gi /'phro bcad sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /shin tu dben par sgrub pa byed bdo la/ /bang chen las ka sogs kyi mnyes pa ni/ /de tshe mtshams la har 'don byas nas kyang*/ /bang chen las ka sogs kyi zhabs tog bya/ /las ka sogs kyi zhabs tog byed bdo la/ /las ka bzhag nas sgrub pas mnyes pa yod/ /de tshe las ka 'phro bcad sgrub la zhugs/ /ci nas bla ma mnyes byar song ba na/ /lus ngag zang zing zhabs tog ci byas kyang*/ /sgrub pa'i zhabs tog mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dben pa bsten nas sgrub pa byed snyam yang*/ /bla ma dam pa de la ma mnyes na/ /sgrub pa'i zhabs tog de yang chos bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i zhabs tog nyid du ma song bas/ / */ /sgrub pa ltar snang nyid du song ba yin/ /lus ngag zang zing sogs kyi zhabs tog kyang*/

/ci yod phul zhing ci dgos bsgrubs na yang*/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes par ma gyur na/ /lus ngag zang zing sogs kyi zhabs tog de/ /dam chos sgrib pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba yi/ /zhabs tog gnad du song ba ma yin no/ /des na bla ma bsten cing sgrub pa yi/ /chos de dam pa'i chos su ma song bar/ /chos de las bsam phral du song ba yi/ /byed lo kun gyi rang brgyud mi thul pas/ /bla ma bsten cing sgrub par byas pa des/ /rang gzhan 'gro ba kun la byams pa dang*/ /snying rje byang sems ris med skyes gyur nas/ /'gro kun bla ma dkon mchog ji bzhin du/ /spyi bor khur nas dad cing mchod byed na/ /bla ma bsten bsgrub byas pa de kun kyang*/ /dam chos sgrib pa'i gnyen por song ba yin/ /bla ma dam pa dgyes dang mi dgyes kyi/ /snang tshul ji ltar ston pa mdzad na yang*/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus pa 'jug pa'i phyir/ /de nyid byin rlabs yin par shes pa na/ /bla ma thugs rje chen po'i rtse shugs kyis/ /dbang med mi dgyes ka med 'byung ba yin/ /slob ma'i mos gus drag sngags zab mo des/ /bla ma'i thugs yid dbang du bsdus nas ni/ /rang sems sgrib bral chos kyi sku nyid dang*/ /dbyer med bla ma rang gi sems nyid las/ /gzhan du tshol mi dgos par bsten chog pas/ /bla ma nyid dang 'bral ba med pa yin/ /de tshe dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres zhes/ /bla ma dam pa'i go 'phang thob pa yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bad na don che zhing*/ gdul bya tha shal ba bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i byang thang gi ser skya pho mo rnams nas kyang thabs dang rnam pa du mas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su mjal ba la 'bad cing*/ mjal rung ma mjal rung gdul byar gyur pa'i bod 'brog gi ser skya pho mo sprang phyug kun gyis dad mos brtan pos bkur bsti dang rje 'gro ba'i mgon po sogs kar mkhyen la brtson pa dang*/ kun mkhyen blo gros mtha' yas kyi zhal nas/

blo snying brang gsum bla ma rje la gtad//lus sems rje btsun bla ma'i bran du 'bul//bdog pa thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su gtong*//legs pa ci mchis rje yi sri zhur bsngo//bya ba ci byed sku yi rim gror bgyid//brjod pa'i tshig kun bka' drin can khyod bsngags//lus dang srog la 'phangs pa ma mchis par//dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed pa skong bgyid pas//tshe 'dir khyed kyi go 'phang la 'god nas//'gro ba'i don kun khyed bzhin 'grub par shog/ces gsungs pa ltar yid la brnags pa gal che zhes dred po rang nyid la smras so// // dpag med bskal pa'i sngon du sangs rgyas kyang*/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis srid na rgyal sras tshul/ /lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las can/ /zhwa nag can gyi bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ 1 /gang la sred dang len pa mi mnga' yang*/ /rgyal bas bla med zhing du rab bsngags phyir/ /sgo gsum dge tshogs 'khor 'das zhing 'byor kun/ /rgyun mi 'chad par mchod pa'i sprin du spro/ 2 /don la bshags bya bshags byed ma dmigs kyang*/ /so skye gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis/ /thog med dus nas da bar bcas rang nyes/ /ji snyed ma lus bshags shing sdom par bgyi/ 3 /'phags skye'i bsod nams spyi dang khyad par du/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar rgya mtsho dang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i mdzad phrin bsam yas la/ /dang 'dod yid ches blo yis rjes yi rang*/ 4 /yang dag don la chos 'khor rtag gnas kyang*/ /ma smin 'gro la snang bar mi 'gyur bas/ /'gro kun dam chos bdud rtsi'i snod du smin/ /gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ 5 /don dam gtsang rtag bde bdag phar phyin sku/ /rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*/ /gdul bya'i blo ngor sprul pa'i snang byed mchog /nam yang nub med zhabs pad rtag brtan gsol/ 6 /'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ /'gro kun gtan bde'i rgyal sar 'god pa'i phyir/

/bya byed las gsum 'khor gsum yongs dag gis/ /bla med byang chub snying por bsngo bar bgyi/ 7 /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam ma gyur yid can kun/ / deng bzung byang chub bar du tshe rabs kun/ /bla ma mchog gis 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub nus byin gyis rlobs/ 8 /'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i rten mchog gis/ /las 'bras yid ches sdom dang dam tshig ldan/ /thos pas mig yangs bsam pas nges pa rnyed/ /bsgoms pas chos sems 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ 9 /grub mtha'i bzhed srol tha dad mang na yang*/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs gdul ba'i phyir/ /thams cad mnyam med thub pa'i bstan par gcig /bcos min dag snang 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ 10 /sngon byon dam pas dgag sgrub mang po rnams/ /mkhas pa'i bgyi gsum rgyal bstan 'dzin spel slad/ /dgongs gzhi dgos dbang ji bzhin rtogs dka' bas/ /phyogs rer zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ 11 /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin phyogs lhung chags sdang gis/ /rang phyogs skyong ba zhabs tog yin snyam pas/ /ma tshor chos spangs ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa che/ /rgyal bstan yongs la mdza' bar byin gyis rlobs/ 12 /mi rtag bsams pas tshe 'di blo yis thong*/ /rgyu 'bras bsams pas rten 'brel blang dor mkhas/ /nges 'byung bsams pas chos brgyad 'ching las grol/ /dam chos gnad du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ 13 /byang chub sems mchog rnal ma ma skyes na/ /theg pa chen po'ang tshig gi lam du zad/ /de yi rtsa ba tshad med rnam pa bzhi/ /bcos min rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dang por rang rgyud dbu mas bden gnyis nges/ /bar du thal 'gyur dbu mas spros mtshan bcad/ /tha mar lhan skyes ye shes mngon du gyur/ /mtha' bral lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ 15 /dang por sems can la dmigs snying rje bsgom/ /bar du chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje skyes/

/tha mar dmigs med snying rje klong du gyur/ /theg chen rtsa ba tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ 16 /dang por rgyu rgyud gnas tshul thos bsam 'bad/ /bar du thabs rgyud smin grol lam la bslab/ /tha mar 'bras rgyud sku bzhi mngon du gyur/ /theg mchog skal pa ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ 17 /dang por bskyed rim bcos ma'i blo yis bsgom/ /bar du mtshan nyid bzhi ldan nges pa rnyed/ /tha mar rtsol med tshad brgyad gyad du gyur/ /bskyed rim brtan pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ 18 /dang por thabs lam zab mos bde ba skyed/ /bar du bde ba stong pa'i dbyings su bstim/ /tha mar 'pho med bde chen rdo rje grub/ /thun min zab lam dbang 'byor byin gyis rlobs/ 19 /dang por dben gsum sgyu lus mngon par grub/ /bar du 'od gsal gyis sbyangs dri ma zad/ /tha mar mi slob zung 'jug mngon du gyur/ /rim lnga'i skal pa ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ 20 /dang por rtsol bcas dran pas rtse gcig bsgom/ /bar du rtsol med gnyug ma rang babs bzhag /tha mar sems nyid gcer bu dri ma bral/ /gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ 21 /dang por chos nyid mngon sum sgo 'phar phye/ /bar du 'od gsal nyams snang gong du 'phel/ /tha mar rig pa skur smin tshad du phebs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ 22 /dang por dpal ldan bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /bar du bcos min mos gus khong nas 'bar/ /tha mar thugs yid gcig 'dres bla mar grub/ /nye lam snying po bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ 23 /mdor na zab mo lta bas 'khor gsum bral/ /rgya chen spyod par zhum dang chog shes med/ /theg chen smon lam rgya mtsho yongs la zhugs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i rjes slob byin gyis rlobs/ 24 /rang don dag gnyis chos sku mngon du gyur/ /gzhan don gzugs skus 'khor ba ji srid du/ /lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las kyang*/

/rgyal ba kun dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ 25 /sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ /chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa dang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs bden mthu yis/ /ji ltar smon pa'i 'dod don ma lus pa/ /gegs med myur ba nyid du 'grub pa dang*/ /dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis stsol//zhes pa rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di nyid gang gi sku phreng bco lnga pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs/ 7kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje yab sras rnams kyis zhabs rdul spyi bos reg cing skyabs 'og tu 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal grwa rgan ma ṇi pa karma nges don bstan rgyas pas/ bstan pa spyi lugs jo bo rje'i bzhed pas bdag cag gi ston pa shing glang lor bltams nas bgrang bya bzhi stong brgya dang*/ bdun pa lcags yos lor 'og min mtshur gyi ghan+dho lar gzims chung kun khyab pho brang gi 'dab rol du rang dang rang 'dra blo dman rnams kyi dad pa'i bag chags gso phyir sbyar ba la nyes 'gal mchis na bshags shing dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti/ chos dbyings mkha' la ye shes dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /tshad med phrin las 'od stong zhing kun khyab/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos karma pa'i/ /skyes rabs rma med yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng*/ /skye rgu'i gtan gyi dbul ba sel byed mgon/ /rim par byon pa'i rmad byung rnam thar gang*/ /rgyu skar dbus na nyin byed dbang po bzhin/ /'dzin pa'i khyon 'dir ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags/ /gang gi gsang gsum yon tan mtha' yas pa'i/ /'jug pa rgya mtsho dus gsum zhing kun na/ /spro ba'i pha mtha' nyid kyi spyod yul las/ /rgyal ba gzhan gyis dpogs par nus min phyir/

/cha shas tsam yang brjod pa'i mtha' bral yang*/ /skal ldan dad pa'i chu gter 'phel byed cing*/ /bsod nams dam pa'i myu gu rgyas pa'i slad/ /mchog gi rnam thar nyung ngur bsdus pa'i tshul/ /rdzogs ldan sprin gyi dga' char dam pa 'di/ /bka' brgyud chu bo yongs kyi 'byung ba'i gnas/ /he ru ka dpal thugs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas/ /sa spyod 'og min mtshur mdo'i chos grwa che'i*/ /mkhan po lung gi gdams pas rgyud phyug shing*/ /rgyal ba'i gsung pa'i de nyid tshul bzhin rigs/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa'i rgyal mtshan kun gyis phul/ /gang gi blo gros lha lam yangs pa las/ /rgyu skar bdag po'i gzugs brnyan 'phos pa bzhin/ /skal ldan blo yi rdzing bu mdzes byed pa'i/ /ngo mtshar spar gyi 'phrul 'di bskrun pa'i dges/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan dad pa'i grur zhugs nas/ /byang chen spyod pa'i rnam thar rab rdzogs te/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen karma pa'i/ /go 'phang mchog la rigs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga lā k+ṣar tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ /maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// karma pa bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal karma pa bco lnga pa dpal ldan kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma chen po phrin las mkha' khyab rtag pa'i rdo rje de nyid kyi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan dang*/ rnam par thar pa ni so skye'i blo yi spyod yul du lta ci/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyis kyang ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ma yin la/ der ma zad bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la'ang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan rnam rol/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge sogs byon cing 'byon par 'gyur ba dang*/ da lta rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa 'dir yang mngon dga'i zhing na rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ ri bo tā lar snying rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten dbang phyug

zangs mdog dpal rir snang srid zil gnon pad+ma kā ra/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sa ra ha sogs 'phags skye'i rnam 'phrul bsam brjod las 'das shing*/ khyad par rang cag gangs can ljongs 'di'i mgon por lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul yang*/ ji skad du/ mdo las/ nga 'das lo ni nyis stong na//gdong dmar yul du bstan pa 'byung*//spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar 'gyur//de'i bstan pa'i snyigs ma la//byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra//karma ka zhes bya ba 'byung*//ting 'dzin dbang thob 'gro ba 'dul//mthong thos dran reg bde la bkod/ /ces dang*/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phrin las skyong byed cing : mtshur phu zhes byar dus gsum mkhyen pa 'byung : zhes dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung gi rnam 'phrul las: dga' ldan gnas nas sems can don du 'phos: dang po'i gsang spyod dus gsum mkhyen zhes grags: dbang rtags rigs kyi cod pan zhwa nag 'dzin: skad cig re la sems can dpag med 'dren: de dag mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams: skye ba de 'phos 'phags pa'i drung du skye: zhes dang*/ o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i gsang lung las/ lo tsā rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bdag la gson: gsung gi gnas mchog zla gam pho brang du: ma 'ongs khyed kyi skye ba nyer gcig 'byung : spyan ras gzigs sprul dus gsum kun mkhyen pa: zhes sogs skyes rabs kyi phreng ba re re nas lan gcig min par yang nas yang du lung gis bsngags shing*/ mthun snang tsam du'ang 'dul ba rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyi sgo du mas snang ba dang mi snang ba'i 'gro ba kun la rnam par grol ba'i sa bon 'debs pa dang*/ smin pa dang*/ grol bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin 'jig rten kun dang khyad par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir zla ba ltar gsal zhing grags pa las/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal dbang bco lnga pa chen po 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi rnam par thar pa las gdul bya so so'i las snang dang mthun pa'i phyi'i rnam par thar pa gcig pu'ang dpyis phyin par brjod pa lta ci bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du nges mod/

'on kyang rang nyid kyi mthong thos las rnam thar rags rim sa bon tsam brjod par bya ste/ de yang gter chen chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i lung bstan las/ theg mchog mya ngan 'das 'og dgos pa'i mtshan: bde ba'i bdag nyid rig pa'i rdo rje dang : o rgyan phrin las bsam gtan la sogs 'byung : zhib par mdo byang gud sbas lung bzhin la: nga yi sprul pa karma'i bstan pa ni: bskal bzang bstan pa rdzogs par mi rdzogs so: zhes dang*/ bco lnga pa la bsod nams snyan grags 'byung : zhes gsungs shing*/ mchog dbyangs sprul pa sngags rig 'dzin: rta'am lug gi lo pa ni: mkha' la mkha' yis rgyas thebs na: tshe 'phrang gsum sel bstan srog 'dzin: bod khams bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel: zhes sogs o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi gter lung rnams dang*/ grub chen chos kyi bla ma karma pak+shi'i ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur stsal ba'i lung byang dang mthun par bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul nye bar bstan pa'i yul/ gangs can bod yul g.yas ru gtsang gi char/ myang stod shel dkar rgyal rtser grags pa/ yul gyi dge bcu tshang ba'i sa yi thig le dran ma spel gsar byang du 'bod pa na/ sngon dus kyang chos skyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ blon po/ mkhas shing grub pa chen po'i sa la bzhugs pa 'phags chen skyes bu dam pa rgyun mi chad par byung ba/ rlangs lha gzigs ral pa'i gdung las chad pa/ yab rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug skad gtong grub chen he ru ka dam pa snyan grags dbang po gtsos sku mched lnga la/ yum rang bzhin gyi dge ba la goms shing bud med kyi yon tan tshang ba/ rus pa bya

nyang*/ mtshan skal bzang sgron ma bya ba'i sras sring sku mched drug gi tha chung skyabs mgon rin po che 'di nyid lcags lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcur sku bltams pa ste/ de yang thog mar yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa nas yab yum gyi rmi ltas rgyal chen bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs shing dung 'bud pa dang*/ mchod rten 'od 'bar ba brtsigs shing bskor ba byed pa sogs dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa khang steng du bab pa sogs mthong snang khyad par can dang*/ yab rje grub dbang nyid kyis gzigs snang khyad par can gyis rang re la slob dpon chen po'i sprul pa zhig yong ba 'dug ces gsungs shing*/ sku bltams pa'i tshe yang yum la gnod pa med par 'ja' dang me tog gi char sogs dge zhing shis pa'i mtshan ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas sku bltams ma thag tu spyan gnyis nam mkha' la hrig ger gzigs pa sogs mtha' dag re re nas brjod par mi long zhing*/ yab yum gyis mtshan don grub rdo rjer gsol/ zla ba re re bzhin yang byis pa gzhan las bskyed che zhing*/ smin mtshams su mdzod spu dkar po'i mtshan bzang dang ldan pa/ byams snying rje thugs rgyud la lhan skyes kyis 'byungs pa'i gsungs dang*/ mdzad pa kho nas ma ṇi'i tshogs dpon mdzad pa sogs 'gro ba'i don rang shugs kyis skyong ba las/ sems can la gnod pa phra mo tsam yang mi gnang zhing*/ gzhan la'ang spang blang gi bslab bya 'doms mkhyen pa dang*/ skabs su sngaun gnas rjes dran gyi gtam dang*/ lkog gyur legs nyes mngon sum du gzigs pa'i gsungs gleng sogs chos khrid sdig po che rnams kyang rang shugs kyis dad cing ngo mtshar bskyed nus pa mdzad cing*/ skabs zhig rtse chen dgon du 'chams gzigs la gdan drangs te/ yar lam rgya mi zhig gis pang du bzung ste khrom mang rab zhig dang lhan gcig phebs pa na/

mun rub nye bar lam 'og gtsang chab zhig gi 'gram du ban hrul sprang chas khres po khur ba gsum bzhi dang*/ lam gong gad pa zhig la kyung ka lta bu bya nag mang po 'ur dir gyis 'tshogs pa gzigs te/ yar tsam byon pa dang*/ mun rub ste lam yang mi mthong bar gyur pa na/ phyi bzhin sngo dmar gyi me chen po yul lung yang gsal snyams byed pa zhig gis rjes ded nas byung ba na/ der yod tshang mas 'dre byung zhes 'jigs skrag gis skyabs 'gro bzla bzhin ci bya gtol bral gyis lam gar thob tu bros pa'i skabs/ skyes bu chen po 'di ni sku na phra yang thugs dkyil che bas cung zad kyang bag tsha ba med par byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs stangs mdzad pa tsam gyis me de dag skar ma bzhin thang chen por gang bar grams shing*/ mthar je chung gis yal ba las/ 'byung po gdug pa can gyis gnod 'tsher bgyis pa gor ma chags na'ang*/ skyes bu chen po'i thugs rjes khrom tshogs de dag gi mi rta su la'ang glags ma rnyed cing*/ dgung lo lnga yi ngo zin nas skyes thob kyi shes rab 'gran zla med pas 'don klog mkhas pa dang*/ ma bslab par yang dpe cha 'di rigs la go rgyu zhig yod pa red gsungs shing go ba thar thor rnyed pa sogs skyes bu dam pa'i rang mtshan mngon sum du gsal bar mdzad cing*/ dgung lo drug bzhes pa'i me byi lor 'jam mgon rnam gnyis dang*/ gter chen mchog gyur gling pa/ rje btsun dpa' bo rin po che sogs lkog gyur gzigs pa'i ye shes sgrib pa med pa rnams kyi dgongs nyams dang rtse mthun par skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'brug chen mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po'i dgongs par dpal ldan rang byung ma'i me long las mchog gi sprul sku'i gnas yul sgo khyim rigs rus skyed byed bcas mngon sum bzhin gsal bar ston cing*/ 'dod khams dbang mos bskul ma nan tan du gnang ba bzhin ra lung du phebs skabs ngos 'dzin mdzad de/

re zhig gsang rgya dgos pa'i bka' rtsis su sdom yang 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gi zla zhal gtsang gi phyogs su tshes par gyur to zhes/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis ma bshad par grags pas khyab par mdzadapa bzhin/ snang ba dang mi snang ba'i skye bo'i tshogs nyin re bzhin yang zhal mjal du lhags/ dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin 'phel bar gyur to//de nas me glang lor rje dbon don grub sprul sku dpon slob rnams na bza' mtshan gsol gdan zhus su phebs pa/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes 7 nyin yab gzhis nye skor du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ tshes brgyad gza' skar sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i snga char 'khrungs khang steng du rgyal mtshan btsug /lha bsang dang*/ khrus gsol bcas na bza' phul/ bzhugs khri'i steng du bzhugs te tshe ril phyag gis bzhes pa dang dus mtshungs par nyi 'od du la char 'dres ma babs shing*/ dbyar rnga ldir ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel shin tu legs par byung zhing*/ chos dgu phebs gyam du gdan 'dren zhus te bzhugs sgar du khri ston mdor bsdus bcas spyan drangs/ tshes bco lnga nyin rgyal rtse rdzong brgyud phebs pa na/ de yi nyin ngor 'od dkar po shas che ba'i 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs mig mang ris bkra bas gar byon sngon rjes kun tu gang ba dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa sogs kun gyi mthong snang du gyur/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la/ skyabs mgon 'brug chen rin po che dang*/ rje dbon chos dbang rin po che/ 'jang drung pa sprul sku sogs bla sprul dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos chibs bsu ser sbreng lha mi'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa bcas gdan sa chen po 'og min mtshur mdo'i gtsug lag khang gi chos kyi khri chen por shis brjod mnga' dbul dang 'brel bas/ 7dpal ldan kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma chen po phrin las mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes dang*/

7gong sa yas phyin rtse shod sku tshabs dang 'brel/ 7blo bzang don gnyis lhun grub mkha' khyab rdo rje mkhyen rab kun gyi 'byung gnas bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes mtshan gyi dril bsgrags/ mthong grol cod pan 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag dbu la bzhes pa na che chung mnyam pa rang 'grigs su byung zhing*/ sku'i zil dang gzi byin blta bas mi ngoms pa bcas 'dul bya mtha' dag skal bzang gi dga' ston la spyad cing*/ mtha' dbus kyi skye rgu mchog phal rnams kyis dad pa'i legs skyes kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi bkod pa lta bus nyin re bzhin yang sum rtsen gyi dpal la 'gran pa bzhin byung ngo*/ /zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis nyin lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gcig mdun mchod sprin gzab rgyas bcas/ mkhan po 'brug chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ las slob bde chen yongs 'dzin shes bya kun mkhyen/ dus go ba mkhan chen rin chen dar rgyas/ kha skong rje dbon rnam gnyis/ gcung sprul sogs las kyi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rab tu byung pa'i bslab pa bzhes pa'i mtshan du 7dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma phrin las snang ba mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol/ rim pas rgyud sde sogs phyag dpe thugs 'dzin dang*/ phyag bris gzab gshar/ lany war/ 'bru tsha sogs phul bas tshegs chung ngus byang chub par mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad par sa stag zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la chos dbang sprul sku rin po ches mdzod nag rten gtor nyams gsos skabs/ rab gnas dang mgon por phrin bcol thugs thog nas gnang zhing rten rdzas snyan shal la 'dod gsol ljags tsam mdzad/ lo de'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga la rab gnas ser phreng phebs pas phyag nas zang thal du byon cing*/ rten kha shas kyi thugs kar len pa dang*/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa las me tog gi char dang*/ sa gzhi la rol mo'i sgra grags pa sogs byin chen phebs pa'i mngon rtags ya mtshan pa byung zhing*/

zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la sgrol dkar dus mchod bcas de nas bzung*/ yang mar tshes bcu/ tshes bco lnga/ bco brgyad/ nyer dgur mgon gsol sogs sku tshe ril por dus mchod rigs ma chags par mdzad/ gdul bya gang la gang mtshams kyi mos 'dod yid bzhin spel ba'i 'gro don dang*/ bar mtshams kun tu rnam g.yengs kyi go skabs med par gzhung 'grel rig gnas skor la gsan bsam dang*/ ris med pa'i rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi smin grol rgyab brten bcas pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bar med du gsol bas mkhyen rab kyi rtsal rdzogs shing*/ chu rta zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la lha sar gong sa chen po sku phreng bcu bdun pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad du bcar bas/ 7ngag dbang chos kyi 'byung gnas mkha' khyab ting 'dzin rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan dang*/ shis brjod kyi legs skyes rgya cher spel bas gzengs bstod/ bstan srung chen po rdo rje grags ldan nas kyang*/ rten ma dung phyag tu phul zhing gus pas gtsug tu bkur/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer bdun byang rigs sde bzhi'i 'dod skong du chibs bsgyur gnang ste dad ldan gson gshin 'brel tshad don ldan gyis blo yid tshim par mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu nas mkhan chen bla ma bkra shis 'od zer mdun nas skyabs rje rin po che dbus 'dus pa nyi shu skor gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung dang*/ rtse le'i bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung*/ dpa' bo rin po che gtsug lag nyin byed las 'ja' tshan pod drug gi dbang lung*/ sngags grwa rig 'dzin chen po las 'jam mgon si tu kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' 'bum lung sogs gsan bzhes dang*/ bar mtshams su bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub kyi rdo rje rgyal po gnang bas/ sman rnams kha dog dri ro nus bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ dad mos can gyi ngor bka' chos smin dbang khrid lung sogs dang*/

gsol 'debs zhal gdams bsang gsol gsung rtsom gnang sbyin gyis mtshon re ba yid bzhin bskang ba dang*/ gnas nang nyams gso la rab gnas gzigs skyong dang*/ shing sprel dgung grangs bcu bzhir son pa na/ li thang spang phug dgon pa'i gtsug lag nyams gsos gsar bskrun la rab gnas dgongs gtad dus tshes bsgrigs te rtags thon dgos zhes zhus pas/ zhal bzhes kyis dus thog khel nyin mtshur mdo'i lha chen rgya phibs 'og tu dgon de'i shog thang ri mor bris pa la sku rtsed lta bus 'bras dkar dri bzang gis sbags pa 'thor bar mdzad/ spang phug dgon du kun gyis mchod sprin gzab rgyas bcas de ring rtags mtshan ci 'ong zhes gleng ba na sprin dkar gyi gseng nas 'bras ser gyi char pa phyi nang khyab par babs pa/ de phyogs sde ris kun gyi mthong snang rtsod bral du byung bas thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod/ skabs su bdud 'dul rgyal po/ jo lugs sgrol dkar/ 'phags ma'i snying thig sogs kyi sku mtshams ljags bsnyen dang*/ nag tshang sogs kyi zhus ngor byang 'brog tu chibs bsgyur gyi zhor du zab bu lung sogs sgrub gnas rnams su gnas gzigs dang*/ tshogs mchod/ bod yul bde ba'i gsol smon bcas gnang*/ me khyir mdo smad du chibs btegs/ lam bar so sor dad 'dus rnams kyi 'dod pa bskang ste/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la dpal spungs su chags phebs/ me phag zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis nas yang khrod du rje 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdun phebs te/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis bar/ rang lugs rtsa gsum spyi dang*/ bka' brgyud sngags mdzod sogs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gsan bzhes bar med du mdzad/ sngon du brda' ltas kyis bskul ma byung bar brten ma mgon dam bzhag la dbyangs yig zhig mdzad par/ 'di skabs cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyer bdun nub tho rengs rmi lam du mi nag po gri thod 'dzin pa zhig gis na re/

khyed kyis nga la dbyangs brtsams pa legs/ 'on kyang nged la mthong ba don ldan gyis brtsams pa 'di yin/ 'di ltar bris na legs shes shog dril smug po zhig bstan byung ba'i nang na dbyangs yig 'dug pa bzhin sad 'phral thugs la 'dug bzhin phyag bris kyang mdzad/ tshes bdun brgyad la lha sar khang du srol gnyis las byung ba'i sems bskyed bzhes te/ dpal ldan mchog gi blo gros lung rtogs chos kyi nyin byed phrin las gzi brjid rab tu rgyas pa'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang chabs c-ig dbyar rnga lan gsum ldir zhing char chen po babs pa sogs rten 'brel legs/ de nas dbyar khang du phebs nas zla ba drug pa'i tshes dgu bar gdams mdzod sogs kyi dbang lung dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen bdag po chen po'i bar rdzogs par gsan pa'i gsang mtshan/ dpal rang byung bde chen ye shes lhan gcig skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por mnga' gsol/ bar der lha sar khang du yab sras lhan rgyas kyis bka' brgyad sman sgrub kyang mdzad/ dpal spungs dbon rgan rin po che gtsos bla las rnams nas si tu rin po che'i sprul sku'i don skor dgongs brtag snyan sbran phul/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer dgu la dbyar khang du 'jam mgon rin po che'i bka' bzhin pak+shi'i phyag bris thugs dam mgon sku'i zhal phyes pas/ ser drag dang sbrag ra chen skor du thog gsum tsam lhung ba sogs 'tshubs lhong gi rnam pa phran bu byung*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la rdzong sar du phebs/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang po mjal 'phrad gnang*/ tshes nyer gcig la thog ma'i chos kyi sgo 'byed dkar po lha gsum gyi dbang lung gsan/ de nas rdzong shod du 'jam mgon rin po che dang lhan rgyas kyis phebs/ rtsa gsum tshogs skong*/ khrom la smin dbang*/ yul lhar bsang dang gser skyems sogs kyis der 'dus kyi lha mi'i 'gro ba rnams don ldan du mdzad/

gnas gzigs ri skor phebs pas/ gu ru yab yum gyi sgrub phug /karma pa'i gzim phug sogs phug pa mang por ming 'dogs mdzad/ 'jam mgon rin po ches da dung skyabs mgon chen po gnas 'dir slar yang tshar gcig phebs rgyu yong bar 'dug ces thugs dgyes tshor gnang*/ dad sbyin rnams kyi zhus ngor hor rong tsha brgyud/ li thang spang phug dgon du phebs/ der phyogs kyi brag ngo zhig las rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku yi rang byon snga na med pa zhal phyes pa dang*/ brag skam po las tshe chu 'o ma'i mdog lta bu lhung lhung bab pa sogs kun kyang ngo mtshar skyes par gyur/ de nas rtse shag drung sde sogs kyi gdan zhus dang*/ nyag spyi bad lhun gdan zhus bcas la ri nub brgyud chibs btegs/ tre ho a thub dpon sde/ ban dgon sogs dgon khag rnams kyi 'dod skong dang*/ khyad par rje dus mkhyen dgung lo bco lnga'i skabs zhabs 'dren bar chad zhus pa'i bsnyan dgra gtsang 'gram grong pa la smon tshigs kyis spa bkong ba na/ gal te bzod gsol gyis nyams pa sor chud par 'dod na phyi ma'i dus su kho bo'i gnas 'dir ra skad grags pa zhig yong*/ de dus nga nyid gnas 'dir yong bas de la gsol ba thob ces ma 'ongs lung bstan bstsal ba'i ngag rgyun bzhin/ de nas tsam gtsang 'gram grong der mi rabs brgyud mar lo re bzhin na tsha shi chad rgyun ma chad pa yod mus su/ ra stag steng zhes dus mkhyen sku 'bum yod pa'i nye skor der gzugs med pa'i ra yi skad gsal ba thams cad nas go rgyu yod pa lan kha shas byung ba dang*/ skyabs rje rin po che hor stod du phebs pa dus 'grigs te/ gong gi lung don thog tu khel bar shes te/ be ri dpon sde nas gdan zhus kyis gtsang 'gram grong des bzod gsol phul bas/ de nas gzung sngon gyi mi shis pa'i rkyen gyi 'phro chad par gyur/ rim gyis dpal spungs su phebs pa dang*/

skyabs rje 'brug chen rin po che'i yang srid rgyal dbang mchog gi dgongs brtags dang*/ bod nas gser bum rtse mthun byung bar brten/ 'dzi sgar rin po che dang*/ gsang gling pa bcas nas zhabs bskul zhus bzhin/ 'brug chen mchog gi sprul skur na bza' mtshan gsol/ rten 'brel mjal dar rten gsum 'bul tshan bcas gnang sbyin mdzad/ sa byi zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer bdun la yang khrod 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang khrid kyi sta gon nas brtsam/ bar skabs su sgrub chen dang*/ dpal spungs dgon gyi lha sar/ gzim chung steng shod sogs su rab gnas gnang*/ dbyar khang du 'jam mgon rin po che las/ sgra/ rtsis/ sman/ snyan ngag sogs rig gnas rnams la 'brel 'jog dang*/ shes bya kun khyab/ mngon mdzod/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon rgyan/ rgyud bla/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ gsang 'dus/ dri med 'od/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po rnams kyi bshad khrid bcas gsan/ lhag bsam nas snyan ngag phul bas dpe brjod mdzad de/ 'jam mgon rin po cher gzigs phul skabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug mkhyen pa'i do ra na//shes bya'i chos kun ma sgribs sa ler 'char//slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal sgor brgyud tsam gyis//kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i gom stabs gcig gis bgrod//ces bsngags brjod gnang*/ bum sgrub tshes bcu rnams kyi tshogs dbur phebs/ char shin tu che bas tshes bcu'i gar 'chams nyin gnyis la byas pas/ tshes bcu nyin rgyal dbang rin po ches sa 'dul/ byin 'bebs/ gser skyems rnams la 'chams phebs kyis byin rlabs gnang*/ tshes bcu gcig nyin gtum rngams zil gnon zhabs 'chams gnang skabs 'ja' dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa sogs byung*/ zla ba bdun pa'i nang 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun/ zhabs brtan dngos 'bul gzab spros bcas chos mtshams kyis/ phyogs kyi 'dod skong du tshab tsha/ ban chen/

'dan gzhung rnams su chibs bskyod kyis sa glang zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la dpal spungs su slar 'khor te rdzong sar du phebs/ si tu'i 'khrungs yul li thang gi lung pa'i 'gro tshul/ mdun ri/ rgyab ri/ chu dang zam pa yod lugs/ khang pa'i thog rtsag sgo dang skar khung yod phyogs bcas shog khrar ri mo mdzad de/ dgongs brtag bzhin yang srid brtsad bcad du spung sprul/ 'brong bla bstan 'dzin chos rgyal bcas li thang tsho gsum 'ja' pa grong du mngag btang gis der yang thugs dam bzhin btsal ma dgos par rnyed/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i mdun nas sgrub btus sogs dbang lung khrid gsum gdams ngag rgya mtsho lta bu ngom med du gsol ste thugs nang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ phar tshur zhabs brtan 'bul nod bcas mdzad/ nyin shas bar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang brtse'i gsung gleng bka' 'dri bslab ston rigs zhib rgyas su gnang*/ slar yang dpal spungs su phebs/ 'jam mgon rin po che nas gzhi len gyis bla ma dgongs 'dus sgrub chen/ sman sgrub sogs yan lag gi sgrub pa kun tshang mtha' rgyas su dpon slob brgya dang brgyad yar brgal gyis zhag bcu'i khongs su grub par mdzad cing*/ mthar 'jam mgon rin po che las sgrub dbang chen mo gsan/ de skabs bar gseng kun tu shangs chos skor dang*/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma sogs thun mong dang*/ gter mdzod bka' rgya'i skor dang*/ rang lugs chos srung bka' gtad srog dbang sogs thun mong min pa'i dbang khrid rgyab brten bcas nyin mtshan 'khor yug lta bu'i gsan bsam mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la si tu'i yang srid rin po che chibs bsu ser phreng bcas dgon du phebs pa mjal 'phrad kyis/ tshes bcu gcig la dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan 'dogs khrir 'don mnga' gsol gnang skyes rgya cher dang*/ dgon gyi phyi nang bca' sgrigs sku gcar yongs 'dzin bsko bzhag sogs phyi nang gi gzigs rtogs nyams smin bcas bka' drin stsal ste/

tshes nyer drug la 'jam mgon rin po che dang rgyal mchog phan tshun bsnyen phreng phul bzhes dang*/ thun min nyams bzhes bka' slob bcas thugs phreng ngang nas mjal dar rtse sprod/ bkra shis smon lam bcas mdzad de lho khog brgyud zur mong nas karma'i gdan sar phebs te bstan 'gro'i spyi rim lung don bzhin phur sgrub rgyun 'dzugs kyi yo byad gnang sbyin dang*/ sgrub chen sman sgrub sbrel ma'i rdo rje rgyal por mdzad de khrom la dbang dang myong grol sman 'gyed bcas gnang*/ mkhan bla ma bkra shis 'od zer phebs pa las 'gro don bar mtshams rnams su khrid lung du ma gsan bzhes kyis/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig nas chibs btegs lho rgyud nas nang chen rgyal khab tu phebs/ chags med/ mnyan sprul sogs bla sprul 'dus pa rgya cher bka' brgyud sngags mdzod dbang lung rdzogs par gnang ste dil yag brgyud chibs bsgyur gyis/ 'brong stod du mkha' 'gro gtor chen phul ba na/ yul lha gter srung chen pos g.yu dmar rin thang bral ba phyag tu phul/ de nas rim gyis lha gdan rgyal khab chen por skyabs mgon rtse dang*/ srid skyong bcas par sger mjal dang*/ ston pa mtshungs med jo shāka yid bzhin nor bur stong mchod gzab spros bcas/ mchod rten khag la gnas gzigs gsol smon thugs bskyed bcas gnang*/ gnas chung du dgra lha chen por sku phebs zhus pas bka' lung bsngags brjod bcas rin chen dang po'i mtheb skor phyag tu phul/ de nas gung thang brgyud bsam yas sogs sgrub gnas khyad par 'phags pa rnams su gnas gzigs stong mchod tshogs 'khor sogs tshogs bsags/ bstan 'gro bde thabs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel thugs smon zab rgyas gnang bzhin gsang gling du phebs/ 'brug chen rin po che'i yang srid gser khrir mnga' gsol legs 'bul rgya chen dang*/ kar 'brug bstan lar gcig dril sngar grol bzhin nyams smin bka' slob kyis skyong*/

lcags yos lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la dgongs nyams dang 'brel bas dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis/ nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra yi gnas kyi snying po mchod kar sprul pa'i pho brang du phebs/ gnas gzigs zhib cha dang 'brel ba'i mtsho sgor rgyas pa dang*/ bde mchog yab yum gyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba khyad par can gnang*/ dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung zhing*/ e ka dza ṭ-i'i gnas gzigs su phebs pa na 'byung bzhir rang dbang 'byor ba'i bkod pa dang*/ ri brag la zang thal du phebs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mthong chos su bstan cing*/ phebs lam kun tu 'ja' tshon gyis sbrel ba dang*/ lha yi me tog dkar po 'dab ma brgyad nas bcu drug bar can gyi char bab pa sogs dge mtshan rmad du byung zhing*/ de dag gi tsher rtsa gsum sgrub thabs kyi brda' byang*/ mahā gu ru'i sku tshab yab yum dzhi k+ṣi las grub pa/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi gdung bcas myong grol skor sogs phyag tu phog pa bcas/ 'dis mtshon zab gter gyi mdzod chen po mnga' bar snang na'ang rnam pa kun tu rang gi yon tan sbrul gyi yan lag bzhin sbas te nga lta bu rmongs brtul tshul 'chal skor sred 'dod gdung can gyis ci yang mi shes/ dus ngan gyi bla gzugs las ngan mtshang brdol bdag 'dras ma byung ba'i tshul kho nas dman sar bzungs shing*/ chos brgyad bral bas lta snang tsam du'ang bcos min nyid las/ thob dang rnam dpyod ngom pa'i che ba/ tshul 'chos sogs med pa 'di'ang 'phags pa'i rnam thar bla na med pa zhig go/ de nas lwa ba phug tu gnas mchod la khyug tsam phebs rtsis kyis der slebs pa dang*/ glo bur zhabs bskor phebs bzhed kyis mi lpags thang nas brtsam/ gangs lam shin tu nyams nga ba rnams su gcan gzan dang*/ byim pa'i rkang rjes lta bur gsal ba'i shul lam du zhugs te nye zho med par pho brang g.yu mtsho/

ltag tshang rong sogs dkyil 'khor gyi gnas rnams shin tu myur por 'khor bar mdzad cing*/ lam du gcong rong ya nga bar chu bo chen po rba klong mi bzod pa zhig gis lam 'gags pa na/ sā la'i ljon pa sbom zhing yal ga rgyas pas khyon kun 'gengs pa zhig /skyes bu chen pos ral gri g.yugs theng gcig gis sdum mer btang ste/ mi brgya phrag gis 'dren dgos snyam pa'i sdong po chen po de nyid rang gi dpung pa'i shugs kyis drangs te zam pa 'dzug pa las zhabs gras kun bde bar phyin par mdzad pa dang*/ zhing skyong gnas phyogs mi sus kyang gtam sogs skad cher bshad mi phod pa'i sa der slebs pa na smug rlangs shin tu 'thug pos lam gcig nas mnyam du yong ba'i mi sngon rjes kyang mi mthong bar gyur pa na/ skyabs rje mchog gis ki mdzad cing gzhan rnams la'ang ki bso rgyab bcol ste na bun rnams skad cig gis bya khyu rdos bkrog pa bzhin med par mdzad/ dpon g.yog kun gsol chas chad pa na dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang pos rtsam zhib kyi phung po byur bur spungs pa sogs ya mtshan dad mos 'phel ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas gsang gling brgyud lha gdan du gzhung sa'i zhabs brtan la phebs/ 'di skor bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi skal pas o rgyan dhā kis gsang lung bzhin rang don nye rgyu'i spyod pas sa lam gcig char du rdzogs pa'i grogs su gyur na'ang*/ gzhan don ltar snang 'byol nyog gi spyod pas bstan pa rin po cher mig ltos lod rkyen du dgongs pas thugs nyams su bzhes bzhed gtan nas ma gnang ba na/ phyi yi 'byung ba cha ma snyoms/ nang gi zla nyi'i khams ma gcig /gsang ba dhā ki'i lung dang 'gal ba'i bka' chad kyis/ rlung rnams rang sor ma tshud pas sku shin tu bltems shing zhing 'di'i mdzad pa bsdu ru nye ba na/ ltos bcas bla ma slob 'bangs kun gyis lha blar lung zhus dang 'brel bas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba rtse gcig tu gtab mthar lung las 'gongs pa'i thabs gzhan ma mchis pas rten 'brel gyi phyag rgya bzhes pas skabs de'i bar chad las grol bar byung zhing*/

thabs la mkhas pa'i myur lam gyi gnad ma go bar rtog ge tshu rol mthong ba rnams ni mkhris nad can la dung dkar ser snang gi dpes tha mal pa bzhin kha zer ba dag la/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i mdzad pa lung rigs kyis mngon gyur sgrub tu mchis na'ang*/ gsang ba bsgrags par ma spobs shing*/ skyes bu dam pa 'di lta bu yid la byas pas ngan 'brel du gyur pa'ang*/ 'brel tshad don ldan du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bdag 'dra'i mos zhen dad pas sgrubs shing bstod pa ni chags sdang bskyed byed du dogs shing*/ de las rang bzhin du 'jog pa nyid legs par mngon no//shing rta lor mtshur phur dge 'dun zur ri'i 'du khang gsar rgyag dang*/ pho brang nyams gso bcas mdzad/ dge rgyal dpal nga rgyal bla dam pa nas zhabs zhus kyis sman gyi nor bu rin po che yang zab ril bu dang*/ mang sbyor chen mo/ dbang ril shel dkar mchod rten sogs bstan 'gro'i sman yon gyi sgo gcig tu phyes shing sbyar bar mdzad/ lha sar jo khang thog tu bstan 'gro'i zhabs rim lung don gzhung chen pos bka' dang mthun rkyen gnang bzhin sgrub brgyud yongs kyi bstan srung tshe ring mched lnga'i rten 'dzug dang*/ bskang gsol rgyun 'dzug rnams mdzad/ bar der rje dbon chos dbang rin po che zhi bar gshegs pas mchod 'bul dgongs rdzogs gzhan 'gran med par gnang*/ shing lug dgung grangs nyer lngar phebs pa na/ slar yang 'jam mgon rin po che las thugs dam dogs sel/ bka' chos 'phros lus gsan bzhes dang*/ mjal 'dun bcas mi 'phrog pa'i dad pas khams su phebs rgyu'i thugs gtan gyis zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer bdun la chibs btegs/ 'di skor thugs nyams kyis gsungs sho lo ka thar thor 'dug pa mi 'thor ba'i ched rim bzhin bkod par bya ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nag chur phebs pa na/ dus kyis shugs kyis bskyed gyur pa'i//'gyur ba sna tshogs 'phel bzhin te//rtag chad 'dzin pa'i rnam thar mtshor//rnal 'byor can gyis rol rtsed bsgyur/
