/zhes dang*/ mdzes ma'i gdong gi zla bas ni//yid kyi chu skyes rmongs byed cing*//kun dā yi ni rgyun mtha' yas//'phel 'dis lus can rnam par bcom//zhes gsungs/ lam bar gyi mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro ba rnams kyi mos 'dod bzhin mthong grol zhwa mjal dang 'brel bas zhal ston/ drang nges chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed pa sogs thar pa dam pa'i sgo skal cir yang 'gyed bzhin dpal spungs nas chibs bsur mgron gnyer sngar lam ltar mkhas dbang bla ma bkra 'phel mngags pa sgis snar mjal ste mtshams zhus mjal dar sogs phul/ de phyin mgron gnyer zhabs zhus kyis/ nang chen/ karma brgyud zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun la dpal spungs su byon grub te/ tshes nyer brgyad nyer dgur dgu gtor tshogs phebs gnang*/ me sprel zla ba dang po'i tshes lnga la tsā 'dra'i yang khrod du 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdun phebs/ dkon spyi'i tshe dbang dang*/ tshogs 'khor bcas gnang*/ tshes brgyad la 'jam mgon rin po cher zhabs brtan phul/ tshes bcu gsum la zhal nas/ dus kyis skyed pa'i skyed tshal bzhin//o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i ye shes nyi//rang byung klong yang rdo rje'i glu//ma 'dres rang gi mkha' na bkra/ aho ye/ snod ldan dus bab byin ldan kyang*//gsang ba brda' yi rang sgra 'di//kun gyis nyams su len par dka'//de phyir mi snang dbyings kyi rgya/ dha thim//zhes gsungs/ 'di skabs rje bla ma'i mdun nas/ bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang chen yongs rdzogs zhib rgyas/ gdams mdzod dang*/ rin gter kha skong gi dbang lung*/ 'jam mgon rang gi zab gter gsang mdzod dang*/ bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ nang brtag rgyud gsum gsung bshad zhib mo nyams khrid dang 'brel ba/ bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud rin po che zhes mtshan don mtshungs pa'i zab chos nā ro chos drug mthar thug rnam nges dbu ma chen po/ nges don 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po/

blo 'das byar med rdzogs pa chen po rnams kyi zab khrid sngon dngos rjes gsum tshang ba re re nas nyams bzhis kyis sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang nyams myong man ngag snyan brgyud skor bcas/ gang bzhugs thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis ma lus pa rdzogs par gsan ste don brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i bdag por gdod nas grub bzhin/ slar yang ye shes dgongs brgyud 'pho ba'i byin rlabs kyis yab sras dgongs pa dbyer med ye shes gcig gi rol pas snying po don gyi rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur/ don brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i bstan pa rin po che phyag tu gtad pas/ dngos grub rnam gnyis nyams 'og tu tshud/ 'khor 'das thams cad bsam mi khyab pa'i brjod bral bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chen po gcig tu dbang 'byor bas/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu'i bdag nyid/ chos kyi rgyal po/ nges pa don gyi sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa nyid do/ /de dag gi skabs su zhal nas/chos brgyad 'ching ba dam pos//blo dman srin bu 'thum kyang*//gnas lugs rtogs pa'i seṅge//'jigs med dbyings su 'phyo 'gro//'dir snang 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo//mig 'phrul sgyu ma'i grong khyer//zhen 'dzin bdud kyi g.yab mo//bden med rtogs pas bzlog dang*/ /zhes dang*/ bde chen rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni//lhun grub bzang mo'i dbyings na gnas//sku gsum sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar//lhun grub snang bzhi'i dbyings na bkra/ /zhes dang*/ 'gyur bde 'pho ba'i rang bzhin//'pho med rtsi yis 'chings dang*//bden med smrig rgyu'i grong khyer//'khrul pa'i rgya mdud zhig 'dug/ces gsungs shing*/ bar der yul bdag chen po rma rgyal spom ra nas/ gser rdog rdo rje pha lam/

gzi byer bcas dngos su phul ba byung*/ dad sbyin rnams kyis zhus ngor skyabs mgon rin po che nyid phebs ma grub kyang don grub sprul sku dpon g.yog la thad du 'dod skong phyir mngags btang mdzad/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal spungs nas chibs btegs/ 'dzi sgar lha thog brgyud karma dgon du phebs/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes dgu la mgon gsol rgyas pa gsungs shing*/ mgon nag shod zhal phyes pa na/ dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' klas pa dang*/ las mgon gyi rten gri dngos su phyag tu phul/ de nas zla nang*/ zur mang brgyud/ skyo thag tu phebs/ gsal bstan dung gsum sprul sku rnams gtsug phud blangs te khrir 'don mdzad/ rag shul brgyud sga khog khra ban la phebs/ rim gyis 'dan gzhung nas me bya zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal spungs su 'khor/ de rnams kyi tsher/ zhal nas/ snang grags ye shes rol mo'i dbyings//bde ba chen po'i 'du ba la//gnyis 'dzin 'ching ba'i mdud pa'i rgya//ka dag dbyings su 'khor gsum bral/ /zhes dang*/ bde chen las kyi phyag rgyas//blo 'das ye shes bstan byung*//'pho med dang la zhog dang*//tshe 'dir rig 'dzin thob 'dug /ces dang*/ yang*/ log rtog gnyis 'dzin mdud pa//mtshan med dbyings su grol song*//mi gnas ye shes sa la//lhun gyis grub par 'dug go/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/ bde chen phyag rgya bzhi yis//gnas skabs bzhi yi ngo 'phrod//sku bzhi'i ye shes rang zhal//'khrul med mthong ba nga skyed/ /zhes dang*/ 'od gsal don gyi ye shes//rnam kun mchog ldan gzugs mdzes//lta sogs 'khor gsum bral bar//rgyun du gzigs mo mdzod dang*//zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ bstan 'gro'i don gyis so so'i blo yid tshim pa dang*/ dgon sde rnams la bsnyen bkur/ gsol ras/ mgon khang khag la spyan gzigs phrin bcol sogs mdzad/ don grub sprul sku rin po che ston 'khor dbu thon gyis dpal spungs su 'khor/

'jam mgon bla ma rin po che yang dgon du phebs nas/ yab sras zhal rgyas pas bka' brgyad sgrub chen khrom dbang*/ mar me'i smon lam bcas nyin bcu yi khongs su grub par mdzad/ de yi bar skabs su'ang*/ bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur//zab gsal ye shes nyi ma//snying gi dkyil nas shar byung*//byams pa'i 'od 'bum bkyes dang*//yang*/ kun+dā bde ba'i grong khyer//shes rab lha mos bsnyegs pas//mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes//'pho med dbyings su bzhugs song*//zhes gsungs/ si tu rin po che la tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang*/ dpal spungs bla brang rtse shod kyi mgo 'dzin klad gzigs/ dbu chos gnyer pa sogs bsko bzhag /'dus pa la dbang dang bslab ston zhal bkod bcas bstsal/ 'jam mgon rin po che dang phan tshun mi phyed pa'i gsol smon bcas thon phyag mjal dar phul bzhes kyi/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bdun la si tu'i yang srid/ mkhan bla ma rin po che bcas phebs bskyel gyis/ lhan rgyas gzhi khre mar zhag bzhugs mdzad/ phyir nang phan tshun mjal dar 'bul gnang bcas thugs phreng bzhin chibs btegs/ tshes bco brgyad mdo gzhung du phebs pa na/ e ma nyon mongs mi bzad tsher ma dang bral bsam gtan zhi ba'i nags klung du//bzod pa dam pa bsil ba'i rang bzhin mchog tu ldan pa tshul khrims sa mchog dri bzang 'thul//sbyin pa'i yal 'dab 'khor yug kun khyab shes rab grib bsil mdzes par gtibs pa bde gshegs tshal//gang der brtson 'grus rkang pas bgrod de mchog gi bde chen dam pa pha rol phyin thob shog/ces gsungs shing*/ gter sgar nas rim gyis zur mang rnam rtser phebs/ bar der khra 'gu ba'i phebs rdzong 'bul skyes bcas byung*/ zhal nas/ shin tu zhi ba ye shes khams//gar yang phyin med phya le ba//lhun grub mnyam yangs bde ba che//me rtog spros bral e ma ho//zhes gsungs/ snyan brgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs gar btsug

/byin rlabs kyi zil dang nyams snang sna tshogs su shar ba byung*/ de skabs zla nang nas rje dbon don sprul rin po che zhi bar gshegs pas thugs g.yengs dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gzab rgyas mdzad/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bdun la zur mang nas btegs/ tshes nyer gcig nang chen sgar du phebs/ kar lugs mgon po rgyun 'dzug gsar bzhag gi rten gtor bca' sgrub dang*/ dbang lung rnams mdzad/ tshes nyer dgu nas rim gyis phebs pa'i lam bar kun tu gzhan don phrin las nyag gcig gis phan bde'i dga' ston stsal bzhin zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bdun la gdan sa chen po 'og min mtshur mda'i gzhal med khang du chag phebs te/ pho brang nyams gso grub par gzigs rtog dang*/ mgon khang bdud dpung zil gnon zhal phyes te gtang rag legs 'bul spyan gzigs rgya cher 'bul gnang dang*/ mgon khang khag la de mtshungs gzab gsol snyan shal spyan gzigs bcas dang*/ 'tshogs mang la phyag 'gyed dang*/ dgu gtor chen mo'i 'chams chas yongs rdzogs spus nam ldan pa gsar bskrun bcas gnang*/ chos dbang rin po che'i gdung zhugs 'bul gdung rten gzungs 'jug sogs dang*/ rje dbon don grub sprul sku rin po che'i mchod bsngo dgongs rdzogs 'phros rnams grub par mdzad/ lho 'brug chos rgyal krong sar dang smon lam dbang gis mchod yon thun min du gyur pas sa khyi zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas lo ltar lo sar zhal sgo dang*/ rnam kun skyabs rten sogs 'bul mi gzim sgar pa mngags btang chad med du grub/ 'brug thim rdzong ab rgan mi phyed pa'i dad pas zhal mjal du lhags te/ 'brug chos zhal thang sogs spam mtho'i dngos rdzas gya nom pa 'bul bzhes dang*/ phar yang dal 'byor don ldan gyi chos bka' sogs kyis smin par mdzad/ phag mo'i dbang chas bzang gos las bskrun pa cha gangs sum cu skor gsar sbyor dang*/ lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes lnga nas rata gling tshe gsang phyi nang gsang sgrub kyi sku mtshams mdzad pas/

gu ru yab yum gyi zhal ston/ dbang dang gdams pas rjes su bzung ba sogs/ rnam kun dag snang sna tshogs 'bral med kyi yon tan ngo mtshar ba nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin lhan skyes su mnga' ba gdon mi za bas thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar lta bu'i brjod byas phongs pa ni mi srid na'ang*/ gsang ba'i gnas rnams bkral ba'i blo gros kyi mig phra bas mthong thos de tsam las ji bzhin 'byed pa'i go skabs ma rnyed cing*/ sa phag zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas bde mchog ljags bsnyen dbu btsugs/ tshes bcu bdun la khams nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i phyag bris rta shad bcas 'byor bzhin 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i yang srid kyi dgongs brtags zhu lan zhib dkrigs dang*/ bkra shis nyi zla zung 'jug g.yas su 'khor//bkra shis chos kyi dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil//bkra shis gser gyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor//bkra shis rnams kyis rtag tu shis gyur cig/ces gsungs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu nas sku mtshams grol te/ chags med rin po che lnga pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin las/ gnam chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan bzhes dang*/ 'du khang steng gsar bzo'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug chog gi rab gnas/ tshes bcu'i 'chams chas su ba so'i ḍā ru gsar bzhag /zur ri drung par gdan sa'i mkhan po'i bsko 'ja' dang*/ nyag gter bsod rgyal la zhal 'phros smrar ba bcas gnang*/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer drug nas tshig bdun bla sgrub ljags bsnyen dang*/ mtshams rgya ring mthud kyis phag mo'i phyi nang gsang gsum bsnyen tshad kha skong bcas mthar phyin pa dang*/ chos drug sngon 'gro dngos gzhi bcas nyams bzhes su gnang ste/ de nas bzung*/ sgyu lus dang bar do dus rgyun lam khyer lta bus sbyang khul dang*/ 'pho ba nyin bdun ring thun re ma chags par sbyang bas nyin gnyis nas rtags thon pa tsam byung*/ 'od gsal dang rmi lam yang rgyun ldan skyong khul byas pas 'od gsal zin nam snyam pa theng gcig gnyis dang*/

rmi lam ngo shes pa tsam lan gcig las yong ma myong bas/ bdag 'chi dus chos pa'i mal na tha mal pa'i ro las yong rgyu med nges red do/ /ces gsungs shing*/ lcags lug zla 4 tshes 1 la dpal spungs ri khrod nas 'jam mgon rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnal ba'i mchod 'bul mkhan 'byor bas sku mchod gzab rgyas nyin gsum la mdzad/ de skabs 'jam mgon mchog gi ye shes skus byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam pa'ang bstan/ lcags glang zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la 'jam mgon bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs 'dus pa zhib 'tshogs kyis bla ma mchod pa stong mchod dang 'brel ba'i mchod 'bul mdzad/ lo de'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gar 'chams gnang skabs snang sems ro gcig tu 'dres shing gu ru rin po che dngos su byon pa'i thugs nyams dang*/ phyir nang yang 'ja' gur khyad mtshar bla g.yel du yun ring gnas shing*/ phyogs mtshams kun tu 'ja' ris mdog dbyibs sna tshogs su shar ba kun gyis mthong snang du gyur/ a mdo sku 'bum rgya yag er thi ni byon pa dang mjal 'phrad gnang*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la yangs can dgon yul rnams kyi 'dod skong du chibs btegs/ tshes nyer bzhi la yangs can dgon du zhing skyong bka' gtad dang*/ kar lugs zhing skyongs gar 'chams gsar 'dzug dang*/ sde yul kun gyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bar mdzad/ slar mtshur phur phebs nas 'brug chen rin po che sogs la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gtsos pa'i dbang lung so so'i zhus don bzhin stsal/ chu stag zla ba gsum pa'i tshes dgu nas thugs gsang sgrub chen dang*/ zla ba drug pa'i nang bkra shis gsar mar mkhar nag rten 'dzug /gzhung zhabs bka' brgyad bzlog pa dang*/ bar lam kun tu 'dod skong gi mdzad brel rgyun ma chad pa bcas/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu dgu nas mtshams rgyas sngon 'gro nas brtsam/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i ljags bsnyen mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i bar du/

lo mjug dgu gtor tshogs dbur phebs/ 'chams sku rnams kyi zhal mdangs legs shing lhag par mgon po'i zhal dbyibs gzhon sha can kun gyi mthong chos ngo mtshar bar gyur/ chu yos lo mgor gong gi ljags bsnyen 'phros gnang*/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bzhi zur rir bka' brgyad sman sgrub/ gzhan yang gzhung zhabs phur zlog gi gtsos rkyen sel zhabs rim/ phyogs kyi 'dus pa rnams la sngags mdzod sogs kyi dbang lung chos 'brel bar med dang*/ shing 'brug zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer lnga nas dbu bzung bka' brgyad sgrub chen tshes gnyis bar mdzad/ slob 'bangs rnams la sgrub dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ khrom dbang bcas gnang shing*/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsang lung bzhin phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel yang mdzad pas lam lhongs su gyur/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes lnga nas dgongs 'dus tshogs sgrub sman sgrub sbrel ma nyin bcu bar mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug la 'brug sku zhabs krong sar dpon 'khor nyung ba bsdus kyis phebs par bzhed skong dang*/ bar mtshams su rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin khrid rgyab brten bcas stsal zhing*/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang dgu gtor mchod rdzas mthongs skor zla bral gsar bzheng yang mdzad/ shing sbrul zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu drug nas sku mtshams skabs/ sog po thog rgod dpon mo nas mngags gnang bzhin gos sku shin tu spus legs 'byor zhing*/ bod khams bde ba'i rten 'brel smon lam gyi ched du zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu la lung bab bzhin gsang stabs kyis lha sar zla ba drug pa'i nang 'khyugs tsam phebs ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bdun la phyir slebs/ thugs dam bsnyen bzlas dang 'gro phan phrin las ya ma bral bar rgyun skyong gis/ me rta zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga gnas rten khag la mchod 'bul gzab rgyas dang 'brel bas bstan 'gro spyi dang bod yul bde ba'i smon lam yang yang mdzad/

zla ba gsum pa'i nang thugs gsang bum sgrub mdzad pas ril bu 'phel ba sogs myong grol grub pa'i rtags khyad par ba byung*/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas sku mtshams kyis sgrol ma dang*/ thugs dam mgon yang du mgon po'i ljags bsnyen bcas gnang ba na/ nang gcig tshag sgra drag po bcas gzhong pa rnam dag gi gtor ma thod snod du bsham pa nyid ling gis bskor ba zhig rgyab ste gtor zhal skyabs mgon mchog la phyogs pa dang*/ nyams dang rmi lam kun mi nag po zhig gis lung bstan pa sogs rtags thon par byung zhing*/ lo mjug dus gtor 'tshogs phebs kyis 'chams dang zor lam sogs rten 'brel dge bar gyur/ me lug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga nyin spyi sger nas sku keg thog phebs pa la zhabs brtan zab rgyas legs 'bul bcas zhus/ bar mtshams kun tu gzhung sa'i zhabs brtan/ bstan 'gro'i re skong*/ bla brang phyi nang gzigs skyong bcas gnang ste/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi nas sku mtshams kyis rgyal khams ris med bde ba'i smon lam gsol 'debs 'bum ther gsungs kyang rten 'brel 'bring smad las yong ma thub/ tshes nyer brgyad nas ma mgon ljags bsnyen gyi lo mjug dus gtor zhabs 'chams sne gsum la phebs/ 'di lo nas bzung*/ mgon po'i gos sku gshams te/ rgyal dbyangs bla g.yel du mdzad/ sa sprel lor skabs su sku mtshams dang*/ bar mtshams kun tu phyogs kyi ser skya rnams kyi 'dod skong gson gshin 'gro don chad med dang*/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu nyin sku tshab bcu gsum spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar gsang 'dus le'u brgyad ma dang*/ gsang thig bla sgrub bcas kyi tshogs mchod rgyas par phul/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i spar gsar brkos kyi nyer bsdogs mdzad/ 'brug nas sku zhabs krong sar gzims sgar ched mngags mdun/ dza pan yul nas bskrun pa'i glang chen mche ba che legs la/

mnyam med don kun grub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur dod du brkos pa bzo dbyibs rgyun ma srid na dkon pa phul ba phyag tu 'byor bas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs shing dus mtha' 'dir yang mtha' 'khob yul nas bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi mdzad pa bzhengs pa'i ngo mtshar gyis thugs shin tu mnyes/ thugs rtsol gnang ba'i rol mo spus legs nyer gnyis/ sil snyan legs pa nyi shu bcas gtan bzhag dang*/ gsar rnying tshang mar lung dang sgril tshal sogs grab mtshungs spus legs gsar bzos mdzad/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig la gong ma bdag po chen po gnam du gshegs pa dang*/ tshes nyer gnyis rgyal yum sku tshe'i ma zin pa bcas la thugs smon sgrib sbyang dang*/ bla ma chos dbyings nas stong nag dgon par dgu chen gsar 'dzug yod pa'i snyan sgron phul bas phod ka gcig dang*/ 'bag bdun bcas gsol ras stsal/ gdan sa chen po'i cho ga phyag bzhes dbyangs rol gar 'chams sogs la dag ther zhus dag gnang*/ 7gong sa chen po rgya nag pho brang nas zla tshes bco brgyad la bod du chibs bsgyur bka' drin dang*/ phebs bsu'i bka' rgya bcas 'byor/ lo mjug dus gtor 'chams dang zor 'dzin rting nan bcas gnang*/ sa bya zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la nyi ma'i byang ngos su nyi gur 'dra ba'i 'ja' bkrag med phyed pa zhig yun ring shar zhing*/ nyi ma yab pa dog dmar zhad can du byung bas/ skyabs rje mchog gi sku tshe'i bar chad phran bu dang*/ bod 'dir dus zing gi rtags su gzigs/ tshes nyer lnga la sku khams rnyogs pas snga bar dus mchod dang*/ gsang thig yum bka'i tshogs mchod bshags bskang rgyas par btang*/ rten 'brel gso byed gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa phyogs 'thus dang*/ bod yul bde ba'i rten 'brel smon lam bcas gnang ba na/ kha ba babs shing shar phyogs nas 'brug skad dal snyan ldir bas rten 'brel cung zad sor chud par mngon/

bar mtshams kun tu rtsa gsum ljags bsnyen/ 'dod skong dbang lung 'chad spel 'khor yug tu gnang*/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu'i 'tshogs dang sku 'chams la phebs/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gong sa chen po'i chibs bsu mjal phyag la chibs btegs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig khra tshang la khar zhal mjal phyag 'bul zhus/ tshes gsum nag chu dbu dgur 7gong sa chen po pho brang du phebs 'phral dgyes ston la zhabs bcar dang*/ tshes drug mdzad chen grub 'phral gzim chung du nang mjal zhus pas bdag rgyan legs par bka' yi dbugs dbyung bcas bka' drin stsal/ tshes brgyad snga bar btegs te zla ba dgu pa'i tshes drug la mtshur phur phebs/ yar mar lam 'khod kyi skye rgu rnams la 'gro don chos sbyin gyis yid tshim par mdzad/ gzhung sa'i bka' 'brel dgon gyi bslab sdom zhib mthar/ bca' khrims bcas dgon zho la rnams la dam sgrags tshan nan gnang*/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku mtshams kyis bzhugs par/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gcig la dpa' bo rin po che dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal bas mtshams tho bsdus te gnas nang du nyung bsdus kyis phebs/ thugs dam gsal 'debs dgongs rdzogs skor dang*/ sngar lam gzim chung nang rten phyag dpe khang sogs tho bkod tham 'dzugs kyi do dam gnang*/ tshes nyer lnga sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus par ljags ma tshigs par byon/ tshes nyer bdun la yar phebs/ sngar 'phros ljags bsnyen mtshams rgya dang*/ bar du gzhung zhabs grub thob bka' brgyad bzlog pa/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu drug nas nyin gsum la 7gong sa chen po pho brang du phebs pa'i dga' ston mdzad/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum la sku mtshams grol ste/ lo mjug dus gtor sogs snga rgyun bzhin dang*/ lcags khyi lor/ rnga 'khyams yongs rdzogs kyi 'chams gos bzhi bcu zhe gsum gsar tshems dang*/ rin gter zhu dag

/phur pa'i zhal 'bag gsar bzo gnang ba'i gsal rab gnas/ thugs gsang sgrub chen bcas mdzad/ bar 'tshams dbang chos 'dod skong dang*/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nas sku mtshams bzhugs par/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gcig la zur mong gter ston a sgrub 'byor bas/ sngon du 'jam mgon rin po che'i zhal nas karma pa'i sku rabs re la bar chad sel zhing phrin las spel ba'i gter ston tshad ma re yong ba red/ des na skyabs mgon rin po che rang gi sku tshe mdzad phrin la phan pa'i dus babs kyi gter ston tshad ma zhig /da ste zur mang nang chen phyogs nas 'byung bas de la sne len rten 'brel ma 'dzol bar mdzod ces bka' chems bzhin/ nang chen khul nas yin pa'i gter ston yin zer tshad la rnam kun 'dri zhib re byed gin yod pas/ dus der yang mtshams khongs su tshes nyer bzhi la ngos 'phrad gnang bas/ rang gi rmi lam nyams sogs gang cir da res 'di legs po zhig byung bas rten 'brel ma 'gags tsam du/ gzim chung mdor zab gter phur pa'i cha lag tshe sgrub kyi cho ga zhig gtong bcol pa yin zhes gsungs shing*/ phyis su bdag rang chos dred mgo 'khregs song gshis gter rdzun mang bas l+h+wam dpe zhwa 'gebs kyis zur mang gter ston 'di pa 'brug rgyal sogs kyis rtsi bskur rgyu stobs che bas/ sne len gnang ba tsam las gter ston tshad ma rang e yin snyams pa'i dogs gnas las/ zhe gting gi dad 'dun sogs gtan nas skye ma myong bas/ skabs shig rgyal dbang rin po che'i mdun 'phros mol zhig gi skabs/ zur gter 'di tshad ma yin min bka' 'dri zhus pas/ gong gi 'jam mgon rin po che'i bka' chems dang*/ de rjes khong gi gter chos tshe sgrub de kho pas nyams bzhes gnang bas/ dus mi ring bar rtags snang thon pa zhig 'dug stabs kho bo nas tshad mar bzung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang da phyin khyed rang gis kyang 'di yi mtshams sgrubs shig gyis dang*/

dngos nyams rmi lam gyi 'grub rtags yid ches skye ba gzhan la yin min dri brtsad mi dgos pa zhig 'dug ces phebs pas/ de phyin gus rmongs nas kyang dag snang ci skye byed pa las log lta byed phod ma myong*/ tshes nyer drug nas tshe gsang gsungs/ bar der 'dzi sgar rin po che dpon slob dang mjal 'phrad/ skyes rabs zhal thang gsar bzhengs gong sham bzos/ rgyal tshab rin po che sogs la mi tra brgya rtsa gtsos dbang chos gnang*/ lo mjug dus gtor 'chams sogs gang legs dang*/ mgon po'i sbyin sreg la phebs pa'i me rgya smug mthong ma myong ba zhig 'bar bas kun kyang ngo mtshar skyes par gyur/ lcags phag lor phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams la dbang lung zab khrid mos pa bzhin stsal skyong dang*/ a mdo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dpon slob hrag bsdus drug cu skor zhal mjal du phebs/ rgyal dbang rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan por mdzad/ gos sku mthong grol chen mo'i mjal kha gnang*/ zla ba drug pa'i nang yangs can dgon du phebs te zhing skyong rten mdos bca' sgrub dang*/ phyogs de'i re skong phan bde'i btsas rnams sgrub/ gangs dkar sha med kyis dam tshig gi rdo rje khyad par can dngos su phul/ mtshur mdor pho brang nyams gso dang*/ gzhung gi bstan rim rata phur sgrub chen smad las sbrel ma dang*/ lo mjug sku mtshams thugs dam dgu gtor sogs snga rgyun bzhin gnang*/ chu byi lo sar nas gzhan don 'chad rtsams/ bla brang gi gzigs skyong*/ thugs dam nyams bzhes bar med dang*/ lhag par zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la lha chen sku hril po/ gu ru tshe dpag sogs la gser zhal/ nyer sras brgyad chog 'brel ba'i stong mchod/ lha khang khag la brgya mchod snyan shal bcas gangs can bde ba'i gsol smon nan tan dang*/ sprang ston spam mtho dge rtsar 'gyur nges gnang*/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu drug la 'jam mgon bla ma'i phyag mdzod tshe ring don grub dpon g.yog 'byor/

'jam mgon rin po che'i zab gter gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga khyad 'phags/ 'jam mgon rnam gnyis mchog gling lhan rgyas kyis sing du g.yu mtsho nas bzhes pa'i gter gser phag mo'i rang byon ngo mtshar can bcas phyag tu phul bas/ snga nub rten 'brel la zab gnad kyi rmi ltas kyang byung bas thugs dgyes tshor gnang*/ zla ba bcu pa'i nang dam sri langs pa'i ltas gzigs pas zhabs 'phar phur zlog dam sri mnan pa bcas dang*/ lo mjug dus gtong la ma thug bar sku mtshams dang*/ dgu chen sngar rgyun bzhin legs lam du gyur/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug la gangs can mgon po rgya gar nas chibs bsgyur gyis pho brang chen por zhabs 'khod/ chu glang zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu nas sku mtshams kyis bzhugs pa'i tshes bco lngar dus min 'chi zlog gi gsol smon dgongs klong nas rdol bzhin gnang*/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi sku mtshams gzhengs te/ 'dod skong phyag las rtsag rtsig rigs grub pa dang*/ tshes nyer dgu lha gdan du phebs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bzhi nor gling du gong sa chen po'i zhabs pad du bcar mjal thon sbrag ma zhus/ jo khang du stong mchod gtsos lha rten khag la mchod 'bul dang*/ dad 'dus rnams la sne len bcas gnang ste gang myur mtshur gdan du phebs/ thugs gsang myong grol sgrub chen dang*/ tshes bcu chen mor zhabs 'chams sogs legs lam mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu drug nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin byed gnang ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la mtha' rten mnga' dbang*/ tshe dbang bcas grub par mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes dgu la mkha' 'gro dgyes byed kyi rten 'brel zhig brtsam pas don chen srub na legs tshogs kyi gzigs nyams byung 'dug pa/ bsod nams dbang gis phyag len du theb pa ma gyur rung*/ thugs dam bcad rgya'i khongs su bzhugs/ gnas skabs de nas dam grib dbang gis 'tshubs gegs kyi rnam par byung zhing*/

rgyal zla bshol ba phyi ma'i tshes nyi shu nas zhabs rim rten 'brel la nyams gsos su/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi skong chog mdzad/ tshes nyer dgu 'cham gzigs pas/ 'tshogs dang zhabs 'chams la phebs ma grub/ de skabs zhal nas/ mkha' 'gro khros pa'i rgyang ltas dang*//rdo rje g.yu yis lag skyor nas//chu chung zhig las bsgral nas slar//chabs pa'i nyams 'gyur ston pa mthong*//zhes gsungs/ shing stag zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bdun la thugs nyams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gzigs shing*/ snyan lam du'ang*/ kri na pi pa to bhun ḍa/ /bi u na si tsa mun ta/ /dur dum kun+tu ṭi o yi/ /su khaṃ ghi sho na mon ṭa/ /sin+tu ku ma la phu la she/ /te na bhu dza dzo ṇar kuṃ/ /e ṭa dzi ṇa ro ṣaduṃ/ /zhes mkha' 'gro'i brda'i glu de gsan pa'i rjes thog tu/ slar yang o rgyan dang phra men ma'i skad 'dres pa'i brda' tshigs skabs re'i nang du bod skad rkang pa gsum re gsan rgyu yod pa'i thugs nyams shar ba phyag bris su gtab pa ni/ snyigs dus pad+ma'i pho nyar mngags pa'i//skyes bu'i 'gro don rten 'brel mtha' mar//bab pa'i dbang gis bar chad mang po//de slad ḍā ki'i tshogs pa nged tsho//mi mo'i lus la zhugs pa'i reg byas//rtsa thig rlung gi skyon rnams sel zhing*//skal med khyed kyis mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor//kun tu rgyu yi tshogs kyi ston mos//mgu bya'i g.yar dam blangs pa dran nam//dam bcas shes bzhin tshig par byed pa'i//byis pa re blun phyi yi bshags pas//nang gi rten 'byung sor chud mi 'gyur//zhes 'dug pa dang chabs cig ka dag dbyings su sogs kyi skyo glu'ang mdzad/ 'di nub phyi dbugs nang dbugs chad pa theng bdun tsam byung*/ ha ha/ pak+shi'i grub rtags min kyang*/ ma yengs rang ngor bzhag pa'i drin gyis ma smad rnams re zhig dwa yugs gsum lus tsam byung*/

zhes gsungs shing*/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nas thugs gsang sgrub chen la phebs pa'i nyams snang du/ dbyings las bka' 'das bu khyod 'jig rten khams 'dir yun du mi bzhag ces zer zhing*/ zhag brgya dang lnga bcu tsam las mi bzhugs pa'i thugs nyams shar bas/ zhabs brtan tshogs 'bum bskul 'bum sogs sgrubs mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog gi rkyen gyis glo bur zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bzhir gdung sras rje btsun chos dbyings sgrol ma zhi dbyings su gzhol pas/ phyi nang gi rtags mtshan khyad par can byung zhing*/ dgongs rdzogs rlabs po che mdzad/ 'di skabs mi las 'das pa'i rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo mkha' 'gro'i brda' ru gzigs na'ang*/ ji bzhin skabs su khel ba ma byung zhing*/ snga mar 'brug pa'i lo sar 'bul ma'i gdongs/ rmis ltas su shar rigs zur gter mdun/ lo zlar ma nges pa'i grangs sum cu la khams 'tsho ba'i brda' ston dang*/ 'phar rtsa yang rtsa sdod lta bu rgyun ring song bas de la skyon yod med dogs gcod bka' 'dri phebs len la/ rtsa gsum tshogs skong stong phrag dang 'brel bas bla ma mkha' 'gror gsol 'debs phur tshugs su bgyis pa'i tho rengs shig tu nyams mi 'dres pa'i snang lam du/ bud med mang po'i tshogs kyis glu len pa'i skad la/ rten 'byung rab 'bring tha ma yi ngang tshul//lo dang phyed dang zla ba yi grangs can//snang ngor nges 'gro gnas tshul gyi gshis la//skye dang 'chi ba'i rang bzhin ni ma mthong*//khyed rnams mthong na dam skong la bsgrims shing*//pad+ma'i bcud kyi bdud rtsi yi ro la//phyogs med rol pa'i sgyu rtsal la sbyangs na//cung zad o ṭi bhu kha ṇi pa na//tsu ta bhi no tri du na a dzo dzo/ /a la la kūm̐ sin+dhu//zhes thos/ de'i 'phros glu len bzhin rgyang ring du ring du song nas ma thos shing*/ mi nyams 'di las sad ma thag tshigs bcad 'di dag yid la 'dug pas yi ger btab ste phul ba lags shing*/

de la rang gis rmongs dpyad pa gyis na rten 'brel rab la lo sum bcu so gsum/ 'bring la phyed lo sum cu so gsum/ tha mar zla ba sum cu so gsum e yin bsam pa dang*/ zhabs rim dam tshig skong ba'i chog sogs dang*/ gzhon nu ma'i ston mo dang*/ rigs ldan ma'i bcud len phyogs med brten gnang dgos rgyu'i don 'dra zhing*/ sngags tshig 'di dag gi don mi go 'dug pas zhes sogs gzhan yang gnad don mang tsam gyi 'phros su/ phyag rtsar skyon zhugs pa spyir sku 'tshubs la los lta yang*/ da lam gzungs ma rnam gnyis dang*/ sras mo rnams la cung 'tshubs 'dra zhes mkha' 'gro'i brda' lung bcas phul ba/ thugs nyams dang shin tu mthun cing sras mo'i don mngon gyur du zin pa bcas/ de phyin gter ston par yang yid ches blo brtan khel ba zhig byung zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang zhal nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer bzhir nam smad shar lho'i bar snang nas skya reng lta bu zhig shar ba'i sne rgyang ring po 'dra ba nas tshur a rigs kyi mi rgan sha skem pa/ gdong nyag cing sna mtho ba/ mdog smug po/ 'brum chag chen po yod pa/ mgo la tshar zhwa dang*/ gos kyang skya slog gyon pa shing gi mal khri skya bo gru bzhi'i nang skyil krung gis sdod pha zhig ling ling gis lding bzhin 'ong nas kho bo'i mdun du mar bab byung bar/ khyod su yin byas pas de na re/ bdag ni rgyal po shing bya can yin zer/ 'o na khyed chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma yin pas deng sang gtor ma bsngo mkhan ji tsam yod/ nged kyis gtor ma bsangs gsur bsngos pa rnams khyed la thob kyi 'dug gam byas pas/ de na re/ sngon tshe rig 'dzin gnam gyi skar mas//'dod rgu 'byor pa'i brngan pa//longs su spyod par mi khams//da lta gangs can 'di na//lho mon 'brug gi phyogs su//ban gyi gter ston bla ma gcig dang*//'di na khyed rang ma gtogs//nged cag 'byung po'i sde la//gtor gsur thob par bsngo mkhan//gzhan pa su yang mi gda'//zer bar de lta bu nged nas bsngos pa bzhin khyed rnams kyis thob na/

kho bos gnyer du gtad/ phrin las bcol pa thams cad khyed nas sgrub kyin los yod byas par/ kho na re/ khyod rang byang chub sems dpa'i//thugs la gtad pa mi 'dug/don chung gal med 'ga' la//nged tsho gnad nas gzir zhing*//don chen brnag pa'i las rnams//yal bar dor nas mi bskul//mdo med mdzad par ya cha//bka' bzhin byed pa lags te//sems la 'babs pa rang mi 'dug/zer zhing kho sngar ltar bar snang la lding nas byang shar ngos su phar ling ling byed cing song ba'i shul du/ du ba lta bu sngo skya lam lam zhig gis nam mkha' khengs snang shar ba'i skabs gnyid phal cher sad pa'i nyams snang la/ gong gi gter ston de zur mang gter ston bla ma 'brug phyogs bzhugs yod pas de yin par 'dug /gtor ma thob par bsngo mkhan nged gnyis las med par ga la srid kyang*/ lha 'dres ngo bstod ches pas khyad mtshar/ nged kyis don phra mo la nan gyis gzir zer ba ni sbyin bdag gi rkyen bzlog 'dra bgyis pas de yin par 'dug /gal chen la yal bar dor nas mi bskul bar 'dug zer ba ni/ dam log dang*/ bstan don yin rgyu ba'i rang don gal che'i rigs la ma rbad par byang chub sems la blo sbyong ba'i khul byas pa de la zer ba yin par 'dug snyams pa zhig shar ba'i skabs nyams de sad pa dang nam langs 'dug /ces dang*/ bar der dad 'dus rnams kyi mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i dbang khrid lung sogs chos sbyin bar med du stsal ba'i nub gcig /ye shes mtsho rgyal yin rgyu'i bod chas can gyi mdzes ma zhig gis khus nas dbyung ba'i grogs dag stsal zhing*/ brda snang khyad par ba bcas/ 'di ni 'jig rten dam tshig mkha' 'gro//ldog pa'i rnam 'gyur brda' ru shar ro//'di las dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa//da ni stong pas brten par mi rung*//zhes sogs kha yar stsal ba'i thugs nyams dang*/ lho 'brug phyogs su sbas yul a rgya gnas zhes pa sngar rje brgyad pa'i dus sgrub sde phyag 'debs mdzad shul bu le bla ma nas nyams gso byas yod pas dgon gnas mgo 'dzin/

byin rlabs rten ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ dgon par ming bcas stsal gnang zhus pa de bzhin zhal bzhes byin rten/ ye shes sems dpa'i rten sogs mos 'dod ltar dang*/ dgon pa'i ming la karma nges don bstan pa dar rgyas phun tshogs bsam gtan bde chen gling gi sde/ zhes gnang*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la rje btsun gshegs ma de nyid kyis skyes yum skal bzang dpal sgron thugs g.yengs chen pos ji gyur yang yang gsol ba btab pa na/ e ma/ shin tu stobs chen ye shes kyi snang cha/ /gzhon nu'i lang tsho 'dzin pa yi bu mo/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i snang tshul du shar gyi/ /don la ma grub bden zhen gyis ma 'chings/ /'byung ba chu yi rgya mtsho yi klong nas/ /rten 'byung dbang gis chu bur zhig shar mod/ /chu dang chu bur tha dad du med par/ /chu dang ro gcig dpe don la sbyor 'tshal/ /snang tshul tsam du rigs bzang gi bu mo'i/ /sgyu ma zhig pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'di zad de/ /dag pa rab 'byams dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros/ /mdun nas bsu zhing dga' ldan gyi lha yi/ /mchod pa dang bcas rig 'dzin gyi zhing khams/ /nub phyogs pad+mo bkod pa ru gshegs nas/ /ston pa pad+mo 'od snang gi mtha' yas/ /thugs ka'i klong du thim pa yi mod la/ /rang rig ye shes sangs rgyas kyi chos skur/ /chu la chu bzhin dbyer med du 'dres nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par ni nges so/ /don dam gnyug ma'i gnas tshul gyi gshis la/ /dag pa'i zhing dang sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa/ /gzhan du ma 'dzin spra 'chal gyi pha rgan/ /don grub rdo rje'i rang rig gi klong du/ /bu mo thim par sdug bsngal gyis ci bya/ /pha yi dgongs pa zag med kyi dbyings la/ /ston pa pad+mo mtha' yas de bzhugs kyi/ /nye ring blo yi ngal ba ni ma dgos/ /las smon gyis sbrel skal bzang gi gzung ma/ /rmi lam las kyang rmi lam du gyur pa'i/

/bden med sgyu ma'i 'khrul rjes su ma 'brang*/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rol mo 'dir gzigs nas/ /gnyis med spros bral bde chen gyi go 'phang*/ /khrob par bzang mo spro ba ni skyed cing*/ /byar med chos sku'i rang zhal 'di mjal nas/ /khyed kyang gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang*/ /dal rten 'di la thob pa zhig mdzod cig /de skad gtad med spra 'chal gyi pha rgan/ /smyo ba'i rdzun ris bden pa yang srid kyi/ /mdzes ma'i snying gi bcud phur du bsten phyir/ /gang shar yi ge'i phreng ba ru thal lo//zhes pa'ang a ma'i 'dod pa skong slad gang shar gyi ri mo mi 'debs dka' med gyur pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzod par mdzod cig /guh+ya/ zhes gsungs shing gnang*/ bar lam rnams su phyag chen rgya gzhung rje dgu pa'i bka' 'bum sogs 'chad spel brgyud mar stsal ba dang*/ tshe gsang ljags bsnyen bcas mdzad/ lho 'brug nas skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhabs brtan sgrub rten dngul rdil bcu bzhi phul bas/ rdor sems tshogs dang*/ dri med bshags rgyud 'bum ther/ yig brgya 'bum ther dgung grangs/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs skong me mchod rnams shin tu grangs mang*/ rdor sems stong sku sogs bsgrubs/ yang tshes nyi shu nub mo tho rengs khar nyams rmis 'dres mar/ sngags srung ma yin rgyu ba'i rtsis byed pa gsang grogs gzhon pa bde ldan ma lta bu zhig nas/ da res rdo rje g.yu sgron mar/ mnyam sbyor gsang ba'i pū dza yi/ /dga' ston chen po'i 'du ba la/ /cis kyang rol cig sogs zhus pa'i mur nyams de sad pas tshig mjug ma gsal zhes gsungs/ yang tshes nyer gnyis nyin tshe gsang dngos grub blangs pa'i nub mor/ rmi lam du chu bo rgyas pa dang*/ ne'u seng bkra ba sogs legs ltas dang*/ bud med rgan mo zhig nas 'di skor gyi chu 'di la ba tshwa 'dug pas gtan nas btung mi nyan/ lho phyogs kyi chu klung chen po'i dkyil de na chu ba tshwa med pa gcig 'dug pa de btung rung tsam zer ba'i brda' zhig smras byung ba'i don ji bzhin ma shes kyang*/

dam grib yod pa'i lung par ma sdod ces pa'i brda' yin nam snyam zhes gsungs/ zla ba de'i tshes nyer bzhi spen pa snar ma'i 'grub sbyor la sku mtshams kyis nam mkha'i rdo rje'i gter gsar rdo rje phur pa'i cha lag tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig gi ljags bsnyen gnang ba'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis nub rmis ltas 'tshubs pa dang*/ khyad par rigs sras gsum las gcig tsam zhig bzhugs rgyu red e yong*/ de min gnas skabs zhing gzhan du 'gro rgyu red zer ba'i mkha' 'gro'i brda' lung yin rgyu ba bcas zar zir shin tu mang ba zhig byung ba 'di skor mkha' 'gro'i brda' dang*/ bdud kyi cho 'phrul gang yin ma nges zhes gsungs yang*/ dpyad na gdung sras gsum gyi sku tshe dngos yin par mi snang zhing*/ dad dam gtsang zhing bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin nus pa la yin pa gor ma chag pas lung don logs sogs gtan nas mi srid la/ tshes bzhir mtshan ltas dge zhing*/ thun mong min pa'i lung byang kyang phyag tu phog par byung*/ tshes bcu drug zla dgon la sku thang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ spyan gzigs gnam gshams rgyal mtshan/ phye phur/ ka 'phan/ gos yol/ dbang gos rgyan gzhi sogs kyi 'cham gos lnga/ stod le gsum/ zhal 'bag bco lnga/ brgya kong*/ tsā dī'i rkang gling sogs gya nom spam mtho stsal/ tshes bcu dgur tho bsdus te gling kha 'og tu phebs/ slar yang mtshams rgya'i khongs su bzhugs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la slob dpon lags gtsos chibs bsu sum cu skor sogs sngar lam ltar phebs zhus kyis si tu rin po che dpon 'khor khams nas 'byor ba pho brang du bzhugs/ tshes nyer lngar tho bsdus te mjal 'phrad bzhugs ston bcas gnang*/ tshes nyer bdun nub mor/ gling kha 'og lta bu skyed mos tshal rgyas pa zhig gi nang der kho bo dang*/ g.yogs rigs 'das gson mang po dang bcas 'dug skabs lho ngos kyi bar snang nas tshur nged kyi mgo thog tu sprin dang na bun gyi snam bu sngo skya srab mo zhig ta ler byung ba de lung pa'i phar tshur bar zam pa lta bu zhig chags/

nged rang gi lus de yar bar snang du btegs snang zhig shar nas snga ma'i sprin de'i steng slebs 'dug pa'i mgo yi thod du 'ja' gur 'dra min sna tshogs shar zhing me tog gi char pa sa la bab tu med pa'i bar snang gi dgung du ling ling phar bskyod tshur bskyod byed pa la g.yog po de rnams ngo mtshar byed pa dang*/ nub phyogs nas mtshur phu dgon 'dra ba'i dgon pa legs po zhig nas nged la bsu ba'i ser phreng gi bkod la rgyas par byed 'dug pa rmis pa bzang ngan ci yin ma shes zhes gsungs shing*/ yang tshes nyer brgyad nub mo mkha' 'gro ma mang po byi'u mchil pa'i gzugs su byung ba dang*/ grwa pa dang byis pa kha shas nas de rnams la rtsed 'jo'i rnam pas khang pa'i sgo dang skar khung rnams 'gag nas ngan byed 'dug pa dang*/ ri ngos shin tu gzar bar rang byes bgrod kyi sgar pa bab yod rtsis yang*/ mun pa rub pa'i smag gis mi mthong zhing g.yang sar lhung grab yod skabs mi zhig nas phyi gling pa'i 'phrul me zhig spar byung ba'i mthus gsang bar ma 'gril tsam gyis thar pa dang*/ 'di'i tshes sum cu nyin nyi myur spre'u'i steng nyi 'dzin yod pa de yin rtsis gyis/ yang snying mi mang pos/ da nyi ma bzung song zer zhing rol cha ldir 'dug kyang*/ bzung ba dngos mi mthong 'dug par bud med zhig nas shel mig 'di gyon nas ltos dang zer byung ba bzhin/ shel mig de mig la bkab nas bltas pas/ nyi ma 'od zer shin tu che zhing dwangs pa la/ 'og nas yar rma bya'i sgro thig gi dkyil lta bu byas nas nag thig ger gzas bzung ba mthong rgyu 'dug pa'i ngang*/ nyi ma de 'od hril hril byed pa skar mda' bzhin rgya lha'i ri rtse nas nub song ba'i rjes nas nyi ma de slar lta rgyu yod rtsis dang*/ nyi ma de da lta gzhu snye mor sdod yod zer zhing*/ rgya lha'i ri yi steng nas kho bo'i lag pas mar mnan nas yol ba'i gong nas bltas pa bzhin bltas kyang phar nang du ri de mtshungs mang pos bsgrib nas ma mthong*/

zhes gsungs pa'ang ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa'i brdar snang la/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga la pho brang du yar phebs/ zla bzang sprul sku la zhal mjal gnang*/ lo mjug dus gtor la 'tshogs phebs dang*/ si tu rin po che'ang rang tshes nyer dgu la tshogs phebs mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes drug la skar 'dzin gyis si tu rin po che'i mdun nas bla ma dgongs 'dus gzhung pod yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung gsan/ 'brug nas bstan pa spyi bye'i rkyen sel zhabs brtan yon sbyor bzhin yab sras lhan rgyas nas rang phur sgrub chen khongs su dbal mdos bcas tshugs par mdzad/ dpa' bo rin po che'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gsal pos kun kyang yid gnyis bral ba gyur/ bar mtshams kun tu 'gro phan phrin las sgo ma 'gags pas skyong zhing*/ zla ba bzhi par tshes bcu'i gar 'chams dang*/ tshes bcu gcig khrom dbang zhwa mjal/ tshes bcu gnyis kun rtse nas glo bur nyin 'tshogs gos sku zhus bzhin mjal kha btang*/ tshes bcu gsum la gdung sras 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che khri 'don gyis bka' brgyud yab sras drug las/ si tu dang che mnyam mnga' gsol 'ja' sa thaṃ ka bcas gnang zhing*/ de bzhin phyogs kyi bla sprul dgon khag bcas pas brtsi srung dang*/ sku nar ma son bar ri khrod bla brang bcas pa'i phyi nang gzigs skyongs dbu 'don che bskur zhabs zhus rigs rang dngos dang mi gnyis pa'i khur bzhes gnang dgos zhes si tu rin po che la sger bcar zhal bsgos dang*/ de 'brel phyag mdzod sogs mdun 'dug rnams la'ang bslab ston bka' nan bcas gnang*/ tshes nyi shu rgyal tho bcas nyin bcu'i khongs su bka' brgyad sgrub chen sman sgrub bcas legs lam du gyur/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la si tu rin po cher legs 'bul dang*/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po cher sku skal bcas phul/ tshes bcu dgu si tu rin po che ston 'khor chibs btegs phebs bskyel sogs sngar lam ltar gnang*/

'di skabs si tu rin po che yun tsam lhing bzhugs thog /don brgyud rin po che'i bka' chos nang gnas smin khrid bcas gnang bzhed thugs re ci che yod 'dug na'ang mdzad brel gyis che bzhag chung thon lta bu zhig byung bar sems phreng yang skal ba de tsam du zad ces gsungs shing*/ thugs dgongs rdzogs pa zhig byung ma thub pa ni snying po'i bstan don la bsod nams kyi mthu phra bas 'byung 'gyur rten 'brel gyi bgo skal du mngon la/ tshes nyer lnga phyi ma'i nyin 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che khams phebs chibs bskyod kyis tshugs sa'i bar yab sras lhan rgyas kyis zhag bzhugs mdzad/ tshes nyer bdun la bkra shis smon lam bcas chibs bskyel gnang*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la gnas nang du phebs/ rje btsun dpa' bo rin po che'i sprul sku khrir 'don dang legs 'bul sogs mdzad/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gsum 'di'i nub tho rangs phyi ma'i snang tshul brda ru shar bzhin yi ger btab par mdzad/ phyis rten 'brel gyis 'di nyid sor gnas ma byung bas med par bcol/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum dgongs 'dus dbang gi sne sel dang*/ tshes bco lnga dgongs 'dus sa chog /tshes bco brgyad nas bum dbang chen mo'i 'jug pa sogs sgrub dbang chen mo zhib rgyas su stsal/ 'di nub bu mo zhig gis tshe chu phul ba dang*/ gter ston pa'i skor gyi brda' ston byung*/ 'di skor dgongs 'dus sgrub chen tsher nyin bzhin dbyangs rol sogs spros bcas mdzad pas/ nyin snga ma gnyis su sha rta'i spyan 'dren le tshan dbyangs gnang ba/ de yi nub ma gnyis su dgongs btsan nas mdun du phan tshun byon pa sogs cho 'phrul 'dug pa/ de yi phyir nyin btsan gyi spyan 'dren dbyangs btang bas de phyin cho 'phrul zhi ba sogs dbyangs gdangs 'di rigs rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i dgos gnad gal po cher 'dug ces gsungs shing*/

tshes nyer dgu nub mor 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang gi ye shes kyi skus dgongs 'dus kyi dbang yongs rdzogs dngos su bstsal ba sogs rtsa gsum zhi khro'i zhal gzigs lung bstan dgongs nyams khyad par can dang*/ slob ma rnams la'ang sgo gsum rnal du phebs shing bde stong gi nyams dang rtsol med kyi mos gus skye ba sogs dang*/ phyi rtags su'ang lung par drod skyes shing gnas khang byin chags pa dang*/ mar me brgya mchod chung ngu'i rigs rnams kyis kyang nyin bdun bar mched pa sogs byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i rtags snang mtha' yas pas/ kun kyang lha dang bla ma zab chos bcas par dad mos yid ches nges shes skyes par gyur/ lo mjug dus gtor tshogs phebs skor snga rgyun bzhin gnang*/ me 'brug zla ba dang po'i tshes nas zhabs brtan sogs rgya cher sgrub gnang dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyan sprul skor phebs 'byor la mjal kha dang*/ dbang lung chos tshan 'dod skong rigs dang*/ rta phag sku gsar bzhengs dang*/ 'brug nas gu ru'i sku 'byor ba bcas la gzungs 'bul rab gnas bcas gnang*/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu la gter ston rin po che phebs pas mjal 'phrad dang*/ dus mchod mdzad/ gter ston la tshe gsang don dbang gnang*/ gu ru'i sku tshab khyad par can phyag tu phul tshes bcu gsum la gter ston nas gter gsar tshe sgrub ye shes srog tig dang rjes 'brel mkha' 'gro'i sum bzlog zhabs brtan dang*/ tshe dbang don dbang*/ tshe rdzas/ tshe rgyud shog ser/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs dngos rdzas legs skyes bcas phul/ tshe rgyud shog ser las gter ston rin po che nas pha pa'i ma bzhin phyag bris gnang ste grub par mdzad/ tshes nyer brgyad nas mtshams tho bzhag ste/ gter gsar tshe sgrub gsungs/ gter ston rin po ches zhabs rim skor dang*/ mkhar nag klu rten rgya bskyed nyams gsos dang*/ klu chog bcas nyin grangs mdzad pa/ 'di skabs mkhar nag la phog thug shor rkyen rjes sor gter ston rin po che snyun gzhi dwangs med 'da' rkyen bcas 'dis yong bar 'dug ces gsungs shing*/

zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku mtshams grol ste cog grwa rin po che bdun pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas/ 'brug lugs rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang*/ jo nang rin 'byung*/ bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor yongs rdzogs/ pad dkar dang chos snang bka' 'bum/ las 'brel gza' pod/ shan dmar/ rdor gling bka' thang gnam lcags ma sogs kyi dbang lung rim can du gsan/ gter ston nas thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sgrub chen tshugs/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug nas gter chen sogs la sngar bzhin dgongs 'dus sgrub dbang yongs rdzogs/ phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams kyi mos 'dod bzhin sngags mdzod sogs zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' tshim par stsal/ bar mtshams su gter ston zhabs rim rkyen sel dbang khrus sogs kyang nyin bzhin mdzad/ de nas gter ston rin po che 'brug tu phar phebs rgyu'i dgongs bzhed skabs rang gi sku tsher rje btsun dpa' bo rin po che dang ngo mnyams kyi yab sras 'bring po'i 'ja' sa gdan thob sogs gnang ste mnga' gsol bstsal/ phyogs mtha' nas lhags pa'i mjal zhus rnams kyi sne len dang*/ bla brang phyi nang mdzad sgo rigs kyang tshags su tshud par gnang*/ lo mjug dus gtor chags med dang*/ me sbrul lor rdor slob zur pa bla ma legs bshad la mkhan po'i bsko 'ja' dang*/ chos bcu'i rtsa 'chams la zhus dag mdzad/ mgon sku me 'bar mar gser ljang brdung gi gzhugs khang phul/ dgon du sgrib sbyang cho ga nyin bco lnga/ dgu gtor 'chams 'gyed sogs kyi gtan bzhag ma rtsa gnang*/ byang gnam ru sgar dpon nang gsod kyis gshin 'dre mngon rgyug tu gyur nas der phyogs mi nor kun la gnod tshabs che zhing phyogs na pa bla sprul gdan zhus kyis rim gro sogs sgrub pas/ de dag la'ang 'das grongs sogs rkyen chags shin tu che bas/ sus kyang ci byar ma rnyed pa na/

skyabs mgon rin po che gdan zhus kyi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la chibs btegs/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig rta rdzi la bsang khrus sogs mdzad/ sos sna gzhung der bzhugs pa na/ de nub tho rengs khar brtan skyong rdo rje gangs dkar sha med kyis rdo rje 'dzin khyed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon du gshegs re ran na'ang*/ da ste lo lngar 'di la brten nas bzhugs par mdzod/ /ces gri thung rtse shag cig phul ba'i thugs nyams byung zhing*/ de las sad pa na sngar nas sku khams byings ma bde ba yod pa sku yi rtsibs log g.yon phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin byung 'dug gsungs shing*/ de nas rim gyis sha brag nas lung ring du phebs/ lam bar so so'i 'dod skong dbang chos zhwa mjal sogs gnang*/ der sgar dpon de nyid gson khogs gshin zhugs kyis kun kyang 'jigs snang bcas/ snga ma'i gson dus ji bzhin pa lta bu zhig byas te sku mdun du byung ba na/ byams pa chen po'i skyabs 'og tu btsud/ las rgyu 'bras nas byang chub sems bskyed bar gyi chos gsungs/ 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlab pa bsngos te yid tshims par mdzad/ mthar ma dag pa'i rnam shes bla dang phral ste dag pa'i zhing du gnas spar bcas/ snying rje chen pos rjes su bzung nas/ de phyin yid lus rgyun chad de gson gshin thams cad bde ba la bkod/ de nas tshur rim gyis phebs te tshes bcu gcig la gnam mtshor snga lam bzhin me mda' dang gri spus ldan bcas phul/ lar gnam mtsho'i phyogs 'dir snga phyi lan gnyis phebs 'dug par snga mar sa gzhi las g.yu 'brug zhig thog med du nam mkhar song ba dang*/ rjes mar yang 'brug de mtshungs zhig rnga ma'i 'og nas smug rlangs sbra chen tsam gyis btegs te yar mtho tsam re phyin pa dang*/ mar cung zad re bab pa sogs rgyun ring tsam gyi mthar nam mkhar song bar gzigs/ kha skad la 'brug gyen du song ba mthong na legs/

mthur du bab pa mthong na ngan zer srol bzhin/ gyen du 'gro ba la'ang yun 'gor zhan la legs nyes ltas lta rgyu yod nges 'dra zhes gsungs/ tshes nyer dgu rga lo dgon par phebs/ dbang dang rab gnas sogs gnang*/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bzhi la bde chen yangs pa can du phebs/ zhing skyong rten mdos gsungs/ 'dus pa la mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur gnang*/ tshes nyer gsum pho brang du phebs/ tshes nyer bdun nas sku khams shin tu lci bas 'phral mar sgrub sde lhun grub pho brang du phebs/ snye thang nas mkhar nag sku log ma la mjal kha dang gsol ras bcas gnang*/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi dgon du 'brug chen phebs/ sa rta zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nas bco brgyad bar bka' brgyad sgrub chen gsungs shing*/ bar mtshams sngags mdzod dbang lung sogs chos sbyin 'dzad med du stsal/ 'di skor bka' brgyud sngags mdzod chen mo'i spar bzheng bzhed gnang yang*/ de ngang du lus/ 'brug chen rin po che nas yab yum bar 'gal 'du bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyang skyong bas kar 'brug sngar gyi bzang sṛ'i rjes su nye bar gyur/ lha khang gi spyan gzigs rigs gsar tshems dang*/ lha chen nang gi rgyal ba rigs lngar gdan khri gsar bkod dang gzungs 'bul bcas mdzad/ smras pa/ o ḍi sa rar ma hā ḍā ki thog/myur 'gro sngon po dpal gyi ri la song*//lhan skyes dbu rgyan bcos pa'i thabs ma rnyed//dam rdzas dam tshig sgrol ma las btsun pas//dus kyi 'phrang las bsten pa'i skyor ma dang*//'pho med dga' bzhi bskyed rten mtha' ru phyin//ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig la/ zur mang gar dbang dang*/ gus phran rnams zhal mjal du lhags pa mtshur mdor slebs/ mgron gnyer brgyud dar btang*/ thabs bsu thog rol bcas gnang*/ tshes gnyis ri khrod du mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mjal la rings pas phyin ste zhal mjal dang*/

gsol ja bzhes 'bras bcas dga' ston gnang*/ tshes bzhir sor 'brang pak+shi'i gser 'khor chen mo phyag spar gnang ba'i zhabs phyi la bcar bas/ gar dbang la dgyes rtsed kyis yar lam 'ong lugs sogs gsan don med par mngon mkhyen med du gsungs/ tshes dgur dwags lha sgom po'i mchog sprul phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes bcu gsum gus pa kho nar thog ma'i chos kyi sgo 'byed dam grib nyes pa kun sel gyi bkru bya ba dang*/ rje na rim thugs dam rten lung bstan sgrol ma zhal phyes pa'i mdun jo lugs sgrol dkar dbang lung zhib rgyas bcas bka' drin chen pos skal bzang du thob/ tshes nyer bdun nas bka' brgyud sngags mdzod chen mo'i dbang khrid lung bcas stsal gnang gis zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcur mtha' rgyas kyis grub ste/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i ljags lung dbu tshugs/ tshes nyer lngar kaḥthog si tu rin po che phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes nyer dgu la gus pas zhus ngor ma mgon bla rdo srog 'khor nyin rdzogs su grub par rab gnas bcas mdzad pas phyag nas rnams stan la khab zug pa bzhin 'byar ba'i ngo mtshar kho bo cag gi mngon sum du gyur cing*/ bar lam du rje dgu pa'i phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho dang*/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i nges don sgron me shan sbyar gyi zhib khrid dang*/ chos sku mdzub tshugs/ ma rig mun sel/ chos drug bdud rtsi'i nying khu rnams ljags khrid/ kar lugs dkyil 'khor rnams kyi phyag bzhes/ na srung mdud mdud tshul dang*/ phyag 'tshal tshul tshun bka' drin chen pos pha mas byis pa skyong ba bzhin bslab par mdzad/ tshes bco lnga gza' skar legs pa'i nyin thog ma'i chos 'brel phul dgos bka' phebs bzhin/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la 'bul nus kyi yon tan spobs pa bral bas shin tu 'jigs kyang*/ dam srib nyes sel gyi sku khrus dang*/ 'jam mgon zab gter gu ru dang*/

bai ro'i rnam thar zhal gdams bcas lung phul mdog byas/ lo mjug dus gtor la sku mdun dang*/ bka' bzhin tshes nyer brgyad nyer dgu la dgon du 'chams mjal dang 'brel 'jog 'tshogs la phyin ste/ gnam stong dngos grub len chog skabs yar slebs/ sa lug zla ba dang po'i tshes nas sku khams dngas bskyed che ba byung*/ bar lam bla brang du me dogs dang mdzod khang rigs la rkun dogs kyis shes lan grangs phebs bzhin dogs zan ngang bka' phebs ltar byung bas zhus gnang dang*/ gyid sgo skor la gzigs rtogs nyams gsos/ 'ja' tshon pod drug sogs chos tshan 'dod skongs bcas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun la rgyud 'bum grub nas chos mtshams dang*/ 'di skabs gus phran sgrub khang gzim chung shod du yod pa la/ nub gcig sku rtsed kyis gus rtsar na bza' sogs rgyun ldan de rigs mchod bzhin sku lus gzugs gzhan du bsgyur te zangs thal gyis phebs par mar me'i ngogs yun ring du mjal yang zhal gtan nas ma tshor ba na slar yang sku lus sngar ltar bstan pa bcas mngon sum rdzu 'phrul la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i chos tshul zur tsam bstan pa'ang thun mong min pa'i bka' drin gyis skyong ba'i skal pa bzang po thob cing*/ tshes bcu drug nas sku mtshams kyis zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la sku mtshams grol/ phyi dror bka' 'gyur rin po che'i lung 'phros rim stsol/ bar mtshams su gus nas/ zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po'i bka' 'bum/ ra shag ma mo sgeng shar gyi gzhung pod/ sman bsdus e waṃ/ 'chi med nor phreng ma bu/ 'ja' tshon bka' 'bum/ klong gsal gur drag ye 'bar gzhung pod sogs bklags lung maṇ+ḍal phul khul zhus/ tshes nyer brgyad la rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum bka' rgya skor dang*/ tshes nyer dgu la ma mgon zhal sbyor dbang dang*/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu'i tsher sku mtshams kyis tshes bcu gcig la gter gsar tshe sgrub dbang chen bcas gus rang kher rkyang la bka' drin du stsal/

tshes bcu gsum la mi sna mjal kha dang*/ 'dod skong sne len gnang*/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum zhabs drung te lo rin po che zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs thugs smon mdzad/ tshes lnga skyed tshal dar gling pho brang du phebs/ stag ras sprul sku sogs kyi ngor smin dbang sogs bka' chos bar med dang*/ tshes bcur bla gzhung grwa mang spyi dang dpa' bo rin po che/ gus phran bcas pas zhabs brtan phul/ phyi dror rgyal bka' rin po che'i 'phros mdo mang nas gsungs/ zla ba lnga pa bshol ba'i phyi ma'i tshes bcu la rgyal bka' rin po che legs par grub pa'i smon lam shis brjod bcas dang*/ gter ston rin po che'i bla ma dgongs 'dus zhal thang rigs la rgyab byang dang*/ me phreng sgo nas rab gnas bcas mdzad/ gus pas bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i bka' 'bum/ rje brgyad pa'i 'dul ṭīka /jo nang rje btsun bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang*/ rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang bcas phul 'dun bgyis/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lngar gar dbang sprul sku/ gla bra nor sprul sogs la rje bcu bzhi pa'i bka' 'bum lung dang*/ smin gling sga rje'i dbu mdzad sogs la zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum/ gdams mdzod las bka' brgyud/ rnying ma/ bka' gdams skor rnams kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs sogs chos 'khor bar med du bskor bar mdzad/ sgrub sder pho brang zhig gsos gsar bzo sogs kyi bslab ston gnang*/ gus par rje dgu pa dang*/ rgyal dbang nyid kyi bka' 'bum phyag dpe bzhugs rigs yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs/ chos tshan gang zhus mtha' dag sku tshegs la mi ltos par re ba yid bzhin du gang bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin tshe rabs su gzhal bar mi nus par thob/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig ri khrod du phebs/ khang par rab gnas sogs dga' ston mdzad/ tshes nyer lnga nas gus par dbang lung stsal 'bul sogs dang*/

ye shes snying por sngags mdzod spar gzhi bri rgyu gnang zhing*/ lho gro bo lung gi nyams gso'i thebs dang*/ slong yig bcas stsal bar mdzad/ skabs shig sgar bsang chen mo gsungs te thang lha'i nang slebs pa na glo bur gzim chung du gar byung med pa'i rlung 'tshubs shig dang sbrags bsang me'i me stag lha shug dud pa bcas khengs byung bas me stag gis na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs la phran bu tshig pa'ang mngon sum byung ba sgo dang skar khung sogs las ni 'ong don gtan nas med pa ma zad de dag la skyon phran tsam med pa 'di'ang yul lha sogs mngon sum zhabs pad du bcar ba 'dra yang 'di red ces gang yang ma gsungs pas bka' 'dri ni zhu ma spobs/ bar mtshams su/ cog grwa rin po che las bod mkhas snyan 'grel/ shel sgang phreng sogs kyi lung gsan/ tshes bdun gus par gsol ras gnang skyes dang dbugs dbyung bcas stsal zhing*/ lar nas khyed rang da lan mi rang gnyis don lo shas sdod rgyu yong ba zhig gis rang re'i dbang lung rgyun gang yod thams cad 'bul gnang mthar phyin par byung na po po yang blo sems bde zhing*/ bstan srid spyi bye'i gal gnad phan thogs pa zhig yong ba 'dug ces snga phyi lan grangs gsungs kyang*/ bdag nyid bsod nams dman pas gzhan dbang kho nas 'dod dbang du byung thub ma song thog /da res khyed rang 'gro rgyu byung ba des bsam pa bzhin ma byung*/ 'on kyang 'phral du yar phyin thub pa zhig gyis dang*/ da dung gter mdzod sogs dbang lung bya 'dun yid bzhag byed/ khyed nas kyang khams khul nas stag shams/ rata gling rnams kyi chos bka'i dbang lung khrid rgyun gang bzhugs dang*/ rje gnyis pa/ /drug pa/ bdun pa bcas kyi bka' 'bum skor dpe lung rgyun gang rnyed/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i bka' 'bum pod gnyis kyi dpe rgyun/ rang tshang ma mgon gyi rgyud yod do cog gi lung rgyun/ gsar rnying rgyud 'bum nang ma bzhugs pa'i rgyud dang*/

'khor lnga'i gzhung 'dir med rigs kyi dbang lung dpe bcas rtsol sgrub thog /rgan bu lo nas ma gtugs kyang*/ nad khams kyis ci 'gyur ma shes pas/ cis kyang khyi lo nang yar slebs pa zhig rem zhes gsungs shing thugs phreng tshul mdzad/ rang nas kyang de bzhin gzhan dbang du ma gyur na zhu 'ong zhus te thon phyag mjal dar phul bas/ dar lan gnang zhing dbu thod gtug /lag pa nas bzung ste bkra shis smon lam bcas stsal/ bka' bstan 'di la sgrub brgyud rin po che zhes ming don mtshungs pa'i bya bas phan cha rgya mi chung ba'i sems bskyed ci nas kyang gyis zhes phebs par/ rang yang sems phreng zhing*/ skyabs gcig thugs rje'i nyi ma dang bye ba'i mya ngan gyis sems khong tshud pas sdug bsngal la bzod glags med pa zhig byung rung*/ rten 'brel gyi khyad yod snyam ste lags so zhus pa las gzhan gang yang zhu ma nus te dgon du phyin/ tshes brgyad la gzim chung khag la khrus gsol rab gnas zhib mjal bcas gyis zhes phebs bzhin de rtsis byas/ tshes dgu snga char 'gro rtsis la/ 'di nas lan zhig ma yong bar ma 'gro zhes phebs bzhin sgugs pas/ nyi shar la bsnyen phreng ngo ma lha dar gyis lcibs te gnang ba spyi bor phebs shing*/ rang gi snag snyug de'ang ri khrod du dge slong rtsar lus song 'dug pa bcas rten 'brel legs/ da dung lan gcig mjal rgyu yong las che snyam dga' gdung dang bcas lha sa brgyud rang yul du log pa na/ nag chu tsam du slebs skabs/ phyag bris phebs par/ mkhyen nus brtse ba'i gter chen rin po che//snying gi nor bu dam pa'i zhabs drung du/ /zhu mchid/ kho bo rnam g.yengs chu rlung drag po'i rbar//'phyan pas zhib 'bul smreng bar ma lcogs kyang*//skye tshe kun tu mdza' bcug gis sbrel ba'i//gdung ba'i sems dang thal mo'i gar stabs kyis//mgrin mchid phul bzhin dgyes brtses rtag 'dzin cing*//mchog gi zhabs brtan bdag kyang tshe ring gnas//karma'i bstan la lhan cig bya ba byed//mi ring myur mjal chos mchog dga' ston la//dal bde skyid pa'i ngang nas spyod pa ru//snying nas smon bzhin 'grub pa'i thugs bskyed zhu//gter ston zhu yig thugs dgongs zhib gzigs kyis//sgrub bya dang bcas gsung lan gnang bar mkhyen//zhu 'degs rten mtshon bkra shis lha dar bcas//grogs med kher lus rgan bu nad pas phul//zhes pa skal pa bzang po'i dpyid du stsal son gyur/

dpa' bo rin po che/ cog grwa sogs la chos gling skor dbang lung yongs rdzogs gnang*/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgu la kaḥthog si tu rin po che phebs/ rnying rgyud sna sel tshugs/ tshes bcu gnyis nas rnying rgyud lung dang mchog gling rdzogs chen sde gsum dbang lung khrid bcas gsan/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig la grub pas/ maṇ+ḍal legs 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ si tu rin po che la rgyal rgyam lha dgu'i dbang dang*/ sba lugs/ sba mkhar ma'i rtsa gzhung skor gyi lung dang*/ rje bcu bzhi pa'i sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid lung sogs mdzad/ tshes nyer bdun kaḥthog si tu rin po che chibs btegs/ dgu gtor sogs sngar bzhin gsungs/ lcags sprel lo gsar nas sku mtshams bzhugs mus/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang mdzod nag shod du gtor sgam chung ngu zhig sngar yod byi bas gtor ba/ gtor sgrom gsar bzos gyis/ rten gtor gzungs 'bul sogs phyag bstar gyis hor gos shubs sogs spus nam ldan pa gsar bzhengs la/ gdan 'khor/ gur 'khor sogs phyag bris dang*/ yig cha rnying pa rigs yig skyon dang*/ man ngag gab 'khrugs su yod pa la/ slad nas bstan pa'i btsas su zin tho gsar pa bltas chog mar mdzad/ rab gnas sogs grub nas tshes nyer bdun la mdzod nag shod du gdan 'dren bzhugs su gsol ste/ tshes nyer bdun phyi ma nas mkhan po sogs la nyin gsum gtor sgrub 'tshogs bcol/ mi la'i rnam mgur/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum/ rje gsum pa'i bka' 'bum las pod gsum/ rje brgyad pa'i khrid thung*/ 'dul ṭīka /dgu pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa/ bcu bzhi pa rnams kyi bka' 'bum/ 'jam mgon bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung dang dbang khrid sogs rgyal tshab/ dpa' bo/ cog grwa sogs kyi thugs bzhed bzhin bar med du gnang*/ yangs can dgon pa nyams gso'i rim gro sogs la nan zhus ngor/ zla ba drug pa phyi ma'i tshes bcu gcig la mdor bsdus kyis phebs te/

yangs dgon zhwa dmar gzim chung du bzhugs/ 'dod skong rigs dang*/ tshes nyer gsum la sde spyi'i rim gro sogs mdzad/ rga lo dgon du phebs/ smin khrid bslab ston sogs blo yid tshim par stsal nas slar yang yangs can phebs nas rten mdos sogs/ tshes nyi shu rje dus mkhyen sgrub gnas rta rdzi'i dar yol phug tu phebs/ thun bzhi bsngo smon sogs zab rgyas dang*/ rta rdzir gzhi bdag rten bkol/ dbu rir 'bum par zhabs bkod nas bum gter sogs gnang*/ slar mtshur phur phebs te dar gling du nyin shas thugs song lta bur bzhugs nas zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcur sgrub sder phebs/ mchog gling sku tsha tshang gsar bla chab sprul sku bsam gtan rgya mtsho las/ mchog gling gter chos de snga dbang lung ma gsan rigs phyag dpe gang 'byor gyi dbang lung rnams dang*/ klong chen pa'i ngal so skor gsum/ gsung thor bu/ byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar sogs kyi lung rnams gsan/ lar gal chung chos la byed pa'i snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa khengs sems can phal gyi rnam thar dang mi 'dra bar/ gzhan gyi yon tan phra mo la'ang dgyes tshul gyi gus 'dud dang*/ chos la chog shes med par bstan pa rin po che'i bshad sgrub/ smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa'i rgyun mi nyams shing spel ba'i thugs bskyed kho nas gsan bsam ngoms pa med par mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba'i bar du zol zog dam sel sogs kyi skyon dang bral zhing*/ chos spyod kyi rnam thar gtsang ma mnga' phyin/ rigs rus grags 'byor tsam la ma ltos par smin grol gyi rgyun gang la mnga' ba'i bla ma thams cad yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bkur ste chos tshul bzhes rigs zhib par gsan tho sogs su gsal ba las/ 'dir zhib par 'god du mi long la/ de ltar gsan nas kyang deng song gi chos zhus pa'i drin rtsi phar la byed cing*/ chos dang bla ma la dbang za ba de ltar ma yin pa/

bshes gnyen rnams la byas pa bzo ba'i gtang rag legs 'bul gya nom pa spro bar mdzad cing*/ ngos lkog med par dam tshig gi gzhung dang 'brel bas gus 'dud zol med lhur bzhes pa las/ dag snang 'byang bas ku re'i phyir yang skyon dang smod par lta ba'i tshigs gcig kyang 'byon par mi mnga' zhing*/ gang gsan pa de dag thos lo tsam du ma lus par/ mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pas sgro 'dogs chod cing*/ man ngag gi nges shes 'drang bar mdzad pas/ mkhas grub tu rlom pa sus kyang mkhyen rtogs kyi gting mi dpog la/ zhabs pad du bcar ba tsam gyis khengs pa bsnyil zhing mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa bskyed pa'i ngo mtshar rnam dpyod mtshungs zla med pa mngon sum du grub pa 'di dag byung ba ste/ de yang gtso bor bsgom byung gi shes rab klong brdol du gyur pa yin cing*/ cho ga phyag bzhes phra mo tshun yang rang rang gi lugs ltar zhib tig nan tan gnang bas rgyud lung man ngag phyag bzhes ya ma bral ba las/ gang byung des chog glu brgya ngag gcig sogs ma dgos pa'i tshul gcig pu 'di'ang*/ deng song tsam na bstan pa 'di la 'gran zla med pa'i yon tan du mngon no/ /zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la si tu rin po che/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che/ gus phran bcas par phyag bris stsal gnang las/ gus par gsungs shog gnas tshul zhib rgyas mthar/ bu rin po che la gzigs skyong*/ lta grub lod mi shor ba dang*/ a ra kha che mi red pa/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi tog 'ong babs kyi bka' drin gyis kyang zhu zhu zhu/ shin tu mdza' ba'i snying gi nyi zla zung*//shin tu dag pa'i mkha' la zung 'grogs shing*//gdod nas 'bral ma myong ba'i rten 'byung gis//dgyes zhal myur du mjal ba'i rten 'brel zhu//zhes phebs shing*/ de 'brel 'jam mgon sprul sku rin po che la'ang phyi nang bka' bslab bcas gnang 'dug /zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bla brang sku mdun bcas pa'i 'gros sgo btang thebs lag sne rigs/

phyag khang las byed sku mdun pa rnams la rtsis bstsal gyis phyi nang mtshams dam por bcad/ tshes gnyis nas gter chen rjes bka' lung bzhin dgongs 'dus me phreng la brten pa'i tshogs mchod gter srung gtor bsngos bcas nan tan thob/ zab gter brda' byang gter sgrub kyis thugs chen rgyud dang sgrub thabs bcas stod cha rigs phab zin mtshams lus pa/ tshes gsum brda' bkrol ril bu bzhes pas yud tsam dran med du song mtshams/ de las sad 'phral brda' shar ba bzhin spa le spo lar bris pas rgyud rdzogs phrin las kyi bar cha rnams kyang bri thub par byung*/ tshes bdun phyi dro brda' 'gags pas bshol/ tshes dgur slar yang tho kha gsos bcug ste/ thugs chen ye shes sgron me thun gnyis re dpe'i steng nas gsungs shing*/ dpe gzhan rnams mchod gzhi'i steng du bkod nas sgrub/ gnam gang la btang rag khyug tsam dang*/ bsang bcas gsungs nas mtshams cung zad lhod par mdzad/ 'di don zhib par ma mngon kyang*/ bstan 'gro gegs chags ches pas rten 'brel mthar phyin byung yod ma 'dra/ lcags bya zla ba dang po'i tshes nas sngar 'gros mtshams rgya de mus su sgrol phur ljags bsnyen dang*/ tshes bcu nas krong sar zhabs rim tshe gsang sgrub chen mdzad nas mtshams tho blangs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nas ri che gnam lcags sprul sku/ kong po bde dgon bla ma sogs phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams kyi 'dod skong du/ rje dgu pa'i gsung 'bum sogs dbang lung khrid gsum rgyun ma chad par stsal/ 'brug chen khyugs tsam phebs te mjal 'phrad gnang*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis la dpa' bo rin po cher phyag bris gnang rgyu'i bslab ston stsal/ sgar grwa mang nas zhabs brtan phul zhing*/ sna mkhar ba spyi nas gdan zhus dang*/ phyag mdzod nas nan tan zhus ngor/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun la sna mkhar du phebs/ 'ong skor sogs la 'dod skong du gzigs mo dang*/

tshes bcu dgur yul lha'i rtser gzhi bdag rten bkol dang*/ spyi rim sogs gnang nas zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi la ri khrod du phebs/ 'di nas gzung sku khams ma bde ba che tsam gyis/ dwangs du ba sna tshogs las/ dwangs bskyed thon pa gtan nas ma byung*/ tshes brgyad la dpal spungs nas byams mgon rin po che'i phyag bris dang*/ gnang rten rnying rgyud phyag dpe tshar gnyis bcas bang mi ched btang 'byor/ dga' ldan byams pa'i zhing bkod sogs lha bris pa mgon lur bri rgyur bstsal ste bslab bkod gnang*/ tshes nyer drug dgongs 'dus zhal thang bcu gsum kha skong la rgyab byang dang*/ tshes nyer dgu zhal sbyor bla rdo srog 'khor cha gnyis gri snying du bcug ste sbyang khrus rab gnas bcas mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bzhi nas mtshams rgya'i rnam pas bzhugs shing*/ tshes sum cu la phyag khang me shor skyon shin tu che ba byung yang*/ zhal nas/ khyung tshad thab nas me rkyen bla brang gi//phyag khang lte ba rjes med lta bur 'bar// yig cha phyar dang lo gsar chas rnams dang*//dbu gur chen mo la sogs 'ja' bzhin yal//dkon mchog drin gyis gtsug lag khang dngos la//skyon med byung zhing rgyu gyong cher phogs kyang*//rtsa rtse'i zil mtshungs rmi lam lta bu la//bden 'dzin chags sems bor nas lo 'ga' thal//'on kyang gnyis snang bag chags ma zad pas//dgu chen phyir dar rgyu gro 'gro rdil tshad 160 skor//lo gsar chas bcas da lta 'tshabs bzhin dang*//sogs gus phran la phyag bris phebs bzhin/ zla ba 11 pa'i tshes gsum nas phyag khang phyi nang nyams gso'i mgo tshugs/ pho brang thog gi ar sga bcas par/ mtshur nang*/ she ma/ mi ser/ grwa mang*/ sku ngo sogs thams cad la khang pa so sor shog khra bcas bsgos nas 'phral thon dgos pa'i bkod khyab dang*/ 'di rigs las 'jug ma lus pa zhig byung na zhes sogs thugs khur dang*/ yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i gsungs tshig rgyun chags su gnang*/

dgu gtor phyar dar tshems rgyu dang*/ lo gsar chas 'khor gsar sgrigs rnams kyi las mgo btsug /cog grwa rin po che la dgon du khrus dang rab gnas gnang bcol/ tshes bcu bzhi nas mtshams tho bzhag ste thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gsungs/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dngos grub len chog bcas tho nang ma bsdus/ sde rgyal tha'i ji sogs la mjal kha dang chos 'brel 'dod skong bcas dang*/ tshes gnyis bla brang las byed rnams la phyi nang las don bka' bslab zhib par gnang*/ tshes gsum tho kha gsos nas bla ma dgongs 'dus bsnyen pa gsungs shing*/ zhabs brtan mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus sogs tshugs/ bla brang nas kyang zhabs rim hur bskyed zhus/ 'di skor 'jam tshul sogs zhabs gras nang ma la/ khams phyogs gser ldan 'bab pa'i 'grams/ mi rtsa hrag cing chos dang ldan pa'i rigs rgyud du skye ba len par 'dug ces lan kha shas gsungs shing*/ sngon du gus rang zhabs drung du yod skabs bla brang las byed sogs la thugs sun tshul gyis/ da ni las ngan lus ngan dgon gog 'khor ngan 'di 'dra'i lus su nam yang mi skye bar shog ces phebs par/ sus nas de 'dra'i thugs bskyed gtan nas mi gnang bar cis kyang zhu zhes zhus par/ a cang sems chad pas kha nas thal ba red/ tshe 'dis skye ba chad pa zhig e thon bsam yang de ni thon ma song*/ des na lus rten gzhan du srid par sbyor yang bag chags ngan goms kyis bstan pa 'di la slar 'khor ba las gang du 'gro zhes gsungs par/ 'o na sku tshe 'di rjes skye ba gang 'dra zhig tu bzhes yong dar na zhus pas/ khams phyogs de sa skyid khyad par khams pa'i mi de pho rus che zhing mi rtsa bzang bar 'dug /de 'dra zhig tu skyes na/ kho bo rtsal shed ma rdzogs par karma dgon lta bur sdod rgyu byung na legs po zhig yong ba mi 'dug gam/ lar sngar lo nas phyi ma'i snang tshul thar thor zhig shar 'dug pa yi ger bkod nas rten sgam rta sgam 'di nang da lta bzhag yod ces phebs pa la bka' 'dri zhu 'dun che yang*/

zhib par zhu nus pa ma byung*/ tshes bcu gsum la dpal spungs bod mi phyir slog gdongs/ gus rtsar phyag bris phebs nang*/ gnas tshul phran bu zhu rgyu mchis kyang*/ rgya ma grol bas der zad ces 'dug pa'ang sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul sogs yin par 'dug cing*/ tshes bco brgyad la tho bsdus te ka gdung 'dren mi sogs khrom rigs phyag zhabs su btang*/ phyar dar gsar pa rigs legs grub byung zhing*/ lo mjug dus gtor tshes sum cu btang rag bcas dgu chen grub/ chu khyi mtshur zla'i 1 tshes gcig la tho rengs snyan gsan rgya gling sogs kha shar phyogs su bskor te btang bcol mdzad/ nyi ma rtse shar phyis nang mtshams tho bzhag /mtshams 'og tu yod pa'i mdun 'dug skor nas dar btang sogs byas/ thun bzhi chags med mdzad cing*/ tshes lnga nas thor thun srod thun gnyis/ snga dgong thun gnyis rnams la bka' rgya can gyi bsnyen pa gsungs/ 'di skor nas sku khams lhag par ma bde ba byung*/ sgrub sde nas dam grib nyes sel gyi sgo nas bkru bya ba glud bsngo/ dam glud sogs grangs mang dang*/ dgon par zhabs 'phar bka' 'gyur dag tshar tshugs/ mtshur lugs cho 'phrul gshol zla phyi ma'i tshes bdun la mtshams lhod nas/ dgon gyi rgyud sde blo 'don sgrol ma tshe ring ma sogs 'don rgyug blangs shing*/ bca' bsgrigs skor rgyun du do dam gnang mus su/ dbu chos rigs la slar yang bka' nan gnang*/ 'tshogs mang nas rnam 'joms gzungs 'ur 'don gnang shing bsnyen bkur zab rgyas su stsal/ bar mtshams su'ang phyogs na 'byon pa'i sku gcar zhu mi rigs la/ mjal kha/ dbang lung khrid sogs 'dod skong rigs ma chags par mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la rgyal tshab rin po che phebs/ sngon du dbang lung gang bzhugs phal cher bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang grub pa'i sku yon maṇ+ḍal gzab rgyas dang*/ zhabs brtan bcas phul/ tshes drug pho brang nyams gsos la dgon du bsang gsol arga spo chog bcas la dge slong 'jam tshul mngags btang mdzad/

tshes bcu drug la sku zhabs krong sar zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub gsungs/ ar las rnams la gsol ras sogs rgya cher stsal/ phyag khang nyams gso dang bla brang btang thebs bcas pa'i lag sne phongs med du gnang*/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcur sgrub grwar gsang thig yab bka' dang 'brel bar 'ja' tshon mkha' 'gro grib sel/ yum ka'i tshogs bskang bshags dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor bcas btang*/ tshes bcu gcig 'brug nas krong sar a zhe gshegs pa'i sgrib sbyang sreg sogs mdzad/ grwa mang nas zhabs brtan phul/ tshes bcu bdun la/ si tu rin po che/ zur mang gar dbang bcas la phyag bris dang*/ zhabs brtan yig brgya/ dam grib nyes sel/ gdugs dkar bcas grangs mang sgrub dgos khams phyogs kar dgon khag la zhabs 'phar 'grub thabs gsungs shing*/ de mnyam 'jam mgon sprul sku rin po che dang*/ kaḥthog si tu rin po che/ gus phran bcas par phyag bris stsal 'byor bcas gus par phebs tshogs 'jam tshul nas bris par deng skabs yig 'bri ma thub pas gzhan tshul zhib par 'bul thub ma song zhes sogs yig mtha' 'dum 'phros su phyag bris ngo mar/ pha rgan bdag kyang yun ring sdod dka' bas/ sngar 'phros yid 'jog 'phral bskyod grub dgos/ kho bo'i skye ba gzhan tshun skyabs 'jug bslab rem/ āḥzhes gnang 'dug pa'ang ma 'ongs yongs sprul tshun gyi lung bstan du mngon/ tshes bco brgyad 'jam tshul sogs nas zab bdun rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gdugs dkar gtor zlog /tshes bcu dgu zhabs 'phar gro lod gtor ma 'phangs/ dus mchod rnam sras lus pa gsungs/ tshes nyer gnyis a sga brdung mi rigs la mang 'gyed stsal/ las sne rnams la gtsug lag nyams gso/ phyi nang do dam/ dgon gyi bca' bsgrigs bcas zhabs tog ngos lkog thub pa'i nan tan dgos rgyu'i phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i bka' bkod zhib lhugs su stsal/ gam 'khod rnams kyi yid gsos su re zhig mi skyon pa'i tshul gsungs shing*/

tshes nyer lnga dus mchod bar chad kun sel gyi phrin las 'bring po btang*/ thugs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas mdzad par phyi nang 'grub rkyen re'ang byung bas sku khams cung dub pa byung*/ 'di nyin nas kha ba cher babs shing*/ yul lung gi kha dogs nyams pa sogs/ der phyogs rang bzhin gnas mjal yong ba'i mi rnams kyang don med du snying stong blo mi bde ba zhig yong gin 'dug zer/ yang dgon rje drung*/ rtse sprul bcas pa'i zhu yig re 'byor bar so sor gsung lan gnang*/ tshes nyer drug yang sku khams de mus kyis thugs dam zhal 'don skor sogs ma chags par gnang mus las ha cang zhan pa'i bsnyung gzer sogs gang yang med par/ phyag bris sogs zhal thang chung ngu mang po yod pa'i sgam las thang chung rnams kha phyes gsungs te nyer gnas rnams la ltar bcug /rin po che rang gis kyang phran bu re gzigs tshul mdzad/ da don 'grub pa red/ 'phro brlag ma shor ba bsdus zhes gsungs te gzugs sku bsdu ba'i brdar mdzad/ phyi dror kaḥthog sprul sku kun bzang sku mdun du bcar bas thugs dgyes nyams lhag par gnang*/ 'di nyin yang 'grul rkyen bcas sku khams dub pas gsung 'phros gnang dka' ba tsam gyis/ 'jig rten 'dir snang gi bya bzhag la zin pa med tshul dang*/ phyi nang gi gnas snang 'gyur ba gang la dgongs kyang yun du bzhugs pa la dgos don mi snang zhing*/ don brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba nyag phra bas thugs phreng cung zad las/ gzhan thugs dgongs lhag ma med tshul gyi bka' phebs pas/ blo ma bde yang 'phral der zhing gzhan la gzigs rgyu'i dgongs pa ma rtogs pas slad nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs zhu rtsis kyis rang gnas su ldog /dgongs mor thugs dam sogs rgyun bzhin gsungs shing*/ dge slong 'jam tshul la zhal chems phyag bris bka' rgya bcas de yi sngon tsam nas gnang*/ de nub srod la zhal lag bcas mdzad de gzim phyi tsam du gyur/

sku gsang la byon nas tshur phebs bzhugs gdan la 'khod pa dang bsnyun gzhi 'phar ba'i rnam par bstan cing*/ de 'phral lha thog lha rje/ mtshur rtsis pa/ ru em chi rnams nas sman bcos sogs phul yang ci bya med par nam phyed byi ba'i chu tshod dang por zin pa dang*/ zhabs skyil krung*/ sku g.yas phyogs su cung zad bsnyel stabs kyis/ zag pa kun zad zhi ba 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa chos sku chen po'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /'di ni lam dus rnal 'byor pa rnams thugs dam gsal 'debs sogs kyis 'chi ba 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i rang ngor rtsol bcas kyis mnyam par 'jog pa lta bu ma yin par khang khyim sogs gnas nas gnas su 'gro ba bzhin/ mchog gi sprul sku 'di snang bsdus pa'i de ma thag par rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor tshogs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gdan drangs te 'og min chen po sogs dag pa'i zhing du ta ler byon pa ni 'phags chen rnams kyi chos nyid de/ des na 'di nub dgon du yod pa kha shas kyi na bun gseb nas 'od dkar po snam bu brkyang ba lta bu sgrub sde'i yang thog tu zug pa mthong 'dug pa'ang zhing khams gzhan gyi ston par gshegs par mngon mod/ 'on kyang 'phags chen rnams kyi rnam thar ni mig 'phrul bzhin bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas la dbang 'byor ba'i phyir/ gzhan snang tsam du sku yi gzi byin zhal ras 'dzum mdangs sogs ma nyams par 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su thugs dam la bzhugs pas/ zhag gsum gyi ring bcas bcos med pa de gar bzhag /'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bka' lung bzlog med mngon du gyur te/ dam grib rang gi rkyen gyis glo bur du gshegs stabs/ smin gling rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa bshams te/ gzim chung sgor/ mkhan bla ma legs bshad phun tshogs/ kaḥthog sprul sku kun bzang*/ dge slong 'jam tshul/

drung zur sprul sku rnams nas 'jam 'don gyis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bshags sbyangs/ tshogs bsags/ dbang len sogs zhus/ nyer dgu'i tho rangs nas bstan pa bu gcig pa'i rgyud dang*/ btags grol rigs bklags shing*/ thugs rje 'gro don la bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam rigs nan tan du byas pas/ de skabs shar phyogs nas ri nyil ba lta bu'i thug chom 'ur ldir gyi sgra chen po shar nas shar du brgyud de song ba lho rgyud tshun khams dbus kyi mi kun gyis thos gsal du gyur pa'ang*/ 'od gsal las bzhengs shing sprul pa'i sku rin po che shar phyogs bod chen po'i ljongs su phebs par thugs brtse gtad pa'i brda' byung ba dang bstun/ sku gdung rin po cher gzungs sngags kyis sgrub pa'i bum chus khrus gsol dang*/ rgyud dgu sogs kyi gnas yig rnams ma 'dres par phul/ ka shi ka yi ras gtsang ma ga bur sogs sman sna dri bzang pos sbags pas sku yi cha thams cad legs par dkris/ dbu la mthong grol/ phyag tu rdor dril sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas rnams phul te tshoms chen 'og mar gdan drangs shing mchod pa'i rnam grangs du ma bcas nyin shas bzhugs su gsol/ 'dus sde byings sogs nyer 'khor gyi dad 'dus slob rigs rnams nas gdung mjal dang*/ rang rang 'byor 'khos gang lcogs kyi mchod 'bul/ dbang len/ thugs yid bsres shing mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ gsol 'debs/ smon lam sogs byas/ lha gdan sogs phyogs 'gyang gi mi rnams kyi mthong chos su/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i nub mo tshes nyer drug nas/ mtshur phu'i steng phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi gur mig mang ris su bris pa mngon gsal du byung 'dug pa dang*/ slad nas dad ldan dam tshig can la byin rten gdung tshwa nyar ba las ring bsrel dngos su 'phel ba sogs sku gdung rin po ches kyang grol ba bzhi ldan gyi phrin las mtha' yas pas snang ba dang mi snang ba'i 'gro ba grangs kyi mi lang ba'i don mdzad/

mthar gdung tshwa 'bul rgyu sogs ma 'ongs gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du yun du bzhugs pa'i bca' tshags legs par bsdams te mchod pa'i bkod pa bcas yang dag par byas shing*/ gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang du 'dus sde tshogs mang nas dgung tshig ma yol bar/ bla mchod dang*/ rang lugs dkyil 'khor rnams kyi sgrub mchod bstar chags su mdzad/ gdung mdun du'ang dam ldan slob tshogs rnams kyis bdun phrag so sor smin gling rdor sems/ dgongs 'dus skong chog /rgyal rgyam lha dgu/ pad+ma badz+ra/ thugs sgrub sngags gso/ kar gling zhi khro/ rngog lugs kyai rdor lha dgu/ bla sgrub bde chen thig le dang 'brel ba'i mgur mtsho sogs/ 'khor lo'i mgon po'am mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ thugs dam gnad bskul gyi smon lam bcas nan tan du mdzad/ bla brang gzhung nas gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs ma deb bzhin/ chos 'khor chen po rnams dang*/ khams dbus kyi bla sprul che phra/ dgon sde rnams la dgongs rdzogs mchod sbyin tshogs bsags bcas gnang zhing*/ de 'brel 'jam mgon sprul sku rin po che sogs khams dbus kyi slob rigs so sos mchod 'bul mkhos bstun gang lcog rgya cher dang*/ khyad par lho 'brug chos rgyal chen pos btang phod gzhan 'gran med pa'i mchod 'bul gzab rgyas dang*/ sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs yul mchod sdong chen po'i nang shing tsan+dan dang*/ phyi g.yogs gser dngul rin po che'i phra tshom/ bzo bo rnams la gla chas gsol ras bcas phongs med du bstsal ba'i mgo 'dzin ban chan mkhan po dang*/ mtshur phu bla gzhung nas mthun 'gyur bcas bsod nams rlabs po che yi bka' drin don gnyis lhun grub tu stsal zhing*/ de 'brel lung zin mkha' 'gro o rgyan mtsho mo lags nas kyang sgo gsum bla ma'i zhabs tog tu dmigs pas dam tshig gtsang zhing thugs bzhed mthar 'chol bar mdzad pa nas/
