sku gdung rin po che'i mdun phyag chen sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi nas rtsam chos spyod sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor bzung*/ bdog pa ci mchis yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis zhag nang 'dra sku rin po che gzhengs pas/ dad dam smon lam mthu yis byin brlab gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi zhing du grub par gyur to/ /mdor na kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi zhal nas/ kho bo sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor reg pa'i bka' drin la brten nas/ rig gnas dang*/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod/ sngags phyi nang gi skor du ma'i bshad rgyun dang*/ khyad par don brgyud kyi smin grol tshangs sprugs su thob shing*/ thugs rje'i ye shes bdag rgyud la 'phos pa'i dbang chen thob/ de rnams kyang gal chung ngu ma byas par/ rang lugs rtsa gsum gyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan ma 'grub kyang*/ dad pa'i shing rta la brten nas gsol 'debs kyi tshul du grangs kyi bsnyen pa gtso bor bton/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa go yul mos pa lam byed tsam re/ nyams bzhes kyi brgyud pa ma bcad pa'i zhabs 'degs su rloms pa'i re ba byas/ khyad par zab gsang mthar thug blo 'das phyag rgya chen po dang*/ de'i myur lam gyi khyad chos zab lam nā ro chos drug la'ang 'brel 'jog tsam bgyis/ grub pa'i lag rtags thon pa ma mchis kyang*/ rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pas blo las su rung zhing*/ spang gnyen gnyis mgo mnyam pa tsam dang*/ kun rdzob byang sems la blo brtan pas/ sems can blos spangs dang*/ rnam dkar ci bgyis rang don du dmigs pa'i nyes pas ma gos shing*/ dgra gnyen mgo ma nyams tsam gyi blo ma bcos pa shar/ don gyi gnas lugs la go nyams legs par rnyed/ bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' dag 'gal med du go/ 'dir snang la bden 'dzin rags pa zhig pas snang ba 'di kun mdangs kyi rmi lam lta bur mthong*/

nor rdzas zang zing dang*/ gtam bzang ngan la zhen blo med/ sgo gsum gyi spyod lam gang byas thams cad mkha' la rlung dam/ chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin las bag chags bsogs pa'i rjes ngan mi dod tsam snang*/ nyams len gyi mthil gshis lugs brjod med kyi rig pa so ma'i steng du/ yengs med tsam du 'jog pa las/ blos dpyad dang*/ dgag sgrub bzo bcos kyi lhan pa gdab mi dgos pa'i khul du mchis/ de las mchog tu gyur pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i pad+mo bzhin du gyur/ dus zad 'di lta bur kho bo yang bka' brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi phreng ba'i bzhugs gral gyi gsham du bzhag nas/ don rgyud kyi khungs su byed pa shar tshe/ rgyud la sdom pa gsum ldan du tshang dgos mod/ tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs bzang po'i dri tsam las kyang ring du gyur cing*/ nyes brgya'i 'dam du tshud pa mthong chos su gyur pa 'di ltar lags/ 'on kyang gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ nyon mongs rang ga ma'i lugs su ma gyur tsam gyi lha sngags chos nyid du shes pa'i rgyas 'debs bag re ba dang*/ kun rdzob spyi sems kyi dus gnad gnang bkag shes pas/ dgos par 'brel ba ma gtogs rdo rje theg pa'i tshangs spyod la bsnyen pa lhur len pa'i khul du byas/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin gong du rags rim tsam smros pa'i rtsa gsum rnams kyi smin khrid ji ltar gsan pa de rnams kyang zhus lo tsam du ma lus par/ de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su gdams pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la nan tan du mdzad cing*/ sde snod gsum gyi nyams bzhes dang*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las skad gcig kyang g.yel ba med pas lam gyi srog bzung*/ snga phyir bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa'i grangs zhib par ma nges kyang*/ bar skabs phyag thor bkod pa ni/ oṃ swasti/ ye shes rgya mtshor rtag tu snyoms zhugs kyang*//srid 'gro nyams nga spyan gyis mi 'dor zhing*//rdo rje gsum gyi cho 'phrul mkha' 'dra ba'i//bdag gi bla ma sku gsum ston par 'dud//sgyu ma chen po gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i gar//du ma'i rnam 'gyur zhal phyag cir yang ston//thabs dang shes rab 'gyur med sdom pa che//bde chen rdo rje rtsa gsum lha la 'dud//byis pa'i skye bo nying 'khrul 'chings ba can//bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i cha shas phra gyur kyang*//mos pa'i dad pa kho na gzhir drangs te//lhag pa'i lha yi snying po nyung zad cig/bzlas pa'i rnam grangs tsam zhig spel ba 'di//gang zag gzhan ngo 'brid phyir ma yin te//rmongs pa bdag gi brjed nges ngal gso phyir//rim pa bzhin du yi ger btab pa lags//zhes pa nas mthar chags su stsal ba brir mi long yang*/

rags bsdus/ dgung grangs bcu gsum bar gu ru'i thugs sgrub bdud 'dul rgyal po'i bsnyen sgrub zhag bco lnga nas/ lo bstar rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi sngar srol bzhin jo lugs sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen sgrub zla res nyung mtha' brten pas phal cher chags med/ rang lugs ma mgon gyi bsnyen sgrub de mtshungs/ rat+na'i tshe sgrub gsang 'dus bsnyen tshad mthar phyin lan grangs brgyad/ 'phags ma'i snying thig bsnyen sgrub lan gnyis/ zab bdun phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub rgyas pa/ phyag chen/ chos drug /rdzogs chen dkon spyi bcas pa'i sngon 'gro so so nas 'bum lnga/ dkon spyi'i phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang las sbyor tshe sgrub bcas pa'i bsnyen chen/ kha skong sbyin sreg bcas/ bde mchog dang*/ phag mo'i phyi nang gsang gsum/ rgyal rgyam lha dgu'i phyi nang gsang ba dril sgrub bcas rtags thon/ mar lugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsnyen chen/ smin gling rdor sems/ chos dbang bla ma gsang 'dus/ kar gling zhi khro/ nyang gter bka' brgyad/ chos gling phur pa rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan/ snga phyir bla ma dgongs 'dus bsnyen sgrub lan gsum/ o rgyan gling pa'i bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter gro lod bsnyen bsgrub cha tshang*/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i snyan brgyud phur pa/ gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ yang dag /bdud rtsi/ phur pa/ ma mo bcas pa'i bsnyen sgrub dang*/ gsang thig phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub lan grangs/ 'jam mgon zab gter gro lod hūm̐ sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub/ gsang thig yab bka' yum bka' so so'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshe sgrub dang bcas pa/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi phrin las snying por brten pa'i sngon 'gro bcas bsnyen sgrub las gsum yongs rdzogs/

dam grib nyes pa kun sel/ gtsug gtor gdugs dkar ljags bzlas tshad ldan/ zur gter phur pa yang gsang bcud dril gyi bsnyen sgrub theng gcig /tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig bsnyen sgrub rgyas bsdus lan gsum bcas dus grangs rtags kyi bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol bar mdzad/ rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes chags med bcad dkrigs su mdzad pa yang*/ thor thun la phyag chen sngon 'gro'i skyabs 'gro/ maṇ+ḍal/ ma nam bzhi skor/ tshig rkang drug pa rnams nyer gcig re/ yig brgya lnga bcu/ yig drug brgya brgyad/ gu ru'i bla sgrub bdud 'dul rgyal po'i bsnyen pa sum brgya brgyad/ thun bzhi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i kar mkhyen sum brgya brgyad/ phag mo'i bsnyen pa sum brgya brgyad/ bde mchog bsnyen pa sum brgya brgyad/ sgrol dkar yig bcu sum brgya brgyad re bcas/ 'jam dbyangs/ sman bla/ rnam 'joms/ sme brtsegs/ nyang gter mig 'byed/ rnam rgyal ma rnams kyi bsgom bzlas bsnyen pa brgya brgyad re/ theg chen gso sbyong bcas/ nang snga gtor ma brgya rtsa/ brul gtor/ 'byung bzhi/ dzam lha rigs gsum/ chu sbyin bcas dang*/ dgongs mor gsang sngags nang gtor/ chos skyong spyi sger gyi bskang gsol/ ma mgon bsnyen pa sum brgya brgyad/ bsur bsngo dang*/ dgongs thun thugs dam/ phur pa sum brgya brgyad/ gro lod bsnyen pa lnga brgya/ seng gdong bsnyen pa brgya brgyad/ rgyal rgyam gsang sgrub bsnyen pa yongs bsdoms stong lhag re/ tshe gsang bsnyen pa sum brgya brgyad/ kun bzang smon lam rgyal khams bde ba'i smon lam sogs bsngo smon dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo/ spyi bshags bcas/ yig brgya brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba/ rgyun bar thugs lcog dang bstun pa'i yig drug sogs rgyun bzlas gnang ba/ ma ṇi dung phyur lhag tsam/ sid+dhi dung*/ sgrol ma bye chen lnga/ a mi dhe wa bye chen gsum/

mgon po'i bsnyen pa bye ba bzhi/ gsol 'debs dus gsum sangs rgyas 'bum ther gsum sogs gsungs shing*/ chos drug las gtum mo'i rlung sbyong*/ sgyu lus/ bar do/ rmi lam 'od gsal gtsos/ de 'brel gsar rnying rdzogs rim chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar nyams bzhes bcas/ de dag la brten pa'i lam rtags kyi ye shes yon tan rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyag cig gi spyod yul las/ tshur mthong tsam du'ang rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lha yis ye shes kyi skus dngos su zhal ston/ dbang bskur/ gdams pa stsal ba'i tshul ni/ sngon li thang pang phug tu bzhugs skabs grub chen pak+shis dngos su gdams par stsal bas yon tan mgon po'i skor mdzad pa nas bzung*/ rtag par dag snang dang mi 'bral bas/ snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i chos skor mtha' klas pa'i gdams mdzod thugs rgyud la rdzogs shing*/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ rje mi bskyod zhabs dang*/ dbang phyug rdo rje rnams las bka' 'bum nye brgyud du gsan pa'i lung rgyun kyang bzhugs pa las/ rje dgu pa'i bka' 'bum tsam las bdag cag bsod nams kyi mthus spel mdzad ma grub la/ zab lam nā ro chos drug gi nyams khrid dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pas dngos su bstsal ba'i man ngag byin rlabs kyi rgyun thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs pas/ 'di las zab khrid thob pa kun la byin rlabs drod rtags dngos su bskyed pas yid ches kyi nges pa ster nus pa dang*/ o rgyan yab yum 'bral ba med pas rtag par byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sman sgrub gnang ba'i skabs shig sman phud las gu ru bde ba chen po'i sku rang byon pa rgyan rdzogs ngo mtshar can 'khrungs pa dang*/ dpal mgon po bran bzhin du 'khor zhing ma bcol bar yang phrin las mtha' dag sgrubs pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong ba rnams kyi ngor chung ngu'i dus nas gzhan sems mkhyen cing*/ lha mig dag pas skye gnas tshe tshad sogs mngon sum du ma 'dres par gzigs shing*/

rang nyid kyi sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung 'gyur bcas dus gsum sa ler gzigs pas skyes rabs sarga bcu pa dang*/ ma 'ongs 'da' ba'i zhal chems sogs thun mong min pa'i bka' lung ngo mtshar ba kun gyi spyod yul du grub pa 'di ltar lags shing*/ rnam pa kun tu rang gi yon tan bum nang gi mar me bzhin gsang ba bsrung bas ji bzhin mi gsungs shing*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sogs bstan par mi mdzad kyang*/ rang bzhin zhal 'phros su/ kho bo'i rmi lam du hor gling 'khrugs pa chen po zhig bkye 'dug pa/ khong rgya tsha zhal dkar yin snang gis 'khor gsum bcas g.yul du chas 'gro gi 'dug par/ sems la 'jigs snang tshad med zhig yod 'dug pas/ dpa' ya med rgya tsha zer ba 'jigs skrag bag tshag tan nas med pa zhig yin dar mi 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang sngon gnas rjes dran las ma 'das shing*/ ye shes gtad tsam gyis byin rlabs 'pho ba'i tshul yang snga phyir sku mdun du gzim khyi ha ba gnyis yod pa/ shi song skabs gnyis ka nas thugs dam bzhugs te/ gam sdod kyi mi rnams ngo mtshar gyis ha las par gyur pa dang*/ lha khang gi ka ba yo ba phyag mdas srang zhing*/ sgrub sde'i gzim spug shod du mchod gtor rnams byi bas zos pa la bka' shog bsgrags pas de phyin byi bas gnod pa gtan nas med pa dang*/ skabs shig tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad skabs tshogs chang phor ba gang do gis myos min zhig gleng bas/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas nges par byas na chang byas kyang chu red/ rdza bum gang do btung yang myos zer ba ga la yod gsungs pas/ thams cad kyis chang gis mi myos pa mi srid ces zhus pas/ 'o na khyer shog dang kho bos mi myos pa bya yi gsungs nas/ nam rgyun chang thig pa gcig mchod pa'i srol med na'ang/ de nyin ltar snang kha pho rus gnang ba lta bus chang rag rdza bum chen po zhig gi gsum stabs gcig tu gsol bas/

mchod zhal gang bzhes pa'i nyams tsam yang med pa ni sngar gyi grub chen bir wa pa'i rnam thar ltar lags shing*/ yang kaḥthog kun bzang sogs 'dus pa 'ga' la gro lod hūm̐ sgrubs kyi smin dbang mdzad skabs dbang rdzas mar me mtshan thub chen po sdong bu lnga spar te mar khu zhu ba stems kyis khengs pa mgo thog tu bag tsa/ kun bzang nas tho phog pa lta bus mar me rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku spang thog nas khri rtsa bar 'gril byung ba na/ mar khu thig pa gcig kyang ma bo bar yar bzhes pa dang*/ dus phyis byang chub kyi sems dpa' gzung rang dbang thobs shing*/ 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa sogs/ rtsa rlung dang snang sems rang dbang bsgyur ba'i rtags su mngon par bcas zhib par bdag 'dras brjod par lta ci bsam pa'i spyod yul las 'das shing*/ ma dag las snang 'khrul shes dbang gis dam pa'i yon tan phal cher skyon du mthong ba las ji bzhin ston kyang mjal bar mi 'gyur ro//de ltar thos bsam sgom gsum bsnyen sgrub yan lag dang bcas pa la brtson pas lam rim gyis sbyang pa'i tshul ston pa de rnams kyang rang don gdod nas spang rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir gsar du bsgrub par bya ba 'ga' yang med mod/ gzhan don 'jig rten 'di yi rgud pa sel zhing 'gro rnams bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag 'dra bla ming ston par khas 'ches pa dag gis snyan grags zang zing gi phyir du 'chad nyan ci dgar bya ba mi dbang bas/ thog ma nyid du brgyud ldan gyi bla ma las dbang lung nod cing dam tshig srung ba dang*/ de nyid bsnyen sgrub kyis bdag nyid las su rung bar byas te/ rim gyis 'chad spel bya ba ni bstan pa'i rgyun dang*/ skyes bu dam pa sbyangs pa sngon song 'di rnams kyis bsnyen sgrub nyams bzhes 'di tsam dgos na/ bdag lta bus ci'i phyir mi dgos zhes bla slob kun gyi mig ltos la phan pa'i mdzad pa ste/

yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las tshigs bcad gcig tsam gang gsan pa mtha' dag nyams su bzhes shing de dag kyang lan re 'chad spel ma grub pa gtan nas med la/ khyad par ris med gdul bya spyi dang*/ rang lugs chos sde bcas pa'i slob rigs dad 'dus dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyun chad med pa la gzhi byes kun tu sku khams 'khrugs pa dang*/ sku mtshams bcad rgya dam po'i skabs bcas las/ so so'i mos bstun gyis zhus ngor/ gshin por gnas lung sgrib sbyang byang bsreg bsngo smon rigs dang*/ spyi don khrom dbang*/ zhwa mjal/ sgom lung*/ rkyen sel/ thun mong blo ldog rnam bzhi/ kun rdzob sems bskyed sogs kyi khrid dang*/ dge sgrub sdig spang gi bslab bya sogs rgyun chad med par stsal zhing*/ gtso bor rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i ljags lung tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur lung yod rigs pod sum cu skor tshar gcig /bka' brgyud sngags mdzod chen mo'i smin grol rgyab brten bcas lan lnga/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin grol rgyab brten yongs rdzogs lan gnyis/ gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod phal cher dang*/ bka' rnying gdams skor rnams lan grangs du ma/ shes bya mdzod rtsa 'grel bshad lung tshar gnyis/ 'jam mgon bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi smin lung lan gsum/ mi la'i rnam mgur tshar gnyis/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum tshar lnga/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum tshar gsum/ rang byung ba'i bka' 'bum las pod gsum tshar gnyis/ phyag chen rgya gzhung dang*/ rje brgyad pa'i khrid thung pod gnyis tshar gsum/ 'dul ṭīka tshar gcig /rje dgu pa dang*/ rje bcu gsum pa'i bka' 'bum spar bris kha sab bcas tshar gsum/ theg mchog rdo rje'i bka' 'bum tshar gnyis/ rgyal dbang rang gi bka' 'bum tshang ma lan gnyis/ dgongs 'dus smin byed yongs rdzogs lan gnyis/ gzhung pod lung yongs rdzogs lan gcig /chos dbang bla ma gsang 'dus dbang lung phal cher lan gsum/

rdor gling hūm̐ skor snying thig gi dbang lung khrid gsum lan gnyis/ kar gling zhi khro'i dbang chen lan gsum/ gzhung pod lung lan gnyis/ smin dbang 'bring po dang gtor dbang sogs lan du+u ma/ 'ja' tshon pod drug dbang lung yongs rdzogs lan bdun/ chos gling zab gter bka' 'bum skor bcas dbang lung lan gcig /stag sham 'od chog bdud 'dul drag mo'i dbang lung*/ mtsho rgyal rnam thar bcas kyi lung*/ yongs dge'i gter chos skor gyi smin grol lung bcas lan du ma/ klong chen mdzod bdun lan gnyis/ srong btsan bka' 'bum/ rtse le'i bka' 'bum/

chags med ri chos/ rgyab chos bcas dang*/ kar gcod skor yongs rdzogs/ bka' thang shel brag /thang yig sde lnga/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos sogs tshar gnyis re bcas mthong thos rag rim dang*/ dkon spyi'i dbang lung khrid gsum/ lce btsun snying tig dbang lung khrid gsum/ kar lugs rgyud sde rnams kyi dbang lung lan du ma/ gzhan yang dbang lung 'dod skong rgyun chags mdzad rigs re re nas smos su mi long zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po sngon dngos kyi khrid dang*/ nā ro chos drug gi zab khrid rnams ni lan grangs du ma rgyun chags su mdzad pa lta bu bcas mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam grol la 'god pa'i phrin las kyi pha mtha' sus kyang gzhal bar mi nus la/ de lta bu'i smin grol 'bog pa de dag 'chad spel nyams bzhes kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma'ang*/ si tu/ rgyal tshab/ dpa' bo/ tre ho/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che sogs chos brgyud 'di nyid kyi yab sras/ gdan sa gong 'og gi gdan 'dzin/ chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dgon sde che phra rnams su bzhugs pa'i gar dbang*/ ras chung*/ khra leb/ sangs rgyas mnyan sprul/ bya btang sogs bla sprul che phra rigs ma lus pa lta bu/ bka' brgyud bstan pa'i chu mgo dwags lha sgam po'i mchog sprul rin po che dang*/ 'brug chen/ yongs 'dzin/ chos mgon/ cog grwa sogs dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdan sa phan tshun gyi bstan 'dzin skyes mchog du ma/ gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan gzhi chen po smin gling*/ kaḥthog sogs nas snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi brgyud 'dzin mkhan slob dang*/ sngags rigs 'dzin pa'i slob tshogs 'dus pa grangs kyis mi longs pa bcas/ mdor na mnga' ris dbus gtsang*/ 'bras ljongs/ lho mon/ spu kong*/ byang 'brog /mdo khams/ rgya 'jang*/ hor sog tshun gsung gi bdud rtsi'i smin grol du gyur pa brjod par mi nus shing*/ slob tshogs de dag yul ris dang bcas pas bskul ngor stsal ba'i/

gsol 'debs smon lam/ bsang gsur/ sgom bzlas/ zin bris/ khrid yig zhal gdams sogs dang*/ slad nas o rgyan rdo rje 'chang dang*/ 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che'i bstan pa'i nyams gso'i zhabs 'degs kho na la thugs khur lhur bzhes kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang zin sogs/ mtshams sbyor/ chog sgrigs ci rigs mdzad pa bcas/ sdeb legs kyi tshig sbyor zab don byin rlabs kyis mdzes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa las/ sku na phra dus kyi gsungs thor bu rje dbon rnam gnyis kyis bka' drin chen pos thugs tshags mdzad pa las/ bar der gsungs rtsam mdzad pa phal cher zhu ba po so sor de nyid du gnang ba las sku mdun du dpe bshu sogs kyis nyar tshags shes pa ye ma byung bas phyogs mthar song rigs bsdu thub pa ma byung yang*/ phyis su gser rong lha rtse ba'i dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos sku tshe mthar 'khyol zhabs pad du bcar zhing*/ mdzad chos rigs la yi ge ba sogs kyi sri zhu lhod med dang*/ rgyu mtshan shes pas slar yang dpe bshu sogs kyis ngal ba la ma ltos par bsdus shing nyar bas/ bka' 'bum du grags pa 'di nyid ni dge slong rang gi bka' drin las byung zhing de 'brel bka' 'bum 'di la sa bcad zhig gnang grub ces zhus par/ 1 gzhon nu'i dus kyi rtsom thor bu'i skor phyogs gcig tu byas pa dbyar gyi ne'u seng sil ma/ 2 bstod tshogs skor dad gsum yid kyis bskul ba'i mgrin rnga/ 3 rgyal ba rnams kyi zhabs pad la bsngags brjod bya dka'i rgyan gyi re'u mig tu spel ba'i skor byis pa dga' byed me tog chun po/ 4 rnam thar skor ngo mtshar dpal gyi be'u'i 'dzum phreng*/ 5 bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor byin rlabs sprin gyi bla bre/ 6 gsar rnying bka' gter lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi sgom zlas kyi skor sna tshogs nor bu'i char rgyun/

7 rtsa gsum sgrub phrin chog bsgrigs skor dngos grub 'byung ba'i bum pa bzang po/ 8 smin byed dbang gi mtshams sbyor skor rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu gter/ 9 rtsa ba gsum sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub nyer mkho'i zin bris skor rmongs pa'i mig 'byed gser gyi thur ma/ 10 bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro mnyes byed sreg blug gi cho ga'i skor sgrib 'joms ye shes me'i gur khyim/ 11 mchod skong mdos kyi cho ga snang srid bde chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor/ 12 drag po mngon spyod kyi las 'phang mnan dmod pa'i skor bstan dgra brlag byed reg 'joms me yi spu gri/ 12 rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyi mchod phrin bstod bskul skor dpa' bo rnam par rol pa'i dga' ston/ 14 yul gzhi'i gnas bdag rnams kyi bsang gsol mchod phrin skor yid bzhin re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam ljon shing*/ 15 yul dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs skor lha yi bu skya rengs gzhon nu'i shing rta/ 16 bka' bsgo bden tshig skor rdo rje'i ri dbang*/ 17 rgyal ba'i sras po rnams zhi dbyings las 'gro don la bskul ba'i gsol 'debs skor 'gro mgon thugs rje bskul ba'i pho nya/ 18 ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams gar 'khrungs brtag pa dang ngos 'dzin skor gyi yi ge lhag bsam gtsang ma'i me long*/ 19 ris med bstan 'dzin rnams kyi mtshan yig zhabs brtan skor bsam 'grub lha yi rnga bo che/ 20 gnas yig dkar chag gi skor rnam dkar rgya mtsho 'phel byed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 21 shis par byed pa'i mchod brjod kyi skor rdzogs ldan sprin gyi lding khang*/ 22 yul dam pa rnams dang bar ma bcas la phul ba'i zhu phrin dang 'bul yig chab shog gi skor 'chi med bu mo'i tam bu ra/ 23 bca' ba chos khrims la sogs pa gnang bkag gdams pa'i yi ge'i skor tshangs pa chen po'i sgra dbyangs/

24 log smon gyi rgol ba phyir bcos kyi yi ge'i skor ngan 'gro'i shul lam 'gegs pa'i sgo chen/ 25 tshoms bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gtong thun skor rma bya gzhon nu'i zlos gar/ 26 nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge sna tshogs 'dus pa'i skor phan bde 'jo ba'i bang mdzod/ 27 gzhan gyi dri ba khag gi lan ldon du bris pa sbrang rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 28 zhal gdams su btags pa'i smyon tshig nam mkha'i sprin sgra/ 29 zab mo'i rnam bshad skor mdo sngags dgongs bcud snying por dril ba/ 30 dpe thog bro brdung gi snang tshul sogs gang dran yi ger btab pa rang mtshangs ston pa'i glu chung nam mkha'i me tog gzhon nu'i lding khang*/ 31 don gnyer can rnams kyi ngor byas pa'i smon lam skor bsam 'grub lha yi ljon shing*/ 32 thun min bka' rgya'i skor grub gnyis 'dod 'jo'i rdo rje'i rgya mdud bcas mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi grangs nges su mdzad/ gzhan yang gdan sa chen po 'og min mtshur mdo'i gan+dho lar snga phyi'i nyams gsos dang 'brel/ dgu gtor/ tshes bcu/ phur sgrub/ grwa tshang dus gtor sogs kyi spyan gzigs 'chams chas sogs gsar bskrun dang*/ gser zangs las grub pa'i gu ru dang*/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing zhal thang sogs bris 'bur gyi sku rten che phra brjod las 'das pa/ gsungs rab kyi pusta ka spar bris khyon bsdom stong phrag brgal ba/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo gtsos pa'i chos sbyin 'dzad med spar gyi 'du 'god/ yongs 'dzin rje dbon rnam gnyis kyi gdung rten sogs thugs rten dang*/ rin chen dang po las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod pa'i yo byad bcas 'byor ldan khengs pa 'phrog pa'i rten bzhengs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ 'og min karma/ shar phyogs spungs ri sogs phyogs mtha'i chos sde che phra kun la mchod thebs/ nyams gso/ rten gsum 'du 'god sogs rgya cher ma gnang ba med cing*/

sman sdong dgon/ dge rgyal dgon sogs nges don sgrub rgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon sde lnga tsam gsar 'debs la/ bka' phyag chu bo gcig 'dres kyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i rjes su slob pa'i bslab gsum gyi bca' khrims nyams pa med pa'i bka' bkod bcas/ dus dang rgyun gyi sgrub pa'i mchod thebs/ rten gsum/ yo byad 'du khang sogs kyi mthun rkyen bcas/ dgos dgu yid bzhin stsal zhing*/ tha na dbul po slong mo ba tshun la gsol ras sogs gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi sgo 'phar dus rtag tu 'gyed par mdzad cing*/ 'khor gyi log sgrub dang gdul bya'i 'dod mang la skyo ngal med par/ mchog dman kun dang mthun par spyod pa'i thabs mkhas kyis gzhan sems bsrung zhing*/ rnam pa kun tu gsar 'grogs dang phrag dog med pas phyi thag ring ba sogs bsdu dngos bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa bsam mi khyab pas dngos brgyud nas byang chub chen po'i lam la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i phrin las bcas/ mdor na bshad sgrub las gsum gyi 'khor lo chen pos 'brel tshad don dang ldan cing*/ sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i bka' drin dang rnam thar phyi ma'i dus 'di tsam na 'gran zla dang bral ba nyid do// //slar smras pa/ gang gi rtsal ni skad cig gcig gis zhib mor 'byed pa'i shes rab dang*/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin bye ba phrag brgyar dbang bsgyur de bzhin 'gro ba'i blor/ /yang yang 'bebs la ngal bas ci bya thugs rje'i ye shes gtad tsam gyis/ /dmigs pa med pa'i bde chen stsol 'di bdag gi bla ma'i rnam thar ste/ /gang zhig bcos na lcags kyang gser la rdo yang dngul du bsgyur nus kyi/ /ma bcos tshul khrims mnyam pa nyid las mi mnyam yon tan mkha' 'dra ba/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i nyin mor byed la mtshan mor rgyu dag mig tsha yang*/ /dus 'dir 'chos bzhin bzang mthar phyin na der yang bsngags pas me tog 'thor/

/kun tu ngal bas mi tshe ring por bla ma bsten byas chos mnyan cing*/ /gzhung mang brgya phrag sbyangs mthar phyin pas khengs ldan rnams kyis zla med pa/ /ma brtson rig pa'i gam stabs gcig gis rgyal ba'i bstan la 'chad rtsam gyi/ /'gying 'gros ngoms 'dis deng song khyed la mkhas rnams phrag dog ci'i mi skye/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs skrag shes bzhin shes la dpa' bo'i gam pa phyir mi spo/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs shing gzigs pas thugs rje'i phyag gis mi lhod par/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la don gyis bsnyengs pa med pa'i phrin las sgo/ /mtha' yas 'byed la rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi phrin las khyed kyis bzlums/ /de slad khyed ni 'gro ba'i khur gyis mya ngan mtsho las yongs mi 'da'/ /de srid zhi ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu gter 'gro khams srid 'dir mi 'dzad na/ /dre tshul shes pa'i mig bu phra yang kun tu lta 'dod mos pa'i blos/ /de snyed kun mkhyen bla ma'i phrin las spel ba'i byed por bdag 'gyur shog/ ces kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po bco lnga pa chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos nos te/ gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi ngoms med du btung ba'i skal bzang thob pa slob bu'i tha shal shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer ram/ blo gros mi bzad byams pa'i go cha 'od zer dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bgyi bas sgrub brgyud mchog gi ring lugs la sman pa'i blos bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs spar du bzhengs pa'i nye thog der 'di ltar sbyor zhes rang gi nye gnas karma phun tshogs nas nan tan gyis bskul ba'i re ba rdzogs slad dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi rang gnas lhun grub bsam gtan yid 'ong gling gi skyes mos tshal du rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang gses chu bya lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i dbang phyogs kyi tshes bcu gza' skar dge ba'i nyin grub par bgyis te bris pa sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ban+tu/

zhes kar rabs rim byon rnam thar spar bskrun zhu skabs/ zhal bskang ched du mkhan ming khra 'gu bas/ rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum dkar chag las rnam thar skor zur bkol zhus pa lags/ ༄༅/ /rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so// thog mar mdo sngags lung bstan gyi che ba dang bcas skyes rabs ji ltar byon cing*/ sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul gyi skabs/ de nas skyes chen rnams kyis ngos 'dzin dang 'brel bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa so sor mnga' gsol khri 'bul zhus pa'i skabs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du 'bri klog nas brtsam/ phyag chen chos drug gi bar/ gsan bsam ji ltar gnang ba'i skabs/bsod nams kyi tshogs spel ba'i phyir lho gnas/ 'phags yul gangs ri bcas la gnas gzigs dang 'brel mchod 'bul gnang ba'i skabs/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i phyir/ rgya dkar nag bod kyi yul khag rnams su chibs zhal bsgyur ba'i skabs/ bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i phyir/ rgya gar du btsan byol byon nas gdan sa chen po bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling gsar du bskrun pa'i skabs/ rgya gar/ bal yul/ 'bras ljongs/ 'brug yul bcas la mchod yon 'brel ba'i sgo nas bshad sgrub 'dzin pa'i gdan sa gsar bskrun gnang ba'i skabs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nub phyogs kyi yul gru rnams su spel ba'i phyir chibs zhal bsgyur nas phrin las bskyang ba'i skabs/ ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog brgya phrag phyed la zung gis 'phel ba'i bgrang byar byon pa yan gyi rnam thar bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig dran pas 'khor ba'i gdung sel zhing*//bsam kun yongs rdzogs mdzad pa grags dkar gyis//khor yug rgyas 'gengs rgyal ba'i rnam par thar//yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs la phyag bgyi'o//gang gi mkhyen pa'i ye shes me long ngogs//ji lta ji snyed zab dang rgya che'i gzugs//sgrib bral dag tshang 'char zhing rdzogs gyur pa//rgyal dbang rig pa'i rdo rjes dge legs stsol//gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mi mchog karma pa'i//mtshan gyi rnga chen rgyun mi 'chad 'di bzhin//'dzam gling bye ba brgyar yang de bzhin te//bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes gcig gi 'phrul//ji snyed sna tshogs shes bya'i rjes 'gro ba'i//ngo mtshar phrin las rgya mtsho mi zad pa//de snyed 'phags pa'i blos kyang mtshon min na//so skye'i blo yis spyod yul ga la zhig/rin chen rin thang med pa'i kha byang bzhin//thos pas don ldan nges par mi bslu ba//skyes bu dam pa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul//nyung ngu'i ngag gis rnam par dbye bar bya//de la rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las kyi rang gzugs rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa sku yi 'phreng ba na rim du byon pa las skyes rabs bcu drug pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog gi rnam par thar pa cung zad 'god pa la/

spyir rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu bsdus te gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul du bsgyur bar mdzad pa ni/ sa la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*/ ji lta ba bzhin 'chad pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i yul las 'das pas na so skye dman pa bdag lta bus phyogs tsam yang zhu ba'i spobs pa ga la skye nus/ 'on kyang dad ldan spro ba bskyed pa'i mig rgyan lta bur/ gdul bya thun mong gi snang ngor bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che ji ltar bskyangs pa dang*/ dmu rgod rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ thun min rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul las brtsam ste/ brjod bya'i don rnams skabs brgyad du bsdus nas bkod pa la/ thog mar mdo sngags lung bstan gyi che ba dang bcas skyes rabs ji ltar byon cing*/ sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul gyi skabs ni/ de yang ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po'i dpal gyi mgul nas lung gi me tog 'thor ba 'di ltar/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ nga 'das lo ni nyis stong na//gdong dmar yul du bstan pa 'byung*//spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar 'gyur//de yi bstan pa'i snyigs ma la//byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra//karma pa zhes bya ba 'byung*//zhes ma 'ongs par bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren drug par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra yi rnam 'phrul du lung bstan pa dang*/ yang khro bo gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ yongs su dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa'i//tshe 'dir grub pa ston pa'i ched//karma pa zhes yongs grags 'byung*//zhes dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs su lung bstan pa dang*/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phrin las skyong byed cing : mtshur phu zhes byar dus gsum mkhyen pa 'byung :

dbang rtags rigs kyi cod pan zhwa nag 'dzin: skad cig re la sems can dpag med 'dren: zhes gdan sa/ cod pan bcas lung bstan pa dang*/ yang*/ lo tsā rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bdag la gson//gsung gi sprul pa zla gam pho brang du//ma 'ongs khyod kyi skye ba nyer gcig 'byung*//spyan ras gzigs sprul dus gsum kun mkhyen pa//zhes sku phreng nyer gcig bar 'byung bar lung bstan pa dang*/ khyad par du rje bcu drug pa chen po bye brag tu lung bstan pa'i tshul ni/ o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pa'i gter lung las/ theg mchog mya ngan 'das 'og dgos pa'i mtshan: bde ba'i bdag nyid rig pa'i rdo rje dang : o rgyan phrin las bsam gtan la sogs 'byung : zhes sogs lung gis yongs su bsngags pa ltar/ thog mar skyes rabs kyi dbang du byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nga ro snyan pa'i drung du/ phyag dar khrod kyi gos phul nas dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa nas brtsam/ ma 'ongs par bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren lnga pa'i rgyal tshab tu dga' ldan lha yi gnas su/ lha yi bu legs pa skyes zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes nas/ slar yang 'dzam bu'i gling du gzigs pa rnam pa bzhis gzigs te/ me tog lha yi grong khyer zhes bya ba na/ yab rgyal po seng ge stag zhes bya ba dang*/ yum lha mo dga' ba'i nga ro zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su byon nas/ bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren drug pa seng ge'i sgra/ zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas/ lo bdun khrir dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa'i bar/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la brtson par mdzad cing*/ bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren 'di'i bstan pa la'ang*/ ri bo ta lar snying rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten dbang phyug /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du grub pa'i slob dpon sa ra ha dang*/

klu yi byang chub sogs pan grub mang po dang*/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang lo tsā ba rgyal dbang mchog dbyangs/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang po dang*/ gzhan yang chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po sogs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams su skye ba bzhes nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa dang*/ lhag par rje dus gsum mkhyen pa nas brtsam/ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bar sku phreng na rim du byon te/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi go 'phang la 'god par mdzad nas/ slar yang ches snyigs mar gyur pa'i skyabs dang*/ mgon dang dpung gnyen du dgongs shing*/ khyad par bod gangs can gyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rmeng med du bcom pa na/ bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha btsan por bsgos te sku yi skye ba bzhes pa na/ thog mar lung bstan pa'i tshul ni/ spyir yang karma pa ni/ bod kyi sprul pa'i sku thams cad las snga shos yin pa/ bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad zhal mthun la/ 'phags chen 'di rnams ngos 'dzin gnang ba'i tshe yang*/ mo brtag lung zhu tsam ma yin par/ sku phreng snga mas 'byung 'gyur mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ gnas dang*/ dus 'di lta bur srid pa nye bar bzung ba'i nges pa gzigs nas lung bstan bstsal ba'i shog dril gnang srol yod pa dang*/ de nyid khyer nas brtsal bas mchog sprul 'khrul bral nges rnyed 'gyur ba ltar/ rgyal mchog bco lnga pa chen pos ma 'ongs gsal gzigs kyis lung bstan du bstsal ba'i zhal chems bka' rgya bcas/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims la gnang ba 'di ltar/ 'di nas shar phyogs gser ldan chu yi 'gram//mda' bsnun dpa' bos bzung ba'i ljongs kyi char//lhun chags seng ge 'gyings pa'i phang pa ru//dpal gyi ri la a dang thub kyis brgyan//sa yi khyim du chos dkar rje'u'i rigs//'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i lhums su gnas mal mthong*//glang gi nya'am byi ba lo pa zhig/a ti khyab brdal kun bzang mkha' dbyings las//snang rig zung 'jug ye shes sgron me che//rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rjer 'bod//ces pa'i lung don bzhin gdan sa chen po mtshur mdo bo lung gi shar phyogs/

mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khul/ chu bo gser ldan te/ yongs su grags pa 'bri klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram/ gling rje ge sar skyes bu don grub byon pa'i skabs su skyen po'i mda' la rang dbang thob pa/ tsha zhang mdan ma byang khras skyong ba'i yul ljongs mdan khog /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ya gyal/ glang thang byang chub sgrol ma'i gtsug lag khang gi nye zhol du/ sa skyong sde dge'i mdun na 'don/ chos la dkar ba'i rje'u'i rigs/ a thub zhes pa'i 'khrungs gzhis su/ yab rje sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i sras kyi go gnas can tshe dbang phun tshogs dang*/ yum 'jig rten mkha' 'gro mi mo'i tshul du bzung ba skal bzang chos sgron gnyis la sras bzhi dang sras mo bzhi brgyad yod pa'i mched bdun par/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing pho A D 1924 byi ba'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes 15 la sku bltams/ yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pa'i dus su'ang*/ yig drug gsung ba'i sgra gsal bar thos pa dang*/ zla 6 tshes 14 nyin/ lhums su ma bzhugs pas yab yum rnams thugs tshab dgos pa byung*/ slar yang yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan par mdzad pa dang*/ rdzogs chen mchog sprul lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes/ thog mar lhums su bzhugs skabs nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin dang*/ sku bltams pa'i gnas skye bo mi nag pa'i khyim du ma yin par/ gtsang zhing dben pa seng ge rnam rdzong gi ngogs su sku 'khrungs dgos par lung bstan gnang ba ltar/ gnas de nyid du sku 'khrungs pa ni/ lhun chags seng ge 'gyings pa'i phang pa ru zhes gong ma'i zhal chems dang mthun zhing*/ 'khrungs pa'i dus nam mkha' dang bar snang nas lha yi rol mo dang glu dbyangs snyan pa sna tshogs sgrogs pa kun gyis mthong zhing*/ gzim gur 'od zer dkar pos khyab pa dang*/

der yod pa'i chu snod dang*/ yon chab sogs 'o mar 'gyur ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ dgung grangs bzhi lnga'i steng la sku rtsed tshul du/ yab gzhis pho brang yang thog nas sgong nga sa la brdab pa ma chag pa dang*/ yang gsol zho blug pa'i zhal dkar kha bsdams pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa rnams phyis su yab gzhis a thub kyi g.yang sgam du mjal rgyu yod/gnyis pa skyes chen rnams kyis ngos 'dzin dang 'brel/ bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa so sor mnga' gsol khri 'bul zhus pa'i skabs ni/ ngos 'dzin gnang skabs/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i gzim lam du/ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje/ phyag rdor dril bsnol thabs/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis/ 'khrungs gzhis a thub kyi gzim khang thog tu bzhugs pa gzigs pa dang*/ rje gong ma'i 'da' ka'i zhal chems ang yig tu yod pa gzhan gyis shes ma nus kyang*/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po ches zhib gzigs kyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu gyur nas ngos 'dzin gsal bar byung yang*/ sngar zhal chems ha cang gsang ba dam pa'i nyer len lta bus/ gzhung sar snyan 'bul zhu skabs 'gal rkyen phran bu byung ba'i dbang gis gser khrir mnga' gsol cung zad phyi 'gyangs dgos pa byung yang*/ mthar ye shes kyi chos skyong rnams kyis phrin las dus su sgrub pa'i rang rtags mngon sum du byung bas/ gegs dang bar chad thams cad rang zhir gyur te/ 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen por snyan 'bul zhus skabs/ gong gsal ngos 'dzin rnams dang dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu gyur nas/ yang srid rtsod med kyi bka' gsal phebs te/ ngos 'dzin 'khrul bral du gnang nas/ dgung grangs bdun pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho rta yi lor/ byams mgon si tu rin po che dang*/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che rnam pa gnyis ched phebs kyis/

thog mar sku tshe 7zhabs pad yun du bstan pa'i ched tshe dbang dang*/ khrus gsol/ na bza' mtshan gsol dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phul/ lcags lugs zla 1 tshes 27 nyin/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po che dang*/ mtshur phu'i gzim tshab pa bcas nas thog mar khrus gsol gyis dbu zhwa 'bul ba sogs rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar zab dgu phyes te mjal kha gnang*/ tshes 29 nyin sangs rgyas mnyan pa rin po ches mjal kha zhus/ zla 2 tshes 1 nyin chibs zhal dpal spungs phyogs bsgyur bar mdzad de/ mdan rnam rgyal gling du bzhugs/ dgon de'i dge 'dun pa rnams nas dad mjal zhus shing*/ maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bteg 'bul zhus/ de nas gling tshang gi thab bsu dang mjal kha zhus/ zis pha wa ta sor sde dge'i gzhung zhabs pa rnams chibs bsu dang po bcar/ rmog mdar chibs bsu gnyis pa bcar/ phebs lam rim brgyud kyis sde dge rgyal sa lhun grub steng du phebs/ sde dge chos rgyal tshe dbang bdud 'dul dang*/ nang chen btsun mo g.yu sgron gtsos gzhung zhabs mi mang bcas la mjal bcar byin rlabs mdzad/ phebs lam du lcang ra pho brang nas kun bzang rtses gdan zhus mjal kha gnang nas/ rtse zul mdor a lo dpal 'byor dgon gyi phebs bsu dang*/ mgon lcer dge 'dun pa rnams la mjal kha bstsal/ mgo se lar dpal spungs kyi dge 'dun pa rnams kyis gtsos chibs bsu ser skya drug brgya brgal ba bcar/ gzhi khre ma zhes pa'i sa gnas de/ sngar nas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar gsar du phye zhing*/ legs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas yin pa der/ kan ting ta yi si tu byams mgon pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po ched phebs gnang ste/ mjal dar 'bul bzhes gnang*/ de nas zla 2 tshes 8 nyin dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gdan sa chen por spos bsu gser phreng sogs kyi bkod pa rgya che dang*/ phyi nang thams cad chag chag gdab cing*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas bar med du sbrel ba dang*/

bsang dud spos kyi ngad pa sogs sprin bzhin gtibs pa'i dbus nas/ 'du khang chen mor gdan zhus kyis mi 'jigs gdong lngas bteg pa'i khri 'phang mthon por bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ chabs cig skyabs mchog si tu rin po che mchog nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang sbrags 7zhabs brtan 'bul bar mdzad cing*/ slar tshes 12 nyin yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gzhal med khang chen por seng ges bteg pa'i khri la mnga' gsol zab rgyas kyi mdun sar/ mdo sngags gzhung rigs la gzigs pa'i spyan ras yangs pa rnams kyis rgyud dang*/ gzhung chen rnams kyi tshogs bshad 'bel bas chos kyi mchod pas sna drangs te/ mdo smad khul yod ris med kyi bla sprul dgon sde/ dad sbyin/ rgyal blon dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lhag par kaṃ tshang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bla sprul dge 'dun pa rnams lta ci smos/ grub mtha' bka' brgyud pa yod do cog nas khri 'bul gyi bkod pa rgya chen po phul ba dang 'brel/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar du 7zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pas mtshon/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che 'byung ba'i phrin las kyi sgo brgya phye bar mdzad do//de nas spyir ye gdod ma nas yon tan thams cad rang chas su bzhugs mod kyi/ thun mong gdul bya rnams kyang rang rang gi brtson 'grus dang*/ shes rab la brten nas gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad mngon du byed dgos par gdams pa'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis tshe ring gi drung nas thog mar 'bri klog sbyang ba'i dbu tshugs gnang zhing*/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nyin thugs rje chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshogs dbur phebs/ tshes bco lnga nyin bka' dbang dang mjal kha gnang*/ zla ba de'i tshes 22 nyin sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i chu mgo gcig pur gyur pa 'og min thugs kyi gnas mchog mtshur mdo bo lung gi gtsug lag khang gi chos kyi khri 'phang mngon mthor mnga' gsol ba'i phyir/

si tu rin po che mchog dang*/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po che bcas lhan du dpal spungs nas lhan rgyas chibs bteg /dpal spungs kyi dge 'dun pa rnams kyis phebs skyel zhus/ phebs lam rim brgyud kyis/ gter ston dgon dang*/ skyabs che dgon/ rgyun ne dgon sogs dgon sde rnams su zhabs kyis bcags shing mjal kha gnang*/ gdan sa bar gyi phebs bsu dang 'brel/ gdan 'dren zhus kyang re zhig phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes ma gnang*/ de nas drung ram dgon/ bla bo dgon/ rdo dgon sogs rim pas phebs shing*/ nang chen rgyal po'i mdun zhabs kha shas nas sa tshugs mang po bar zhabs zhu bcar/ dga' ldan dgon/ zur mang rnam rgyal rtse/ mchog gling dgon/ go che dgon bcas la phebs/ khra 'ug gnas mdo sogs phebs lam du ma 'khel bas mjal kha zhu bar bcar/ skyo brag tu phebs shing nang chen gyi gdan zhu dang*/ mtshur phu sgar chen gzhung gi phebs bsu'i thog ma dge g.yog chos bzang nas mjal kha zhus/ de nas rim par byon pas/ nang chen rgyal sras gtsos pas chibs bsu zhus te/ nang chen rgyal sar phebs/ phyogs der 'khod pa'i dgon sde spyi dang*/ lhag par gdan sa bar gyi bla sprul ched bcar zhus/ de nas dpal kha lder mo dgon brgyud dil yag dgon du phebs/ zla sprul dang*/ sa bcu sprul sku gnyis kyis dbus/ bla sprul dge 'dun rnams la mjal kha gnang*/ sgi rna dgon du mtshur phu sgar chen bla gzhung gi phebs bsu zab rgyas dang sgar grwa sgrigs shing*/ dbus su dbu gur tshe 'phel kun 'dus phub pa'i nang gdan zhus dang 'brel/ sgar chen mdzod pa sogs nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul/ rgyal dbang mchog kyang sngar 'dris mi bzhin zhabs bsu rnams la thugs dgongs dgyes mnyes mdzad/ gzhan yang dge rgyas ri pa stod smad bar gsum sogs kyi bla sprul dgon sde/ yul mi mchog dman kun nas dad mjal ltar mjal kha gnang*/

tshes 13 nyin mthong grol zhwa nag gi cod pan thog mar sgron 'bul zhu skabs/ nam mkhar 'ja' sprin 'khrigs shing*/ me tog gi char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar gyi yid can mtha' dag gtan bder 'god pa'i lam sne thog mar ston par mdzad/ de nas dpal spungs mkhyen brtse rin po che gdan sar phyir phebs kyi mjal bcar gnang ba bzhin thugs la btags/ tshes 15 nyin sgar chen phebs bsu'i bla grwa rnams nas gso sbyong bzhes/ 'brong pa nas bzung phebs lam rim brgyud nag chur zhabs sor 'khod/ nag chu rdzong nas mthong grol dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron zhus/ de nas phebs lam rim bgrod kyis/ zla ba bdun pa tshes bcu dgu nyin gnyan chen thang lha'i mdun du phebs pa dang*/ rten rdzas rgya chen dang*/ lha g.yag dkar po zhig phul ba/ mis khrid pa ltar sgar khrod nas thang lha'i rten mkhar bar shar gyis song ba/ rten rdzas dngos su bzhes pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar ba byung*/ tshes 20 nyin rgyal sras 'jam mgon rin po che ston 'khor dbus nas/ dpal spungs su phebs pa dang*/ zhal mjal bas rten 'brel legs tshogs kyi snang ba brtas/ la thog la rtser mtshur phu sgar chen gzhung dang*/ chos gong rgyal tshab bla brang gi phebs bsu dang po bcar/ de nas yag chu khar yangs chen dgon dang*/ rga lo dgon gyi ser skya rnams nas mjal kha zhus/ de nas spis chu khar/ mtshur sgar bla gzhung gis phebs bsu gnyis pa la rje gong ma'i thugs sras byams pa rin po che mchog dang*/ chos gong bla brang gi sku tshab bcas bcar/ zla 8 ches 4 nyin mtshur phu la steng du/ chos gong rgyal tshab rin po che dang*/ gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che/ gzhan yang mtshur sgar bla brang*/ chos gong*/ gnas nang bcas kyi dge 'dun pa tshang ma chibs bsur bcar te/ rten 'brel dge legs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i snang byed mgron du 'bod pa'i dge mtshan thog mar 'char ro//de nas tshes 5

gza' dang rgyu skar sogs phyi nang dus sbyor gyi rten 'byung gi sgo brgya lhun gyis grub pa'i nyin/ gdan sa chen po 'og min thugs kyi gnas mchog mtshur mdo bo lung gi gdan sar 7zhabs sor dgod rgyu'i thog mar skyed tshal bsam 'grub gling du/ bla brang gzhung gi thab bsu dang 'brel rgyal ba rigs lnga zhes pa nas/ 'dus tshogs nor bu'i phreng bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ phye ma'i phur ma/ dar cha'i rigs 'phyar zhing*/ 'bud dkrol brdung gsum rol mo'i rigs sna tshogs pa dang*/ rma bya'i gdugs la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag dang*/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas tshe ring rnam drug dang*/ rjes 'brel gdong lnga'i dbang pos gar 'cham sogs lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas mdun bsus te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa na rim gyi byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor 'og min thugs kyi gnas mchog mtshur mdo bo lung gi gtsug lag khang gi gzim dkyil bkra shis khang gsar du zhabs kyi re kha bkod ma thag /der 'dus pa kun gyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang 'brel brtan bzhugs phul/ de nas zla 9 tshes nyin lha ldan du chibs zhal bsgyur nas/ 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i mdun du dbu skra gtsug phud phul/ 'di skabs 7gong sa chen pos 'bral med cod pan dbu la bzhes pa'i gzigs snang gsal bar byung ba ma zad/ dbu zhwa gtan nas gsol med na'ang*/ der bzhugs bka' blon khri mon pas/ de ring mchog sprul rin po ches dbu zhwa phud ma song zhes yab rje la gsungs pa ni/ ye shes rang snang gi cod pan 'bral med du bzhugs pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon sum du bstan par mdzad la/ de skabs 7gong sa chen pos/ rgyal ba'i dbang po na rim gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i ched du/ thub bstan rig grol ye shes zhes pa'i mtshan dang*/

zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste bstsal ba'i nang*/ mang thos yon tan kun gyi gzhi'am rtsa ba bslab pa gsum//lhag pa'i tshul khrims mkhan slob spyan sngar khas blangs ji srid 'tshor//'dul ba lung sde bzhi yi dgongs don dam sdom tshul khrims ni//mig 'bras ltar bsrung gnas brtan 'od srung che de'i rjes 'gror shog/zhes gsungs pa'ang*/ rje gong mas rtsa rlung gi geg skyon lam du slong ba'i phyir/ bla ma dang*/ lhag pa'i lhas gnang ba thob cing lung bstan pa ltar/ lam gyi grogs bsten par mdzad pa la thugs yid ma rang ba'i gsung lta bur mngon na yang*/ de ltar ma yin par byang chub sems dpa' chen pos bden pa'i tshig dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid btsun pa'i rnam par thar pa 'od srung chen po dang*/ chos mtshungs par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i ma 'ongs gsal gzigs kyi lung bstan du bstsal ba'ang*/ mngon sum 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di nyid dang*/ yang*/ rang lugs mig ldongs 'byung bya'i log rtog dag/legs sel thar lam mig bu gsal ston shog /ces dang*/bka' brgyud gtsang ma'i rnam thar ci mchis pa//sngon byon rnam thar ji bzhin mthar 'khyongs shog/ces gsungs pa/ spyir rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog grub mtha' ris med la gzigs pa'i spyan ras yangs shing*/ lhag par rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum sogs la ha cang gces spras che zhing*/ nyams med yun du gnas pa'i ched bstan don kho nar brtson pa'i phyag bzhes 'di lta bu mjal ba'i tshe/ bden gsol smon tshig gsung bar mdzad pa po mchog la'ang shin tu dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba'i gnas su gyur pa'o/ /zla 11 pa'i nang gdan sar slar ldog par mdzad/ zla tshes gza' skar dus sbyor tat+kal shin tu dge ba'i nyin mtshur mdo bo lung gi sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol rgyas pa zhus shing*/

byams mgon ta yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po dang*/ skyabs mgon 'brug chen mi pham chos kyi dbang po/ rgyal tshab grags pa rgya mtsho/ dpa' bo gtsug lag smra ba sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis mnga' dbang shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor bar mdzad cing*/ lung rigs la gzigs pa'i spyan ras yangs pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi rtogs brjod/ sa lam gyi rnam gzhag /phun tshogs lnga ldan dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa sogs mdzad cing*/ bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad du gtogs pa'i dgon sde khag gis gtsos/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gis dgyes rgu'i sri zhur brtson pa'i legs 'bul dang 'brel/ 7zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya phye bar mdzad do// gsum pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du 'bri klog nas brtsam phyag chen chos drug gi bar/ gsan bsam ji ltar gnang ba'i skabs ni/ de nas bzung lo bzhi'i ring*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'bo gangs dkar rin po che'i mdun nas thos bsam mdzad pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i skabs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi skyes rabs ngo mtshar ba du ma gangs dkar rin po cher bstsal/ de nas dgung grangs bcu gnyis/ shing phag zla 12 tshes 3 nyin skyabs rje byams mgon si tu rin po ches dbus/ skyes chen dam pa rnams las zab chos spyi dang lhag par thun min nā ro chos drug dang*/ phyag rgya chen po sogs kyi gdams ngag rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa'i phyir/ chibs zhal mdo khams su bsgyur bar mdzad/ tshes 8 nyin yangs can spyi sor phebs/ sngar med pa'i chu mig gsar du byung ba dang*/ rta rdzi'i chu tshan du phebs pas/ nam zla dgun kha yin kyang*/ sbrul du ma zh-ig 'ong ste/ mgul dang sku pang du sku rtsed rtse ba'i tshul mdzad/ tshes 29 nyin thang lha'i ri zhol du phebs nas rten mkhar du byon skabs/ lcags lug lor phul ba'i lha g.yag dkar po de nyid/

thang lha'i ri sul nas byung ste/ ngar sgra dang bcas rnga ma g.yab pa sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis sgar gyi thad du byung zhing*/ slar mi mngon par gyur pa sogs kun gyis mthong bas ya mtshan skyes/ de nas dbu ma thang du rdzogs chen dgon nas gcung dpon slob rin po che mchog phebs bsu dang*/ rten 'brel zhu mkhan 'byor ba bzhin/ sgar chen bla gzhung gis kyang rten 'brel dang*/ so sor mjal kha gnang*/ de nas nag chu sogs phebs lam rnams la dad ldan rnams kyis bskul ngor/ dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che mjal sgron dang*/ bka' dbang sogs kyis re skong mdzad bzhin/ dgung grangs bcu gsum me byi lor/ 'brong pa stod ma'i sa mtshams mtsho 'bur zhes par phebs/ der chu chung ngu zhig yod pa dgun gyis 'khyag pa chags pa'i steng*/ skyabs rje mchog phebs skabs zhabs rjes bzhag gnang ba/ slar 'khyag pa bzhus nas kyang*/ chu yi steng du zhabs rjes gsal bar mngon pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa khyad par can ston par mdzad do//de nas bla tshang dgon du phebs skabs kyang*/ zhal dkar gsol cog steng nas 'phar te zhal ba'i thog shugs cher brdabs kyang chag grums ma byung ba dang*/ de nas zla 3 tshes 5 la sgi rnar phebs/ der dpal spungs kyi mgron gnyer dbus phebs bsu khag dang*/ nang chen sa chigs zhabs zhu hor 'dra bcas sku bcar la phyag dbang bstsal/ de nas ri pa stod ma dang*/ bar mar phebs nas bka' dbang dang*/ dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron/ dgon la khrus gsol sogs gnang*/ 'di skabs ha sag mi rigs kyi dmag slebs pas sde dge rgyal po dang*/ nang chen rgyal po lhan nas brtag zhu slebs par/ bstan pa spyi yi zhabs rim dang*/ dmag zlog tu gro lod yas zor gsungs/ sbyin bsreg gi hom gyi me sbar skabs me dpung chen po shar phyogs su nyin lam mang por 'gro ba kun gyis mthong*/ de nas ri pa smad ma dang*/

stong nag bla chung dang bla chen dgon du phebs/ bla chen dgon du rab gnas rnam dag dgongs gsal gsungs pa'i/ phyag nas las ring bsrel 'khrungs pa da lta sgar chen rten khrod du bzhugs/ de nas tshangs gsar mgon po dgon/ gnam dgon/ dkar chung dgon rnams su phebs nas bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa/ rab gnas/ rten khrus sogs mdzad de 'gro don rgya cher bskyangs/ de nas rta rna dgon du phebs te/ grub chen yer pa ye shes brtsegs kyi gzim chung du bzhugs pa na/ ri pa smad ma dgon du bzhugs skabs phul ba'i spyan gzigs rna ba gcig yod pa des rdo la rmig rjes gsal bar bzhag/de nas 'gro don bskyang bzhin gad chags dgon brgyud rdzong mgo ri khrod du phebs/ der chu shin tu dkon zhing thag ring nas 'khur dgos stabs/ bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtshos chu 'byung bar gsol ba btab pas/ sku khrus gsol ba dang*/ char zil bur babs/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pas/ phyis sku khrus gsol ba'i gnas de nyid nas rgyun 'chad med pa'i chu mig gsar du byung*/ de nas rim phebs kyis dil yag dgon du phebs skabs/ spyan gzigs rna ba la chibs nas rdzu 'phrul gyis gzim gur gyi chon thag dang*/ yol gor gyi steng nas phebs pas der yod kun gyis mjal/ de nas nang chen rgyal po'i gdan zhu ltar/ rgyal khang du phebs/ tshe dbang bstsal/ der mkhyen sprul rin po che dbus su phebs skabs dang 'khel bas/ de'i mdun nas yon dge'i dag snang pak+ṣi'i bla sgrub dang jo lugs sgrol dkar gyi bka' dbang gsan/ de nas ja pa dgon zhabs su phebs skabs/ dgon de'i rgyab ri sngar gong ma theg mchog rdo rjes bka' bsgo dam bzhag gnang zhing*/ lha mgron du mnga' gsol ba'i btsan rgod phyā rgyal me tri yin pas/ der spyan gzigs btsan rta dmar po zhig phul ba bdag tu bzung tshul gsal por bstan te/ mis khrid pa bzhin ri rtse der song*/

de nas zla 8 tshes 1 nyin gdan sa bar pa karma'i dgon du phebs nas gong ma na rim gyis zhabs kyis bcags pa karma'i khri dmar zhes pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol zhing mnga' gsol karma'i mkhan sprul nas ka rabs na rim gyi rtogs brjod sogs chos kyi bgro gleng dang 'brel maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul zhing*/ 'di skabs bka' brgyud gser phreng gi sku brnyan 'ga' shas dbu zhwa phud pa sogs skyes bu dam pa'i rang rtags 'gog med du bstan par mdzad/ si tu rin po che mchog kyang gdan sa 'di bar chibs bsur phebs/ de nas lha thog brgyud ris med kyi dgon sde spyi dang*/ lhag par bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa/ skyabs rje dgon dang*/ drung ram sogs su zhabs kyis bcags shing 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ skam thog gru brgyud a lo rtse sum mdor bzhugs/ sde dge rgyal blon la mjal phyag gnang*/ me byi lo dgung grangs bcu gsum zla 10 tshes 5 nyin dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du chibs bsu gser phreng mchod pa'i yo byad du mas sngun blangs te/ yab sras lhan rgyas zhabs sor 'khod cing nyin mtshan khor yug tu phyi nang rig pa'i gnas gzhung chen skor dang*/ rgyud sde rgya mtshor gsan bsam gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing*/ dgung grangs bco lnga pa stag lo rgyal bas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus chen dkar phyogs gral tshes 6 nyin si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi thugs rten chos 'khor bkra shis sgo mang gi mdun sar/ si tu rin po che karma bshad sgrub chos kyi seng ge nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gis mkhan slob sbrags mar mdzad nas/ tshig snga ma dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ bar ma rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnams bstsal te/ dpal ldan rang byung rig pa'i ye shes lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma phrin las don kun grub pa'i sde zhes mtshan phul bar mdzad/ yang tshes 9 nyin rgya chen spyod pa dang*/

zab mo lta ba'i srol gnyis las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gnyis stabs cig tu gsan te/ mtshan byang chub sems dpa' blo gros zhi ba'i snying po gzhan phan chos kyi zla ba zhes gsol/ gzhan yang lho brag mar pa'i gser chos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bka' brgyud sngags mdzod dang*/ sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi gdams ngag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa gdams ngag mdzod bcas kyi smin byed dbang*/ grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab brten klags lung bcas pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen sogs mdor na bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bzhes gnang zhing*/ don brgyud kyi rgyal sar phebs so//de nas lha thog rgyal po sku gshegs/ der chibs zhal bsgyur zhing*/ lam bar du khro ru dang*/ 'dzi sgar rnams su phebs/ mchog sprul yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang*/ tshur phebs lam/ mdzo rdzi/ rgyun ne/ skyabs rje/ drung ram sogs gdan sa rnams su phebs shing gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro don bskyangs shing slar dpal spungs su phebs/ sa stag zla 9 tshes 3 nyin yab sras lhan rgyas li thang phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur phebs lam du mkhyen brtse rin po ches gtsos rdzong gsar dgon gyis chibs bsu dang 'brel gdan 'dren zhus/ dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che mjal sgron skabs mkhyen brtse rin po che chos kyi blo gros kyis dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku mngon sum dang*/ dbu zhwa yang dbu las khru gang tsam 'phags pa mjal/ de skabs rdzong gsar dgon gyi nang rten rnams mjal kha zhu gnang mdzad/ de nas phebs lam rim brgyud kyis li thang spangs phug dgon du phebs nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i 'dra brnyan gsung byon ma mjal khar phebs skabs/ lha khang gi ka ba g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi ka gdan rdo ba'i steng du/ rgyal dbang mchog dang*/ si tu rin po che yab sras gnyis bka' mol gnang ba'i tshul gyis zhabs rjes re re byon/

yang bar skor du'ang*/ gzim khyis lder mo'i rjes dang*/ chibs rar chibs pa'i smig rjes kyang byon/ yang skor lam du skyabs mchog rnam gnyis nas so sor zhabs rjes re byon/ mtsho skor du phebs skabs mtsho nang nas dung dang rgya gling gi snyan gsan btang ba kun gyis thos shing*/ mtsho mthar yang zhabs rjes mang du byon pa sogs thun mong gi mthong chos su grub/ dgon grwar mang ja dang phyag 'gyed gnang nas/ 'brug zhi dgon du phebs/ dbang dang*/ khrus/ rab gnas sogs mdzad cing*/ der rmu ti dang*/ lcags phu zhes pa'i yul tsho gnyis sngon gyi zhe 'khon gyis lo bcu'i ring dme 'khrugs sna tshogs kyis mi grangs 84 tsam rkyen lam du btang ba/ de'i grong bdag so sor mjam kha bcar nas/ mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pas bde ba'i lam du bkod par mdzad/ der yongs 'dzin karma tshe ring sku gshegs zhag gnyis tsam thugs dam ma grol bar bzhugs pa ngo mtshar ba'i rnam pa bstan der tshogs gnyis sbyang spel gyi gsung chos dang*/ sku spur bsreg bzhus yang dag pa mdzad/ slar rdza sgo dgon/ phyag phreng lha go mtsho stod dgon/ bang ra dgon sogs su re skong mdzad de/ spangs phug tu phebs skabs/ dus mkhyen gsung byon ma'i lha khang 'gram du mchong rgyugs mdzad tshul bstan par phyis zhabs rjes bdun byon/ de nas zla 3 tshes 12 nyin dpal spungs phyogs su zhabs bteg li thang dgon chen du phebs/ der rgya nag tu phebs dgos tshul rgya gzhung gi pho nya'am gser yig pa slebs kyang*/ srid kyi che thabs tsam las bstan don dang chos kyi 'gro don de tsam mi 'byung ba dgongs nas/ gnam gshis sogs kyis ngo phebs ma grub pa'i lo rgyus dang 'brel pho nya phyir btang mdzad/ zla 5 tshes 6 nyin dpal spungs su 7zhabs sor bkod/ de nas sgrub thabs kun btus dbang lung gsan bzhes dang*/ mkhyen sprul rin po che'i mdun nas phyag dpe gsan sbyang rim par gnang*/

de nas lcags 'brug zla 9 tshes 15 nyin gdan sa mtshur phu ste dbus la chibs zhal bsgyur/ si tu rin po che dang*/ mkhyen brtse rin po che gnyis nas phebs skyel skabs/ yab sras 'bral mi phod pa'i tshul gyis spyan chab bsil zhing mjal dar 'bul bzhes mdzad/ de nas phebs lam rim brgyud kyis/ zla 10 tshes 8 la mdan khog tu 'khrungs gzhis su yab yum lhan rgyas dang*/ gcung dpon dpon slob rin po che bcas lhan 'dzoms gnang*/ de nas mdan rnam rgyas gling*/ 'bru tshe bh+rum̐ dgon/ dran thang dgon/ zhwa mgon dgon sogs bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa rnams la zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ mnyan pa rin po che phebs bsur bcar/ ban chen bsam 'grub chos gling du phebs shing*/ mgon khang du mnyan pa rin po ches gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i zhing skyong sku brnyan gyis chibs pas 'tsher bas/ zhing skyong gi bskang mdos gsar 'dzugs gnang*/ tshes bcu'i gar 'chams sogs gzigs 'bul zhus/ de nas khra 'gu dgon du phebs/ tshe sgrub kyi gar 'cham sogs gzigs 'bul zhus/ 'dam dkar dgon du phebs lam rgya nag ma ṇi/ khra legs rin po ches dung 'khor gsar bzhengs la rab gnas gnang*/ de nas 'dam dkar/ khra 'gu/ ban chen/ bla'o/ /bdud rtsi mthil brgyud rnam rgyal rtser phebs/ der rtse gling gnyis kha mchu lo mang byas shing*/ mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi bya ngan rgyun ring byung ba'i 'khon pa bsdums par mdzad de/ dgon khag gcig tu dril bar mdzad pas/ de nas bzung 'khon med sprin bral zla ba yar gyi ngo lta bu byung*/ drung pa mchog sprul chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes/ de nas gter chen mchog gyur gling pa'i gdan sa rtsi rke nor bu gsum mdo brgyud/ slar karma dgon du phebs/ der zhag bco lnga tsam ring dad ldan rnams la smin grol gyi gdams pa rgya chen bstsal/ slar nang chen rgyal sa dang*/ dpal kha lder mo dgon/

dil yag dgon rnams su dad ldan rnams kyi re skong dang 'brel/ sgis sna dgon du phebs/ zla 6 tshes 15 nyin 'dam gzhung a mye 'bring rgyas mdun phebs/ der sde brgyad kheng mdos sogs zhabs rim sgrub gnang mdzad/ spyir gzhi bdag 'di nyid kyis rgyal dbang sku phreng na rim la mi ma yin gyis bzos pa'i dngos po khyad 'phags re phul ba ltar/ skabs 'dir yang gzi nor khyad 'phags rin chen rma med cig phul/ de nas phebs lam rim brgyud 'o lung zhes par zla 6 tshes 20 nyin ma yum dgongs pa rdzogs/ thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'pho ba dang*/ sku gdung bsreg sbyang mdzad/ de nas bar mtha' dang*/ nag chu sogs brgyud nas gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las skyong bzhin/ zla 9 tshes 10 nyin gdan sa chen po mtshur mdo bo lung du phebs par/ dpa' bo rin po che/ rgyal tshab rin po che/ rnam gnyis kyis dbus dgon khag rnams kyi bla ma las sne/ grwa tshang bcas kyis phebs bsu zab cing rgya che ba mdzad de zhabs sor bkod do//de nas zla 10 tshes 15 nyin lha ldan du 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa thog ma'i mjal phyag tu phebs shing*/ gong ma na rim gyi lam don bzhin mjal phyag zhu sgo sogs legs grub kyis/ slar rang gnas gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod cing*/ phyag dpe gsan sbyong gnang ba dang*/ zur mang bstan sprul rin po che'i drung nas chos gling gter chos skor phal cher gsan/ der rgyun ma bzhugs pa rnams bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas gsan bzhes dang*/ bklag lung rnams mchog sprul o rgyan rin po che drung nas gsan bzhes mdzad do/ /chu rta zla 1 tshes 26 nyin pho brang gsar bzhengs dbu tshugs skabs mi ma yin gyis phul ba'i gser/ rang bzhin rtsig pa'i bar nas rnyed son byung ba dang*/ chu lug bar phyi nang gi rten khyad par can du ma gsar bzhengs mdzad do// bzhi pa bsod nams kyi tshogs gong mthor spel ba'i phyir lho gnas/

'phags yul/ gangs ri bcas la gnas gzigs dang 'brel mchod 'bul gnang ba'i skabs ni/ shing sprel zla 2 tshes 4 nyin lho gnas su chibs zhal bsgyur/ thog mar gzhong pa lha chur thugs sgrub kyi sgo nas tshogs brgya mdzad/ de nas snye thang du jo bo bzhugs khrir jo bo'i bla mchod gsung*/ de nas gangs ri thod dkar du lo chen mdun nas zhi byed gcod dang*/ snying thig gi dbang lung 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas bsam yas su phebs/ g.yu zhal khang du kha rag yongs 'dzin rin po che mchog nas mkha' 'gro bsu zlog dang 'brel brtan bzhugs phul/ thugs sgrub kyi tshogs brgya dang*/ mchod 'bul rgya cher gnang*/ has po rir 'dzam gling spyi dang*/ bod ljongs kyi yul lhar bsang gsol dang phrin bcol gnang*/ de nas phag gru'i gdan sa mthil kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod kyi rten mjal mdzad cing*/ tshogs mchod kyang rgya che bcas/ zangs ri kha dmar du gcod kyi tshogs brgya/ khra 'brug tu sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog /sne'u gdong rtser mang ja phyag 'gyed yar lung shel brag tu gu ru'i tshogs brgya/ ras chung phug tu mang 'gyed/ 'chong rgyas ri bo bde chen du dge 'dun stong phrag brgal ba la mang ja phyag 'gyed/ de nas lho brag sna bo cog /bran pa phyag rdor/ lho brag lha khang bcas su gu ru'i tshogs brgya/ lho brag mkhar chur rten mjal dang lha mo lcags phur can/ dpal gyi phug ring du tshogs brgya/ de nas lho brag nyi lde dgon du rten mjal dang*/ dgon grwar mang 'gyed/ sras mkhar dgu thog tu phebs/ mar mi dwags gsum gyi bla sgrub gsung*/ lho gro bo lung du phebs/ rje mar pa'i bla sgrub gsung skabs gong ma rnam gsum gyi zhal gzigs shing*/ gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs kyang mdzad/ stag gnya' lung bstan phug tu phebs/ mi la'i bla sgrub dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod rgya cher gnang*/ 'brug rgyal gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang phyug gis gdan zhu 'byor ba ltar/

mon la dkar chung nas mtshams pa brgyud 'brug tu phebs/ zhabs rje thang dang*/ thang kha sbir rnams su tshogs brgya dang 'brel mchod 'bul gnang*/ 'brug rgyal yab sras zhabs gras bcas chibs bsur bcar/ gser phreng rgya che dang bcas gu ru'i sku rjes yod pa'i lha khang du bzhugs/ de nas rgyal btsun phun tshogs chos sgron dang*/ pad+ma bde chen gnyis nas so sor gdan zhu phul ba ltar/ bkra shis chos gling dang*/ dbang 'dud chos gling gnyis su so sor phebs nas gang 'dul gyi smin grol mdzad/ de nas byams pa lha khang du rgyal sras dbang mos gdan zhu ltar mchod 'bul rgya che gnang*/ ban chen mkhan po'i gdung rten la rab gnas mdzad/ bum thang du bzhugs ring*/ dad mjal stong phrag mang por bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa sogs so sor re skong gnang*/ 'brug rgyal mchog la mar mi dwags gsum dang*/ mgon po/ phur pa bcas kyi gtor dbang gnang*/ sku rjes lha khang gi gu ru'i sku brnyan thog so gnyis pa can la/ rje nyid kyis snyan shal sgron 'bul skabs mdzod spu'i thad snyan shal bzhes pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bstan/ de nas bod zla 5 tshes 15 nyin bod phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur skabs/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pas dad gdung gis mchi ma 'don par mdzad cing*/ lhag par rgyal po rang nyid/ rje nyid dang 'bral ba'i gdung ba mi bzod pas gsung shugs chen pos bshums par mdzad do/ /de ni slar yang mi mjal ba'i rtags su snang zhes rje nyid kyis gsung de nas lha lung dgon dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed gnang*/ gu ru lha khang gi phyi nang rten rnams mjal kha gnang*/ de nas phebs lam rim brgyud kyis zla 6 tshes 15 nyin ston 'khor rnams rang gi gdan sa dam par zhabs zung gi re kha bkod par mdzad/ shing bya zla 9 tshes 11 nyin byams mgon si tu rin po che gdan sar phebs/ zla 10 nang rgya chen bka' mdzod dang*/ gcig shes kun grol gyi dbang lung gsan bzhes gnang*/

de nas me pho khyi yi lor dgung grangs nyer gsum steng cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes 15 nyin byams mgon si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i drung nas gsol bzhi las kyi sgo nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen mang po'i dbus su btsun pa'i rnam thar gyis sa steng khyab bzhin pa 'di'o//de nas me phag gnam lo gsar 'char nas bzung dgon gyi mchod pa'i yo byad nang rten rigs gsar bskrun dang nyams gso ci rigs gnang*/ dge 'dun pa rnams la/ mthong rgyun phyag bzhes dang*/ sgrigs lam kun spyod rnams dag bsher 'brel gsar 'dzugs kyang gnang*/ si tu rin po che ston 'khor rnams kyang mdo khams su chibs bsgyur bskyangs pa'i rjes/ zla 4 tshes 15 nyin gangs ri chen po ti si dang*/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi gnas gzigs ched stod phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur/ dga' bde sogs byang brgyud yul tsho re re bzhin la 'gro don bskyangs shing*/ 'bu dkar dang*/ sman ldong dgon sogs la phebs/ zla 9 tshes shar la skra bdun rnam snang dkar por phebs grub ste/ tshogs mchod rgya che phul/ de nas ne pal gyi sa mtshams glo brgyud/ zla 11 tshes 1 nyin spogs rar phebs/ sgar chen gyi rten gri (

hor shan pa'i rug ral 'bar ba ) bor brlag byung ste/ der zhag bcu bdun tsam 'dri brtsad gnang rung phyir son ma byung*/ phyis lung pa de la mes 'jigs pa byung yang*/ bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i rgan mo cig yod pa la ci yang ma gnod/ tshes 23 nyin 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa sku bltams pa'i gnas/ lum 'bi nir phebs te/ mchod 'bul rgya che gnang*/ de nas bal yul du phebs/ mchod rten rnam gsum mdun rgyud sde rnams dang 'brel/ mchod 'bul zab rgyas gnang*/ a su ra dang*/ yang le shod kyi brag phug dag tu gu ru'i tshogs brgya dang 'brel mchod 'bul gnang*/ 'di skabs snye shangs sogs bal yul byang brgyud kyi skye 'gro khri phrag brgal bar dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che mjal kha dang bka' dbang sogs so sos 'dod pa ltar re bskang mdzad/ de nas ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas yul wā rā ṇa sīr phyag phebs/ gnas bcu dang*/ ston pa nye sras brgyad mchod pa'i cho ga dang 'brel mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bu gnang*/ de nas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du phebs/ rten mahā bodhi dang*/ byang chub ljon shing gi drung du mchod sprin zab cing rgyas pa dang*/ phyag bskor kyang mang du gnang zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su nad mug mtshon bskal mi 'byung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i thugs smon gang zab gnang*/ gzhan yang dur khrod bsil ba tshal dang*/ sha ba ri'i sgrub phug sogs su phebs shing mchod 'bul gang zab spros/ de skabs 'bras ljongs nas kar dgon khag gsum gyis gdan zhu 'byor ba ltar/ ka tar brgyud sa byi zla 1 tshes 3 la 'bras ljongs sgang tog tu zhabs sor bkod cing*/ 'bras rgyal bkra shis rnam rgyal mjal phrad gnang*/ rgyal blon dgon khag mi mang bcas par bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa rin po che sogs 'dod gnyer lhag med du bskangs nas/

slar rdo gdan du phebs/ de nas mtsho pad+mar bzhud/ lo der pad sdong mtsho bskor ma byon par skyabs mchog mtsho bskor phebs pa dang lhan du pad sdong yang phebs bsu'i tshul gyis byon cing*/ snyan shal sgron 'bul dang 'brel/ tshogs dang stong mchod sogs rgya che phul/ de nas khu nu brgyud lam bar gyi skye 'gro rnams la smin grol sogs gang la ci mtshams bka' drin bskyangs te/ gangs ri'i mdun du slar ldog par mdzad/ 'bri ra phug tu tshogs mchod dang*/ sgrol ma la steng du sgrol chog gsung*/ mtsho ka pā la zhes par sngon btsog grib lta bus rkyen/ mtsho dar gyis bcings shing zhal mi phye ba/ skabs der zhal bye ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul phug /rgyang grags phug dgon/ khrus sgo sogs gnas rnams zhib mjal dang*/ dge 'dun pa gar yod rnams la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed dang*/ zhabs bskor grangs mang gnang zin nas/ 'brong pa seng stod brgyud brag skyar phebs/ dgon gyi sku gsung thugs rten nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gnang*/ de phyogs dad ldan yul khag rnams kyis gdan zhus ltar zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ so so'i 'dod don ltar re ba bskangs te/ dge rgyas dgon du phebs dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron dang*/ khrus gsol/ rab gnas sogs 'dod skong rdzogs par mdzad/ slar 'bu dkar dgon dang*/ sman sdong rnams su rim gyis phebs/ phebs lam gyi skye 'gro rnams chos dang*/ zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas phebs pas/ rga lo dang*/ yangs can rnams su 'dod chos bstsal te/ zla 11 tshes 17 nyin gzhis yod bla brang gis phebs bsu'i bkod pa zab cing rgya che bcas rang gdan mtshur phur 7zhabs pad bkod par mdzad do//sa glang lor skyed tshal dar rgyas chos gling gsar bzhengs dang*/ rgyal sras 'jam mgon dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer mchog mtshur phur ched phebs gnang bar/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang bskur gnang bar gsol nas/

zla 5 pa'i nang sna sel gyi sku rim rnams smin sgrub kyis/ zla 6 tshes 27 gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu dge ba'i nyin dbu 'dzugs gnang ste/ 7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa chen po'i phyag bzhed ltar/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa gsan bzhes kyis lcags stag zla 6 tshes 24 la mtha' brgyan par mdzad cing bkra shis legs grub byung ste/ gzhan yang phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho/ zab lam nā ro chos drug sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos skor rgya cher gsan pa dang thugs gtod par mdzad pa'i dus 'da'/ lhag pa don brgyud kyi gdams pa pha nor bu lag tu lhag med sprad pa bzhin phul bzhes mdzad pas/ rgyal dbang mchog nas kyang*/ rang nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol zhing*/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i brgyud pa gser ri'i phreng bar bzhugs su gsol/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas bla slob dgongs pa dbyer ma mchis shing*/ 'jam mgon rin po ches 7rgyal dbang mchog gi thugs dam sa mtshams gsal bar bstan pa'i rtogs mgur yang gsungs/ lcags yos lor 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang ston 'khor chibs zhal shar sde dge dpal spungs su bsgyur bas/ yab sras 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang nas mjal dar 'bul res gnang ste byon/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po che'i yang srid chos khrir gzengs bstod mdzad do// lnga pa bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir/ rgya dkar nag dang bod kyi yul khag rnams su chibs zhal bsgyur ba'i skabs ni/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po gro mo nas lha ldan du phebs pa'i chibs bsu'i ched du/ zla 6 tshes 27 nyin gdan sa nas chibs bteg /zla 7 tshes 8 la zas chos 'khor yang rtser 7gong sa chen po mchog mjal kha dang 'bul ba sogs rgya che bstar/ dgon de'i las byed dang*/ grwa tshang rnams nas bskul ngor/ dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron dang*/

bka' dbang bcas bstsal/ 'dus mang spyi la bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed bcas gnang*/ slar gdan sar zhabs sor bkod/ de nas zla 10 tshes 9 nyin snye mo 'du khungs nas gdan zhu byung ba ltar/ snye mor chibs bteg ste/ lha bu dgon pa dkar dgon snye mo sgye mdo dgon sogs la rim phebs kyis gang la de 'tshams dbang dang*/ dbu zhwa sgron pa sogs 'dod chos bstsal/ dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja bsnyen bkur zab rgyas gnang*/ de nas ja pa dgon rnying dang*/ mar rkyang rdzong 'go dmangs kyis gdan zhus ltar phebs/ khul de'i 'go dmang rnams la dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che mjal kha dang*/ khrom dbang gnang skabs jo mo gangs dkar bud med mdzes ma lag na mda' dar thogs pa dbang zhu bcar ba/ sgrub dpon bstan 'dzin rin po ches dag snang du gzigs/ khul de'i zhing pa 'ga' zhig la chu yis gnod skyon gyis dka' ngal che ba lo ltar byung zhing*/ gzhung chu la shwa 'od sogs kyis rkyen pas zhing gi phyogs su yo nas/ chu lon sogs ji ltar bzos kyang ma thub pas ci bya gtol med lta bu'i skabs/ skyabs rje mchog la skyabs 'jug gnang thabs zhus pas/ 'bru son khal mang po la phyag nas byin rlabs gnang ste/ chu yi nyen kha yod pa'i zhing sa rnams su sa bon 'di nyid btab na/ chu yi nyen kha las grol bar gsung bzang gnang ba bzhin byas pas/ dbyar dus chu bo brugs pa'am rgyas pa'i skabs/ zhing sa med pa'i sa gnas snye mo ru zhes par mi mang gi 'dod don bzhin chu bo de phyogs su kha 'gyur nas ha cang bka' drin che ba byung ngo*//de nas chos sde dgon dang*/ chu bzang dgon sogs phebs lam gyi skye 'gro rnams kyi re 'dod bskangs te/ zla 11 tshes22 nyin gdan sar 7zhabs sor 'khod nas lo 'khor 'brum nad shugs cher byung ba zlog pa'i slad du/ rat+na gling pas gter 'byin phur pa'i sgo nas mnan bsreg 'phangs gsum gnang bas nad yams kha dag par mdzad

do/ /chu 'brug zla 2 tshes 6 nyin rgyal tshab rin po che grags pa rgya mtsho zhi bar mnal ba'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gnang*/ de nas gnam ru 'du khungs bcu gsum/ bar mtha' sde gsar bcas nas gdan zhu phul ba ltar/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang chibs zhal bsgyur te yul khag so sor/ bka' dbang*/ khrus/ rab gnas/ mthong grol rin po che mjal sgron/ dgra lha'i bsang gsol dpa' bstod/ tsho pa'i spyi rim sogs gang la gang 'os kyi chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ shwa ba brag /zar mo dgon/ dkar chung dgon sogs su phebs/ dkar chung dgon du bzhugs skabs zhal lud gyang logs su bor bar gnang ba/ shog bur dril nas dad rten du nyar ba las ring bsrel stong phrag brgal ba 'khrungs pa/ da lta sgar chen rten khrod du bzhugs su gsol/ 'di skabs skyabs mchog si tu rin po che zla 8 tshes 25 la sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul 'byor bas thugs shin tu skyo ba'i tshul bcas mchod 'bul zab rgyas gnang*/ de nas dol pa/ gnam ru sogs yul gru khag gi 'dod skong dang 'brel/ 'dzi ri dgon sogs su phebs shing*/ zla 8 tshes 17 nyin rang gdan du 7zhabs sor bkod/ chu sbrul zla 3 tshes 3 nyin rang gzhis sna dkar la chibs bsgyur bskyang*/ yul lha'i ri rtser gnas chen byin 'bebs dang 'brel/ lha srin dam bsgrags dang*/ ri khrus/ klung khrus sogs dang*/ bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron gang la ci mos kyi 'dod skong gnang grub nas/ slar skyed tshal dar rgyas chos gling du zhabs zung 'khod/ zla 4 tshes 28 nyin 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog gi zhal snga nas 'jigs byed dbang chen gsan bzhes kyi ched du/ lha sar kun bde gling du bzhugs nas/ jo bo'i sku mdun stong mchod dang*/ tshogs brgya sogs mchod 'bul zab rgyas 'bul gnang mdzad cing*/ 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i mjal phyag zhus/ 'di skabs 'jam mgon rin po che zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i gnas ngan gsan zhing*/

shin tu thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pa bcas dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gang zab mdzad/ gzhan yang cog po ri sogs lha ldan du bzhugs so cog gi rten rnams la mchod 'bul rgya che dang 'brel rten mjal mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes shar la 'jigs byed dbang chen gnang 'go tshugs shing dbang zhur phebs/ sngon gong ma rim byon bzhin 7gong sa chen po mchog dang chos dam zab 'brel du gyur/ skyabs rje yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis mjal phyag zhus shing mdzad sgo mtha' dag legs grub kyis/ zla 8 tshes 25 nyin chibs bteg /dpa' bo mchog sprul rin po ches dbus gnas nang dgon gyis phebs bsu gang zab dang bcas gnas dgon du zhabs sor bkod/ bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron/ khrus gsol rab gnas sogs mdzad/ rten 'brel du a ce lha mo'i zlos gar gzigs dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ zla 9 tshes 1 nyin gdan sar phebs/ spyir phyogs phebs dang gdan sar bzhugs pa gang yin rung bstan pa'i mig rgyan kho na gong 'phel mdzad rgyu'i phrin las nyag gcig la brtson par mdzad/ de nas smin grol gling gcung rin po che mchog nas mchog gling gter chos skor dbang lung 7rgyal dbang mchog gi drung nas gsan bzhes gnang rgyu gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ shing rta lo gsar gyi dga' ston dang 'brel/ dbang lung dbu 'dzugs gnang ste zla bzhi pa'i nang zab bdun phur pa'i tshogs dbur phebs shing*/ dngos grub len chog gis mtha' rgyan te grub/ zla lnga pa'i nang bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas sman sgrub tshogs gnang rgyur/ gcung rin po che'i bkas bskul ba bzhin sgrub pa 'tshugs gnang zhing mtha' rgyas kyi grol/ 'di skabs dpal spungs ri khrod gong gi mdzod pa yon tan ngo g.yog mjal bcar byung zhing*/ gong ma zhi bar mnal ba'i yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang bskul zhus pa'i phyir phebs brtag yig tu/ jo bo shākya mu ne'i g.yon phyogs su//khyim bdag 'byor ldan khyim sgo lhor bstan pa//mi ngo bkra shis rtags kyi grangs ldan can//shes rab pad+ma'i mtshan gyi sgras bstan par//khyi'u shing rta lo pa rtags mtshan can//bai ro'i rnam 'phrul 'jam mgon bla ma yi//sprul pa'i yang srid 'khrul med yin par mngon*//zhes bstsal 'dug pa 'di/

dus 'gyur gyis brtag yig ngo ma lag tu ma thob kyang*/ 'jam mgon sku gong 'og gi mdun zhabs pa'i yid la yod pa bzhin yi ger bkod pa'o//yang 'brong gsar be hu grags pa rnam rgyal gyis/ kho pas gsar bzhengs dgon 'dzin bla sprul tshad ldan cig med pas 'di phyi'i skyabs su 'os pa zhig 7rgyal dbang mchog nas gsol ras gnang dgos zhes yang yang zhus ngor/ spyir skyes bu dam pa rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba bzhin du/ shar sde dge dpal spungs mkhyen brtse'i yang srid cig ngos 'dzin bya rgyu yod cing*/ de dag khyod kyi dgon pa'i bstan bdag tu mnga' gsol na/ bstan 'gror sman ngo che zhes gsungs te/ ngos 'dzin brtag yig 'di ltar/ gangs ljongs yul dbus thad drangs nub stod phyogs//myur 'gro'i nyin lam gnyis su bgrod pa'i tshun//khyim sgo shar bstan khyim bdag 'byor dman te//pha ming ngag gi dbang phyug mgon po'i mtshan//ma ming a ya tā ra chos kyi sgron//zung gi khyi'u rtags mtshan khyi lo pa//rigs rus gtsang zhing dam pa'i rang rtags can//mkhyen brtse dbang po'i rnam 'phrul bsnyon med nges//zhes bstsal ba ltar yang srid 'khrul med rnyed do/ /'di skabs rgya nag gzhung gis bka' ltar/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos dbus/ bod kyi bla chen dang*/ dpon rigs che khag rnams gdan zhus ltar/ zla 5 tshes 13 nyin rang gdan nas chibs bteg /lha ldan du phebs shing*/ 'bras ljongs rgyal sras bla ma don grub rnam rgyal ched bcar zhus/ de nas tshes 15 nyin bod kyi bla dpon rnams lhan rgyas zhabs bteg /phebs lam rim brgyud 'bri gung kong po sogs brgyud/ spo'o stong 'jug rdzong nas chibs bsu bcas bla chen sku drag khag bcas rang khungs nas bzhugs bsgrigs gsol ston rgya cher gnang*/ de nas zla steng dgon/ g.yu ru dgon sogs bla grwar chos 'brel rgya cher gnang*/

chab mdor dpal spungs mdzod bla cog ga nas/ si tu rin po che'i yang srid brtsad gcod zhus/ de nas dar rtse mdor brgyud/ khri 'dur phebs/ 7gong sa mchog dang*/ skyabs mchog sogs gnam gru brgyud pe cin du phebs/ rgya gzhung gis dga' bsu rgya che'i rnam 'gyur bstan cing*/ pe cin phan bde zhes par bzhugs/ gzhung zhabs rnams dang mjal phrad gnang zhing mdzad sgo khag la dgongs 'char gnang ba sogs nyin mtshan khor yug tu mdzad phrin gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de skabs rgya mi'i drung yig zhabs zhur ched 'dzugs byas pa ( wan man phru'u/ ) zhes pa nas sku bcar zhu ba'i skabs bzhugs gdan las/ sku gzugs ma mjal bar nyi 'od phog pa lta bu zhig mthong nas gzim chung gi phyi la don te/ gsol dpon sbyin pa la skyabs rje mchog gang du phebs pa'i skor dri ba byas skabs/ gang du'ang ma byon par gzim chung du bzhugs yod pa'i lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ slar gzim chung du sku bcar zhu skabs yid nor mchog bzhugs gdan du bzhugs pa dang*/ der nyi 'od phog yul gyi sge'u khung sogs gang yang med par mthong skabs ha cang ya mtshan pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ spyir kho rang dmar po'i lta ba la snying nas yid ches skyes pa zhig yin mod/ de rjes chos dang chos byed par yid ches pa'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ skyabs gnas mchog la'ang bcos min gyi mos gus skyes/ de nas 'bo gangs dkar rin po che rgyun bcar zhus te chos kyi bgro gleng gnang*/ zla 9 tshes 22 nyin si tu rin po che brtag yig zhal gsal dang*/ 'khrungs yul dpe bris bcas bstsal zhing*/ gangs dkar rin po ches yi ger dpod de dpal spungs su bang mi btang*/
