( brtag yig 'byor mtshams 'dir 'dzud dgos/ ) de nas then cin/ nan cin/ 'u shis/ hang gru sogs su phebs/ de skabs ha shang gi dge slong kha shas la bka' dbang yang gnang*/ de nas bod phyogs su chibs bsgyur skabs/ g.yag rngar nas rgya rong khri bcu dpon sogs rgya rong phyogs nas gdan zhu nan cher phul yang phebs ma grub/ zla 12 tshes 29 nyin dar rtse mdor phebs/ shing lug gnam lo gsar tshes la khri byang rin po che dang*/ gcung rin po che bcas bkra shis bde legs kyi mjal dar 'bul res mdzad/ khri byang rin po che li thang du phebs skabs thon mjal gnang*/ gangs dkar rin po cher sku tshe'i tshad lung bstan gnang ba'ang phyis de ltar byung*/ mi nyag tu dga' ldan gyi 'dus pa brgya phrag brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas brag mgo dkar mdzes/ dar rgyas dgon sogs ris med kyi dgon sde khag rnams/ hor a thub/ rta so la dkar sogs 'byor ldan rnams kyis gdan zhus/ ban rgan dgon du phebs/ dgon grwar mang 'gyed dang*/ rten khrus rab gnas bstsal/ dgon nas dad dngul rgya cher byung ba rnams sku gsung thugs rten gyi thebs rtsar phyir stsol mdzad/ de nas yid lhung*/ dgon chen rnams su phebs/ sde dge'i mdun 'khor rnams kyis gtsos mjal mang khri phrag brgal bar chos 'brel gnang*/ dpal spungs mdzod bla cog ga nas gdan zhus ltar/ phebs su gser phreng bcas zab rgyas dang 'brel dpal spungs dgon du phebs/ 'di skabs si tu rin po che'i yang srid da dung rtsad ma chod rkyen thugs 'khrugs pa'i tshul gyis skyabs rje gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul med nges par rnyed dgos rgyu las/ che 'dod dang drag 'dod kyi dgos pa gang yang med tshul gyi bka' bslab nan du gnang*/ si tu rin po che'i yang srid ched du mgon khang du mgon sgrub nyin bdun gsungs nas/ slar ye shes kyi mkhyen pas gzigs nas brtag yig zhib gsal dang*/

sa cha dang*/ khyim gyi mtshan nyid go bder gsungs te 'tshol mkhan ched btang mdzad pas/ yang srid nges rnyed byung ste/ de 'phral dbon bsam sprul dang*/ sgrub dpon bstan 'dzin rin po che rnam gnyis khrus gsol 'bul bar mngags/ zla tshes nyin dpal spungs kyi bla grwa rnams dang*/ phyogs 'dus kar dgon rnams kyi bla sprul khag /der yod yul gru khag gi skye bo khri phrag brgal bas chibs bsu dang*/ slar yang dge 'dun pa rnams nas mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas mdun bsus te/ mchog sprul rin po che yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs/ dri gtsang khang gi nang byams chen mthong grol rin po che'i spyan snga nas rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis dbu skra gtsug phud gsil slar yang zla tshes nyin gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus shing*/ sde dge chos rgyal chen po'ang der sku bcar zhus shing khri 'bul sogs rgya chen phul nas mdzad sgo legs grub dang*/ de skabs mdo smad phyogs kyi bla sprul mchis so cog sku bcar zhus shing mjal kha dang*/ gzhan yang dus kyi dbang gis srid kyi 'gyur ba glog gi zlos gar bzhin 'byung du nye ba la/ de'i stobs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gegs skyon mi 'byung ba'i thabs shes 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i tshul zhib gsal go bde lhug par bstsal gnang mdzad nas/ dus yun thung ngu tsam gyi bar dus kyi 'gyur bas ma gnod par bstan pa mi nyams gong 'phel du byung*/ de nas tsan+d+ra dang*/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po che'i sgrub khang*/ chos drug sgrub khang bcas su byin rlabs sogs rgya che gnang*/ si tu mchog sprul rin po cher srol gnyis las byung ba'i sems bskyed/ kar lugs rgyal rgyam lha dgu dang*/ mchog gling thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' dbang*/ dpal ye shes mgon po ber nag can gyi bka' gtad dang 'brel gtor dbang bstsal/

der 'dus kyi mdo smad dgon sde khag gi bla sprul grwa rigs gsum brgya brgal bar rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal nas/ rtse zur mdor 7gong sa chen po mchog phebs lam du 'khel bas gdan zhus kyis mdo smad dgon sde khag yongs rdzogs kyi dbu 'doms gnang ste/ phebs sgrigs rgya che dang bcas gdan zhus chos 'brel kyang bstsal/ 7gong sa chen po chab mdor chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ skyabs mchog sa gnas de gar bzhugs nas dpal spungs kyis gtsos/ dgon sde khag gi bla sprul las sne che phra dang*/ sde dge'i mi chen khag bcas par thugs byams pa dang snying rjes rjes su brtse bas bka' slob snying gi bdud rtsi lta bu dang*/ 'di dang gtan du dge ba'i dam chos zab mo'i gdams ngag bcas bka' drin bstsal nas chab mdo brgyud/ zla 5 tshes 14 nyin lha ldan du zhabs sor bkod/ po ta la dang 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod 'bul rgya cher gnang*/ 7gong sa chen po'i drung nas thon phyag bcas/ tshes 18 nyin gdan sa mtshur phur zhabs zung bkod/ de nas zla 7 tshes shar la pho brang nyams gso mdzad cing phun tshogs 'khyil pa gsar bzhengs grub/ me spre lor sngar srol ltar 7gong sa chen po rang gdan du phebs thub pa'i snyan 'bul mdzad don bzhin gsung bzang thob cing gdan zhu'i sta gon mdzad/ bod zla 6 tshes 5 nyin 7gong sa chen po mchog lha gdan nas chibs zhal bsgyur/ bkra shis sgang du 7skyabs mchog mtshams zhu'i mjal dar 'bul bzhes mdzad cing*/ slar gser 'phreng thog rol sogs rgya gang che bcas pas bsngun drangs nas gzim chung phun tshogs 'khyil par zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod/ bod gzhung nas dge 'dun pa rnams la mang 'gyed rgya che bstsal/ tshes bcu chen mo'i gar 'cham gzigs 'bul zhus/ skyabs mchog dbus ser skya rnams la spyan ras gzigs bka' dbang bstsal ba dang chabs cig /chos srid gnyis phyogs kyi slob ston rgya che gnang*/

sgar chen gyi nang rten rnams rten mjal phul zhing*/ dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che yang sgron mjal gnang zhing*/ tshes 13 nyin phebs skyel bcas slar chibs bteg/de nas zla 7 tshes 20 nyin gzhung nas bang mi 'byor te lha ldan du phebs/ sgar mdzod pas gtsos zhabs gras tshang mas dgongs 'khrol zhus kyang ngo phebs ma gnang thabs med lta bur byung ste/ kong po brgyud tshes 29 nyin chab mdor phebs nas nyin ltar dbu yon lhan tshogs zhes pa'i sar phebs shing*/ zhi mthun sgo nas bstan 'gro'i bde don thabs shes gang drag gnang*/ mdo khams kyi skye bo bgrang las 'das pa nyin mtshan bar med du bcar zhing de rnams la byin rlabs thugs smon zab rgyas thog lha ldan du phyir phebs/ nor gling du thon phyag dang*/ jo bo yid bzhin nor bus gtsos pas rten rnams la mjal kha dang 'brel mchod 'bul zab cing rgyas pa gnang ste/ zla 8 tshes 25 nyin rang gdan du zhabs sor 'khod/ de nas 'phral du rgya gar phyogs gnas gzigs phebs bzhed kyis zla 9 tshes 29 nyin rang gdan nas chibs bteg sngar nas gdan zhu'i snyan zhu phul ba ltar chos mgon rin po che mchog nas phebs bsu bcas bde chen chos dgon du phebs/ bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa mjal sgron sogs gang 'os bzhin dang*/ dgon grwar mang 'gyed dang*/ phyi nang gi nang rten rnams la khrus gsol rab gnas/ tshogs mchod sogs rgya cher gnang nas chibs bteg /phebs lam gyi skye 'gro rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas/ zla 10 tshes 23 nyin 'bras ljongs rgyal blon gyis phebs bsu bcas sgang tog tu phebs nas dad mjal rnams la bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa rin po che sgron mjal sogs rang 'dod bzhin gyis tshim par mdzad cing*/ de nas shri gu ri brgyud/ bya rgod spungs ri dang*/ rdo rje gdan gnyis la mchod 'bul rgya che gnang*/ rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse rin po che bzhugs pa dang mjal phrad gnang*/

de nas wā rā ṇa sīr mchod 'bul dang*/ bhe ta'i grong khyer gzigs zhib tu phebs shing*/ de nas bal yul du mchod rten rnam gsum mdun/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod zab rgyas dang*/ dri bzang gi na bza' phul/ der 'khod dad mjal rnams la smin grol gyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas lag na'u brgyud a lo ra dang*/ a jan ta sogs sgrub phug rnams su tshogs mchod dang 'brel mjal phyag mdzad de phebs lam rim brgyud rdo rje gling du phebs/ rdo btsug dgon du bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa rab gnas khrus sogs rgya cher gnang zhing*/ slar me bya zla 2 tshes 3 nyin sgang tog tu phebs nas 'bras rgyal mchog dang mjal phrad gnang*/ de nas pho tang dgon nas gdan zhus bzhin phebs te/ bka' dbang*/ dbu zhwa sogs 'dod chos kyis re skong gnang zhing sgang tog tu phebs/ rum bteg bsam gtan chos gling gi 'dus sde rnams kyang gdan 'dren zhus skabs/ rjes mar slebs yong zhes bka' gnang bas/ khong rnams kyis da lta thag nyer yod skabs ngo phebs ma grub na/ bod du phebs zin gdan 'dren zhu re bral bas da res phebs grub nan cher zhus skabs/ rjes ma lhod dal du sleb yong zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan du bka' bstsal bar mdzad cing*/ de nas gro mo brgyud/ dung dkar/ bka' brgyud dgon so sor 'gro don bskyangs/ zla 3 tshes 9 nyin rang gdan du zhabs zung bkod do//de 'phral myong grol ril nag rin po che bsgril gnang mdzad/ chos gong bla brang gi las byed rnams nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ rgyal tshab mchog sprul rin po che'i yang srid ngos 'dzin brtag yig phebs don/ dgon 'di'i nub stod myur 'gros nyin gnyis tshun//khyim bdag 'byor 'bring khyim sgo shar gtad kyi//pha ming blo gros ma ming sgrol mas mtshan//khyi'u shing rta lo pa rtags mtshan can//zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin 'khrul bral nges rnyed byung*/

zla 6 tshes 16 nyin dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes shing*/ tshes 22 gza' skar dge ba'i nyin gser khrir mnga' gsol khri 'bul bcas mdzad sgo mtha' rgyas su grub/ sa khyi lor zhe chen kong sprul rin po che'i mdun nas klong chen mdzod bdun lung gsan/ 'di skabs mdo smad du dus 'gyur shin tu che ba'i dbang gis byams mgon si tu rin po che ston 'khor zla 4 tshes 19 nyin 'og min mtshur gyi gdan sar phebs/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas mnyan pa rin po che/ dil mgo mkhyen brtse/ khra legs nyi ma 'gyur med sogs bla sprul du ma byon pa rnams la bsnyen bkur zab rgyas bka' drin bskyangs/ dus 'gyur ci che byung bar sgar chen mdzod pa sogs las byed rnams kyis sa gnas gzhan zhig tu phebs rgyu las 'gan blos mi bzod pa'i zhu ba nan tan du phul kyang*/ dus la 'khel mtshams 'gro bas chog gsungs pa dang*/ zhabs rim du mgon gsol dang*/ rata gling phur pa'i zlog pa/ yul 'khor srung gi dmag zlog dang*/ raḥkhro gter ston gyis lung ltar bdud 'dul mchod rten gsum gsar bzhengs bcas la rab gnas mdzad pa sogs zhabs rim 'thus gtsang byung ba'i bka' drin las/ btsan byol skabs bde phebs thub pa byung*/ de skabs zhe chen kong sprul rin po che 'dzin bzung sa gnas nges med du gdan zhus gsan 'phral dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gnang*/ de nas si tu rin po che ston 'khor 'brug dang*/ mnyan pa rin po che sogs bla sprul rnams re zhig lho brag nyi lde dgon du ched gtong mdzad do// drug pa bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i phyir 'phags yul du btsan byol byon nas/ gdan sa chen po bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar du bskrun pa'i skabs ni/ sa phag lor phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i gsung mang po gnang zhing*/ rgya gar phyogs su phebs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de/ sa phag zla 2 tshes 4 nyin bla grwa zhabs 'bring brgya dang drug cu'i skor dang*/

ka rabs na rim gyi thugs dam rten sogs rin thang bral zhing*/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku gsung thugs rnams dang*/ ha cang gal che ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad bcas mnangs 'gangs gang che ba phyogs bsdus mdzad de mnyam bsnams kyis 'a 'ur ngang nas bteg/'di skabs gtsang chu lcags zam khar dmag zing ci che yang bde phebs grub cing*/ der shar pa chos rje'i sras bstan 'dzin skyabs rje mchog dang mnyam du rgya 'brug phyogs phebs thub par skyabs 'jug zhus pas ming sgra shin tu legs pas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar dbye ba lta bu'i lung bstan bstsal/ de nas dus 'gyur gyis nyen pas skye bo rnams la skyabs srung dang thugs smon rgya gang che gnang zhing*/ lho brag sras mkhar dang nyi lde dgon du byon/ g.yul 'khrug skabs srog nyen byung ba'i skye bo nyam thag pa rnams su thugs smon gang zab dang 'brel mchod 'bul rgya che gnang*/ de nas 'brug bod sa mtshams brgal te/ tshes 26 nyin zhabs rjes thang du phebs/ rje btsun tshul khrims dpal mo mchog nas skyabs rje ston 'khor bde phebs grub par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba dang bcas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ sku rjes thang du phebs/ si tu rin po che mchog dang*/ mkhyen brtse rin po che rnams mjal phrad gnang*/ de nas sku rjes lha khang*/ byams pa lha khang sogs la tshogs mchod rgya che dang 'brel/ slar yang rang dbang yul gru rnams su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i me ro gso thub pa'i thugs smon rgya che gnang*/ khul de'i dad 'dus rnams la dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas bkra shis chos gling du phebs/ 'brug skur stod dar rgyas chos gling gi grwa mang bdun cu skor la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang*/ bod zla 4 tshes 5 nyin 'brug gzhung brgyud rgya phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur/ skabs 'dir byams mgon si tu rin po che dang*/

rje btsun tshul khrims dpal mo mchog bcas 'bras ljongs bar lhan rgyas su phebs thon gnang*/ krong gsar dge 'dun pa brgyad cu skor la mjal kha gnang*/ lam bar gyi skye 'gro rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas/ rgyal sa thim phug gi nye 'gram kha sa brag chu zhes par 'brug rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje mchog dang mjal phrad gnang zhing*/ gzhan yang pu ṇa kha'i grwa tshang dang 'brug mi mang bcas nas bkur sti rgya cher zhus/ de nas 'brug gzhung brgyud/ rgya gar gzhung la bka' mol zhus 'bras/ rgya gar he ma cal zhing chen khul rda ram sa lar bzhugs gnas gtan khel zhus pa bzhin/ 'brug brgyud rim gyis phebs/ sa gnas sbag sa khar/ 'bras ljongs gzhung gi sku tshab gdan sa pa bkra shis dgra 'dul mchog dang*/ rgya gzhung sku tshab a brug bha bu lhan rgyas ched bcar gyis/ karma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje nas bzung da lta'i chos rgyal bkra shis rnam rgyal bar gong ma na rim gyis mchod yon dam gtsang la dgongs pas ston 'khor yongs rdzogs 'bras ljongs su gdan 'dren zhu rgyu dang*/ de la rgya gar gzhung gis ngos len gtsang ma gnang gtan ltar/ sngon nas chos kyi 'brel pa dang*/ ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyis phyogs der phebs rgyu'i thugs gtan khel zhing*/ sa phag zla 4 tshes 25 nyin sgang tog tu 'bras ljongs kar dgon rnams kyis phebs bsu sne len dang 'brel zhabs sor 'khod/ 'bras ljongs chos rgyal yab sras blon 'bangs bcas pas bkur bzos zad med kyis bzhugs gnas kyang*/ stag rtse pho brang gtsos sa gnas khag mang thugs babs gang gnang chog pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad mod/ rgyal dbang mchog nas rang re rnams 'og min thugs kyi 'khor lo dpal gyi stod lung mtshur phu gtsos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu de nyid yongs su bor nas gzhan yul du btsan byol 'byor ba 'di/ rang mgo gang thon dang*/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid don gnyer tsam dang*/

g.yul 'khrug gi srog nyen tsam la brten btsan g.yol ma yin par bstan pa rtsa ba brlag shor ba de nyid kyi me ro slar gso gang thub dgos pa las gu yangs sos dal du bsdad thabs bral bas/ bstan pa'i me ro slar gso'i gzhi'am/ rtsa ba 'dzugs bskrun bya yul/ rten 'brel dang dgos pa khyad par can gyis dbang gis sngon rgyal mchog dgu pas phyag btab gnang ba'i sa gnas rum bteg dgon du re zhig bzhugs gnas stabs bder gnang chog par gsungs/ zla 5 tshes 5 nyin rum bteg dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/ skabs der skyabs mgon mchog dbus zhabs 'bring ser skya bcas la/ sdod gnas dang 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen rgya che ba med kyang*/ bla brang la gang yod lag don gnang ste chos dang mthun pa'i sgrig bkod dang 'brel bla sprul dge 'dun gcig brgya lnga bcu tsam gyis nyin re bzhin snga dro sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang*/ phyi dro rang lugs bstan srung rnams kyi gsol bskang*/ nya stong gi gso sbyong*/ tshes 8 dang tshes 10 nyer lnga bcas la bde phag rgyal gsum sgrub mchod khag dang*/ bar mtshams rnams su sgrub dpon bstan 'dzin rin po che mchog nas/ dwags po'i thar rgyan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gzhung gi bshad khrid sogs dang*/ bla grwa sku bgres rnams la zab lam nā ro chos drug gi man ngag bcas bstsal/ lhag par 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog la/ 'brug rje btsun tshul khrims dpal mo nas bskul ma zhus pa bzhin/ skyabs 'gro'i lo rgyus ljags brtsams gnang ba sogs chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ zla 6 tshes 7 nyin 'brug bkra shis chos gling nas rdor slob rin po che 'od zer dbang phyug sku tshe ma zin pa'i gnas tshul gsan 'phral thugs smon dang mchod 'bul gnang*/ yang 'di skabs zhig tu sngon gyi sgrub brgyud gser ri'i phreng tshogs zhes pa'i phrin bcol gsar brtsams gnang ste rgyun gsol gyi nang du 'dzug par mdzad/

de nas 'jam mgon rin po che'i yang srid mchog dang*/ yab yum bcas ched phebs byung*/ gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge ba'i nyin dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes shing na bza' 'bul gnang dang 'brel/ pak+shi bla sgrub/ rgyal rgyam/ jo lugs sgrol dkar bcas kyi bka' dbang gnang*/ de nas zhabs grwa dge 'dun pa rnams bar lam dus 'gyur rkyen gyis grwa chas na bza' med par/ gsar du 'tshol sgrub kyis cha tshang re gsol ras bstsal/ de nas rgyal sras dpal ldan don grub rnam rgyal mchog sku bcar zhus te bstan dgon gsar bzhengs gnang rgyu thugs gtan khel/ zla 11 tshes 8 nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu dge ba'i nyin sa bdag lto phye'i thig btab/ sa slong dang*/ bsang mchod bcas gnang zhing*/ rgyal sras mchog la legs skyes su rgya gar sha li las grub pa gu ru'i sku brnyan spus legs zhig phul gnang mdzad cing*/ de nas tshes 23 nyin ka dgon rab gling du gdan zhus ltar ched phebs gnang zhing dgu gtor tshogs dbur phebs/ yul der bon lugs lta bus dmar mchod byed pa la/ da tshun srog gcod ma dgos par dmar bsur dang*/ mgon khang du gsol bskang tshad ma zhig gis 'thus par byin rlabs bstsal bas de nas yul der srog bcad kyi mchod sbyin ma dgos pa byung zhing slar chos sgar du zhabs sor 'khod/ de rjes 'brug nas sku yi gcen mo mchog sku tshe ma zin par ris med kyi bla sprul khag la mchod bsngo dang*/ sgar gyi 'dus sde rnams kyis bdun tshig so sor mchod 'bul rgya cher gnang zhing*/ slar zla 12 tshes 15 nyin rgya gar du gnas gzigs ched phebs te/ rdo rje gdan/ wā rā ṇa sā+-i sogs la phebs shing*/ mchod 'bul rgya chen dang*/ der 'dus dad mjal rnams la re bskang gnang zhing*/ slar gdan sar phebs/ lcags byi zla 5 tshes 3 nas dbu 'dzugs kyis mchog sprul rnam pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ khra legs rin po che/

dil mgo mkhyen brtse sogs bla sprul bco lnga tsam dang*/ dge 'dun pa brgya phrag brgal ba/ gzhan yang 'bras ljongs chos byed pa sogs mang po zhig la/ mar rngog gi rgyud sde rin po che phyogs gcig tu sgrig pa bka' brgyud sngags mdzod chen mo dbu 'dzugs gnang ba nas nyin ltar 'chad med sku ngal sogs la mi ltos par gnang bas/ zla 6 tshes 4 rgyal bas chos 'khor skor ba'i dus chen nyin gtang rag tshogs mchod bcas kyis mtha' rgyas yongs su grub pa dang*/ slar zla 6 tshes 11 nyin dbu 'dzugs kyis sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi man ngag smin byed dbang*/ grol byed khrid/ rgyab brten lung bcas bka' drin chen pos mtha' dbyung mdzad/ de skabs gzhung chen khag dang*/ rig gnas skor/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde sogs dpe rgyun shin tu dkon stabs bstan pa'i gzhi ma gsung rab kho nar rag las par dgongs te/ dwags po'i thar rgyan/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung*/ nang brtag rgyud gsum rtsa 'grel/ spyod 'jug /gsang snying rtsa ba/ mgon gsol sdang ba rnam sreg dang*/ mi nub bstan rgyas sogs ji snyed cig shing gi thog par bskrun gnang ba'i las grwa gsar 'dzugs dang*/ bka' brgyud gser phreng gi sku brnyan khru tshad can gsar bskrun dang rang khongs rgyal ba yab sras sogs bla grwa bsdu 'gugs kyis phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i dbu 'dzugs mdzad/ de nas lcags glang lor o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas gter lung las gsal ba bzhin dus su babs pa'i mthu dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog kyang 'dul ba'i lag len gtsang mar 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sder gces spras shin tu che ba'i dbang gis/ dge 'dun sde rnams dbyar khas len gnang ste/ 'dul ba'i lung las gsungs pa bzhin rgyun 'dzugs mdzad/ skabs der chos rgyal dam pa bkra shis rnam rgyal mchog dang*/ rgyal sras dpal ldan don grub rnam rgyal gnyis dgongs pa gcig mthun gyi dge 'dun gyi sde gsar bskrun gnang*/

yul sa khyon rang dbang rang bdag tu khral med gtsang 'bul mdzad/ chu stag lor/ la dwags dang*/ 'bom rdi la khul dmag zing shin tu che ba byung bas ka rdor sgang sogs nas nyen g.yol 'gro mkhan yang ci rigs byung skabs ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyis skyabs rje mchog thugs bag phebs su bzhugs pa ma zad/ dus 'gyur skor la thugs dam zhu mkhan la'ang nyen kha med pa'i bka' bzang gnang ba dang*/ dmag zlog gro lod yas zor gyi zlog pa bdun phrag gsum gnang*/ zla 9 tshes 21 nyin mnyan pa rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus/ zla 10 tshes 10 nyin gcung po dpon slob rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pas mchod 'bul dang dgongs rdzogs rgya che gnang*/ zla 11 tshes 22 nyin bstan dgon gsar bzhengs kyi dbu 'dzugs gnang zhing*/ ser skya las byed mi mang bcas nas char chu drod nyi sogs kyi dka' ngal la ma ltos par ar las ngal rtsol gnang ba dang*/ 'di skabs sa nyil gyis mnan pa dang las khri'i steng nas lhung ba sogs skyon med par bde 'gror thub pa byung ba ni rje nyid kyi thugs rje kho na'o//'di skabs spyan gzigs rma bya ri la shor ba/ bya khwa ta'i gzugs 'dra ba zhig gis ded cing rma bya tshang du bsdus pa dang*/ spyan gzigs byi'u nam mkhar 'phur ba la phyag gis brda mdzad pas slar log pa dang*/ sku tshe'i stod la gzim khyi g.yi phrug zhes pa cig byung ba des nya stong rnams su sha mi za/ gal te tshes grangs brjed pa na/ de ring nya stong du 'khel ba 'dra g.yi phrug gis sha mi za 'dug zhes brjod dgos pa'i ngo mtshar byung zhing*/ spyir sku tshe'i ring la spyan gzigs byi'u la shin tu mnyes shing de rnams shi ba'i skabs thugs dam du zhag gcig dang gnyis gsum sogs gnas thub pa byung ba de rnams rten dman pa dud 'gro yin kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i smon lam dang*/

thugs bskyed kyi stobs kyis gdul byar gyur pa las thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam yang dag par zhugs pa ni bdag cag rnams kyi mngon sum 'dren byed kyi spyod yul du gyur bzhin pa 'di'o//de nas shing 'brug lor kun gzigs zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che bar lam gser khri mnga' gsol mi chog pa gzhung gis bkas bcad yod kyang*/ 7gong sa spyi nor chen pos mnga' gsol khri bkod dgos pa'i bka' slob dang 'brel gser khrir mnga' gsol gyis mtshon mtshan gnas slar gso zhu rgyur thugs gtan khel nas/ zla 3 tshes 3 nyin stobs dga' dang lhan du rda sar 7gong sa chen po'i mdun/ sngar lam bzhin dbu skra gtsug phud 'bul bar phebs thon gnang*/ de nas skyabs mgon 'brug chen rin po che'i ngos 'dzin brtag yig tu/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las dbyar rnga pa//snyan grags nam mkha'i mu khyud brgal ba'i mgon//gang de'i sprul pa'i zla zhal srid pa 'dir//'char ba'i gnas sogs mtshan la 'di ltar mthong*//'phags yul ljongs kyi bye brag ku li'i char//bde stong mi 'gyur tsan+d+ra'i khams kyi rgyun//dbang gsum ye shes rig ma'i lter rol na//lhan skyes 'bras bu khams drug 'dzum dang bcas//rnam dag gtsang ma'i rigs su lhums bzung 'gyur//zhes zhabs rim bsgrub sgo bcas gnang*/ yang bde chen chos dgon yongs 'dzin rin po che'i ngos 'dzin brtag yig la/ e waṃ lhan skyes gzhi yi chos nyid las//'gag med nā da'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i zla//ka dag don gnyis spungs pa'i ljongs kyi char//snang ba thabs kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i sgra//stong pa shes rab chu skyes pad+mas mtshan//sras mchog sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i 'phrul//dgung rtags bcu gnyis lo yi thog ma 'dzin//thal byung dgongs pa dam pa'i rtags can du//a 'thas rang snang dbyings su 'char ba'i 'od//dam pa gang de'i skye sprul 'khrul med yin//zhabs rim bcas gzhan yang 'dzi sgar mchog sprul rin po che'i brtag yig 'di ltar/

lho ljongs gu ru'i zhing gi bye brag tu//spa zhes grags pa'i phun tshogs ljongs kyi char//thabs mchog blo gros shes rab mtsho mo zhes//khyim bdag 'byor 'bring khyi'u glang lo pa//a 'thas 'khrul pa'i snang ba der 'char bas//sna sel yig brgya sogs zhabs rim bcas bstsal/ yang sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i yang srid brtag yig tu/ bstan pa'i dpal gcig grub chen birba pa//'gro phyir bsam bzhin rnam 'phrul mdan ma grub//mchog gi phrin las gcig bsdus sprul pa'i gar//'di nas shar phyogs lho ljongs chos kyi zhing*//spa gro ma hā gu ru grub pa'i gnas//khyim bdag 'byor dman rigs rus gtsang ldan pa//pha ming nyi ma'i gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i ming*//ma ming chos kyi ming can zung 'gros kyis//khyi'u 'brug lo tshad ma mchog sprul nyid//phrin las sprul pa sgrub bstan gsal ba'i dpal//don brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba'i brgyud 'dzin cing*//mkha' khyab gdul zhing smin cing grol bar smon//zhabs rim bcas bstsal zhing brtag yig tu ji ltar gsal ba bzhin mchog sprul nges rnyed byung ba sha stag go /zla 4 tshes 13 nyin kun gzigs zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku gser khrir mnga' gsol gnang*/ de nas bstan dgon gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las phal mo che mjug 'khyongs kyis me sbrul lo mjug tu gtsug lag khang dang*/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba khor yug bcas legs par grub ste/ bod nas sku ngal khyad bsad kyis gdan zhu gnang ba'i sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba rnams gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ lha mi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog bla na med par grub par mdzad/ de nas zla 1 tshes 1 dgung gsar rten 'brel dang 'brel/ rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis dbus dge 'dun 'khor bcas gdan sa gsar par zhabs sor bkod/ de nas bzung dge 'dun pa rnams 'dul ba'i lung ltar bca' ba chos kyi khrims bsdams zla ngo re bzhin sgrub mchod dus mchod sogs gang 'os bsgrigs gnang ba/

zla ba dang po tshes sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor nyin bdun/ zla ba gnyis pa sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang*/ tshe ring ma bcas bdun sgrub/ zla ba gsum pa la/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ zla ba bzhi pa sngar srol bzhin tshes bcu le'u brgyad pa dang*/ mchog gling gter 'byin phur pa'i sgrub chen res mos kyis spros bcas gar 'cham sogs ltad mo'i rnam 'gyur tsam ma yin pa sbyor dngos rjes gtsang gis phyag bzhes ji bzhin gnang*/ zla ba lnga pa 'khor lo bde mchog bdun sgrub/ zla ba drug pa zhi byed gcod kyi tshogs 'khor dang*/ dbyar khas bzhes skabs/ gzhung rig rgyud sde sogs kyi 'chad nyan sogs chos kyi bgro gleng gis dus 'da' ba yis mtshan thos dag skabs rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis dbus pas dge 'dun rnams rang rang gi shes tshad dang*/ sbyangs rtags kyis tshogs bshad 'bel gtam gyis dus bkang ngo*//zla ba brgyad par bka' brgyud mgur mtsho dang*/ chos spyod rab gsal/ zla ba dgu par spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ kar gling zhi khro bcas/ zla ba bcu par kun rig rnam grol sgo chen/ zla ba bcu gcig pa mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor zlog nyin bdun/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa mgon po ber can gyi dus gtor bdun sgrub la spros bcas gar 'chams bcas zla ngo re bzhin yar mar gyi gso sbyong*/ tshes bcu nyer lnga/ lo dus sgrub mchod chad med/ mgon khang chen mor dge slong bzhi sde/ gro lod dang tshe ring ma'i mgon khang gsar 'dzugs dang 'brel bstan 'gro spyi'i bde thabs dang*/ lhag par bod ljongs bstan pa chab srid bcas la sman phyir bskang rgyun chad med rgyun bsring btsugs gnang mdzad do/ /dus rgyun rgyal ba yab sras bla sprul na gzhon rnams kyis rig gnas mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams la gsan bsam rgyun mthud/ bshad rgyugs dang brgal brtag rtsod gleng*/ dge 'dun pa che chung kun nas 'bri klog

/rgyud sde'i cho ga bcu gnyis blor 'dzin/ thig rdul tshon gtor bzo dkar rgyan/ gdangs dbyangs 'bud dkrol sogs bstan pa'i snying po lung rtogs gnyis kyi gzhi rkang tshugs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang sku rten/ ston mchog don kun grub pa'i snang brnyan stong sku khru sor bcu gnyis pa gzungs zhugs tshad ldan/ rab gnas kyi ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bstims pa'i mchod sdong chen po la rin chen dang po'i na bza' phul cing*/ rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis phyag bstar mdzad pa'i sku so so las ring bsrel byon pa der 'dus kun gyis mthong bas shin tu byin can no//gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che sde dge mtshal par/ bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma spus ldan de 'grel/ rin chen gter mdzod sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab dpe mdzod/ par brko ba rnams la rgyun rko 'jug pas gsung rab nyams gso spar khang bskrun pa dang*/ de bzhin bka' brgyud gser phreng dang*/ yi dam/ chos skyong sogs rtsa gsum rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zhal thang*/ bzang gos sna tshogs las grub pa'i spyan gzigs/ 'chams gos sogs kyi yo byad gsar rnying ci rigs/ zhi drag gi zhal 'bag /phod ka /zhwa nag /phyag mtshan bcas rang 'grig /gser dngul gyi mchod chas spus legs gsar rnying bcas mdor na rten dang brten pa phyi nang gnyis mtshungs dper 'os pa gsar du bskrun pa bcas mthong chos su grub pa ltar ro//bdun pa rgya gar bal yul/ 'bras ljongs/ 'brug yul bcas la mchod yon 'brel ba'i sgo nas bshad sgrub 'dzin pa'i gdan sa gsar bskrun gnang ba'i skabs ni/me lug lor/ la dwags mi mang spyi mgrin nas gdan zhu phul ba bzhin zla 5 tshes 12 nyin gdan sa rum bteg nas chibs bsgyur gyis/ dhi li dang can rdi sgar brgyud tshes 17 nyin la dwags rgyal sa sle la phebs/ rgyal sras ba ku la rin po che dang*/

la dwags rtogs ldan rin po che sogs mjal phrad gnang zhing*/ sler 'khod pa'i mi dmangs yongs la dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron dang dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas hi mi stag tshang dgon/ g.yung drung dgon/ khregs rtse dgon sogs la rim phebs kyis la dwags yul mi spyi dang*/ btsan byol bod mi bcas par rang rang 'dod chos kyis 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ rim par la dwags byang brgyud du sgrub dpon bde chen tshe dbang rin po che mjal bcar zhus par/ bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa gsar bzhengs gnang dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang ba la brten/ phyis su dgon pa gnyis dang*/ btsun dgon gcig bcas gsar bzhengs gnang zhing*/ de yang phyi nang gnyis 'dzoms bstan par smin nges byung*/ de bzhin bla ma 'chi med rdo rje la'ang*/ la dwags sler dgon pa bzhengs dgos tshul bka' 'brel ltar/ dgon pa rten dang brten par bcas pa phyag btab par mdzad do//de nas tshes 21 la la dwags nas chibs bteg /can rdi sgar brgyud/ rda ram sa lar 7gong sa chen po mchog dbus/ skyabs rje yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis bcas mjal phrad gnang*/ de nas sbir gzhis/ ke la sha sogs la phebs/ zla 7 tshes 1 nyin khams sprul bzhugs gzhis su sprul sku gnyis dang*/ grwa pa bcu gsum la dge tshul sdom pa bstsal/ de nas ldi li la bstan don gal che 'ga'i ched phebs don grub nas ka tar brgyud/ rdor gling su na mdar bla ma ka lu'i sgrub sde dang*/ bya bral sangs rgyas rdo rje'i klong chen snying thig gi sgrub sde bcas la zhabs bkod/ sgrub sde yar rgyas dang*/ der gnas pa'i sgrub pa rnams nyams rtogs gong 'phel 'byung ba'i thugs smon byin 'bebs rab gnas bcas gnang*/ de nas su na mdar/ skyabs mgon 'brug chen rin po che mchog dang*/ khra legs skyabs mgon rnam gnyis dbus pas dge 'dun bcu phrag lhag par dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal zhing*/

tshes 24 nyin rang gdan du 7zhabs sor 'khod/ slar 'brug mnga' bdag chen po dang gzhung nas gdan zhus ltar/ zla 8 tshes 10 nyin lho ljongs su chibs bsgyur gnang*/ rgyal sa bkra shis chos gling*/ spa gro stag tshang bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du tshe sgrub bdun phrag gcig sku mtshams dam par bzhugs/ de nas skyid chur gnas gzigs dang 'brel/ lha khang gsar rnying rnams su rab gnas mdzad/ 'brug mnga' bdag chen po mchog nas rgyal bstan nyams chag gis rkyen pas skye 'gro'i bde thabs kho nar dmigs bstan pa'i me ro slar gso'i dgongs gzhi rlabs chen la brten/ 'brug rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje dang*/ ma yum phun tshogs chos sgron yum sras rnam gnyis nas bum thang bkra shis chos gling rdzong gzhis gnyis ka gtsang 'bul gnang*/ rim par gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs kyi 'gro song gnang 'char bcas/ slar gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod/ de skabs khams sprul rin po che mchog phebs bcar zhus shing*/ bde chos chos mgon yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu gnang la/ thol byung gis 'di ltar/ glang chen nor bu'i dal 'bab myur 'gro'i char//thabs mchog mgon po shes rab pad+mas mtshan//khyi'u lug lo rtags mtshan ldan pa zhig/ces sogs brtag yig bstsal/ lo mjug dus gtor skabs/ 'brug nas rgyal yum phun tshogs chos sgron dang*/ ma yum pad+ma bde chen gnyis ched phebs gnang bar dbang chos ci 'dod ltar bstsal/ sa sprel zla 2 tshes 1 nyin rje dbon dpon slob rin po che sku phreng bdun pa gser khrir mnga' gsol gnang*/ 'di'i yang srid ngos 'dzin/ yum legs bshad sgrol ma'i mngal du byis pa yod med skabs nas/ legs bshad kyi khog tu dpon slob rin po che'i yang srid yod ces mdzod pa dam chos yongs 'du dang*/ gsol zhabs rnams kyi go bar bka' gnang ba ltar 'khrungs pas/ da dung the tshom gyi dra ba gcod phyir 7gong sa chen po mchog la'ang brtag zhus 'khrul med yin par phebs pa dang*/

gzhan yang ya pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang*/ sku zla sras mo 'jim lags rnam gnyis mjal bcar byung skabs/ 'di'i mngal du zur mang gar dbang gi yang srid 'dug gsungs pa dang*/ sngon bod nas sga khra 'gu dgon gyi khra legs nyi ma 'gyur med kyi skye srid kyi brtag yig tu'ang*/ brtag yig gnang tshes shing rta zla 5 tshes 19 'khod cing*/ gsar lo zla 1 tshes 10 bar gsang rgya gyis/ de nas rtag yig kha phye nas 'tshol dgos gsungs pa bzhin/ dus thog la kha dbye zhing mjal te brtag pa'i dgongs babs 'di ltar/ khra legs nyi ma 'gyur med kyi skye srid/ dgon nas nub phyogs cang shes sa tshugs gsum tshun/ khyim bdag 'byor pa 'bring smad/ pha ming blo gros/ ma ming pad+ma/ gnyis kyi khyi'u lug lo pa rtags mtshan can zhig yod ngo shar/ zhabs rim bcas phebs pa bzhin btsal bas/ yab yum/ dgung rtags/ 'khrungs dus rtags mtshan can me lug zla 1 tshes 8 la sku bltams pa nor bu rang lag tu bzhag pa bzhin the tshom bral ba nges rnyed byung bas mtshon mngon mkhyen chags thogs dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes mi rnyed ka med du gyur pa lags so//gzhan yang grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes chen ngos 'dzin bskyang ba'i lo rgyus mang du mchis kyang*/ brtag yig gi sa bon yig cha bod du lus pas/ 'dir rgyas 'god ma thub pas bzod par gsol/ zla 6 tshes 22 nas mchog sprul rnams dang*/ dge 'dun pa spyir phyag chen rgya gzhung gi ljags lung gnang*/ slar yang 'brug rgyal blon rnams kyis gdan zhus ltar lho ljongs su chibs bsgyur nas/ thim phu dang spa gro la ched phebs/ mtha' 'dul skyid chu lha khang du sgrol dkar ljags bsnyen dang 'brel ba'i bcad rgyar bzhugs/ bkra shis chos gling gi gdan sa gsar bzhengs kyi shing cha sogs go sgrig gnang*/ spa gro dang*/ thim phu bcas kyi dge 'dun par mang 'gyed sogs zhabs tog bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa gnang rjes/

rang gdan du zhabs sor bkod/ de nas ka tar/ ldi li bcas la 'khyug skor phebs shing dad ldan dngos mjal rnams chos dbang gis smin par mdzad/ sa bya lor zla 4 tshes 19 nas brtsams/ bum thang bkra shis chos gling rten dgon dbu 'dzugs kyis dbyar gnas theng dang po gsar 'dzugs ched/ ri bar bag yod rin po che sogs bla grwa sum cu skor dang*/ rten bzhengs dbu 'dzugs kyi dbu 'doms ched mdzod pa dam chos yongs 'du mchog dbus/ gnyer drung las tshan bcas bstan pa dar rgyas yong ba'i thugs smon zab rgyas bcas ched mngags mdzad/ de'i zla ba gsum gyi rjes skyabs mchog yab sras rnams kyang thim phur chos rgyal mjal phrad du 'khyug skor phebs nas bum thang du rten bzhengs sar phebs/ sku tsha stobs dga' lags dang rgyal sras a zhe chos skyid zung gis gdan zhu ltar/ dbang 'dud chos gling du phebs shing*/ lho brag nam mkha'i snying po'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin dang*/ sku rjes lha khang du mchod sprin zab 'bul gnang ste/ bkra shis chos gling du slar phebs shing*/ gtsug lag gsar bzhengs gnang yul sa 'dul ched/ rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i bde mchog bdun sgrub gnang*/ de nas lha mo dpal gyi g.yang sgrub bcas mdzad rjes slar rum bteg tu zhabs sor bkod/ de nas bal yul nas bka' brgyud dgon spyis gdan zhus ltar phebs shing*/ mchod rten rin po che dang*/ zla bzang mchog sprul rin po ches gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gtsug lag khang la rab gnas dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags shing dgon skyabs mchog la phul nas dar rgyas yong ba bskul ltar sa bcu rin po che der bzhugs nas gzigs rtogs gnang dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang*/ gzhan yang kir rti dgon pa gsar bzhengs gnang sgo'i skor sogs bka' mngags/ spog ra nas bla ma sgrub seng dang*/ bod mi'i sdod sgar nas gdan zhus ltar rib tsam phebs shing bka' dbang*/ dbu sgron sogs kyis 'dod skong mdzad/

bla ma sgrub seng la rten dgon 'dzin skyong gong 'phel skor la bka' slob bcas/ phyir phebs bal yul brgyud rang gdan rum bteg tu phebs/ dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che nas skul ngor/ lcags khyi zla 1 tshes 13 la zhe chen rab 'byams kyi yang srid ngos 'dzin dang*/ chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol kyang mdzad/ 'di skabs 'bras ljongs grong gseb phal che bar srog gcod kyi mchod sbyin byed srol spangs shing*/ phyin chad de ltar mi bgyid pa'i dam bca' khas len bcug /de'i tshab tu skyabs rje mchog nas yul lha'am/ mi ma yin de rnams la dmar gsur bsngo ba'i yig cha dang 'brel byin rlabs mdzad pas phyis de bzhin srog gcod mi dgos pa byung*/ lcags phag zla 4 tshes 15 nyin kun gzigs zhwa dmar rin po cher bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal/ lcags phag lo zla 5 tshes 19 la mchog sprul rnam pas dbus bla grwa yongs rdzogs/ aḥyang sprul sku sogs byes 'byor bla grwa mang 'dzom bcas la/ rgya chen bka' mdzod kyi dbang lung cha tshang dang*/ rje dgu pas phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba gcig shes kun grol gyi dbang lung bcas bka' drin bstsal/ 'di skabs ma'i sor bod mi'i gzhis sgar du bka' brgyud dgon gsar bzhengs gnang dgos pa'i bka' mngags aḥyang rin po cher bstsal/ ke na ḍa nas dad mjal mi gcig brgya skor 'byor bar dbang chos bka' drin bskyangs shing*/ dge slong a ban+dha bo dhi zhes par theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa bstsal zhing*/ sngon smon stobs kyis bstan don la shin tu phan pa byung*/ drung ram rgyal sprul rin po che ngos 'dzin sngon bal yul nas gnang ba ltar khrir ston gnang*/ phi li spin gling phran nas sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'bo gangs dkar rin po che'i slob rgyun yin pa chos tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin zhig phebs bcar ngor/ bde mchog dang*/ dgyes rdor ma ha ma ya sogs dbang lung mang po zhus pa bzhin bka' drin bskyangs/

skyabs rje mchog zhe dgu'i dgung skeg steng phebs pa'i zhabs rim du/ yon dge'i sprul brgyud gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rjes bla grwa nyi shu nas gro lod yas zor gtor zlog rtags thon dang*/ bag yod rin po ches dbus bla grwa bcu nas gshin rje khro bcu dug gdong gi zlog pa bcas gnang*/ gzhan yang zhabs rim phyi nang gang sa nas sgrub/ 'brug rgyal sras seng ge dbang phyug mchog krong gsar dpon slob kyi go gnas bzhes pa'i mdzad ston la/ skyabs mchog gi sku tshab tu kun gzigs zhwa dmar rin po che dang*/ mdzod pa bcas ched mngags mdzad cing phebs don bde legs byung*/ de nas dgun dus sku phya'i zhabs brtan ched rgya gar gnas chen phal mo cher chibs bsgyur dang 'brel gnas so sor tshogs mchod dang mchod sprin zab 'bul gnang*/ de nas ka ta'i hi ma la ya nang pa'i chos tshogs kyi gtsug lag khang nyams gso gsar bskrun gnang rgyu'i bka' mol gnang*/ slar rum bteg gdan sar phebs/ chu glang zla 1 tshes 15 nyin byams mgon si tu rin po che/ 'jam mgon rin po che/ rgyal tshab rin po che bcas rnam pa gsum la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas bkra shis chos gling gi rten bzhengs phyag las 'phro skyong dang*/ 'brug rgyal bzhi pa 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug gis gdan zhu ltar thim phur phebs/ 'brug rgyal gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa'i mchod rten la rab gnas bstsal/ bkra shis chos gling du phebs shing dge 'dun pa bdun cu skor gyis dbyar zhal bzhes gnang*/ de bzhin 'brug rgyal mchog nas kyang rten bzhengs su rogs 'degs gang zab gnang*/ khra 'gu dgon gyi zur sprul ngos 'dzin dang khrir 'don mdzad/ rgyal yum phun tshogs chos sgron nas phul ba kang lung shes rab rtse'i lha khang 'dzin skyong du khra legs skyabs mgon dbus bla grwa bcu gnyis skor ched gtong mdzad cing bstan don gyi bya ba gang legs dgos pa'i bka' slob kyang gnang*/

de nas mar phebs zhor ka lu rin po ches gsar bzhengs mchod rten dang*/ sgrub sde gtsug lag khang rab gnas ched gdan zhus ltar phebs shing*/ ka lu rin po che mchog gi thugs bskyed rgya che zhing rnam par dag pa'i mdzad rjes la thugs mnyes bzhin du/ der yod phyi rgyal mi rigs rin po che'i zhal slob rnams la gsung chos byin rlabs bcas bstsal/ ka lu rin po che la bstan don ched yun 'tsho'i brtan bzhugs phul gnang mdzad/ de nas rang gdan du phebs/ 'brong pa mkhyen brtse rin po che/ bka' dbang dang*/ gdams ngag sogs zhu phyir sku bcar zhus/ dbang lung sogs phal cher grub nas bstan don gang zab kyi thugs bskyed mi zhum pa'i bka' slob kyang gnang ste/ gzhis dgon yar rgyas kyi ched rang gnas su gtong gnang mdzad/ rum bteg dgon gsar bzhengs kyi mgon khang du ma mgon mgar gsum gyi sku gsar bzhengs gnang rgyu'i mthun rkyen cha tshang bstsal ba dang*/ phyis gzungs gzhug rab gnas bcas bka' drin bskyangs/ spog ra'i kar dgon 'dzin skyong skor dang*/ mthun rkyen zhwa dag 'cham gos rang 'grigs kyis gang 'os gsol bstsal gnang*/ de nas shing stag lor bkra shis chos gling du bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs mdzad bzhed kyis lo rim 'dzin grwa'i 'char gzhi sgrigs 'dzugs dang*/ lhag par phyag dpe spar bskrun gnang rgyu'i phyag tho rim 'god mdzad/ zla 1 tshes 15 nyin skyabs rje yab sras ston 'khor rnams kyis/ rje dbon dpon slob rin po che dang*/ mnyan pa rin po che/ sgrub dpon rin po che bcas par rab byung gi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas zla 4 tshes 15 nas 'brug rgyal bzhi pa rgyal khrir phebs pa'i mnga' gsol gyi rten 'byung du 'khyug skor phebs/ rgyal srid kyi mdzad sgo'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar gsar du dbye bar mdzad nas/ skyabs mchog ston 'khor phyi rgyal du phebs rgyu'i pā se yang phul bzhes gnang ste/

bkra shis chos gling du bskyar phebs kyis mdzad sgo skabs der grub nas gdan sa rum bteg tu phebs so//brgyad pa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nub phyogs kyi yul gru rnams su spel ba'i phyir chibs zhal bsgyur nas phrin las bskyang ba'i skabs ni/ gter chen mchog 'gyur gling pa'i gter lung dus su babs pa lta bus/ zla 7 tshes 25 nyin chibs zhal nub phyogs yo rob dang*/ a mi ri ka'i gling du bsgyur ba'i thog mar/ lon ḍon brgyud a ri'i ni'u yog tu chos tshogs khag gis phebs bsu bcas zhabs sor 'khod cing*/ drung pa rin po ches gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dharma dha tu'i chos tshogs kyi 'du khang du dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron dang 'brel/ sgrol ma'i bka' dbang dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi ljags lung bcas bstsal zhing*/ yang sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi bskyal zin pa brgya lhag der/ grub chen karma pak+shi'i bla sgrub kyi bka' dbang bcas bka' drin bskyangs/ sku zhabs shan zhes pas bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i phyag dpe rnams spar bskrun zhu rgyu'i 'gan len zhus/ ko la ra ḍo'i chos tshogs kyis gdan zhus ltar phebs/ mi grangs lnga brgya lhag nas mjal phyag zhus shing*/ slar snod ldan pho mo lnga bcu skor la pak+shi bla sgrub bka' dbang gnang*/ stag gi rnga ma zhes pa'i sgom sgrub khang la phebs/ bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung ba dang*/ sgom sgrub byed mi rnams gegs dang gol sa sogs mi 'byung bar/ ting 'dzin rnam par dag pa rgyud la skyes shing*/ mthar 'bras sku gnyis zung 'jug gi go 'phang nges par thob pa'i thugs smon zab rgyas 'brel/ bstan rgyas smon lam dang*/ phyag chen smon lam bcas gsungs shing*/ de'i rten gtsor thub dbang sku brnyan dang*/ mgon po ber gyi thang ga bcas gnang*/ gsol bskang dang phrin bcol mdzad/ zhing chen bho kron gyi karma rdzong zhes pa'i chos tshogs su phebs shing*/

phyag chen gsol 'debs kyi ljags lung gnang*/ slar drung pa rin po ches dbus zhal slob nyis brgya tsam la mgon po ber gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dbyin rje'i mi rigs kyi dge tshul zhig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang*/ chos tshogs khongs kyi dad mi brgyad brgya skor la dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron gnang*/ yang drung pa'i zhal slob zhi gnas sgom mkhan nyis brgya tsam la pak+shi bla sgrub bka' dbang bstsal/ sgom grwa de rnams kyi shag tu rab gnas bcas bstsal nas/ yang rdo rje khyung rdzong zhes pa'i chos tshogs su mjal kha dang*/ chos 'brel gnang nas a ri'i glo pa'i mi rigs kyi yul gru khag gsum tsam du+u phebs/ de gar char pa gtan nas ma byung bar lo nyes yong nyer brten/ skyabs mchog la skyabs 'jug zhus pas de'i dgong mo nas bzung char pa shin tu legs pa babs pas yul mi rnams thun min gyi chos dad skye dgos pa byung*/ de nas ka li'i pho ni yar bka' brgyud chos tshogs dang*/ sa skya'i chos tshogs/ rnying ma'i chos tshogs bcas par ched phebs kyis chos 'brel/ dbang lung sogs re 'dod bzhin bskyangs*/ ke na ḍa'i sa gnas bhan ku bar phebs/ ka lu rin po che'i chos tshogs su phebs shing dbang lung chos 'brel gnang zhing*/ khro ran khror phebs/ slar sku zhabs shan zhes pas dgon pa gsar bzhengs zhu rgyu'i skor bka' bsdur gnang*/ rnam rgyal rin po che'i chos tshogs su dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron gnang zhing*/ yang rnying ma'i chos tshogs su dbu zhwa sgron mjal gnang zhing*/ rnam rgyal rin po che'i mchod rten gsar bzhengs kyi gzungs sgrub khrus gsol mdzad/ de bzhin sgom grwar thugs smon zab rgyas kyis karma phrin las chos tshogs kaṃ po gangs rar phebs nas sgrol ljang gi bka' dbang gnang*/ de nas mkha' lam brgyud/ ing lan byang phyogs si ko ling ḍir bsam yas gling du zhabs sor 'khod cing*/

tshogs khang du dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron dang 'brel/ mi la'i bla sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs gnang nas chos rje a dkon rin po che'i dbus der yod dad mi rnams dbang chos kyis tshim pa mdzad cing*/ slar lon ḍon du phebs/ sprul sku 'chi med chos tshogs su ston pa'i sku brnyan dang*/ phyag dpe sogs gsol ras gnang*/ de bzhin tha lan ḍi nang pa'i chos tshogs/ sing ga la nang pa'i chos tshogs bcas su phebs shing*/ mkha' lam brgyud nor wi dang*/ sud ḍan*/ ḍe mag /ho lan ḍi/ bhi 'jam bcas su phebs sa gnas so sor dad slob rnams kyi ngor dbu zhwa rin po che mjal sgron/ mi la/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs gang la gang 'dul bka' dbang dang*/ chos 'brel gnang zhing chos la bcug pa dang*/ thar pa'i lam sne zin pa nyams rtogs rgyud la skye ba sogs ci rigs 'byung ba'i sgo nas 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ pha ran sir bka' brgyud chos tshogs 'od gsal gling dang*/ yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi chos tshogs sogs su phebs rang mos chos don zab 'brel gnang*/ e ṭa lir phebs shing*/ rgyal sa rum du bkra shis chos kyi gling zhes pa'i chos tshogs gsar 'dzugs gnang*/ ye shu'i bla chen spog mchog mjal phrad dang 'brel/ slar pha ran sir phebs shing*/ sku zhabs bhan sen nas bstan dgon gsar bzhengs kyi ched du/ sa cha 'bul rgyu'i khas len zhus nas/ slar su tsa len ḍir sku gzugs brtag zhib dang 'brel/ der bod mi dang*/ phyi rgyal chos dad can gyi yul mi khag bcas par dbang chos gang la gang 'dul bstsal zhing*/ pha ran si la bstan dgon gsar bzhengs dang*/ ni'u yog tu bstan dgon gsar bzhengs kyi las 'gul dbu 'dzugs gnang ba po/ rje dbon dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog dang*/ shar sras bstan 'dzin chos nyi gnyis la bskos bzhag gis ched btang mdzad/ slar ldi li'i gnam gru brgyud ldi lir phebs/ 'brel yod khag la bcar grub rjes sku 'khor lhan rgyas gegs med kyis rang gdan du 7zhabs zung bkra shis kyi re kha bkod par mdzad do//sa yos lor sgrub dpon bde chen rin po ches bskul ba bzhin/

si tu rin po che ston 'khor bstan don bka' bslab dang 'brel la dwags su phebs dgos pa'i bka' bzhin bteg par mdzad cing*/ sgrub dpon bde chen rin po che dang*/ bla ma 'chi med rdo rje gnyis la la dwags phyogs bstan pa dar rgyas btang dgos pa'i bka' slob dang*/ sngar phyag rjes gang legs byung ba'i gzeng bstod dang 'brel/ rten gtso byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar ba dang mchod chas gya nom pa bcas gsol ras bstsal zhing*/ la dwags so so'i gzhis dgon du mngags/ de nas a ri dang*/ pha ran sir phebs rgyu'i dge slong drug la/ shes tshad lag khyer dang*/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten mchod chas bcas bskur gnang thog ched mngags gnang*/ de nas rdor gling du e sha ya yi chos tshogs khang*/ hi ma la ya'i nang chos yar rgyas kyi tshogs 'dur gdan zhus ltar ched phebs dang 'brel/ chos don skor lag len nges par dgos pa'i dgongs 'char lhug por bstsal zhing*/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog mjal phrad zhib lhod dang 'brel/ phan tshun thugs dam gcig 'dris las gnyis su med pa ltar dgyes mnyes mdzad/ slar gdan sar zhabs sor bkod/ sku zhabs shan nas sbyin bdag zhal bzhes ltar ldi lir bka' brgyud kyi yig cha mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams spar bskrun gnang bzhin pa dang*/ skyabs mchog sku sger nas gson gshin gyi skyabs bsngo phul ba rnams zur 'jog gis/ ched dmigs dge rtsa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nub pa'i nyi ma slar yang 'char ba bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa'i thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' zhum pa med pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis zhal bkod gnang ba'i sde dge'i mtshal par thog spar bskrun gnang ba'i las byed 'gro gron bcas ched gtong gnang ba sogs 'gro ba yongs kyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i thugs bskyed zab cing rgya che ba'i phrin las bskyang bzhin du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'o//slar smras pa/

phyag gi 'os gyur mgon po gang de'i spyan snga ru//grangs med sprul nas smra ba mkhas pa dang 'grogs te//yon tan phung po gtam du gleng bas 'khur lci bas//yan lag lnga yang dub pas sa la ngal gso bzhin//tshul 'di thog mar mngon par rtsom pa'i g.yar dam gyis//bar du lhag bsam dag pas brtson pa rab brtan te//mtha' ma legs par pha rol phyin la dgyes pa'i 'dzum//brgya phrag grol ba las byung dge ba dkar po yis//khrag gis g.yos pas mig bsgyur smin ma rab bcus nas//rno mtshon mi bzod 'phen bzhin 'debs pa'i tshegs sgra dang*//gsod rgyob nga ro drag pos gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yang*//dog por bgyid pa'i 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi gyur cig/de bzhin 'gro ba kun kyang yang dag lta la gzhol//rang dbang dpal gyis chog shes 'thung la rab dga' bas//mdza' gcugs byams pa'i yon tan bzhin la 'khyud mthong nas//rus pa'i ge sar dga' ba'i dgod la bsti gyur cig/thams cad kyang ni tshe rabs kun tu skye ba'i shing*//dal ba 'byor ba'i yal ga ma tshang med rdzogs nas//thos dang bsam pa sgom pa'i lo 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod//yon tan 'bras bu g.yur du za bas mdzes gyur cig/

ces pa'ang gdan sa nas rgya gar phyogs phebs thon skabs/ rten 'brel bzang po'i mtshan ma dang bcas zhabs zhur bcar ba'i shar sras bstan 'dzin chos nyi mchog nas/ a ri'i rgyal sa ni'u yog nas phyag bris lan gsum du bstsal ba'i sgo nas bskul ma gnang bar brten/ rang ngos nas yon tan pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar phra na'ang*/ mgon po gang gi thugs rjes lcags kyus 'dzin pa'i gdul byar drangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad par dgung grangs bcu gsum par me pho byi ba'i lor/ pha ming kun dga'am tshe 'phel/ ma ming skal bzang ngam sgron ma'i ming can du ngos 'dzin gnang nas sprul pa'i skur dbugs dbyung bstsal ba/ nye bar gnas pa kun gyis khra 'gu bar 'bod pas skyabs mchog gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan rjes su dran te gsar du bris shing*/ de skabs mgon po gang gi smyug 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal nas yig 'bri'i 'bad rtsol gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ 'di ltar bris pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu yis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /de yang rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po la sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa dang*/ phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod par brten/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar sde tshan gsum dang ldan pa zhig bris zhes/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i mdzod 'chang zhang 'gu a gro rin po che nas gsung bskul gnang ba bzhin/ rtsom sgrig zhu 'dun mchis rung*/ bar lam bstan don yin rlom gyis las brel dang*/ le lo'i dbang du shor nas mthar phyin pa zhig ma byung bar brten/ kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar zhal bskang ched du snga mo rgyal dbang mchog zhal bzhugs shing*/ rang nyid zhabs zhur sku bcar zhu skabs su bris pa/ thun mong gi mthun snang la yongs su grags pa tsam las/ thun min sku'i che ba'i yon tan bsgrags na de tsam thugs mnyes po mi gnang bar brten/
